title: Horticulturist II Formal Garden & Conservatories
description:
New England Botanic Garden is committed to connecting people with plants, fostering environmental stewardship, and creating meaningful experiences that inspire our community through horticulture, education, and nature. The Horticulturist II is a hands-on supervisory position tasked with the care and maintenance of New England Botanic Garden’s Conservatories and associated outdoor garden spaces. The Horticulturist II works collaboratively across departments to execute exhibitions and programs in the conservatories and gardens while maintaining NEBG’s horticultural standards and ensuring safe and enjoyable experiences for visitors.

Responsibilities

  • Work within the Formal Gardens team, under the direction of the Formal Gardens Manager, to maintain conservatories and assigned garden areas to high standards established by the Director of Horticulture with an emphasis on sustainability and aesthetics.
  • The position leads maintenance of the following spaces: Orangerie, Limonaia, Winter Garden, Court, and growing houses.
  • Supervise two full-time year-round Gardeners, temporary gardeners, seasonal interns, and volunteers.
  • Works collaboratively with staff within the Horticulture Department and other departments to plan and implement seasonal exhibitions and special events, including but not limited to the annual Orchid Exhibition
  • Coordinates annual Conservatory Move-In and Move-Out with all staff and events schedule.
  • Works with other Horticulture staff to manage, maintain, organize, and stock back-of-house spaces including the Potting Shed, Growing House (including the lift), Pit Hallway, Pit House, and Propagation House.
  • Assists Horticulture staff to overwinter plant material in back-of-house horticulture areas
  • Participate in hiring and performance reviews for direct reports.
  • Design and install seasonal plantings and light displays in assigned garden areas directed by the Formal Gardens Manager.
  • Perform and directs others to complete horticultural tasks including but not limited to weeding, planting, mulching, pruning, deadheading, fertilizing, watering, repotting, and pest management.
  • Operate and maintains power tools, lifts, vehicles, and other equipment.
  • Lead volunteers to carry out regular maintenance of conservatory collection and gardens.
  • Support exhibitions and special events as directed.
  • Support snow removal operations; with training, safely operate snowblowers, salt spreaders, and other snow removal tools and equipment as directed. Weekend and holiday work is required on a rotational on-call basis.
  • Be welcoming to all staff and the public
  • Be respectful of staff differences and preferences
  • Use gender neutral communication styles
  • Respect everyone’s pronouns
  • Attend IDEA workshops and training sessions
  • Work with an awareness of surroundings in accordance with NEBG safety policies.
  • Comply with provisions of the current Employee Handbook, all published personnel policies, and the requirements of the job description.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Schedule

  • The Horticulturist II position is non-exempt. The standard work schedule for this position is five days per week, Monday through Friday, from 7:00 am – 3:30 pm with an unpaid 30-minute lunch.
  • The schedule may be flexible to accommodate the organization's needs. Occasional shifts in schedule will occur for the following events:
    • The Horticulturist II coordinates their own schedule and the conservatory team schedule for weekend/holiday/vacation coverage to ensure 365 day continuous plant care.
    • Evening hours around the Night Lights event in November, December and beginning of January. Three nights minimum are expected for this event.
    • As part of the essential staff, there is the expectation of snow removal assistance as part of a larger team effort. The Horticulturist II will be expected to report to assist with snow removal efforts on a rotational scheduled weekend coverage roster.

Physical Demands / Working Conditions

  • Must be able to lift 50 pounds repeatedly and work outdoors in all seasonal extremes (Rain, snow, heat, cold).
  • Effective communication skills and willingness to interact with the public.
  • Must be able to bend, squat, kneel, stand, and walk for extended periods of time and to navigate uneven grounds and stairs evenly.
  • Poison ivy, ticks, mosquitoes, bees, and other stinging insects will be encountered on the property. Training and personal protective equipment will be provided.
  • Must be able to comfortably and safely work at heights on ladders and lifts with training.
  • Must be able to effectively use standard office technology and software.
  • Must be able to safely work with appropriate hand and power tools. (Handheld blowers, string trimmers, snowblowers, utility carts).

Note: Duties described above, other duties and physical demands have been identified as essential functions as required by the Americans with Disabilities Act.

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:

You should be comfortable working with clients, solving complex problems, and delivering practical automation solutions beyond traditional machine learning approaches.

    • 4+ years of experience in automation engineering, software development, systems engineering, or related technical roles.
    • Strong experience with automation platforms such as n8n, Make.com, Zapier, or similar workflow automation tools.
    • Experience designing and maintaining microservices in cloud environments such as AWS or Azure.
    • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and technologies supporting AI integrations.

    • Experience working with low-code/no-code platforms for rapid solution deployment.
    • Ability to design automation solutions that integrate multiple systems and business processes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a practical approach to technology challenges.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with professional fluency in English.
    • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within agile or startup-style teams.

title: Sales Operations Program Manager
description:
LightEdge Solutions is developing the IT solutions that will propel businesses forward over the next 10 years. Using a combination of shared and private/dedicated platforms, LightEdge has been successful in offering businesses alternatives that streamline operations, improve reliability and reduce costs.
If you are passionate about creating real solutions that help businesses with cutting-edge technology, want to be challenged to think out of the box and be in a position where you can impact change on a daily basis, then LightEdge can offer you a dynamic corporate environment built on teamwork and personal responsibility.

Lightedge is seeking a Sales Operations Program Manager to drive the operational rhythms, process governance, and execution framework that enable consistent sales performance across the organization. This role serves as the operational bridge between Sales Leadership, Sales Operations, Customer Experience, Learning & Development, and IT by transforming strategic direction into repeatable processes, disciplined operating cadences, and scalable sales programs.

The Sales Operations Program Manager owns the day-to-day execution of sales processes, Salesforce governance, sales program administration, and tool adoption. This role focuses on ensuring sales teams operate within standardized processes, continuously identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, adoption, and execution while supporting the company's growth objectives.

Responsibilities:

Sales Operating Cadence

  • Lead weekly forecast and pipeline review meetings with Sales and Customer Experience leaders, ensuring consistent execution of established operating rhythms.
  • Track, communicate, and drive completion of follow-up actions resulting from forecast and deal review meetings.
  • Monitor cadence effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve consistency, accountability, and execution across sales teams.

    • Sales Operations Program Management

    • Administer core Sales Operations programs, including territory management, lead routing, account assignments, enterprise deal support, executive sponsorship initiatives and more.
    • Monitor and escalate activities that break documented Rules of Engagement and work with sales management to communicate and resolve events.
    • Partner with Sales Operations and Enablement to identify areas to improve operational efficiency through automation and AI-enabled process improvements.

      • Salesforce Process Governance

      • Measure and maintain Salesforce quality standards, including opportunity stages, forecast categories, aligned to exit/entry requirements.
      • Monitor process compliance and identify recurring adoption or data quality issues.
      • Collaborate with Sales Enablement to identify training needs resulting from process changes or performance gaps.

        • Sales Process Improvement Support

        • Support adoption of sales technology platforms, including Salesforce, CPQ, ZoomInfo, Momentum.io, and other sales enablement tools.
        • Develop and maintain sales process documentation, ensuring workflows remain current and aligned across the organization.
        • Identify process gaps and recommend scalable solutions to improve organizational performance.

          • Cross-Functional Partnership

          • Collaborate with Sales Leadership, Customer Experience, Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, IT, and Channel teams to improve sales execution and operational consistency.
          • Support cross-functional initiatives that improve forecasting accuracy, sales productivity, customer retention, and enterprise opportunity management.

Education and Experience:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Sales, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or Program Management.
  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce CRM and sales process governance.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving Sales, Customer Success, IT, and Enablement.
  • Excellent organizational, project management, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify operational trends and recommend process improvements.

    • Preferred

    • Experience supporting enterprise technology or SaaS sales organizations.
    • Knowledge of CPQ, ZoomInfo, Momentum.io, or similar sales technologies.
    • Experience with sales forecasting, pipeline management, and revenue operations processes.
    • Familiarity with AI-enabled workflow automation and process optimization.

Success Measures:

Success in this role will be measured by the effectiveness and adoption of the organization's sales operating system, including:

  • Consistent execution of forecast and sales operating cadences.
  • Timely completion of action items resulting from forecast and deal review meetings.
  • Increased adoption of standardized Salesforce processes and sales workflows.
  • Improved data quality and CRM process compliance.
  • Successful administration of Sales Operations programs and enterprise deal governance.
  • Increased adoption and utilization of sales tools and technology.

With over 20 years in business, LightEdge offers a full stack of best-in-class IT services delivering flexibility, security, and control. Our solutions include premier colocation across seven purpose-built data centers spanning Des Moines, IA, Kansas City, MO, Omaha, NE, Austin, TX, and Raleigh, NC, industry-leading private Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and cloud platforms, and the top global security and compliance measures. Our owned and operated facilities, integrated DR solutions, and premium compliant cloud choices make up a true Hybrid Cloud Solution Center. LightEdge annually undergoes third-party audits for ISO 20000-1, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI-DSS 3.2, and SSAE 18 SOC 1 Type II, SOC 2 Type II and SOC 3.

title: RN Staff - Labor & Delivery - PT - 1st Shift
description:
Overview

Labor & Delivery at Huntsville Hospital for Women and Children is proud to be the highest delivering hospital in the state of Alabama as well as the regional referral center for North Alabama and southern Tennessee. We have 20 Labor Rooms, 3 dedicated OR suites as well as a newly renovated PACU. We have an 11 bed high risk Antepartum unit as well as the first Obstetric Emergency Department in the state of Alabama managed by our team of board certified OB/GYN Hospitalists. We collaborate with many disciplines including our Maternal Fetal Medicine physicians to care for a variety of patients along the obstetric spectrum from managing any complication or condition during pregnancy like preeclampsia and gestational diabetes to providing care and support to a mother while laboring and giving birth.

The L&D RN is skilled in caring for pregnant patients during labor, obstetrical emergencies and other obstetric conditions. In addition to assisting women throughout labor and the birthing process, the L&D RN is an active role in cesarean section deliveries as the patient’s circulating nurse as well as the scrub nurse that assists the physician with the birth of the infant and the repair of the mother. They provide incredible patient support, critical nursing care and comprehensive pregnancy and postpartum education.

The RN is accountable for outcomes of patient care delivered during the assigned shift, and strives to provide clinical and service excellence. The RN identifies patient needs and priorities for care through assessment. The RN plans and delegates care based on patient needs. The RN evaluates the patient's response to care and the attainment of or progress toward expected outcomes. The RN is accountable for outcomes of patient care delivered during the assigned shift.

Qualifications

Education: Graduate of state board School of Nursing with current Alabama or multi-state licensure

Experience: Experience preferred; new graduates accepted.

Additional Skill/Abilities: BLS required before the conclusion of the orientation period.

About Us

Highlights of our hospitals

Huntsville Hospital was recently named Best Regional Hospital and #2 in Alabama by U.S. News & World Report. With 971 beds, a specialized Orthopedic & Spine Tower, a Level III Regional Neonatal ICU, and the largest Emergency Department and Level 1 Trauma Center in the state with our own specialized Red Shirt Trauma Program, there are many opportunities to apply your knowledge and skills. We are a certified Primary Stroke Center and named "One of the Top 100 Hospitals in the Nation with Great Heart Programs." From six cath labs and four EP labs to multiple medical and step-down units, you can continually grow your skillset! We offer a training center on campus for continuing education, Shared Governance Program, Clinical Ladder for professional development, The Daisy Award, and if you are a new grad, a Nurse Residency Program to help you transition from student to professional nurse. We care about you and your well-being by offering an excellent benefits package, childcare, health and wellness programs, an onsite employee pharmacy, a free health clinic, tuition assistance, and much more. We are committed to creating a diverse environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are a partner to the U.S. Army’s Partnership for Your Success (PaYS) program. Ask us about incentives and additional opportunities.

Huntsville Hospital Benefits:

We are committed to providing competitive benefits. Our benefits package for eligible employees includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, flexible spending; short term and long term disability; several retirement account options with 401K organization match; nurse residency program; tuition assistance; student loan reimbursement; On-site training and education opportunities; Employee Discounts to phone providers, local restaurants, tickets to shows, apartment application and much more!

Learn more about Huntsville Hospital Health System:

  • Careers: https://careers.hhsys.org/careers-home
  • Benefits: https://careers.hhsys.org/us/en/benefits
  • Education & Professional Development: https://www.huntsvillehospital.org/education
  • Life In Huntsville: https://www.huntsvillehospital.org/about-huntsville-al

title: Enterprise Security Engineer
description:
The Enterprise Security Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining secure enterprise infrastructure across both on-premises and cloud environments. This role establishes security architecture standards, governs identity and access management systems, and ensures segmentation between internal corporate systems and cloud platforms. The engineer will bring deep expertise in enterprise security technologies, cloud security (Azure, GCP), and modern detection/monitoring platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel and CrowdStrike premises and cloud environments.

ESSENTIAL TASKS

Enterprise Security Architecture:

  • Support the design and maintenance of secure network architectures through the provision of recommendations and best practices for segmentation, firewall policies, and access control standards across corporate back-office infrastructure
  • Establish and maintain enterprise security baselines, system hardening standards, and configuration management policies aligned to industry frameworks
  • Lead security architecture reviews for new and existing systems and provide guidance to engineering teams on secure design principles

Cloud Security (Azure & GCP):

  • Design, implement, and maintain cloud security controls in Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS including network security groups, service accounts, workload identity federation, logging, and cloud-native security tooling
  • Support secure integration and connectivity between on-premises environments and cloud-hosted applications and infrastructure
  • Apply cloud hardening standards, ensure proper encryption configurations, and enforce secure deployment patterns.
  • Contribute to cloud security initiatives by applying security best practices for Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) and supporting the organization’s transition from Windows-based environments to modernized cloud-native deployments
  • Develop and implement secure configurations for Cloud SQL in alignment with evolving cloud database security standards

Security Infrastructure & Tooling:

  • Configure, maintain, and develop SIEM and security monitoring technologies including Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike Falcon, and other endpoint, log analytics, or detection platforms
  • Develop and maintain detection rules, alert logic, and automated workflows to strengthen enterprise security posture
  • Manage PKI and security certificates, including lifecycle management, renewal processes, and deployment automation

Infrastructure Security:

  • Conduct infrastructure security assessments across servers, networks, applications, and cloud environments to identify vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
  • Remediate or coordinate remediation of identified issues in collaboration with infrastructure, engineering, and cloud teams.
  • Design and implement secure data handling standards, encryption policies, and key management practices.

AI Utilization:

  • Leverage AI-enabled tools and analytics to enhance decision-making, improve efficiency, and drive measurable business outcomes when appropriate.
  • Apply sound judgment and ethical standards when using AI, ensuring accuracy, data privacy, and responsible human-in-the-loop oversight.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years in enterprise security engineering, infrastructure security, or a systems engineering role with strong security responsibilities
  • Experience designing and securing corporate back office and hybrid cloud environments
  • Expertise with major cloud platforms, particularly Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and cloud-native security features
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike Falcon, or other SIEM/XDR/EDR technologies. Demonstrated fluency in Kusto Query Language (KQL) and Falcon Query Language (FQL)
  • Strong understanding of identity and access management, including Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID, IAM policies, SSO, MFA, and PAM solutions
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools and automation scripting using PowerShell or Python
  • Strong knowledge of networking, encryption, certificates, and security protocols
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams

The pay range for this position is $83,000-$95,000/year; however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, geographic location, skills, and experience. This position is eligible for an annual bonus in addition to a full range of benefits. This information is provided per the relevant state and local pay transparency laws for the location in which this position will be performed.

Benefits

Medical Insurance, Life Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, PTO, Paid Parental Leave, Paid Holidays, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, 401K, Educational Assistance

Please Note: Jenzabar does not sponsor applicants for work visas.

Job applicants are advised that Jenzabar reserves the right to monitor, access, review, and disclose electronic activity conducted on Company‑owned devices, networks, and systems, as well as activity involving Jenzabar applications or accounts accessed on personal devices. Monitoring may include email, messaging, internet usage, files, applications, and other electronic communications or data, and is performed for security, compliance, and operational purposes.

title: Pædagoger til Nøddebo børnehave
description:
To pædagoger søges til Nøddebo Børnehave.

35 timer ugentligt – med mulighed for flere eller færre timer efter aftale

Vil du være en del af en lille børnehave med store ambitioner for børns trivsel, udvikling og fællesskaber?

Så er det måske dig, vi søger til Nøddebo Børnehave i Solrød Strand.

Hvem er vi?

Nøddebo er en mindre børnehave med plads til 65 børn. Vores størrelse giver os mulighed for at skabe tætte professionelle relationer mellem børn, forældre og medarbejdere, og vi lægger vægt på nærvær, tryghed og at personalet i børnehøjde og byder ind med aktiviteter, der tilgodeser alle børn.

Vi er i en spændende udviklingsproces, hvor vi arbejder målrettet med at styrke vores pædagogiske praksis, vores samarbejde og de strukturer, der skaber de bedste rammer for børnene.

Du får en vigtig rolle i vores udvikling

Vi søger en pædagog, der har lyst til at tage ansvar, gå forrest og være en aktiv medspiller i udviklingen af vores hverdag og som er fagligt stolt og gerne vil vise retningen både sammen med leder, faste personale og vikarer.

Du skal kunne se muligheder i forandringer og have lyst til sammen med kolleger og ledelse at skabe tydelige strukturer, stærke børnefællesskaber og et professionelt samarbejdsmiljø.

Vi ønsker en medarbejder, som bidrager med faglig refleksion, initiativ og engagement, og som kan være med til at styrke samarbejdet omkring kerneopgaven – at skabe de bedste betingelser for børnenes trivsel, læring og udvikling.

Hvad kan vi tilbyde?

Hos os bliver du en del af et fagligt fællesskab med gode muligheder for sparring og udvikling.

Hos os får du en unik mulighed for, at være med til at præge fagligheden og en ny kultur.

Du får blandt andet et tæt samarbejde med:

  • Familiehuset i Solrød Kommune
  • Kommunens udviklingspædagoger
  • De omkringliggende skoler om børnenes overgange

Derudover står vi overfor implementeringen af Børnelinealen, som bliver et vigtigt fælles redskab i vores fortsatte arbejde med tidlig indsats, trivsel og udvikling.

Vi søger en pædagog, der:

  • Er uddannet pædagog
  • Har stærke relationskompetencer
  • Kan skabe struktur, overblik og tydelige rammer for børnene
  • Har mod på at gå forrest og tage ansvar i hverdagen
  • Bidrager positivt til samarbejde og fælles løsninger
  • Er fagligt nysgerrig og reflekterende
  • Ser værdien i tværfagligt samarbejde
  • Har fokus på både det enkelte barn og børnefællesskabet

Hos os får du:

  • En lille børnehave med korte beslutningsveje og stor indflydelse
  • Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på den pædagogiske udvikling
  • Engagerede samarbejdspartnere og tværfaglige netværk
  • En arbejdsplads, der ønsker udvikling og bevægelse
  • Glade børn og en meningsfuld hverdag, hvor du gør en forskel

Børnene siger du skal vælge Nøddebo børnehave fordi:

  • Vi har gode kaniner og høns.
  • Vi kører på cykler, gynger, rutcher og har klatrestativ.
  • Nogle gange leger vi vikinger
  • Vi laver bål
  • Kom til os, for vi er søde børn 😊

Stillingen er på 35 timer ugentligt med mulighed for både flere eller færre timer efter aftale.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig, hvis du har lyst til at være med til at udvikle Nøddebo Børnehave og skabe de bedste rammer for børn, forældre og kolleger.

Ansøgningsfrist: 23. aug. 2026

Tiltrædelse

Stillingen ønskes besat senest 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest muligt herefter.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og afholder samtaler løbende.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er omfattet af overenskomst mellem KL og BUPL.

Den forventede månedsløn ved fuldtidsansættelse ligger aktuelt i niveauet 31.000 – 39.000 kr. pr. måned ekskl. pension, afhængigt af erfaring, anciennitet og relevante kvalifikationer.

Derudover ydes pension og eventuelle kvalifikations- og funktionstillæg efter gældende overenskomst og lokale aftaler.

Har du spørgsmål, stort som småt, eller ønsker du at besøge os, inden du søger stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Dagtilbudsleder Heidi Hansen på telefon: 21136793


I Solrød Kommune gør vi en forskel sammen med borgerne. Vi arbejder for at virkeliggøre byrådets vision om, at Solrød skal være det bedste sted at leve og bo. Som arbejdsplads er vi et fællesskab, hvor vi løfter opgaverne på tværs af institutioner og afdelinger, og hvor du som medarbejder er en vigtig medspiller. Vi er i bevægelse og har hele tiden fokus på at lære og blive bedre. Vi tager ansvar for at løse opgaverne med blik for helheden, og du har som medarbejder indflydelse på løsningen af opgaverne og på din arbejdsplads.

title: Pega Developer
description:
We are looking for a Pegar developer in Mexico

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Pega Developer with at least 4 years of hands-on experience in designing and implementing enterprise applications using the Pegasystems platform (Pega PRPC / Pega Infinity). The ideal candidate will contribute to building scalable, high-performance solutions that streamline business processes and support digital transformation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement applications using Pega Platform aligned with business requirements.

  • Configure and manage case types, workflows, business rules, UI components, and data models.

  • Develop and maintain integrations with external systems using REST/SOAP services, APIs, and messaging frameworks.

title: Fullstack Software Engineer (TypeScript, C#, AWS) 12 month Maternity Cover
description:
Maternity Leave Cover - Fixed Term Employee for 12 months

Logistics: Hybrid - 2 days per week in our London HQ

Alto Software Group is a B2B SaaS company that powers more than half of all UK housing transactions each year. We create software solutions that connect businesses and consumers, delivering a one-stop shop for estate agents and home builders. Our goal is to drive efficiency, speed up transactions, reduce risk, and improve the end-customer experience.

Our platform is built on a proven C# and .NET foundation, and we're building what comes next on top of it. That means new frontier AI capabilities in TypeScript, sitting alongside a C# estate we're actively evolving for the next era. The interesting challenge isn't just being productive in both stacks, it's knowing when each is the right tool and keeping the whole system coherent as our product grows. If you are passionate about how software should be built and want to be in the room where those decisions get made, there's never been a better time to join us.

What You'll Do

  • Identify the right problems to solve across a dual-stack C# and TypeScript backend, being intentional about choosing the right tool for the job.
  • Implement microfrontend web applications in React and TypeScript, with an eye for component design and the UX implications of what you build.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of features from early design through to production. You're in the product conversation from the start, move fast from idea to working prototype to learn what's worth building, and see it through to delivery.
  • Work closely with our product team and engage customers to understand the problems worth solving, bringing that perspective back into how you design and build.
  • Work with AWS managed services including ECS/Fargate, Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB, and DocumentDB to build and evolve a scalable, event-driven architecture that performs under real load.
  • Use AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate delivery and embody a genuine shift in how you design, implement and review code
  • Set a high bar for craft and collaboration, from well-considered architecture decisions to clear pull requests, thorough testing, and feedback that levels up the people around you.
  • Help shape how we build, not just what we build. Exploring how AI can remove repetitive toil and tighten feedback loops so we spend our energy on the problems worth solving.

Our Technology Stack

We believe in using the right tool for the job. Our current stack includes:

  • Backend: TypeScript, Node.js, C#, .NET
  • Frontend: TypeScript, React
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS, DocumentDB, DynamoDB), Terraform, SST (Infrastructure as Code)
  • Architecture: Microservices, Microfrontends, Event-driven architecture

What You Need to Be Successful

  • A strong background in TypeScript and C# with experience building modern, production-grade APIs and distributed systems.
  • Proven experience with asynchronous, event-driven architecture and hands-on familiarity with AWS managed services including ECS/Fargate, Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB, and DocumentDB.
  • Real-world experience with AI coding agents and genuine opinions about where they help, where they fall short, and where things are heading.
  • You're actively experimenting with how agentic AI can remove friction from the software delivery lifecycle and create better product experiences.
  • You think like a product engineer, not just a software engineer. Driven by the value a feature creates rather than the mechanics of how it's built, and grounded in evidence to understand what customers actually need.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage work. You prototype to learn and get feedback, and you adapt quickly when the picture changes.
  • Pragmatic about trade-offs. You can balance speed and depth, manage technical debt strategically, and make the call on when good enough ships and when it needs more.
  • A collaborator who raises the bar around them, through clear communication, well-written proposals, actionable feedback, and a willingness to do the unglamorous work that keeps a codebase healthy.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you have a strong foundation in TypeScript or C# and everything above sounds like the way you already think, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits

  • Everyday Flex - greater flexibility over where and when you work
  • 25 days annual leave + extra days for years of service
  • Day off for volunteering & Digital detox day
  • Festive Closure - business closed for period between Christmas and New Year
  • Cycle to work and electric car schemes

  • Group Income Protection and private medical insurance
  • Gym on-site in London

  • Discretionary annual bonus up to 10% of base salary
  • Talent referral bonus up to £5K

We want to make ASG more welcoming, fair and representative every day. We’ll consider everyone who applies for this role in the same way, regardless of your ethnicity, colour, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, physical disability, neurodiversity status, family or parental status, or how long you’ve spent unemployed.

title: Resident Assistant-Mill Creek
description:
Resident Assistant Position Summary-Night Shift

Residents Assistants are an essential part of our wellness team by providing basic personal assistance to the residents in maintaining their highest level of functional independence and psychosocial wellness under the direction and supervision of a RN or LPN.

About American House

Start here, grow your career. American House offers paid training, clear advancement paths, and the chance to build a meaningful future in senior care—one resident at a time. American House Senior Living Communities has served Seniors for more than 40 years. Our Resident Assistants play a vital role in helping residents live with dignity, comfort, and independence.

Job Summary

As a Resident Assistant (RA) at American House, you will play a critical role supporting seniors, enriching their lives, and helping them live their best life. The meaningful relationships you develop will help you support the daily care needs of the residents and support community activities while creating a safe, warm and welcoming environment.---

What You’ll Do

· Assist residents with Activities of Daily Living (ADLs), including bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, and mobility.

· Monitor residents for changes in condition and report observations to leadership.

· Encourage resident engagement in activities, programs, and social events.

· Follow individualized care plans to ensure high-quality, person-centered care.

· Maintain a clean, safe, and organized environment in resident apartments and common areas.

· Support residents with meals, hydration, and light housekeeping.

· Build positive, respectful relationships with residents, families, and team members.

· Support new resident orientation and help them feel welcome in the community.

Qualifications

· A passion for serving seniors and a compassionate, patient approach.

· Ability to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

· Previous caregiving, senior living, or healthcare experience required.

· Ability to lift, push, or pull up to 25–50 lbs as needed for resident care.

What We Offer

· Competitive pay and shift differentials

· Paid training and ongoing development

· Opportunities for advancement (Medication Tech, Lead Caregiver, Supervisor roles)

· Supportive, mission-driven leadership

· A workplace culture centered on respect, teamwork, and hospitality

· Benefits available for eligible team members (medical, dental, vision, PTO, retirement options)

Why You’ll Love Working at American House

· Your work makes a real difference every day.

· You’ll be part of a welcoming team.

· You’ll help seniors live with purpose, comfort, and joy.

Apply Today

If you’re compassionate, dependable, and ready to make an impact, we’d love to meet you. Join the American House family and help us enrich the lives of those we serve.

Company Overview

Founded in 1979, American House Senior Living Communities’ vision is to provide high-quality housing for senior at a price affordable for retirees and their families. That vision of excellence has endured for nearly 40 years and expanded to serve residents at a number of senior housing communities. Our mission is to enrich the lives of those we serve, providing an environment that fosters meaningful relationships. Our vision is to be an innovative senior housing company that created sustainable excellence and stakeholder value, with an unparalleled commitment to passionate care provided by compassionate people.

title: Livstræet søger 2 pædagoger til faste stillinger.
description:
En pige ligger på gulvet og kigger på en ko. Hun siger en lyd. Pædagogen smiler til hende og gentager lyden. Med store, smilende øjne afsøger pigen pædagogens blik, før hun igen siger en lyd. Pædagogen kommenterer med flere lyde og ord, mens hun holder øjenkontakten. De smiler til hinanden.

I Tilst Dagtilbud samler vi på den slags betydningsfulde øjeblikke, der understøtter børnenes trygge tilknytning.

Du har nu en helt unik mulighed for at være med til at skabe disse rammer og fundamentet for børns trivsel, læring, udvikling og dannelse i Livstræet.

Vi er ambitiøse på børnenes vegne og har det enkelte barns trivsel og udvikling i centrum i alt, hvad vi foretager os. Vi søger hele tiden at give barnet de bedste muligheder for, at trives og udvikle sig et læringsmiljø hvor tryg tilknytning er fundamentet.

Nærvær, positive relationer, tryghed, tydelighed og anerkendelse, ved vi får det bedste frem i alle børn og vi arbejder professionelt ud fra et fælles barnesyn og stærke værdier.

Alle børn og forældre skal føle sig velkomne og mødes med varme og omsorg. Børn er noget ganske særligt i vores øjne.

Mangfoldighed ser vi som en styrke og tror på, at stærke fællesskaber og det at høre til, er centralt for børnenes udvikling og trivsel.

Vi er optaget af at udvikle vores faglighed løbende, således vores tilgang til kerneopgaven står på skuldrene af evidens og forskning. Vores pædagogiske afsæt er funderet i neuropsykologisk relationel pædagogik. Vi arbejder i hele Tilst dagtilbuddet med et aktionslæringsforløb, hvor arbejdet med - og implementeringen af - læreplanen er det fælles afsæt.

For at sikre at nye medarbejdere er klædt på til opgaven afholder vi løbende særlige læringsdage for nyansatte.

Vi brænder for at forfine vores pædagogiske miljøer og tilgang igennem refleksive dialoger med kollegaer og forældre.

Personalets mange og alsidige kompetencer bringes i spil på tværs af hele dagtilbuddet, vi arbejder ud fra præmissen –den, der har evnen, har ansvaret.

Vi er bevidste om, at vi stiller høje krav til dig som vores medarbejder, derfor vil vi gerne passe på dig.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Åbne døre til vores pædagogiske leder. Medarbejdere kan altid stille spørgsmål og søge sparring både på tværs af kollegaer men også ved den pædagogiske leder.
  • Mulighed for vejledning og sparring med dagtilbuddets pædagogiske vejleder.
  • En klar holdning til, at ”den der har evnen, har ansvaret”, hvilket i praksis betyder, at du har mulighed for at gøre det du er god til og som giver dig energi.
  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling.
  • ”Faglig fordybelses dag” med dagtilbuddets pædagogiske vejledere, som sikrer at nye medarbejdere får mulighed for at fordybe sig i dagtilbuddets faglige ståsted og værdier.
  • Kontinuerligt arbejde med en åben, nysgerrig og anerkendende omgangstone, som sikrer det gode samarbejde til børnenes bedste.
  • Plads til både den faste, forudsigelige struktur og skæve, spontane input som tager udgangspunkt i børnenes idéer eller de muligheder dagen bringer.
  • En holdning til, at så længe vi som voksne har børnenes perspektiv og vores faglighed forrest, kan næsten alt lade sig gøre.
  • Inspireres af at arbejde med et specialpædagogisk sigte.

Lidt mere om os:

Som pædagog i Livstræet er man en betydningsfuld del af et team, som i fællesskab tager ansvar for at løse opgaverne omkring at støtte alle børn i deres læring, udvikling og trivsel. Vores teams består af en god blanding af nyere medarbejdere og medarbejdere, som har været i husene i flere år. Vi har en overbevisning om, at alle medarbejdere er bedst i stand til at skabe trygge, udviklende rammer for børnene, når de selv er i trivsel i deres arbejde.

Derfor er vores arbejdsmiljø i højsædet, vi arbejder hele tiden på at styrke og bevare den gode trivsel som allerede er eksisterende.

Skal du være vores nye kollega?

  • Kan du mærke arbejdsglæden spire ved at læse hvilken arbejdsplads vi er?
  • Glædes du over at udvikle dig sammen med kollegaer?
  • Finder du motivation i at være medskaber af de bedste læringsmiljøer for barnet?

Hvis du kunne svare ja til det hele, så skal du da være vores nye kollega! Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig med det samme, så du kan fortælle hvad du kan tilbyde os – vi indkalder nemlig til samtaler løbende.

Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt/ efter aftale.



Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.






Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Dygtige lærere til vores skønne indskoling på Hedegårdsskolen
description:
Hedegårdsskolen søger to lærere til vores indskoling. Vi søger en matematiklærer til en af vores 2. klasser samt en dansklærer til en af vores 3. klasser.

Dine vigtigste opgaver
I 2. klasse vil du vil blive matematiklærer samt delt klasselærer, hvor du også vil skulle varetage andre fag afhængig af din fagkombination.

I 3.klasse vil du blive dansklærer med delt klasselærer funktion. I denne stilling vil du også skulle varetage andre fag ligesom ovenstående.

I begge stillinger vil du skulle indgå i et tæt samarbejde med de øvrige lærere og pædagoger, som er tilknyttet klassen.

Du vil blive en del af årgangsteamet omkring 2. eller 3. årgang og generelt indgå i et tæt samarbejde med kollegerne i indskolingen. Vi har ligeledes et tæt samarbejde med skolen BFO (Ballerup Fritidsordning), og der er også pædagoger med i skolen.

Dine kompetencer

  • Er læreruddannet med relevante linjefag, eller med tilsvarende kompetencer
  • Er stærkt fagligt funderet og brænder for dine fag
  • At din klasserumsledelse er tydelig overfor eleverne
  • Er teamplayer og vil bidrage positivt til det kollegiale samarbejde
  • Er engageret, ambitiøs og nysgerrig i dit arbejde med undervisning og læring
  • Er imødekommende og anerkendende i din tilgang til elever og forældre.

Det får du hos os

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder i fællesskaber
  • En spændende arbejdsplads med engagerede kolleger
  • Gode faciliteter
  • En dedikeret ledelse
  • Glade børn og forældre
  • Mentorordning
  • Nyuddannede lærere har max 24 lektioners undervisning pr. uge de første to år. Øvrige lærere har 25 lektioner pr. uge.

Hvem er vi
Hedegårdsskolen er en udviklingsorienteret skole med flotte fysiske rammer, der giver mulighed for spændende pædagogik.

Vi arbejder afdelingsopdelt i årgangsteam. Skolen er kendetegnet ved en god inklusionskultur, mange ressourcer til vejledning, holddannelse og specialpædagogisk bistand, hvoraf en betydelig del af ressourcerne er tildelt årgangsteamet.

Herudover er vi idrætsskole som betyder, at vi breddemæssigt arbejder med bevægelse og sundhed i fagene. Desuden har vi en særlig klasselinje for idrætstalenter i udskolingen under Team Danmark ordningen.

Vi har et godt samarbejde med Ballerup Lærerforening, og har ligeledes et attraktivt lønniveau.

Vil du vide mere
Du kan få mere at vide om stillingen ved at kontakte Anne Eilenberg Svendsen på telefon Tlf.: 3054 1892.

Læs mere om Ballerup Kommune som arbejdsplads på

Ansættelsesproces og løn
Ansættelsesdatoen er den 1. september 2026.

Vi forventer at holde samtaler torsdag d. 27. august 2026.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer og er en fast stilling.

Ansøgningsfrist: 24. august 2026.

Vi tilbyder løn og ansættelsesvilkår ifølge overenskomst for lærere m.fl. folkeskolen i kommuner og efter principper om lokal løndannelse og efter aftale med den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Løninterval for stillingen er 39.726 kr. - 47.314 kr. pr. måned (37 timer)

Vi indhenter straffe- og børneattester.

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke. Derfor opfordrer vi alle uanset køn, alder, handicap, religion, seksuel orientering eller etnisk baggrund til at søge job hos os.

Vi glæder os til at møde dig.

title: Klantenservice medewerker bol - 100% thuiswerken
description:

Achter elke klantvraag zit een verhaal. Als klantenservice medewerker voor bol neem jij de tijd om dat verhaal te begrijpen en help je klanten met een passende oplossing.   • Klanten helpen via telefoon, chat en e-mail

  • Vragen beantwoorden over bestellingen, leveringen en producten

  • Zelfstandig passende oplossingen bedenken

  • Signaleren van verbeteringen en deze delen met je team

  • Elke dag bijdragen aan een uitstekende klantbeleving

Herken jij jezelf hierin?

Jij bent iemand die:

  • Goed kan luisteren en zich makkelijk in anderen verplaatst

  • Ondernemend en oplossingsgericht denkt

  • Snel schakelt tussen verschillende systemen

Waarom werken voor bol via TP?

Je werkt voor één van de bekendste merken van Nederland, vanuit je eigen huis. Daarbij krijg je veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en de kans om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Ben jij klantgericht, oplossingsgericht en klaar om klanten écht blij te maken? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Solliciteer vandaag nog en wie weet word jij wel dé nieuwe stem voor bol!

title: Linux Engineer
description:
About the Position

Our goal is to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street full time while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. As an intern, you'll be paired with full-time employees who act as mentors, collaborating with you on real-world projects we actually need done.

As a Linux Engineering intern, you'll work side by side with full-timers to learn how we build and maintain the critical infrastructure underlying our firm's technology, including our production trading systems. Our work is hugely varied, both in the technical areas we work on and the ways we work. However, a consistent theme is that we typically work closer to the operating system layer, and sometimes dive as deep as the firmware or physical hardware layer. On any given day, we might be chasing a performance issue from the application layer all the way to the hardware, fixing a kernel bug, responding to an overheating datacenter in real time, analyzing data to improve the predictiveness of our monitoring systems, or building robust automation to tackle a previously manual workflow. Our purposeful blending of in-house and open source software allows us to investigate and innovate at every level.

During the program you'll spend the majority of your time working on a project, mentored closely by the full-time employees who designed it. Each project is carefully picked to challenge and develop both your in-depth understanding of Linux systems and your software engineering skills, both while delivering real value that is relevant to the challenges the firm is facing right now. Past projects have touched on a broad range of areas, including: investigating the resilience of different file system implementations at scale, automating the collection of diagnostic information from early boot failures, designing a scalable system for collecting extremely fine-grained TCP diagnostic data, or extending our infrastructure provisioning and management systems to support new forms of compute capacity.

Alongside your project work and classes, you will also get to experience real-time operational work alongside experienced full-timers. This is a unique opportunity to see how our team interacts with almost every other group: resolving emerging issues in our production infrastructure, seeing what happens when things do go wrong, and helping us perform comprehensive root-cause analyses to ensure we learn from such mishaps.

Learn more about Jane Street's internship program here.

About You

If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind, a collaborative spirit, and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. We're more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:

  • Knowledgeable about operating system fundamentals and computer architecture
  • Experienced with systems programming concepts like sockets, virtual memory, and the process life cycle
  • Able to understand network protocols at a basic level
  • Comfortable at the command-line of a Linux machine, whether that’s from coursework, time spent as a systems administrator for your campus computer lab, side projects, etc.
  • Fluent with basic introspection and troubleshooting common aspects of a Linux system (e.g. system health as a whole, individual processes, checking logs, etc.)
  • Someone who solves problems by writing code (in any language) and is invested in robust software engineering
  • Intellectually curious, collaborative, and eager to learn (including from mistakes)
  • Humble and unafraid to ask questions
  • A strong communicator
  • Fluent in English

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com

Position Overview: The On-Site Energy Manager (OsEM) sits within Asset Management’s Energy Team, which oversees the development and execution of NYCEDC’s portfolio-wide strategy. The OsEM will lead energy management and decarbonization efforts at the Brooklyn Army Terminal (BAT)—an almost 4.5 million sq ft industrial campus managed by NYCEDC. The OsEM will work on-site to identify, analyze, and implement energy, water, and process improvements, emphasizing smart systems, digital optimization, and strategic planning. This position bridges technical energy analysis with operational strategy, developing projects that reduce energy use intensity, lower peak demand, improve resiliency, and support long-term compliance with New York City’s decarbonization mandates (LL84, LL87, LL97) and State Climate Leadership and Community Protection Act (CLCPA) goals.

Energy Management and Analysis

Project Development and Implementation

  • Identify and deliver advanced energy projects, including demand-response enablement, networked lighting, and digital-twin performance monitoring.

Operational and Behavioral Optimization

title: Director, Enablement

title: Kafka Developer
description:
Kafka Developer

Detalle del perfil:

El/La Kafka Engineer se especializa en diseñar y habilitar soluciones de mensajería y streaming basadas en Apache Kafka y distribuciones empresariales como Confluent, actuando como referente técnico para la implementación de patrones de integración asíncrona y event-driven. Su propósito es asegurar que los flujos de eventos entre productores y consumidores sean confiables, escalables y coherentes con prácticas de arquitectura moderna, incluso cuando la operación de la plataforma esté a cargo de otro equipo. Desde la perspectiva de desarrollo, este rol define la estrategia de topics, particiones, llaves, retención, semántica de entrega y contratos de datos, para que el streaming soporte correctamente necesidades de negocio y de ingeniería. También contribuye a la creación de frameworks o librerías internas para publicar y consumir eventos de forma segura y consistente, evitando duplicidad de implementaciones y reduciendo errores comunes (pérdida de mensajes, re-procesamientos no controlados, orden incorrecto). Además, el rol colabora estrechamente con arquitectos y equipos de datos para implementar governance de esquemas, compatibilidad de versiones y buenas prácticas de observabilidad lógica (por ejemplo, métricas de lag y throughput a nivel de consumer group). En sistemas complejos, su propósito incluye asesorar en estrategias de resiliencia (retries, DLQs, backpressure), idempotencia y diseño para replays, ayudando a que el event-driven sea mantenible en el tiempo. En suma, habilita que la organización use Kafka como un backbone de integración, minimizando riesgos técnicos y maximizando la trazabilidad y consistencia de los eventos.

Indispensable:

"Confluent Kafka, Schema Registry, serialización Avro/Protobuf/JSON Schema.

Java (Spring Kafka), patrones de consumo (at-least-once/exactly-once).

Kafka Connect, formatos de eventos, headers, tracing correlativo.

Git/Bitbucket, herramientas de documentación (Confluence), Jira."

The Associate Director of High School Math collaborates closely with school-based leaders to design and facilitate high-quality professional development and coach leaders and teachers around content; ensure strong implementation of the math curriculum; create quiz, unit, midterm, and final assessments; and analyze and respond to assessment data.   • Collaborates with the High School Principal, Assistant Principal, Academic Deans, the Math Department Chair, Dean of Student Supports, and math teachers to regularly analyze assessment data and use it to drive instruction;
  • Collaborates with the Associate Directors of Elementary and Middle School Math and the Associate Director of Science, Technology, and Engineering to ensure alignment of our PK-12 STEM programs.
    • Teacher & Leader Development
  • Designs and facilitates high-quality professional development to support teachers and leaders with curriculum implementation;
  • Conducts curriculum implementation and content walkthroughs to support school-based teams in determining focus areas and action steps for instructional improvement by observing math instruction and analyzing student and teacher data;
  • Regularly observes and/or leads Intellectual Prep meetings in order to improve coaching and teacher development practices at Dream Charter High School;
  • Coaches academic deans and math department chair to improve their instructional leadership, content knowledge, and curricular expertise.

    • Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s Degree in Math, Math Education and/or Teaching, Math Curriculum, or School Administration/Leadership, strongly preferred, but not required;
  • Minimum of 5 years experience teaching and/or leading high school math with a record of strong achievement for ALL children;
  • Minimum 1 year (more preferred) of school leadership including a successful record of developing teacher and/or leader knowledge, skill, and productive mindsets around teaching and learning, including experience with design and execution of adult professional development and coaching;
  • Deep knowledge of AP and Regents course design, SAT preparation, standards alignment, assessment design, and pedagogical best practices in high school math;
  • Advanced knowledge of Algebra I, Algebra II, Geometry, Pre-Calculus, Calculus, & Statistics content;
  • A strong analytic, performance management, accountability, and systems-thinking orientation necessary to inform strategy development and execution;
  • Strong interpersonal skills, cultural competency, and an ability to connect and build relationships with a diverse group of people;
  • Strong organizational skills and an ability to project plan, prioritize, and balance multiple projects simultaneously;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to convey complex information to a variety of audiences;
  • A drive to succeed and achieve great results on behalf of all students, especially those furthest from opportunity;
  • A deep commitment to fostering equity and inclusion in our schools;
  • A strong belief in the mission and values of DREAM, including a desire to make a difference in the lives of our students, families, and community.

    • Working Expectations

  • On-site work takes place across three DREAM campuses throughout East Harlem and the South Bronx.

  • Referral bonuses;

  • Benefits are subject to change.

    • Compensation

  • DREAM offers a competitive salary commensurate with relevant experience with the potential for an annual performance-based increase. The incoming salary range for this position is $105,000 to $115,000 per year. New hires are typically brought into the organization at a salary closer to the start of the range depending on qualifications, internal equity, and the budgeted amount for the role. All staff are eligible for annual performance-based increases. Because we value staff tenure in each role, we do not currently cap salary ranges.

    At DREAM, diversity, equity, and inclusion are a matter of mission.

    From our schools to our playing fields, DREAM is committed to building a team where each individual can bring their full identity and experience to work because representation matters—it enriches our team culture, enhances our ability to innovate, and strengthens our impact in and out of the classroom. DREAM engages staff that represent and appreciate the diversity of our majority Black and Hispanic student body, while working to ensure that our practices are equitable, welcoming, and productive. We are dedicated to creating a world where youth, especially youth of color, have permission to dream—along with the tools and opportunities to make their dreams reality.

title: Sr Manufacturing Planning Specialist
description:
Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work is required plus a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree.

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:Department of Defense Secret security clearance is obtainable within a reasonable amount of time after hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position

Developing mission-critical systems that help keep people safe is what we do. At General Dynamics Mission Systems, you’ll be part of the team that helps heroes make a true impact. The work we do is important. The challenges we face are career-defining. The opportunity we can offer is one-of-a-kind. We apply advanced technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain, AR/VR, Cloud Native and Quantum Physics to solve our customers’ missions in cyber, RF, undersea, interstellar and everything in between.

The Sr Manufacturing Planning Specialist is responsible for developing and managing shop orders, tracking production progress, and ensuring timely availability of materials to meet program schedules. They collaborate with cross-functional teams including Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain to maintain shop floor execution and drive on-time delivery across all programs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Creates and maintains all shop orders and repair orders in the ERP system (IFS)
  • Tracks shop order status and performs regular shop order clean-up to ensure accuracy of production records
  • Coordinates the efficient movement of materials with purchasing, production, and engineering
  • Tracks and resolves material shortages to prevent production interruptions
  • Performs MRB (Material Review Board) tasking including disposition coordination and documentation
  • Conducts deviation review and ensures proper documentation and disposition of non-conforming material
  • Supports WAWF (customer sell-off) creation and submission
  • Compiles and monitors monthly production schedules
  • Develops detailed schedules, production plans, and capacity plans
  • Maintains forecast in the production and material planning tool and updates as required
  • Interfaces periodically with supply chain or suppliers on delivery issues and problem resolution
  • Develops reports on unit status and shipments as required
  • Oversees the master schedule and ensures compliance with material requirements for manufacturing
  • Identifies process flow improvements and implements them

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Experience with Power BI to create dashboards supporting production visibility
  • Proficient understanding of MRP/ERP principles; experience with IFS preferred
  • Proficient skills in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint)
  • Ability to effectively communicate both verbally and in writing
  • Ability to problem solve utilizing analytical skills
  • Ability to multi-task while maintaining focus on details
  • Proficient understanding of material planning tools, concepts, and methodologies
  • Proficient understanding of concurrent engineering principles and government compliance regulations
  • Proficient understanding of negotiation and persuasion skills
  • Proficient time management skills
  • Proficient ability to implement change and monitor effectiveness of the change
  • Identifies opportunities to apply continuous improvement on the shop floor
  • Exercises proficient judgment in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results

Education and Experience:

  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent plus a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree.
  • Effective risk management skills to identify and implement risk reduction plan
  • Ability to coordinate the efficient movement of materials with purchasing, production and engineering

Note: This position is 100% on-site in Canonsburg, PA and we are not offering a relocation package at this time.

Salary Note

This estimate represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors (geographic location, etc.). Actual pay may vary. This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.

Combined Salary Range

USD $70,000.00 - USD $75,000.00 /Yr.

Company Overview

General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) engineers a diverse portfolio of high technology solutions, products and services that enable customers to successfully execute missions across all domains of operation. With a global team of 12,000+ top professionals, we partner with the best in industry to expand the bounds of innovation in the defense and scientific arenas. Given the nature of our work and who we are, we value trust, honesty, alignment and transparency. We offer highly competitive benefits and pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose. You will also enjoy a flexible work environment where contributions are recognized and rewarded. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team!

Summary:

This is an opportunity to positively influence and effect substantial revenue-generating outcomes in alignment with legal team guidelines and goals, and Delinea’s strategic objectives.

This position reports to the VP & AGC, Commercial.

• Partner with sales team leadership to align business requirements, manage deal pipeline, and ensure delivery to agreed timelines

• Solid working knowledge of global legal considerations applicable to B2B software licensing and SaaS, including international commercial laws, cross-border transactions, IP rights, data privacy and security and commercial rights and remedies
• Strong strategic thinking, analytical skills, and attention to detail

• Ability to work independently through issues, evaluate risks and choices and make sound judgments even in the face of uncertainty

• Strong collaborative spirit with a high touch customer service approach to working with internal stakeholders and delivering on customer needs

title: Head of Workplace
description:
Location: San Francisco (In-Office)

Mission: Our mission is to bring autonomy to software engineering.

Factory

We build software development agents that accelerate the world's largest enterprise engineering teams. We're helping customers including Nvidia, Adobe, Adyen, Klarna, and Ernst & Young turn their engineering organizations into autonomous development systems — shipping code, reviewing PRs, running tests, and deploying continuously.

In 2026, we raised a $150M Series C. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).

About the Role

We're looking for a Workplace Lead to build and run the physical and experiential backbone of our company as we scale globally. This is a rare role that sits at the intersection of strategy and execution: you'll design the systems, plan for capacity ahead of growth, and create an environment for employees and visitors alike that reflects who we are as a company.

This role is built for someone who thinks like an operator and acts like a host. You're comfortable owning a multi-year space strategy and a same-day event logistics in the same week.

What You'll Own

Operations & Systems

  • Build the infrastructure (vendor relationships, budgets, tooling, processes) that lets Workplace scale without your personal bandwidth being the bottleneck

  • Manage a workplace budget and report on spend, utilization, and ROI

  • Hire and develop a team as scale requires it

Expansion & Space Planning

  • Lead site selection, lease negotiations (with legal/finance support), and buildout for new offices as we expand globally

  • Own headcount-driven capacity planning, forecasting space needs against hiring plans and adjusting in real time

  • Partner with local counsel, contractors, and vendors to stand up compliant, functional offices in new markets

  • Build repeatable playbooks so each new market opens faster and more predictably than the last

Employee & Visitor Experience

  • Own the day-to-day experience of every office the details that make people want to come in and want to bring people to

  • Design and run onsite programs, from daily operations to milestone moments (offsites, board meetings, exec visits)

  • Set the standard for how visitors, candidates, and guests experience the company from the moment they walk in

  • Build feedback loops with employees to continuously improve the workplace experience across locations

  • Build and lead a team of Office Coordinators across the newly formed offices

Events

  • Plan and execute company-wide events, from team offsites to all-hands to external-facing gatherings

  • Manage event budgets, vendors, and logistics end-to-end

  • Partner with Leadership and cross-functional teams on programming that reinforces culture and connection

What You Bring

  • 7+ years in Workplace, Facilities, or a closely related operations role, including experience opening or scaling offices in multiple markets/countries

  • Track record of building systems and playbooks, not just running programs

  • Strong project management and vendor negotiation skills; comfortable owning budgets and being accountable for outcomes

  • A genuine hospitality instinct - you notice the details others miss and care about how people feel in a space

  • Startup DNA: you're energized by ambiguity, move fast, and are just as willing to move furniture as you are to present a capacity plan to leadership

  • Excellent judgment on when to build for scale vs. when to keep things scrappy

  • International experience preferred (real estate, considerations across markets)

Compensation

Base salary: $185,000-$240,000
Equity: Meaningful early-stage equity grant, commensurate with scope and level
Additional: Generous benefits package

Final offer will depend on the candidate's experience, scope of the role at time of hire.

title: Administrative Business Partner to the Chief Product & Technology Officer
description:
About Fora

Fora is the modern travel agency, empowering anyone with a passion for travel to build a thriving advisory business. We're modernizing the $100B+ travel agency industry by combining powerful technology, data, and community to enable thousands of entrepreneurs to build on our platform. Our business-in-a-box platform gives travel entrepreneurs everything they need to launch and scale, from cutting-edge tools and personalized training to a vibrant community and exclusive industry partnerships. At the heart of it all is our mission: to help the next generation of travel entrepreneurs turn their love for travel into a fulfilling career, whether full-time or part-time. We believe that everyone, from seasoned professionals to first-time advisors, can build something both profitable and personal.

Founded in 2021 by seasoned entrepreneurs, Fora has grown steadily since, expanding to a team of 200+ full-time employees based in downtown New York City. In 2026, we announced our $60 million Series D investment round, led by Forerunner and Tactile Ventures, with continued participation from existing investors Thrive Capital, Insight Partners, and Heartcore Capital. We've also been recognized as a LinkedIn Top Startup 2024, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies 2025 and 2023, and we were most recently recognized as one of the TIME100 Most Influential Companies 2026.

We're building the first truly unified platform for all travel needs—leveraging the best of human expertise and technology to transform how people plan and book travel.

About The Role

We're looking for an exceptional Administrative Business Partner to partner directly with our Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) — a Fora co-founder leading our Product, Engineering, Design, and Product Operations organizations. This role will be the operational backbone of the CPTO's day-to-day: managing a high volume of email and correspondence, owning scheduling and calendar management across both work and personal calendars, handling travel planning, prepping for conferences and events, and coordinating across executives so the most important things actually get done. This role will collaborate closely with the Chief of Staff to the CPTO, product and engineering leaders, and other senior executives and their staff.

This is a role for someone who treats administrative work as a craft and is hungry to grow inside a fast-scaling company. You anticipate needs before they're voiced, drive operational excellence in how the CPTO's office runs, and communicate crisply across every audience, elevating the impact and efficiency of the leadership you support. Just as importantly, you lead with empathy and a strong sense of hospitality toward everyone you interact with, whether that's a board member, a partner, a candidate, or a junior engineer asking for fifteen minutes on the calendar. People should leave every exchange with you feeling well taken care of — it's how we operate at Fora, and it's the bar for this role.

You're equal parts gatekeeper and accelerator — protective of the CPTO's time, but allergic to bottlenecks. You read context quickly, anticipate what's needed before being asked, and bring calm, judgment, and discretion to every interaction. You're fluent in modern AI tools and constantly looking for ways to automate the work no one should be doing manually — you'd rather build a workflow than re-do a task. You're not just keeping the trains running; you're a thought partner who helps the CPTO operate at the top of their game.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a high volume of email and correspondence on behalf of the CPTO — triaging, drafting, responding, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Own scheduling and calendar management across both work and personal calendars.
  • Build a deep understanding of the CPTO's priorities so you can optimize time, prioritize commitments, protect deep-work time, balance internal and external commitments, and un-block the team.
  • Coordinate travel planning, including multi-leg itineraries, partner visits, and offsite logistics.
  • Support the execution of internal and external meetings, conferences, and offsites, including logistics, briefing materials, attendee context, and pre- and post-event follow-ups.
  • Coordinate across executives and their teams — partnering closely with the Chief of Staff to the CPTO, product and engineering leaders, and other senior executives and their staff.
  • Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola, Notion AI, and others) to compress turnaround on briefings, summaries, drafts, research, and recurring workflows — and bring new tooling ideas to the table.
  • Draft, edit, and send communications on the CPTO's behalf — internal Slack messages, candidate outreach, partner emails, and board prep notes.
  • Develop a task management system that maintains visibility on competing tasks and deadlines across the CPTO's commitments, and quietly drive open items to closure.
  • Manage expenses, vendor relationships, and administrative workflows tied to the CPTO's office.
  • Handle highly sensitive information — personnel matters, financials, board materials, candidate pipelines — with absolute discretion.

Requirements

  • 3-6 years of Administrative Business Partner (ABP) or Executive Assistant (EA) experience, including direct support of a senior executive (VP, C-level, or founder) at a high-growth startup or scaled tech company
  • Hands-on, daily use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola, Notion AI, or similar) in your current workflow — not just experimenting, but actually leveraging them to move faster
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication; you can adopt your principal's voice when needed and write something they'd be proud to send
  • Strong organizational instincts, with fluency in Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and modern calendar/travel tooling
  • Sharp judgment under pressure, with a strong sense of what's urgent, what's important, and what can wait
  • Comfortable acting as an accountability partner to the CPTO, tactfully surfacing commitments, deadlines, and follow-ups when needed.
  • Deeply discreet and trustworthy; comfortable holding confidential information across product roadmaps, hiring, comp, and board matters
  • Bias toward action — you'd rather make a decision and adjust than wait for direction on things that don't need it
  • Meticulous attention to detail and a high bar for precision — typos, missed details, and dropped balls bother you, and you build systems so they don't happen
  • Warm, empathetic, and naturally hospitable — you make everyone you interact with feel well taken care of, whether they're a board member or a new hire
  • Low-ego and genuinely curious; you build great relationships across functions and seniority levels
  • Based in New York City and able to work in person 4 days/week from our Tribeca/FiDi office
  • Bonus: genuine interest in hospitality and travel, and/or prior experience supporting a Product, Engineering, or Technology leader

Compensation

Compensation for this role varies based on experience, with an indicative range of $100K–$140K + equity. Final compensation will depend on the level at which the candidate is hired, as we’re considering multiple levels for this role.

  • Unlimited vacation
  • Health Insurance (including an option completely covered by Fora HQ)
  • Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Wellhub Memberships
  • 401k plan with company match
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Supplemental Life Insurance
  • Stock Options

This role is based in our beautiful New York City office (Tribeca/Fidi) with lots of natural light and great views. We're in-office 4 days a week, with 3 weeks remote annually and flexible Fridays.

Our Values

We’re forging our own path

Fora has always been about driving change within the industry. We’re not interested in maintaining the status quo.

We’re stronger together

title: Konsulent til Gældsstyrelsen – 20 timer
description:
Kan du arbejde med styring og data og har solid erfaring med det? Og har du lyst til at være med til at sikre en større sammenhæng i den overordnede opgavestyring, så er det dig vi leder efter.

Gældsstyrelsen har ansvaret for at inddrive gæld til det offentlige. Det er en opgave, der har stor betydning for samfundet. Vores opgave er at sikre, at så mange som muligt betaler deres gæld til det offentlige, og at ny gæld forebygges - 'Vi hjælper Danmark ud af gæld. Vi er statens inkasso.'

Om stillingen
Stillingen som konsulent er placeret i vores SOP-kontor i Roskilde. Det er en deltidsstilling på 20 timer om ugen. Du får en masse gode kolleger du skal arbejde sammen med for at skabe de bedste rammer for styring.

Om dig
Du har en relevant baggrund og har arbejdet med data og styring. Du har erfaring fra en lignende stilling i en større offentlig organisation, hvor du har opnået gode resultater i samarbejde med øvrige samarbejdsrelationer i organisationen.

Derudover:

  • har du erfaring fra en lignende stilling, og det vil være en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet i en politisk ledet organisation.
  • Er du en dygtig kommunikatør, der kan samarbejde med alle niveauer i organisationen.
  • Du agerer som rollemodel med fokus på både faglighed, fremdrift og kultur.
Det er vigtigt at du evner at forventningsafstemme i forhold til opgaver, adfærd og udvikling, da vi i Gældsstyrelsen har stort fokus på medarbejdernes og ledernes performance og trivsel. Vi har 1:1 møder mellem ledere og medarbejderne og underdirektør og ledere samt løbende trivselsmålinger, som et led i vores fokus på den kultur, vi ønsker at fremme.

Vi tilbyder

  • Spændende opgaver
  • En afvekslende arbejdsdag fyldt af samarbejde med dygtige medarbejdere og kollegaer på et samfundskritisk og meningsfyldt område på tværs af Skatteforvaltningen.
Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansøgning, CV og eksamensbevis bedes sendt via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest den 18. august 2026.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Kontorchef Helle Antvorskov (72386210).

Der vil forud for ansættelsen blive indhentet en straffeattest samt udført et restancetjek for så vidt angår restancer til det offentlige.

Tiltrædelse 1. september 2026.

Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og It-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for Fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatteministeriet.

Du bliver ansat i Skatteministeriet med tilhørende institutioner og refererer til Gældsstyrelsens direktør. Arbejdsstedet er som udgangspunkt Teglgårdsparken 26, 5500 Middelfart.
