title: Vice President, Health and Beauty
description:
About Us

There’s a reason HUNTER is recognized as a PRWeek Best Place To Work and has been named PRovoke “Consumer Agency of the Year” not once, but twice: At HUNTER, we EARN IT — consumer attention, the trust and loyalty of clients, and the dedication of our staff, currently 350+ strong and counting

Overview

HUNTER is searching for a Vice President of Public Relations to manage a sizeable portion of the agency’s health + wellness business, including development of strategic PR plans, providing strategic counsel to clients, and management of accounts to ensure agency profitability. Vice Presidents also manage account teams to maximize each team member’s performance while driving accountability and fostering respect and collaboration.

Responsibilities

  • Lead health + wellness client PR programs from concept/planning through completion/evaluation
  • Develop and propose strategic, creative ideas and tactical elements for client programs; demonstrate an ability to autonomously handle these responsibilities when needed
  • Ensure that direct reports manage account teams and programs to deliver high quality results on-time and on-budget
  • Anticipate issues; recognize potential fiscal challenges and take action early to remedy them
  • Make recommendations for ways to meet client needs; demonstrate an expertise and understanding of the clients’ marketplace and business
  • Serve as a representative of the client and agency on-site at client events
  • Manage account financials: develop and manage budgets, fee estimates, out-of-pocket expenses, team hour allocations, billing, invoicing, etc.
  • Provide analysis to clients of program results
  • Sustain accounts, minimize and limit account turnover
  • Serve as primary client contact and build/maintain strong relationships with key client personnel
  • Recognize and seek opportunities to grow client accounts; utilize relationships with clients to sell in incremental opportunities
  • Develop a vision for each account’s direction and work with team members to achieve goals
  • Take strategic risks to push accounts to the next level, in an effort to secure incremental business opportunities
  • Recognize and pursue opportunities to introduce clients to the agency’s specialized services, in an effort to secure incremental business opportunities
  • Build, lead and develop engaged and successful account teams
  • Maintain relationships with key editorial contacts at traditional and emerging media outlets; leverage those relationships to obtain desired coverage on behalf of clients
  • Compile presentations for new business and business renewal proposals; participate in new business and/or business renewal pitches
  • Participate in agency brainstorm sessions for client programs

Qualifications

When you work at HUNTER, you can expect Bring Your Parents (And Kids) to Work Days, regular volunteer Days of Service, mid-day Cupcakes and Cocktails mixers and epic Halloween and holiday parties.Founded in 1989, HUNTER has grown into one of the most respected mid-size marketing communications firms in the country, creating work that matters in strategic planning, earned media relations, social and digital media, talent and influencer engagement, experiential marketing, multicultural outreach and content creation and distribution. And we do it all for esteemed companies and brands across every sector you can imagine:

title: E-Discovery Analyst
description:
Overview

The eDiscovery Analyst is responsible for the management, coordination, and execution of complex eDiscovery matters across the full Electronic Discovery Reference Model (EDRM) lifecycle. This role requires a highly organized, proactive, and analytical professional who can successfully manage multiple concurrent projects, navigate competing priorities, and serve as a trusted advisor to legal, compliance, HR, information governance, and business stakeholders.

The successful candidate will combine strong project management expertise with hands-on experience supporting eDiscovery technologies and workflows. While experience with Relativity and RelativityOne is highly valued, candidates with experience in other leading eDiscovery platforms are encouraged to apply. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, solutions-oriented, and capable of anticipating stakeholder needs while delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced environment.

This role collaborates closely with attorneys, paralegals, IT personnel, records management teams, compliance professionals, and outside counsel to support litigation, internal investigations, regulatory responses, employment matters, and other discovery-related initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and oversee all phases of eDiscovery matters, including identification, preservation, collection, processing, review, analysis, production, and matter closeout.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders and provide end-to-end oversight of discovery projects.
  • Conduct and manage custodian interviews, legal hold activities, and document collections across a variety of matters.
  • Manage the process and tracking of employee interviews and document collections on active projects.
  • Utilize Relativity and other industry-leading eDiscovery platforms to support data collections, review workflows, search, analytics, productions, reporting, and quality control activities.
  • Execute searches of structured and unstructured data to identify potentially responsive and relevant information.
  • Review and interpret ESI protocols, discovery requests, and stipulations to ensure compliance with matter requirements.
  • Provide consultative guidance regarding data collections, processing specifications, review workflows, analytics strategies, and production requirements.
  • Develop and maintain strong working relationships with attorneys, compliance teams, HR, IT, records management, and external partners.

title: Pædagog til børnehaven i Bryrup Børnehus
description:
Da en af vores pædagoger har søgt nye udfordringer – så søger vi en engageret og fagligt dygtig pædagog, der med godt humør og samarbejdsevner kan støtte børns udvikling og trivsel i Bryrup Børnehus. Måske er det dig, vi leder efter?


Hvorfor vælge Bryrup Børnehus?

For os, der allerede arbejder her, er svaret enkelt: Det er et fantastisk sted at arbejde. Vi har et stærkt sammenhold, faglig udvikling, godt humør, spændende udfordringer, engagerede forældre og skønne børn. Og så er beliggenheden heller ikke til at kimse ad.

Bryrup Børnehus ligger i et naturskønt område i den sydlige del af Silkeborg Kommune, tæt på skove og søer. Vi arbejder meget med og i naturen og bruger den som grundlag for vores arbejde med læreplanstemaerne.

Vores naturfokus ligger således som udgangspunkt til grund for pædagogikken og aktiviteterne i børnehuset. De seneste 19 år har vi således gjort os fortjent til Friluftsrådets Grønne Spirer Flag – samt Spring-ud-flaget de seneste 6 år. Derudover tænker vi motorisk og sproglig udvikling som dele af fundamentet for børnenes udvikling – naturligvis tilrettelagt efter børnenes behov og NUZO. Vi arbejder pædagogisk med børnenes udvikling hele dagen – samtidigt med at vi vægter at arbejde i læringsgrupper om formiddagen.

Bryrup Børnehus er et 0-6 års børnehus med plads til 24 vuggestuebørn og 100 børnehavebørn i gode rammer. Vi er del af Daginstitutionen Naturstien, der p.t. består af 4 børnehuse – Askehuset, Bøgehuset og Poppelhuset i Them samt Bryrup Børnehus - med en institutionsleder og tre daglige ledere. Institutionslederen fungerer også som daglig leder i Bryrup.


Vi søger en pædagog, der:
  • Er vild med naturen og at arbejde i og med den i hverdagen.
  • Arbejder efter en kropslig tilgang som udgangspunkt for udvikling, trivsel og læring
  • Er legende, iderig og med lyst/evner til at være fysisk aktiv med børnene.
  • Prioriterer det gode, konstruktive og inkluderende forældresamarbejde.
  • Kan have mange bolde i luften i en uforudsigelig hverdag.
  • Er fortrolig med brugen af PC (Office, AULA, Hjernen og Hjertet m.v.)
  • Har kørekort og egen bil.

Vi tilbyder:
  • En alsidig, engageret og udviklingsparat personalegruppe
  • Medinddragelse og medindflydelse
  • Arbejdsdage, der sjældent er ensformige
  • Godt arbejdsmiljø med både faglighed og humor
  • Et børnehus tæt på skov og søer.
  • Et børnehus uden madordning – så du bestemmer selv, hvad madpakken indeholder.
  • Skovhytte kun 400 meter fra børnehaven.

Stillingen er på 37 timer.

Arbejdstiderne er skiftende og ligger i tidsrummet 6.15-16.45. Du må forvente at skulle dække både åbne og lukkevagter, derfor er det vigtigt, at du selv har bil.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og aftale om lokal løndannelse.

Læs mere på:

Yderligere information:
Skulle du have spørgsmål du brænder inde med, så giv os et kald – ja du er selvfølgelig også velkommen til at få en rundvisning. Du kan kontakte Tue Chr. Sørensen, institutionsleder på telefon 2013 6420.

Ansøgningsfrist: Løbende

Samtaler forventes at finde sted: Løbende

Vi foretrækker, at du sender din ansøgning online.
Klik på Ansøg. Vedhæft din ansøgning og relevante bilag.

Vi indhenter offentlig straffeattest og børneattest på den person, vi ønsker at ansætte.

title: Senior Service Reliability Engineer
description:
As a Senior Service Reliability Engineer (SRE) you will take a multifaceted approach to ensure technical excellence and operational efficiency within the infrastructure domain. Specializing in reliability, resilience and system performance, you take a lead role in championing the principles of Site Reliability Engineering. By strategically integrating automation, monitoring and incident response, you facilitate the evolution from traditional operations to a more customer-focused and agile approach. Emphasizing shared responsibility and a commitment to continuous improvement, you cultivate a collaborative culture, enabling organizations to meet and exceed their reliability and business objectives.

Job responsibilities

  • You will improve site reliability by building mechanisms/architectures that enable fault tolerance and faster median time to respond and median time to detect.
  • You will drive the integration of observability automation into the CI/CD pipeline.
  • You will handle production incidents, manage incident communication with clients and draft root cause analysis documents.
  • You will monitor performance of production systems and improve their scaling to ensure business goals are met within expected SLA and SLO metrics.
  • You will work closely with application development teams as advisors on improving system reliability and assisting in implementation for reliability improvements.
  • You will improve system observability across multiple facets such as logging and metrics, reducing false alarms to eliminate unnecessary toil and improving process efficiency.
  • You will implement chaos engineering practices as necessary to test system reliability, setting up processes for such testing to be done regularly .
  • You have a clear understanding of client goals and business needs and setting direction for site reliability in line with the same, e.g.: Achieving application availability with minimum/no disruption (99.999%) if necessary for business.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

  • You have hands-on experience in programming and scripting languages such as Python, Go or Bash.
  • You have a good understanding of at least one Public Cloud, e.g.: AWS, Azure or GCP .
  • You have had exposure to observability tools such as Grafana, Datadog, NewRelic, ELK Stack, Dynatrace or equivalent and you are proficient in using data from these tools to dissect and identify root causes of system and infrastructure issues .
  • You are familiar with DevOps and GitOps practices .
  • You have a good knowledge of container-based architecture and orchestration tools such as Kubernetes, AWS EKS, Docker Swarm, Nomad, etc.
  • You understand technical architecture and modern design patterns, including microservices, serverless functions, NoSQL and RESTful APIs, with experience in fixing bugs, analyzing logs, building metrics and operational dashboards.
  • You are familiar with creating infrastructure resources for improving reliability of system that follows Cloud’s Well Architected Framework principles: Reliability, security, cost optimization, performance efficiency and operational.

Professional Skills

  • You have strong communication and articulation skills, and are proficient in English.
  • You have good people skills with an emphasis on negotiation and close collaboration with multiple cross-functional teams from the client side and/or Thoughtworks.
  • You solve challenging problems and difficult to debug issues with a never give up attitude.
  • You have the ability to work under pressure and with composure during production incidents.
  • You can confidently recommend improvements backed by strong technical arguments to client stakeholders or application development teams.
  • You are able to understand requirements provided by the client on both technical and business aspects and break them down for successful implementation.
  • You have a strong drive and ownership mentality, with a willingness to sign up for and deliver work when called upon, without being too concerned about role boundaries.
  • You’re willing to be part of a rotation- and need-based 24x7 available team.

Other things to know

This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

title: Klinisk vejleder for sygeplejestuderende i Generationernes Hus
description:
I Sundhed og Omsorg, Distrikt Midt, tror vi på, at de bedste medarbejdere skabes gennem stærke læringsmiljøer, høj faglighed og engagerede vejledere.
Derfor søger vi en klinisk vejleder, som brænder for at udvikle mennesker, skabe meningsfulde læringsforløb og være med til at uddanne fremtidens sygeplejersker til det nære sundhedsvæsen.

Vi leder efter en kollega, der kan inspirere, udfordre og understøtte studerende i deres udvikling – og som samtidig ønsker at være en aktiv medspiller i udviklingen af vores praksis, læringskultur og faglige kvalitet. Hos os er uddannelse ikke en sideopgave – det er en kerneopgave.

Vær med til at udvikle fremtidens sundhedsvæsen
Det nære sundhedsvæsen er under hastig udvikling. Borgerne lever længere med komplekse sygdomsforløb, den teknologiske udvikling går stærkt, og kravene til tværprofessionelt samarbejde bliver større år for år. Derfor har vi brug for dygtige kliniske vejledere, som kan skabe læringsmiljøer, hvor studerende lærer at omsætte teori til praksis, udvikler klinisk beslutningskompetence og bliver trygge professionelle sygeplejersker. Som klinisk vejleder bliver du en central aktør i denne udvikling. Du får mulighed for at sætte dit faglige præg på uddannelsen af fremtidens kolleger og bidrage til, at Distrikt Midt fortsat er et attraktivt praktiksted med høj kvalitet og stærke læringsmiljøer.

Om stillingen
Du bliver ansat som klinisk vejleder i en specialiseret fuldtidsstilling og får ansvar for planlægning, koordinering, gennemførelse og udvikling af kliniske uddannelsesforløb for sygeplejestuderende med base i Generationernes Hus på Aarhus Ø.
Du følger de studerende gennem deres praktikforløb og understøtter deres læring gennem refleksion, feedback, studieaktiviteter og klinisk vejledning.
Arbejdet foregår på tværs af enheder og i tæt samarbejde med:

  • plejehjem
  • hjemmeplejen
  • sundhedsenheder
  • ledere
  • uddannelseskonsulenter
  • VIA University College
  • øvrige kliniske vejledere

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt netværk, hvor sparring, udvikling og videndeling er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Dine vigtigste opgaver
Du kommer blandt andet til at:

Uddanne fremtidens sygeplejersker

  • planlægge individuelle kliniske uddannelsesforløb
  • gennemføre klinisk vejledning og undervisning
  • facilitere refleksion og feedback
  • sikre progression i de studerendes læring
  • understøtte koblingen mellem teori og praksis.


Udvikle læringsmiljøer

Du er med til at skabe et inkluderende læringsmiljø, hvor nysgerrighed, psykologisk tryghed og høj faglighed går hånd i hånd.
Du bidrager til, at alle medarbejdere oplever et medansvar for de studerendes læring, og at uddannelse bliver en naturlig del af den daglige praksis.


Være faglig sparringspartner
Du samarbejder tæt med ledere, uddannelseskonsulenter og kolleger om:

  • udvikling af læringsmiljøer
  • implementering af nye studieordninger
  • kvalitetssikring af uddannelsesforløb
  • udvikling af vejledningsmetoder
  • evaluering af praktikforløb.


Bidrage til udvikling
Vi forventer, at du har lyst til at være med til at udvikle vores praksis.
Det kan være gennem undervisning, udviklingsprojekter, netværk, kvalitetsarbejde eller nye læringsformer, som styrker de studerendes udbytte.

Vi forestiller os, at du
Du er autoriseret sygeplejerske med solid klinisk erfaring.
Du er fagligt nysgerrig og motiveres af at udvikle andre mennesker.
Måske er du allerede klinisk vejleder – eller måske har du erfaring med vejledning og ønsker at specialisere dig inden for området.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • har klinisk vejlederuddannelse på diplomniveau eller ønsker at gennemføre den
  • arbejder systematisk og struktureret
  • er dygtig til at skabe relationer
  • kommunikerer tydeligt og anerkendende
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt
  • trives i tværfaglige samarbejder
  • ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger
  • har lyst til at udvikle både mennesker og organisation.

Derfor skal du vælge Sundhed og Omsorg

Vi tilbyder meget mere end et spændende job.
Vi tilbyder et fagligt fællesskab, hvor uddannelse prioriteres højt, og hvor vi investerer i udviklingen af både studerende og medarbejdere.


Hos os får du:

Et stærkt fagligt miljø

Du bliver en del af et engageret netværk af kliniske vejledere, uddannelseskonsulenter og ledere, som brænder for uddannelse.

Stor indflydelse

Du får mulighed for selv at planlægge dit arbejde og præge udviklingen af uddannelsesområdet.

Kompetenceudvikling

Vi prioriterer løbende efteruddannelse, supervision, netværk og faglig sparring.

Du får mulighed for at udvikle dine pædagogiske, didaktiske og kliniske kompetencer.

En arbejdsplads med ambitioner

Vi arbejder målrettet med kvalitet, innovation, rehabilitering, tværprofessionelt samarbejde og udvikling af fremtidens ældrepleje.

Vi arbejder ud fra et fælles uddannelsessyn

I Sundhed og Omsorg ser vi uddannelse som en fælles opgave.

Vi tror på, at de bedste læringsmiljøer er kendetegnet ved:

  • høj faglig kvalitet
  • tillid og psykologisk tryghed
  • refleksion og nysgerrighed
  • plads til forskellighed
  • stærke relationer
  • tværprofessionelt samarbejde
  • kobling mellem teori og praksis
  • fokus på overgangen fra studerende til nyuddannet sygeplejerske.

Som klinisk vejleder bliver du en nøgleperson i at omsætte disse værdier til praksis hver eneste dag.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at der i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen vil blive foretaget opslag i vores referenceregister. Referenceregisteret omfatter tidligere medarbejdere i Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg, der er blevet bortvist grundet væsentlig misligholdelse af ansættelsesforholdet.

Sundhed og Omsorg (MSO) i Aarhus Kommune arbejder med omsorg for ældre og sundhed for alle borgere.


Aarhus Kommune betragter mangfoldighed som en ressource og opfordrer derfor alle - uanset alder, køn, handicap, livsstil, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold - til at ansøge stillingen.
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Data Admin and Analyst Team Leader - Maternity leave cover
description:
Overview

Change Grow Live are a charity dedicated to the belief that we can make a difference to our Service Users lives.

Our core values are ‘Be open, be compassionate and be bold’ and our teams apply these daily, offering support and respect in a safe environment, treating each service user as an individual and working with them to find the right treatment, support and care options.

We have a new and exciting opportunity for a Team Leader to join the Newham Rise team. As part of our multi-disciplinary team, you will work flexibly and creatively to manage the data admin team in Newham.

You will ensure that service users have a safe space to access support and treatment, in a way that best meets their needs. You will also be responsible for managing a team of people in varied roles, including but not limited to:

  • Clinical Administrators
  • Data Administrators
  • Receptionists
  • Data Analysts

You will be responsible for ensuring data collected at the service is of a high quality and work with the wider leadership to drive performance and continuous improvement. You will oversee submissions to NDTMS, regulators, commissioners and external partners.

Where: London Borough of Newham

Full Time Hours: 37.5 per week per week

Contract: Fixed term maternity cover until 12/04/2027

Full-time hours at Change Grow Live are 37.5 hours per week. For part-time roles, the salary and payments will be pro rata based on contracted hours.

Responsibilities

Role Specific responsibilities:

  • Line management of a team of administrative staff which includes supervision, appraisal, performance and sickness management as well as ensuring staff follow CGL and external policies applicable to their roles.
  • To provide advice, information and reports clearly and concisely via the most appropriate channel (e.g. verbally, in writing, telephone, e-mail etc. whilst being sensitive to the needs of the audience e.g. service user, professional).
  • Produce and provide accurate data reporting in line with home office, OHID, commissioner requirements.
  • Share information sensitively within the terms of information sharing protocols with a range of agencies when necessary, in line with Change Grow Live policies and contractual requirements.
  • To be the main port of call for all data relating matters as well as undertake regular and ad hoc requests from Regional Director’s, Service Manager and Commissioning Data.
  • Contribute to the management of an effective appointments system and all elements of office administration, e.g. photocopying, filing, minute taking.
  • To promote the benefits of stopping smoking and the stop smoking services through a variety of mechanisms.
  • Maintain strong governance and monitoring systems, ensuring a consistent, high quality service and ensure professional standards are met and best practice is implemented.
  • To deliver training (as required) to staff and volunteers to ensure administrative requirements and data recording within the service are maintained.
  • Provide additional administration support to ensure the smooth running of Operations across the service when needed.

About You:

  • Experience of line management, ability to lead, inspire and develop a team
  • Experience of carrying out statistical analysis of data/information
  • IT literacy and experience of using data management systems including proficiency in word processing, data entry, maintaining databases and familiarity with Outlook, Word and Excel
  • Experience of managing office and administration functions
  • A professional, empathetic and non-judgmental attitude towards service users
  • Knowledge and experience of delivering services which evidence high performance and quality standards
  • The willingness to keep up-to-date will local and national trends and undertake own training and development as required
  • Understanding of the harmful effects associated with smoking
  • A clear understanding of data protection, information sharing and confidentiality issues
  • Excellent minute taking skills
  • Experience of chair team meetings
  • Knowledge of Health and Safety requirements and procedures
  • Experience of the effective use of leading on supervision

What We Offer You:

  • 25 days of annual leave (plus bank holidays ), increasing by one day for each year of service (capped at 30 days).
  • A paid 'Wellness' hour each week, access to a 'Wellness' hub, and an Employee Assist Programme
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • An array of benefits, including discounts for shopping, cinema, holidays, and more
  • A friendly and supportive team
  • Opportunities for training, career development, and progression
  • A Refer a Friend Scheme

Please ensure that when completing your application form and supporting statement, you reflect on the details outlined in the job description. This will help us understand how your skills and experiences align with the requirements of the role.

As we want to get to know you, not an AI tool. Please make sure your application is written in your own words and genuinely reflects your skills, experience and motivation for this role.

Direct applications only — we will not be engaging agencies for this vacancy.

Please note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK at the time of application. For applicants with time-limited visas, unfortunately, we are unable to support new visa applications or extensions.

We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if we receive a high number of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Salary Range (pro rata if part time)

CGL points 31 to 33 (£36,101.10 - £38,114.53)

ILW / OLW /Fringe

Inner London Weighting (£4,236.47)

Closing Date

16/8/2026

If you have any questions on this opportunity that you would like to talk through please contact us using the below details:

Dan Page | dan.page@cgl.org.uk

This post is subject to a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check at an enhanced level.

title: Fixed Wing Pilot
description:
Overview

Fixed Wing Pilot

Pensacola, FL

EMS Air Ambulance Aircraft: PC12 (IFR)

$30,000 Annual Stipend Available

AIR METHODS: GO ABOVE AND BEYOND HERE!Be a part of something bigger and join a growing and high-performing team that shares your passion for making a difference. As leaders in the industry, we welcome exceptional pilots to partner with us in serving communities nationwide with top-tier air medical transport resources. Elevate your career with a supportive work-life balance, where your safety and well-being are paramount, and your contribution truly matters in making a lasting impact on the lives we care for year-round.

Flying for Air Methods in Pensacola, FL means living where turquoise Gulf waters, white-sand beaches, and nonstop adventure are part of everyday life. From weekends in Destin and Panama City Beach to quick trips to Mobile, the Gulf Coast is packed with energy and exploration.Enjoy world-class boating, fishing, waterfront dining, and the thrill of watching the legendary Blue Angels fly overhead. Responsible to ensure aircraft and weather conditions are airworthy to transport medical crew and patient to receiving hospital within an assigned operational area. Responsible for compliance with Federal Aviation Regulations (FAR), Aeronautical Information Manual (AIM), General Operations Manual guidelines (GOM), and thorough knowledge of Air Methods policies and procedures.

Responsibilities

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Operates Air Methods aircraft in a safe and legal manner.
  • Completes pre-flight before every flight verifying the aircraft is in an airworthy condition by sign off of Daily Flight Log. Pilots will perform a complete walk around of the aircraft prior to entering the cockpit for flight and upon completion of each flight.
  • Final authority with regard to operations of aircraft and for the safety of passengers, cargo and equipment.
  • Must be thoroughly familiar with all aircraft and medical systems of backup aircraft utilized at operational area and also ensures that the medical flight team is familiar and comfortable with the medical interior and systems.
  • Responsible for completion of required documentation.
  • Able to conduct detailed flight planning with little notice to exacting standards.
  • Participates regularly in Air Methods meetings, activities, projects, committees and community outreach.

Subject to applicable laws and Air Method’s policies, regular attendance is an essential function of the position. All employees must follow Air Methods’ employment practices and policies.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. In accordance with applicable laws, Air Methods will provide reasonable accommodations that do not create an undue burden so disabled employees may perform the essential functions of the position.

Skills• Pilots must have flown in category for a commercial operator or in the military within the previous 24 months• Maintains positive interpersonal relationships with colleagues, EMS representatives, hospitals and the public and strives to maintain a friendly and professional working environment

Operation and Safety Requirements: As a member of the Flight Crew, any person employed in this position shall maintain a weight not to exceed 250 pounds and shall be less than seventy (70) years old.

Fixed Wing Instrument Flight Rules (IFR) Program - Required Flight Times: • 2,500 total flight hours with a minimum of 2,000 hours in category • 1,000 hours PIC in category • 500 hours of cross-country flight time • 500 hours Fixed Wing Turbine time • 100 hours of night flight time • 100 hours of flight in actual instrument conditions in category

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations• Commercial & Instrument Rating (for category and class of aircraft)• ATP rating in category meets this requirement• First OR Second Class FAA Medical certificate required.

Education & Experience• Associate’s degree (A.A.) or equivalent from two-year college or technical school and two to five years’ related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience• Bachelor’s degree preferred

title: Engineer, Whole Vehicle Test Requirements and Validation – Propulsion
description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

  • Own whole-vehicle validation definition and execution for propulsion-driven vehicle attributes, including drivability, performance, efficiency, charging, thermal performance, and vehicle capability across real-world customer use cases.
  • Define and develop validation strategies for limit operating conditions, including edge and corner cases that drive propulsion system design requirements, such as power delivery, thermal management, durability, energy consumption, and operating strategies.
  • Establish key validation routes, duty cycles, and environmental conditions that represent worst-case and boundary operating scenarios, providing critical input to propulsion system sizing, battery performance, thermal systems, and vehicle operating strategies.
  • Act as the source of truth for real-world vehicle loads, environmental conditions, and customer usage profiles, ensuring engineering teams have accurate physical inputs for propulsion system and vehicle-level design.
  • Support cross-functional validation alignment across Propulsion, Chassis, Thermal, Controls, Software, Electrical, Vehicle Integration, and Manufacturing teams to ensure cohesive whole-vehicle performance.
  • Develop and manage vehicle-level test cases covering propulsion behavior, drive modes, acceleration, regenerative braking, charging, towing, payload, gradability, off-road capability, and interactions with braking, traction, stability, and ride & handling systems.
  • Translate propulsion functional requirements and vehicle capability targets into executable test procedures, instrumentation strategies, and validation plans at the whole-vehicle level.
  • Ensure propulsion systems perform seamlessly alongside chassis, thermal, electrical, and software interfaces to validate overall vehicle behavior across on-road, towing, off-road, charging, and extreme environmental conditions.
  • Lead and coordinate vehicle-level validation campaigns at proving grounds, public roads, and hot/cold climate locations, evaluating propulsion performance across diverse customer usage profiles and durability routes.
  • Translate customer use cases—including daily commuting, towing, payload hauling, off-road recreation, mountain driving, fast charging, and long-distance travel—into validation scenarios with measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Define and validate key vehicle-level attributes including drivability, torque delivery, energy efficiency, thermal robustness, charging performance, towing capability, off-road performance, and overall propulsion system integration.
  • Drive test execution and data collection, including route development, vehicle preparation, instrumentation planning, data acquisition, and environmental conditioning using vehicle CAN, GPS, thermal instrumentation, pressure, force, and specialized data logging systems.
  • Ensure robust traceability from system requirements through validation plans, test cases, execution, and results using lifecycle management tools such as Codebeamer, Jama, or Jira.
  • Collaborate across Propulsion, Chassis, Controls, Thermal, Electrical, Software, and Vehicle Integration teams to analyze test data, identify performance gaps, perform root-cause investigations, and resolve cross-functional issues.
  • Document validation results, benchmark competitive vehicle performance, and provide data-driven recommendations to support vehicle readiness, program milestones, and release decisions.

title: Director of Product Management, AI

title: Store Collega JD Haarlem| 38H
description:
JD Haarlem zoekt nieuwe collega's (38 uur) die ons team willen ondersteunen en versterken!

Als Store Collega speel je een belangrijke rol in het creëren van een uitstekende winkelervaring. Je zorgt ervoor dat klanten zich welkom, ondersteund en gewaardeerd voelen, en helpt hen bij het ontdekken van onze producten. Je brengt energie naar de winkelvloer door klanten vriendelijk te begroeten, de presentatie van de winkel verzorgd te houden, voorraadaanvulling uit te voeren en hoge service- en kwaliteitsnormen te waarborgen. Dankzij jouw positieve instelling, teamgeest en klantgerichte aanpak draag je bij aan een vlot draaiende winkel en de hoge standaard waarvoor wij bekendstaan.

Ben je klaar om aan de slag te gaan in een dynamische retailomgeving, nieuwe vaardigheden te ontwikkelen en deel uit te maken van een ondersteunend team? Dan is dit een mooie kans om impact te maken en een sterke basis te leggen voor je verdere loopbaan.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je verwelkomt klanten op een vriendelijke en professionele manier en helpt hen bij het vinden van de producten die bij hun wensen passen.
  • Je gebruikt de beschikbare winkeltools en digitale systemen om voorraad te controleren, productinformatie te delen en de klantenervaring te ondersteunen.
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat de winkelvloer netjes, verzorgd en goed aangevuld blijft, zodat productpresentaties aantrekkelijk en inspirerend zijn.
  • Je ondersteunt dagelijkse winkelactiviteiten, zoals kassawerkzaamheden, het aanvullen van voorraad en het naleven van alle veiligheids- en winkelrichtlijnen.

Wie we zoeken

  • Je hebt een positieve en enthousiaste houding die past binnen een dynamische en klantgerichte retailomgeving.
  • Je beschikt over sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en voelt je comfortabel in het contact met klanten en collega's.
  • Je bent leergierig, neemt graag nieuwe taken op en wilt jezelf verder ontwikkelen.
  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar en bereid om verschillende diensten te werken, waaronder avonden, weekends en drukke seizoensperiodes.

Wat jou extra sterk maakt

  • Je hebt een oprechte interesse in merken, trends en nieuwe producten.
  • Je neemt initiatief en stapt gemakkelijk op klanten af om hen verder te helpen.
  • Je hebt oog voor detail en zorgt ervoor dat de winkel er steeds verzorgd en uitnodigend uitziet.
  • Je bent gemotiveerd om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen en door te groeien binnen de organisatie.

Wat wij bieden

Wij zijn een werkgever die gelijke kansen hoog in het vaandel draagt en zich inzet voor een werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich gewaardeerd, gerespecteerd en ondersteund voelt. We geloven dat diversiteit onze organisatie sterker maakt en streven ernaar dat alle collega's, ongeacht achtergrond, identiteit of levenservaring, zich kunnen ontwikkelen en een betekenisvolle bijdrage kunnen leveren. Als onderdeel van een succesvolle en voortdurend evoluerende organisatie krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan onze strategische prioriteiten: mensen centraal stellen, voorop blijven lopen op het gebied van digitale innovatie, nauw aansluiten bij de behoeften van onze klanten en streven naar operationele excellentie. We staan open voor nieuwe ideeën en verwelkomen mensen die elke dag een positieve impact willen maken.

We waarderen de inzet en betrokkenheid van onze medewerkers en bieden daarom een aantrekkelijk pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden en voordelen:

  • Staff korting op alle merken van de JD Group
  • 24 vakantiedagen (op basis van full-time)
  • Korting bij andere retailers in Nederland via de 'www.corporate-benefits.nl' app.
  • Nationale en internationale carrièremogelijkheden
  • Individueel ontwikkelingsbudget
  • Toegang to onze online leerplatform

title: (1527) Technical Project Manager
description:
Join Nortal for your next big adventure. We are seeking a Technical Project Manager to join our team, grow with us, and teach us a few things along the way.

Why join Nortal

  • Say Goodbye to Micromanagement: We champion autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values.
  • Outcomes Over Hours: We believe in a work model focused on impact, providing you with the flexibility to balance your professional success with your personal well-being.
  • Vibrant Community: Join our close-knit LATAM remote team and connect through tech talks, virtual coffee breaks, and team-building activities.
  • Support from Day One: Our People Care team is here to support you throughout your journey, from wellness check-ins to professional growth.

Our benefits ✨

  • Competitive USD salary.
  • 100% remote work: While you can work from anywhere, you’re always welcome to connect with teammates and grow your network at our coworking spaces across LATAM.
  • Paid off & national holidays: Take the time you need according to your country’s regulations while receiving your full salary.
  • Sick leave: Focus on your health without stress. Take the necessary time to recover and feel better.
  • Annual credit: Spend it on the perks you love to enhance your work-life balance.
  • Team-building activities: Join us for coffee breaks, tech talks, and after-work gatherings to bond with your Nortal family and feel part of our vibrant community.
  • Birthday off: Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family.

About the project

As a Technical Project Manager, you will join a team of technical project and program managers who focus on driving business-critical initiatives across the product development organization. You will be a strong self-starter and therefore able to drill into business data and technical trade-offs to identify clear direction and focus for your tasks, projects and programs. You know how to continue to move forward in the face of ambiguity and imperfect knowledge.

What you’ll do

  • Drive end-to-end program planning and execution across multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Support strategic cross-functional planning, leading discovery and prioritization by closely collaborating with product and engineering leads to develop program plans.
  • Partner with product and engineering to develop project milestones, track progress, handle cross-team dependencies, resource planning, mitigate risks and run effective communications.
  • Proactively identify and remove impediments to drive momentum and progress. Identify communication gaps, lead issue resolution and provide support to teams balancing competing priorities.
  • Work closely with stakeholders and product managers to ensure that requirements are translated to the technology requirements that subsequently drive the execution of software development from design through successful deployment and adoption.
  • Collaborate to define the technical architecture of solutions for services and support technical implementation and integration efforts.
  • Document project plans for cross-team initiatives and drive on-schedule delivery of results.
  • Contribute to the definition, development and tracking of product and team metrics and operational improvements.
  • Drive consistent, high-quality project management practices by creating and maintaining a repository of templates and best practices.

What makes you a great fit 🎯

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ Years of experience in technical project management working directly with software engineering teams.
  • 5+ Years of experience working at a technology company, preferably within a SaaS model.
  • 3+ Years of experience leading software development projects with schedules and deadlines.
  • Direct experience using iterative or agile methodologies.
  • Proven track record of successful program delivery and handling complex initiatives across a variety of cross-functional teams.
  • Must have experience using project planning, road mapping and issue tracking tools - JIRA, Confluence, Smartsheet, Roadmunk.
  • Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

Global Impact, Local Culture 🌍

For over 25 years, we’ve been shaping digital transformation, delivering complex solutions for global enterprises and public sector organizations. Today, we are at the forefront of an AI-driven transformation era, helping organizations turn data into real business value. By combining deep domain expertise with data and AI, we design solutions that create immediate impact while scaling for the future.

We believe complexity doesn’t have to mean complicated, and that the best solutions are those that work in the real world, not just on paper. That’s why our clients trust us with their most ambitious, business-critical initiatives.

Apply now and let’s shape the future of technology together! 🧑‍💻

By applying to this position, you authorize Nortal to collect, store, transfer, and process your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For more information, please review our Privacy Policy.

title: Livreddere søges til studie og deltidsstillinger, Gellerup Badet
description:
Om Jobbet:
Vi søger nye kollegaer til vores livredderteam i Gellerupbadet og har både studiestillinger på 5-10 timer om ugen samt deltidsstillinger på 20-30 timer om ugen.

Studiestillinger
Stillingen indebærer arbejde hver 3. weekend med vagter lørdag kl. 9.45-18.30 og søndag kl. 8.00-15.30. Derudover kan der indgå én eftermiddagsvagt om ugen på enten onsdag, torsdag eller fredag i tidsrummet kl. 14.45-18.45.

Deltidsstillinger
Arbejdstiderne følger en skiftende vagtplan, så det er ikke alle vagter, der indgår hver uge. Du skal dog have mulighed for at arbejde på morgenvagter mandag, onsdag og fredag kl. 05.45-12.15, eftermiddagsvagter onsdag, torsdag og fredag kl. 14.45-18.45 samt weekendvagter hver 3. weekend med vagter lørdag kl. 9.45-18.30 og søndag kl. 8.00-15.30.

Du bliver en del af et lille, velfungerende team bestående af livreddere, rengøringsassistenter og tekniker.

Når du sender din ansøgning, bedes du tydeligt oplyse, om du søger en studiestilling eller en deltidsstilling.

Om Gellerupbadet:
Gellerupbadet er et hyggeligt svømmebad med gode faciliteter til både børn og voksne. Vi har mange forskellige brugere – herunder skoler, foreninger og offentlige badegæster.

Som livredder bliver du en vigtig del af hverdagen i Gellerupbadet og er med til at sikre tryghed, god service og en god oplevelse for vores gæster.

Krav:
Stillingen er til enhver tid betinget af, at du kan bestå erhvervslivredderprøven ved ansættelse og efterfølgende én gang om året. Vi vil gøre vores bedste for at klæde dig godt på til at bestå prøven.



Din profil:
Vi søger en medarbejder med færdigheder inden for flere områder:

  • Skal kunne bestå en erhvervslivredderprøve.
    Se mere info om erhvervslivredderprøven på linket herunder:
  • Kan få arbejdspladsen til at fremstå indbydende, ren og pæn
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, og selv se de behov, som opstår i løbet af en arbejdsdag.
  • Møder vores gæster med et smil og bidrager til den gode oplevelse
  • Er løsningsorienteret og konfliktnedtrappende
  • Kan kommunikere på både dansk og engelsk.


Derfor skal du vælge os:
Kan du se dig selv i et spændende job, hvor ovennævnte indgår? Så kan vi tilbyde dig:

  • En arbejdsplads med mange muligheder, hvor der er plads til både høj og lav puls
  • En alsidig arbejdsdag med indflydelse på eget arbejde med arbejdsdage der både kan inkludere morgen-, eftermiddag- og weekendarbejde
  • En god arbejdsplads hvor vi værdsætter et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • At blive en del af en svømmehal i udvikling, hvor du kan være med til at sætte dit præg.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer.

Løn: minimum 162 kr./timen + aften og weekendtillæg

Ugentligt timetal: 5-30 timer

Der vil blive indhentet børneattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesten ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her. Stillingen er til enhver tid betinget af en anmærkningsfri børneattest.

Stillingen er til enhver tid betinget af, at du kan bestå erhvervslivredderprøven én gang om året.



Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til daglig leder, Dinah Dahlgaard Nielsen på mail dni@aarhus.dk



Ansøgning:

Klik på ”Søg stillingen” til højre for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfrist: 16. august 2026

Vi forventer, at samtaler finder sted i uge 34 og livredderprøven finder sted mandag d. 24/8 kl. 10.00 – 14.00 eller fredag d. 28/8 kl. 10.00 – 14.00 på Aarhus svømmestadion.



Om os:
Aarhus Kommunes Idrætscentre består af forskellige idrætscentre, der samarbejder på tværs som en dynamisk enhed.
Hver af idrætscentrene har hver især egne lokale kendetegn. Du kan læse mere om organisationen på www.vigirbyenpuls.dk.

title: Construction Foreman
description:
We are seeking an experienced Construction Foreman to lead field crews and work hands-on across residential, multifamily, renovation, addition, new construction, and light commercial projects throughout the Lancaster, PA area.

This is a field-focused leadership position for a skilled construction professional who can manage daily jobsite operations while working alongside the crew when needed. The ideal candidate has a strong carpentry or general construction background, leads by example, and takes pride in maintaining safe, organized, and productive jobsites while delivering high-quality workmanship.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and work alongside field crews on residential, multifamily, renovation, addition, new home, and light commercial projects.
  • Manage daily jobsite activities to maintain schedules, productivity, quality, and safety.
  • Coordinate crew assignments, materials, subcontractors, and day-to-day field operations.
  • Read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, scopes of work, and field instructions.
  • Perform and oversee carpentry and general construction work as needed.
  • Communicate with company leadership, subcontractors, suppliers, and other field personnel to keep projects moving efficiently.
  • Assist with project startup, site organization, inspections, punch lists, and closeout.
  • Identify and resolve jobsite issues before they impact project schedules or quality.
  • Maintain clean, organized, and safe jobsites.
  • Travel to project locations generally within approximately one hour of Lancaster, PA.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience as a Construction Foreman, Working Foreman, Carpenter Foreman, Lead Carpenter, or similar field leadership role.
  • Strong background in residential construction, multifamily renovations, remodeling, additions, new home construction, and/or light commercial projects.
  • Hands-on carpentry or general construction experience.
  • Proven ability to lead crews while remaining actively involved in field operations.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and scopes of work.
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, jobsite safety, quality control, and field coordination.
  • Strong communication, organization, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to reliably travel to jobsites throughout the Lancaster area.
  • Comfortable working full-time in the field; this is not an office-based, hybrid, or remote position.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation with bonus and profit-sharing opportunities.
  • Health insurance.
  • Retirement plan options.
  • Paid time off.
  • Company-sponsored training and career advancement opportunities.
  • Consistent pipeline of projects with long-term stability.
  • Collaborative, team-oriented work environment.

title: Sr. Construction Project Manager
description:
Overview

Do you consider yourself to be a highly technical, strong communicator with the desire to work in a team environment on complex projects? Next 150 Construction is seeking a Senior Construction Project Manager to serve as the on-site leader responsible for the overall direction, completion, and financial outcome of large, complex self-perform construction projects or multiple projects.

Next 150 Construction, a wholly owned subsidiary of Gilbane Building Company, serves as the self-perform, equipment, and materials arm for Gilbane Building Company. This position will play a critical role in driving project execution, operational excellence, field productivity, safety, quality, and profitability while helping develop and mentor the next generation of project leaders.

This role will sit primarily on the jobsite and serve as an integral member of both the Next 150 project team and the broader organization. The Senior Construction Project Manager will provide leadership to project staff, including Project Managers, Project Engineers, Superintendents, field personnel, and trade partners, while fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture.

Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Execution

  • Lead the overall direction, execution, completion, and financial performance of large, complex self-perform construction projects.
  • Provide leadership and mentorship to Project Managers, Project Engineers, Superintendents, and field personnel while fostering a positive team environment.
  • Manage projects using established controls, procedures, and reporting tools.
  • Lead constructability reviews, coordination efforts, and key project meetings with owners, architects, subcontractors, and internal teams.
  • Develop and execute project-specific strategies to ensure successful delivery.

Safety & Quality

  • Develop and implement project-specific safety and quality plans in partnership with corporate safety personnel.
  • Provide visible leadership in safety, quality, and compliance across all project activities.
  • Ensure project teams consistently meet or exceed company and contract requirements.

Financial Management

  • Oversee project forecasting, budgeting, cash flow, billings, profitability, and financial reporting.
  • Monitor project performance metrics and implement corrective actions when necessary.
  • Develop contingency and recovery plans to address project risks and changing conditions.

Contract Administration & Risk Management

  • Lead subcontracting strategy, buyout activities, and contract administration.
  • Review scopes of work, contracts, purchase orders, and trade partner agreements.
  • Develop and execute risk mitigation plans while ensuring compliance with contractual, insurance, and bonding requirements.
  • Manage change orders and contractual notice provisions.

Preconstruction & Planning

  • Lead preconstruction planning, estimating, scheduling, logistics, and cost control efforts.
  • Partner with estimating teams to develop budgets and execution strategies.
  • Maintain CPM schedules, identify potential impacts, and implement mitigation plans.

Self-Perform Operations

  • Collaborate with field leadership, labor crews, equipment planners, and operations teams to maximize productivity and efficiency.
  • Coordinate labor, equipment, material planning, and staffing requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on operational excellence and self-perform performance.

Business Development & Client Relationships

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, partners, subcontractors, and industry stakeholders.
  • Support business development efforts, project pursuits, and client engagement activities.
  • Represent Next 150 and Gilbane as the "Builder of Choice" within the market.

Team Development & Culture

  • Coach and develop project staff through mentorship and career growth opportunities.
  • Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing culture.
  • Communicate organizational goals and align project teams with company objectives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
  • 10-15+ years of progressive construction management experience.
  • Experience managing projects valued at $50 million or larger.
  • Experience leading self-perform construction operations preferred.
  • Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Strong technical construction knowledge and communication skills.
  • Proven ability to lead large project teams and manage complex construction projects.
  • Experience with project financial management, forecasting, and cost control.
  • Advanced scheduling and CPM planning experience.
  • Experience coordinating multiple trades and administering subcontract agreements.
  • Strong understanding of construction contracts, risk management, and change management processes.
  • Estimating and preconstruction experience preferred.
  • Experience working in a self-perform construction environment strongly preferred.
  • Union construction experience preferred.
  • Proficiency with:
    • Procore
    • Bluebeam
    • Microsoft Office Suite
    • Primavera P6 or equivalent scheduling software
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment while driving accountability and results.

Why Next 150 Construction?

This position offers the opportunity to lead some of the company's most challenging self-perform projects while helping build and strengthen a growing organization. The Senior Construction Project Manager will have a significant impact on project outcomes, operational excellence, workforce development, and client satisfaction while advancing the long-term success of Next 150 Construction.

Salary to be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience of the applicant, as well as the internal equity and alignment with the team.

For (Insert State) this ranges from $120,000 - 150,000 plus benefits and retirement program.

Next 150 Construction Services has an unwavering focus on safety, the environment and caring about everyone involved in our work.

Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test.

Next 150 Construction Services is not accepting unsolicited resumes from third party recruiters at this time.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or disability status. title: Plumbing Service Technician
description:

Are you a high-performing residential service plumber who enjoys solving problems, building trust with homeowners, and getting paid for the value you provide?

We're looking for an experienced Plumbing Service Technician who thrives in a consultative, customer-first environment. In this role, you'll diagnose plumbing issues, educate homeowners, and present Good, Better, Best repair and replacement options that allow customers to make informed decisions for their home and budget.

This is more than a service position—it's an opportunity to build long-term customer relationships while maximizing your earning potential through uncapped commission opportunities. title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About Cogent

Cogent is an Applied AI Lab building the next generation of AI agents for cybersecurity. AI has fundamentally changed how attacks happen, allowing malicious actors to operate at unprecedented speed and scale. Cogent's "AI Taskforce" assesses petabytes of enterprise data to remediate these issues before critical breaches occur.

To stay at the cutting edge, we blend frontier research with real-world execution. Alongside our core product work, Cogent Research serves as our applied AI lab, providing the research horsepower needed to make truly agentic security workflows a reality. We partner with Fortune 500 companies to secure some of the most complex production environments in the world.

We're backed by Greylock & Bain Capital Ventures, and we've built a team with the best minds in applied AI. Our team is comprised of people from:

  • Top universities like Stanford, Berkeley, Penn, Duke, Carnegie Mellon, Waterloo

  • Unicorn, high-growth companies like Scale AI, Databricks, Stripe, Tesla, Coinbase

  • World class cybersecurity experts from Wiz, Abnormal AI, Zscaler

  • Preeminent research labs like Deepmind and SAIL


About the Role

We're hiring a Senior+ Infrastructure Engineer to help build a secure, reliable, cost-effective, and agent-forward foundation for running Cogent's products and services. You'll join a small, fast-growing Core Platform pod (that includes infrastructure, security, and compliance) and work hands-on across our data platform, our security systems, and the platform layer our agents use to build and ship the product. Ultimately you'll help keep the company, our customers, and our employees protected against external and internal threats.

This is an early-stage, high-ownership role for an engineer who has built core infrastructure at startup scale and can operate across many stakeholders.

What You'll Do

  • Build and optimize our data platform, with a focus on storage-level optimizations across Clickhouse and Postgres

  • Make our product deployable on-prem to unlock onboarding for large customers - the last mile needed to land seven-figure accounts

  • Harden our security systems

  • Build an agent-first infra and platform layer, since agents will build our product and need a foundation they can rely on

  • Drive large-scale infrastructure projects end-to-end across a variety of stakeholders

About you

  • 5-7 years of software engineering experience with deep core infrastructure expertise and strong hands-on coding

  • Hands-on AWS experience

  • Experience with Clickhouse Cloud at the serving layer

  • Real depth in Spark and micro-batching

  • A track record of driving large-scale projects across multiple stakeholders

  • Experience building in an AI-forward capacity, with agentic coding fundamentals

  • Startup or early-stage background (up to ~200 people), ideally blended with large-company experience

Bonus Points

  • Prior startup founder experience

  • API gateway auth experience with Envoy or Istio

  • A spike in GCP and Azure

  • SRE strength: agent-forward, but able to operationalize, debug, and triage

  • Familiarity with Hashicorp Vault, MicroVM (Runloop), and SPIFFE / SPIRE for agent identity


For California Based Applicants

The standard base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $300,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

title: Case Coordinator
description:

title: Se her: Bliv Ellas nye trygge voksen: En glad, kærlig og energifyldt pige med Downs syndrom, ADHD og autisme – 5 timer om ugen i Køge
description:
Vi søger en engageret og omsorgsfuld aflaster til Ella Johanne på 10 år i Køge.

Ella Johanne er en livsglad, kærlig og charmerende pige med masser af personlighed. Hun er diagnosticeret med Downs syndrom, ADHD og infantil autisme. Hun elsker at være sammen med voksne, er nysgerrig på verden og har en fantastisk energi – og så elsker hun at drille og få andre til at smile.

Som afløser vil din vigtigste opgave i starten være at skabe en tryg relation til Ella hjemme hos familien. Når relationen er opbygget, vil I sammen kunne tage på små ture og oplevelser, som Ella holder meget af.

Om Ella

Ella er en pige med krudt bagi og stor livsglæde. Hun elsker blandt andet:

  • At cykle
  • At komme i svømmehal
  • Legeland og legepladser
  • Små ture ud af huset
  • Nærvær og kontakt med voksne

Hun bliver hurtigt optaget af nye oplevelser, men kan også hurtigt blive træt eller miste interessen for en aktivitet. Hvis tingene ikke går, som hun forventer, kan hun reagere ved f.eks. at lægge sig på gulvet, kaste med ting eller blive udadreagerende. Det er aldrig af ond vilje, men hendes måde at reagere på, når hun bliver overbelastet eller frustreret.

Ella har et begrænset verbalt sprog og kommunikerer med enkelte ord samt tegn-til-tale. Når hun bliver glad eller begejstret, viser hun det tydeligt – ofte med høj lyd og stor entusiasme.

Hun profiterer af:

  • Faste rammer og genkendelige rutiner.
  • En rolig voksen, der bevarer overblikket.
  • En anerkendende og tålmodig tilgang.
  • Low Arousal og konfliktnedtrappende kommunikation.

Vi søger dig, som:

  • Har erfaring med børn eller unge med særlige behov – gerne inden for Downs syndrom, ADHD eller autisme.
  • Kender til eller har lyst til at arbejde ud fra Low Arousal.
  • Er rolig, stabil og tydelig i din tilgang.
  • Kan skabe struktur og tryghed omkring Ella.
  • Det er et plus hvis du har kørekort, så I kan tage på hyggelige ture sammen.
  • Er mødestabil og oprigtigt engageret i at gøre en forskel for Ella Johanne og hendes familie.
  • Har lyst til at være en vigtig voksen i en skøn piges hverdag.

Praktisk information

  • Stilling: Aflaster/ledsager.
  • Omfang: 5 timer om ugen.
  • Tidspunkt: Eftermiddag eller aften. Timerne planlægges fleksibelt i samarbejde med Ellas forældre.
  • Arbejdssted: Privat hjem i Køge.

Hvis du trives med at skabe trygge relationer, kan bevare roen i pressede situationer og har lyst til at gøre en reel forskel for en pige med masser af charme, humor og livsglæde, så hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig! Opstart er hurtigst mulig.
Inden ansættelse vil du komme på et ”kemi-besøg”

Send en kort ansøgning og fortæl lidt om dig selv, din erfaring og hvorfor du gerne vil være aflastningsperson for Ella Johanne.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Hvem er Olivia Danmark?

  • Vi står for kvalitet, viden og dedikation og arbejder med det daglig.
  • Vi tror på ordentlighed i alt det, vi gør
  • Vi arbejder med at vi meningsfuldt forskellige
  • Vi tager ansvar og skaber løsninger - hver dag

title: Claimback Specialist
location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
description:
Who we are

Intrepid Asia is a leading Ecommerce and Digital Solutions Provider in South East Asia. We offer end-to-end omni-channel ecommerce management, Livestreaming, Video production & Affiliate Management for Social Commerce plus full funnel Digital Marketing Services and advanced Market Intelligence, all powered by state of the art inhouse Technology to our client base of leading international brands across all key marketplaces and social platforms in all 6 SEA countries. Brands love our regional presence, our excellent data-driven and growth-focused services which are enabled by the strongest team in the industry, and our advanced marketing and tech capabilities.

We are growing rapidly and as the exclusive partner of Flywheel in SEA, we offer many exciting opportunities to work with leading brands across multiple categories and key industry players. By joining us, you will work on the cutting edge of digital and social commerce in SEA, and experience what it takes to drive a successful ecommerce business end-to-end.

The team you will be part of

The Value Protection Specialist will be a key member of Intrepid's Claimback team within the Center of Excellence (COE), managing complex multi-step revenue recognition processes across retail, consignment, store management, and fulfillment business models. This role focuses on protecting brand investments through accurate claimback computation, brand confirmation workflows, and AR invoicing across Vietnam, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Philippines operations.

Key responsibilities

Claimback Computation & Reconciliation (40%)

  • Prepare claimback computation files covering marketing/ platform cost recovery, brand-funded vouchers, and price difference settlements.
  • Extract and consolidate transaction data from multiple platforms (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok, etc.) and internal systems
  • Calculate claimback amounts based on agreed commercial terms, promotional mechanics, and campaign parameters
  • Maintain master records for claimback booking automation and account mapping rules
  • Reconcile claimback computations with actual campaign execution data and platform reports
  • Identify discrepancies between commercial agreements and operational execution

Brand Confirmation & Alignment (25%)

  • Coordinate brand confirmation process to obtain sign-off before AR invoicing
  • Prepare clear supporting documentation including transaction details, calculation methodology, and campaign summaries
  • Address brand queries on claimback computations through data validation and explanation
  • Support Finance-Commercial alignment sessions with brand teams (both Intrepid KAMs and client finance contacts)
  • Document agreed billing structures, reconciliation timelines, and escalation paths
  • Track confirmation status and follow up on pending approvals within agreed SLAs

AR Invoicing & Collection (25%)

  • Process multiple AR streams post-brand confirmation:
    • Retail margin invoices
    • Consignment commission and service fee invoices
    • Claimback fee invoices
    • Voucher reimbursements
    • Price difference settlements
    • Store management billing (NMV commission or fixed fees)
    • Fulfillment pass-through (3PL cost invoicing)
  • Generate invoices in NetSuite from automated trackers based on confirmed computations
  • Support payment reconciliation by matching receipts to invoices
  • Assist with collection follow-ups on overdue accounts
  • Coordinate with dedicated AR team on aging management and dispute resolution

Process Compliance & Documentation (10%)

  • Maintain accurate records of claimback agreements, commercial terms, and billing arrangements
  • Ensure compliance with revenue recognition policies (IFRS 15) across different business models
  • Document process workflows and update SOPs for claimback procedures
  • Support internal and external audits with complete documentation trail
  • Flag policy exceptions or unusual transactions for supervisor review
  • Participate in cross-team standardization initiatives for shared AR/AP playbooks

Requirements

What we are looking for - the ideal profile

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
  • 1-2 years of accounting/finance experience, fresh graduates with strong analytical skills will be considered
  • Experience in retail, e-commerce, or marketing services environments is a plus
  • Understanding of promotional mechanics, trade marketing, or claimback structures is advantageous

Technical Skills

  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets proficiency (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, complex formulas, data consolidation)
  • Experience with NetSuite or similar ERP systems is preferred
  • Comfortable working with large data sets from multiple platforms
  • Ability to learn automated booking systems and master data management tools
  • Basic understanding of Vietnamese accounting standards and revenue recognition principles

Core Competencies

  • Exceptional attention to detail - Critical for accurate computation and reconciliation work
  • Strong analytical mindset - Ability to identify patterns, discrepancies, and root causes
  • Systematic approach - Can follow complex multi-step processes (computation → confirmation → invoicing)
  • Effective communication - Clear explanation of technical calculations to commercial and brand teams
  • Stakeholder management - Professional engagement with internal KAMs and external brand contacts
  • Problem-solving orientation - Proactive in resolving misalignments and addressing brand concerns

Language & Communication

  • Fluent in Vietnamese and English (written and verbal)
  • Ability to prepare clear documentation and professional correspondence
  • Comfortable presenting computation details and reconciliation findings to stakeholders

Personal Attributes

  • High tolerance for complexity and ambiguity
  • Collaborative team player who works across business model teams
  • Resilient under pressure during monthly close periods
  • Commitment to continuous learning and process improvement
  • Customer service mindset with brand partner focus

Benefits

In return, you will be getting

  • Join an all-star Finance team which continues to raise the bar, with systems and processes (and company stability) at the level of sophistication of a small multinational, but with a 'start-up' spirit of innovation and continuous improvement in an ever-evolving world
  • In terms of learning opportunities, our organization is second to none. You will get to work on a variety of business models across many different clients as if we are 5 companies in one, and everyone is involved in projects to drive further improvement.
  • Regional teams and country Finance teams collaborate closely to ensure all finance aspects of our business are optimized, giving you a wide exposure and enhanced learning curve in a close-knit and supportive team

We also offer

Best of Both Worlds

We are a scale up: the sophistication of a small multinational, with the agility of a start-up. This means you get to work on cutting-edge projects, and besides your 'standard' job description, we love to see you show entrepreneurial initiative and want to see your take on how you can take your role and our company to the next level. Good ideas get implemented. You are the master of your own destiny.

Culture that Brings Out the Best

At Intrepid, culture is not just a buzzword, it is what we practice at work every day. We believe in collaboration over competition, transparency over politics, and willingness to learn over ego. You will be part of a team where people genuinely support one another, celebrate wins together, and face challenges head-on as one. We put our all into the work but we balance it with fun, whether that is through team lunches, after-work hangouts, events or shared laughter in the office. This is a place where you can thrive professionally while having a great time.

Grow Without Limits

Learning at Intrepid is constant and dynamic. You will have access to formal training through face-to-face sessions, coaching and our very own Intrepid Academy. On top of that, real-world experience such as leading clients, working with advanced tech, and mastering best-in-class processes will accelerate your growth every step of the way. Surrounded by a talented team that raises the bar daily, in a rapidly growing and ever-expanding business, the opportunities for your development are endless.

Rewarding You Right

We believe great work deserves great rewards at Intrepid. That’s why we offer competitive compensation and generous benefits, including comprehensive insurance and ample leave, to support you both in and out of the workplace. We want you to feel valued, cared for, and empowered to bring your best self to work every day.

Note: We will not be accepting any unsolicited resumes or CVs from headhunting or recruitment agencies at this point. Any CVs or profiles shared with us will not be entertained, and in the event of dispute, Intrepid will not be liable for any material compensation to third parties

title: Senior Director, Customer Health & Critical Accounts
location: Austin; Boston; Chicago; Denver; Los Angeles; New York City; United States
description:
The Role

MongoDB is building two connected capabilities that determine how we protect and grow our most important customer relationships: a Critical Accounts program that catches at-risk accounts early and drives them to a durable resolution, and a Customer Health Platform, an AI-powered one-stop shop for customer insights, combining health, adoption, engagement, and experience data with proactive risk identification and recommended actions.

This role owns both. You will build and lead the Critical Accounts function end to end: the framework, the global operating model, and the executive reporting that gives leadership real-time visibility into the portfolio. You will also set the long-term vision and strategy for the Customer Health Platform: what it scores and alerts on, which teams and use cases it serves next, and how it becomes the one-stop shop for customer insight across the company. You will be accountable for how MongoDB identifies, intervenes on, and learns from customer risk, and for where the Customer Health platform goes next.

This is a build role. You are creating the operating rhythm, the standards, and the team structure as much as you are running them.

This role can be based out of our US offices or remotely in the United States.

What You Will Do

Own and Build the Critical Accounts Program

  • Design and iterate on the global Critical Accounts framework: entry/exit criteria, account archetypes, playbooks, health assessment templates, and Get Well Plan standards.
  • Design the central Critical Accounts org structure and hire a lean program management team, establishing this as a durable, well-resourced function within Customer Strategy. This team is the connective tissue that ensures every qualifying account is triaged, resourced, tracked, and ultimately graduated with documented outcomes.
  • Own intake and triage standards so every qualifying nomination is validated, classified, and assigned a process lead and resource plan without delay.
  • Design the path for Critical Accounts to move beyond human nomination alone, working with Customer Health to define the signals and thresholds that proactively detect at-risk accounts and surface them for the cohort, so nominations come from both human judgment and the platform's early-warning detection.
  • Own program coordination: the master tracker of active critical accounts, cross-functional stand-ups with Customer Success, Technical Support, Professional Services, Sales, and Product and Engineering, the 90-day checkpoint process, and resource rebalancing as account needs evolve.
  • Own executive reporting for the program: weekly account status, monthly portfolio readouts with trend analysis, and quarterly summaries covering program KPIs, churn prevented, and cost-to-save ratios.
  • Set and track program KPIs, de-escalation rate, time-to-exit, CSAT delta, churn prevented, resource hours per account, and refine investment tiers based on actual data.
  • Lead post-mortem reviews for every graduated account and route findings into QBRs, product prioritization, and process improvements, ensuring learnings reach the business within one quarter of exit.

Lead Customer Intelligence & AI
