title: Scientist II/Senior Scientist, Computational Biophysics
location: Cambridge, MA USA; London, UK; San Francisco, CA USA
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences is seeking a Computational Biophysics Scientist to help ensure that our AI agents can use biophysics tools in ways that are scientifically correct, reliable, and useful for drug discovery. This person will define how biophysics experiments should be set up, parameterized, validated, and exposed as tools for automated scientific workflows.

The role sits at the intersection of computational biophysics, molecular simulation, and agentic platform design. You will work with computational scientists, research engineers, ML scientists, and drug discovery teams to build a scalable biophysics platform capable of running across hundreds of GPUs while preserving scientific rigor. This is a hands-on scientific role: the expectation is not heavy production software engineering, but strong ownership of the scientific logic, validation standards, and tool requirements that make automated biophysics trustworthy.

This role is differentiated from the broader computational chemistry position by its depth in statistical mechanics, molecular simulation, and the theory, setup, and validation of relative and absolute binding free-energy methods.

This role is one part of a broader agentic drug discovery system: computational chemistry helps judge whether agent-generated optimization strategies are chemically sensible, ML scientists build cofolding and low-data learning models, and research engineers help turn validated scientific protocols into reliable scalable infrastructure.

What You'll Be Building

  • Define the scientific requirements for agent-usable computational biophysics tools, including what inputs are required, what assumptions are acceptable, and what outputs are decision-grade.
  • Design and validate molecular simulation workflows for drug discovery applications, including MM/GBSA and free-energy perturbation methods for relative and absolute binding free energies (RBFE/ABFE).
  • Establish standards for system setup, force field selection, molecular parameterization, equilibration, sampling, analysis, and quality control.
  • Build robust, validated RBFE and ABFE workflows with automated checks for chemical-series compatibility, ligand-pose consistency, and other conditions required for trustworthy agent use.
  • Work with research engineers to turn biophysics protocols into reliable tools, APIs, and guardrails that LLM agents can invoke correctly.
  • Build validation benchmarks and acceptance criteria for molecular dynamics, binding free-energy, and related computational workflows.
  • Evaluate and integrate open-source molecular simulation and free-energy tools, especially OpenMM, OpenFE, and adjacent packages.
  • Identify and mitigate failure modes in simulation setup, parameterization, sampling, analysis, and interpretation.
  • Advise teams on when a biophysics workflow is appropriate, what evidence it can support, and where its limitations matter.
  • Partner with ML teams to refine molecular simulation methods and parameters as new experimental data becomes available.
  • Partner with research engineering and infrastructure teams to scale validated workflows across large GPU fleets with reproducibility and traceability.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • PhD or equivalent experience in computational biophysics, computational chemistry, chemical physics, biophysics, physics, chemistry, or a related field.
  • Deep hands-on experience with molecular dynamics simulation, MM/GBSA, and free-energy perturbation methods for RBFE and ABFE.
  • Practical experience with open-source molecular simulation and free-energy packages, with strong preference for OpenMM and OpenFE.
  • Strong understanding of how to parameterize molecular systems and validate that simulation setups are scientifically sound.
  • Demonstrated history of modeling protein-ligand binding and interpreting results for scientific decision-making.
  • Ability to reason from biophysical first principles while also building practical workflows that other teams can use.
  • Experience translating complex scientific methods into tooling requirements, review standards, and operational workflows.
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills and comfort working with computational scientists, ML researchers, research engineers, and drug discovery teams.

Bonus Points For

  • Industry drug discovery experience, especially in structure-based or computational discovery programs.
  • Familiarity with large-scale GPU simulation infrastructure or distributed scientific computing.
  • Experience building automated or semi-automated scientific workflows.
  • Familiarity with cofolding, structure prediction, or ML-assisted molecular modeling methods.
  • Experience defining benchmark suites, regression tests, or validation harnesses for scientific software.
  • Experience designing perturbation maps for robust RBFE statistics.
  • Experience integrating machine-learned interatomic potentials or hybrid force-field simulations.
  • Experience with active learning or fine-tuning of simulation parameters against experimental data for defined chemical or biological systems.
  • Comfort working with LLM agents or agentic workflow systems.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range
$140,800—$217,800 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We serve neighborhoods ranging from urban to suburban to on-the-edge-of rural. We prize innovation and commitment to learning. We are a fun, forward-thinking organization with a mission to enrich people's lives.

The Johnson County Library seeks engaged, qualified candidates to fill the position of Business Intelligence Analyst II. The Business Intelligence Analyst II brings to the table a vast amount of domain knowledge in which they use to tap into the magic of data and make it meaningful. Under general supervision this position plays a collaborative role working within the Department and/or across the County to develop business intelligence data to inform decision makers on emerging internal/external trends. This position empowers the department to turn data into information, information into insight and insight into business decisions.

Applications for this job will be accepted through 11:59pm CST on Monday, August 17th, 2026.

Duties include:

  • Acts as the domain expert within the department/agency/County understanding the existing systems as well as the culture and business objectives; cleans, reviews, manipulates and conducts higher level analysis; works collaboratively with the Data Analysts to retrieve extracted data from the data warehouse; implements and manages the BI solution; ensures data is secure and develops, implements and revises data cleansing procedures.
  • Designs and develops higher data analysis solutions; reviews and analyzes data from multiple internal and external sources; proactively analyzes data to answer key questions from stakeholders or out of self-initiated curiosity with an eye for what drives business performance; collaborates with (Data Analysts) to create an understanding of the business operations.
  • Through higher level analysis of data, identifies areas or ways to increase success of the department/agency; tracks performance, optimizes operations, predicts success of new programs, identifies trends and business issues; compares data with other entities.
  • Creates advanced data visualization for presentations, ensures presentations are understandable and user friendly.
  • Works collaboratively with (Business Intelligence Specialists) internally across departments and externally in order to communicate the business's data requirements; assists in determining viable solutions for identified deliverables; assesses value of new data elements, creates modeling approaches; ensures constant compliance with standards; works with departments, management, and key stakeholders, in developing detailed business requirements, conducts gap analysis, creates functional designs, and guides the business's leadership through complex analytical data processing.
  • Mentors Business Intelligence Analyst and leadership in order to raise the knowledge base of modeling, data sourcing and communication of complex topics.

title: Scientist II/Senior Scientist, Computational Chemistry, Drug Discovery
location: Cambridge, MA USA; London, UK; San Francisco, CA USA
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences is seeking a Scientist, Computational Chemistry, Drug Discovery to help guide, evaluate, and improve AI-driven drug discovery workflows. This person will bring practical computational chemistry experience in a drug discovery context and will work alongside AI systems to make sure agent-generated optimization plans, compound prioritizations, and modeling workflows are chemically and scientifically sensible. The primary mandate is to make agent-guided discovery scientifically useful, while also contributing directly to live drug discovery programs when human computational chemistry leadership is needed.

This is a role for someone who can look at an agent-driven drug optimization rollout and answer hard questions: Does this plan make sense? Are the right compounds being prioritized? Are the right modeling tools being used? What additional tools, constraints, or review steps should be built so agents can make better discovery decisions? When needed, this person can also step into an active discovery effort and lead the computational chemistry strategy for pursuing a drug program. The role spans docking, virtual screening, SAR modeling, molecular property prediction, compound prioritization, medicinal chemistry support, live program support, and, most centrally, the design and supervision of computational chemistry tools for agentic workflows.

What You'll Be Building

  • Monitor and review drug discovery agents' computational chemistry workflows, recommendations, and optimization plans for scientific and chemical validity.
  • Evaluate agent-generated drug discovery plans that combine chemistry, biophysics, cofolding, simulation, assay, and low-data model outputs, and determine whether the resulting optimization strategy is scientifically coherent.
  • Advise on compound prioritization across discovery programs, including tradeoffs between potency, selectivity, developability, uncertainty, and experimental feasibility.
  • Define which computational chemistry tools agents should use, when they should use them, what inputs are required, and how outputs should be interpreted.
  • Lead computational chemistry strategy for live drug discovery programs when needed, including hypothesis generation, modeling plans, compound prioritization, and interpretation of results.
  • Build, adapt, or guide the creation of open-source-first workflows for docking, virtual screening, SAR analysis, conformer generation, pharmacophore modeling, QSAR, ADMET and property modeling, and cheminformatics.
  • Apply protein-ligand binding modeling to support hypothesis generation, compound design, and prioritization.
  • Partner with medicinal chemists, biologists, computational biophysicists, cofolding and low-data ML scientists, and research engineers to improve AI-assisted discovery loops.
  • Evaluate agent-generated molecular design ideas and identify when proposed chemistry, binding hypotheses, or optimization strategies are weak or unsupported.
  • Help establish validation standards, review protocols, and guardrails for computational chemistry tools used by AI systems.
  • Translate computational chemistry judgment into practical requirements for agent tools, workflows, benchmarks, and decision criteria.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • PhD or equivalent experience in computational chemistry, chemistry, cheminformatics, molecular modeling, biophysics, or a related field.
  • Strong practical experience applying computational chemistry in a drug discovery context, including active program support or leadership.
  • Demonstrated history of modeling protein-ligand binding and using those models to inform discovery decisions.
  • Working knowledge across docking, virtual screening, SAR modeling, conformer generation, pharmacophore modeling, QSAR, ADMET or property prediction, and cheminformatics.
  • Strong medicinal chemistry experience and the ability to reason about compound optimization, SAR, developability, and synthetic or experimental tradeoffs.
  • Fluency in Python and hands-on experience building open-source computational chemistry workflows with libraries such as RDKit, Biopython, OpenMM, MDAnalysis, or comparable tools.
  • Ability to evaluate computational recommendations critically and communicate uncertainty, assumptions, and limitations clearly.
  • Comfort working alongside AI systems, including reviewing, guiding, and improving agent-generated plans rather than only executing human-authored workflows.
  • Strong collaboration skills across chemistry, biology, ML, computational science, and engineering teams.

Bonus Points For

  • Industry drug discovery experience, especially in computational chemistry, structure-based discovery, or medicinal chemistry project support.
  • Experience extending, integrating, or contributing to open-source scientific software.
  • Experience with FEP, MM/GBSA, molecular dynamics, or other physics-based scoring workflows.
  • Experience integrating computational chemistry workflows into automated or agentic systems.
  • Exposure to DEL, high-throughput screening, or other large experimental datasets.
  • Experience with prospective compound prioritization in active discovery programs.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range
$140,800—$217,800 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

title: Full Stack Engineer II
description:
Build with us
Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

Partner Experience sits inside Connect, Mollie's set of tools and APIs that let platforms and marketplaces offer payments to their merchants without friction. This team is focused on the self-serve track: helping partners find the right product, own the integration, and manage multiple sub-merchants with confidence. It is a domain in active transformation, with a broad scope and real engineering influence over how partner interactions evolve.

As an Full-Stack Engineer II on this team, you will take genuine end-to-end ownership of a product alongside a small, dedicated group. This is not a role where you implement a spec and move on. You will work across frontend, backend and full-stack, reason about system design, weigh product trade-offs before writing a line of code, and bring your own ideas to the table. The team actively encourages engineers to challenge thinking and expects the same in return.

If you thrive with broad scope, enjoy context-switching across complex systems, and want to shape a product from the ground up rather than maintain existing logic, this is the right place to do it.

What you'll ship

  • Take end-to-end ownership of product development, from shaping the idea through to building, testing and measuring performance in production.

  • Design, build and maintain APIs, services and embedded components across frontend, backend and full-stack, with a focus on the self-serve integration experience including Connect activation, regular payment API exposure and multi-sub-merchant support.

  • Build and contribute to large-scale systems capable of handling high volumes of transactions efficiently, thinking in system design terms rather than adjusting existing patterns.

  • Weigh product trade-offs and make decisions about what to build and how to expose it to partners, working closely with the Product Manager to shape the self-serve track.

  • Work across multiple interacting systems simultaneously, managing context and keeping focus on what matters most for partners and their merchants.

  • Challenge ideas and bring your own. This team expects engineers to have opinions and act on them.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with genuine full-stack range. You are comfortable owning a feature end-to-end across both frontend and backend, not just shipping UI with light backend glue.

  • Strong frontend engineering skills including React, React Native and TypeScript, combined with real backend capability and the ability to design and reason about more complex backend systems.

  • A product mindset. You ask questions, bring curiosity, and are comfortable making decisions in a complex product space rather than waiting for a fully defined spec.

  • Experience building embedded components for platform or infrastructure use cases, whether frontend, backend or full-stack.

  • Comfort working across multiple interacting systems in a fast-paced, broad-scope environment where the work is sometimes vague and the context shifts frequently.

  • The ability to weigh options and trade-offs to solve a problem, not just execute on what is in front of you.

Grow your way
At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie
We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

description:
Levitate’s employees share a very important mission and goal: helping small businesses grow and thrive. We all contribute to this goal in unique ways, and that’s why we prioritize helping our staff identify their strengths and find genuine fulfillment in their roles.

Across every team and department at Levitate, you’ll find friendship, enthusiasm, intelligence, and drive. In our pursuit to make the world a more creative and entrepreneurial place, we keep our company’s five core values at the center of everything we do:

This intern will use Claude Design and Canva to create sets of social media graphics that pair with the content our team develops. They will be mentored in strategic prompting and design refinement, and their work will flow to a more senior team member for final review and polishing.

  • Create sets of social media graphics using Claude Design, generating visuals that correspond to each client's requested content topics.

  • Meet deadlines within a structured workflow, keeping client content on schedule.

Qualifications

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI and interest in leveraging it for visual content
  • An eye for visual design, including layout, color, and typography
  • Comfort with Canva, or the ability to pick it up quickly
  • Comfort designing within someone else's brand rather than your own aesthetic
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to consistently meet deadlines
  • Good communicator who provides timely updates
  • Openness to feedback and interest in learning from a senior team
  • A portfolio or samples of design work, if any, is appreciated. Work that involved AI tools is welcome but not required

title: Graduate Developer Programme Chicago 2027
description:
Graduate Developer Program Chicago 2027

Maven Securities is a leading proprietary trading firm that leverages sophisticated technology and quantitative analysis to trade in global financial markets. We specialize in options and derivatives market making, where your skills can be directly applied to have a real impact.

At Maven, we believe exceptional careers are built deliberately. Our graduate program is designed for a small number of high-potential individuals each year, combining comprehensive training, real responsibility, and long-term development. We don’t hire large classes with the expectation that only a few will succeed, we invest in every individual who joins the team.

Program details:

  • Location: Chicago (based in London for training period)
  • Program start date: 6th September 2027
  • Application deadline: Rolling basis
  • Total compensation: $140k-$170k

You’ll begin with a structured 10-week training program in London, designed to prepare you for a career in software development. This initial phase focuses on building the technical foundations and professional skills needed for the role, as well as forming crucial working relationships with your UK counterparts - both on the Graduate Program and more senior stakeholders.

Following training, you’ll return to Chicago and roll onto two 14-week rotations, where you’ll continue to learn through hands-on experience. Maven offers a few days of leave to support this transition, as well as travel, accommodation and relocation support.

What you will be doing:

  • Build and optimize systems used in real-time trading
  • Work on performance-critical infrastructure
  • Collaborate directly with Developers and Traders
  • Contribute to production systems early in your career

How and what you will learn:

  • Progress through a structured onboarding program with clear learning milestones
  • Build your foundation through theory and exercise-led training, led by Maven’s Head of Technology Training & Graduates
  • Our technical syllabus covers the fundamentals and beyond of Maven’s main programming languages of C++, C# and Python, as well as TypeScript and React
  • We will teach you how to use and master Maven’s in-house tools and systems. Maven utilizes the latest technology in order to meet and exceed our demanding business challenges. We believe in using the right tool for the right job with a strong focus on engineering rigor
  • Attend regular check-ins with the Technology and Emerging Talent teams

Who you are:

Key criteria:

  • A final-year undergraduate or master’s student
  • A genuine interest in software development and a curiosity to learn
  • Familiarity with one or more programming languages
  • A willingness to adopt and utilise emerging AI technologies

We’re looking for someone who is:

  • An entrepreneurial thinker with the ability to generate ideas, take initiative and drive innovation
  • A critical problem solver and decision maker who can analyze situations, think clearly and make effective decisions
  • An agile learner who is able to quickly acquire knowledge, take on feedback, adapt and apply insights across different contexts
  • Able to synthesize information, resolve conflicting inputs, see the bigger picture, and translate complex information into actionable recommendations
  • Collaborative and influential, able to build trust, work effectively with others and positively impact the team

title: Project Engineer - Dynamic Engineering
description:
About Dynamic

Dynamic Engineering is a nationally recognized multidisciplinary consulting firm providing engineering, surveying, environmental, planning, landscape architecture, traffic engineering, and related consulting services throughout the United States.

What began as a small engineering firm has grown into a family of companies with more than 400 professionals serving commercial, residential, industrial, institutional, and public-sector clients across a broad geographic footprint. Dynamic combines local expertise with the resources and capabilities of a growing national organization.

Founded on the belief that a strong culture drives exceptional performance, we remain committed to fostering collaboration, accountability, innovation, and professional growth while providing employees with meaningful opportunities to contribute, develop, and make an impact.

Position Summary

The Project Engineer is responsible for leading the due diligence investigations as well as the design and engineering analyses of various types of retail, commercial, industrial and residential site layouts throughout regions where we do business. Projects include working with several Fortune 500 companies, as well as working with local and regional developers with varying degrees of complexity.

Responsibilities

  • Review municipal zoning and land development ordinances and applicable agency regulations to determine land development limitations for the property
  • Prepare Site Investigation and Due Diligence Reports to include the review of ordinances, utility service research, outside agency regulations and site visits to establish comprehensive development guidelines
  • Prepare Conceptual Site Plans
  • Prepare preliminary Grading Plans and Design
  • Design of Stormwater Management and Stormwater Conveyance Systems, Utility Systems and Soil Erosion and Sediment Control Design Plans
  • Prepare construction cost estimates
  • Prepare project proposals
  • Prepare and manage project budgets
  • Project coordination with client, other consultants and project team for the purpose of preparing a comprehensive site plan application
  • Prepare technical reports including drainage, sanitary sewer and site investigation reports
  • Prepare written correspondence to outside agencies, client, contractor, etc.
  • Present to planning and zoning boards, municipal agencies and project teams
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering
  • 5+ years’ experience in Civil Site Engineering (residential, institutional, industrial, and/or commercial site design and permitting experience)
  • Engineer-In-Training (EIT) required
  • Professional Engineer (PE) required
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Ability to maintain and operate personal and/or company vehicle

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Proficient with AutoCAD Civil 3D
  • Knowledge of Truck and Turning & Modeling software
  • In depth knowledge of the planning and zoning process
  • Knowledge of Hydrologic and Hydraulic and Stormwater Design
  • Proficient in design and drafting capabilities
  • Proficient grading and drainage design skills
  • Utility design experience including pump station and force mains
  • Experience dealing with regulatory agencies and review professionals
  • Proficient in the use of available mapping websites for due diligence and site investigation purposes
  • Construction support experience
  • Proficient in the use of the following design tools for site engineering:
    • AutoCAD Civil3D
    • Hydrology Software i.e. Hydraflow, HydroCAD, PondPack
    • Hydraulic Software i.e. Hydraflow, StormCAD, Storm and Sanitary Analysis (SSA)
    • HEC-RAS
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Software including Word, Excel, Outlook and Project
  • Proficient in the use of Bluebeam Revu and/or Adobe to prepare design document markups
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Independent and critical thinking abilities
  • Superior organizational and delegation ability
  • Ability to work and lead in a team oriented environment with a focus on staff development and mentoring
  • Client management experience

Why Join Dynamic?

At Dynamic, we believe great careers are built through meaningful work, continuous growth, and strong relationships. Whether you're launching your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to impactful projects, and play a meaningful role in our continued success.

Dynamic Offers:

  • Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, and a 401(k) plan with company match
  • Paid time off, company holidays, and family support benefits
  • Professional development, continuing education, and credential support
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and wellness resources
  • Opportunities to collaborate across disciplines and contribute to meaningful projects
  • Direct access to experienced leaders and exposure to strategic business initiatives
  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial culture that encourages innovation, accountability, and long-term career growth
  • Meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to make an impact from day one

Equal Employment Opportunity & Reasonable Accommodation

We are committed to fostering a workplace where all employees are treated with dignity, fairness, and respect. We believe diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds strengthen our organization, improve decision-making, and help us better serve our employees, clients, and communities.

title: Terminal Operator
description:
Overview

Buzzi Unicem USA is one of the leading cement manufacturing companies in the United States. With over 1,500 valued employees, Buzzi Unicem USA manufactures and distributes its cement products throughout the Midwest, Southwest, Northeast and Southeast regions of the country. Globally, Buzzi Unicem SpA operates in 14 countries and employs almost 10,000 people. We are passionate about sustainably producing our cement products for the benefit of society by providing the foundation for crucial infrastructure projects such as roads, bridges, tunnels, airports, dams and, residential and industrial buildings.

Our commitment to positively contributing to society is a core principle for our business, and the reason we focus heavily on sustainable development. As part of our corporate culture, we recognize our role in meeting the current generation’s needs, while preserving environmental quality and protecting the needs of future generations.

Additionally, quality serves as the foundation of the way we do business at Buzzi Unicem USA. We have established at all our production sites, quality targets for our products that meet not only local regulatory standards but also our customer requirements.

Buzzi Unicem USA strives to provide a corporate culture supporting career growth through strong leadership and development planning. We offer a competitive salary, along with comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits. Plus, our benefits include flexible spending accounts, supplemental life insurance and other voluntary benefits – such as accident and critical illness. We also provide a 401(k) savings plan, Employee Assistance Program, a tuition reimbursement program, professional development and advancement opportunities.

Join our team, be part of the solution, support evolving innovations, and help us continue providing quality products, all while being supported by strong leadership and a comprehensive and competitive benefits program.

Responsibilities

The Terminal Operator position, is critical in supporting our company by performing a combination of duties in a professional, safe and efficient manner. In this position, you will be provided with plenty of opportunities to learn other skills, develop in other areas, and build a career with Buzzi Unicem USA.

The starting base rate for this position is $45,000/year.

  • Loading bulk trucks in a safe, efficient and timely manner from the designated silos, as instructed by the Terminal Manager.

  • Ability to operate forklifts and tractors for cutting grass

title: Foreign Military Sales Manpower Project Manager, Junior, Secret
location: Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, United States
description:
Overview

At Credence, we support our clients’ mission-critical needs, powered by technology. We provide cutting-edge solutions, including AI/ML, enterprise modernization, and advanced intelligence capabilities, to the largest defense and health federal organizations. Through partnership and trust, we increase mission success for warfighters and secure our nation for a better future.

We are privately held, are repeatedly recognized as a top place to work, and have been on the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies list for the last 12 years. We practice servant leadership and believe that by focusing on the success of our clients, team members, and partners, we all achieve greater success.

Credence has an immediate opening for an FMS Manpower Manager who will be primarily responsible for supporting the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center WAM (AFLCMC/WAM) directorate, F-16 division at Wright Patterson AFB, OH.

F-16 “Viper” AFLCMC/WAM is headquartered at Hill Air Force Base with units located at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Tyndall Air Force Base, Eglin Air Force Base, and Davis-Monthan Air Force Base. The F-16 “Viper” is a multi-role fighter jet delivering air-to-air, air-to-ground, and surveillance capabilities for the United States Air Force (USAF) and Coalition Partners.

The F-16 program has the largest Foreign Military Sales (FMS) program in U.S. history producing over 4,500 jets for 24 countries. Each F-16 FMS case is uniquely tailored to country requirements / development / funding. Presently, FMS production orders exist through 2030. Additionally, the F-16 program includes the Multi-National Fighter Program (MNFP). MNFP is not a typical FMS program, but a unique, cooperative USAF and development program implemented through the FMS process under the framework of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU). MNFP began in 1975 with the countries of Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands, and Norway; Portugal joined in 200.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the duties listed below:

  • Support the planning and organizing of program/project activities and analysis and perform professional or technical work related to program management.
  • Plan, organize, complete, and present assessments of program/project management concepts, analyses, studies, and procedures. The Contractor shall assist to evaluate implications of existing or proposed projects, programs, processes, and policies/laws and recommend improvements.
  • Provide project management for FMS manpower modifications and amendments for F-16 production aircraft.
  • Assist to analyze FMS manpower needs for F-16 aircraft according to the LOR and LOA.
  • Assist to monitor expiring positions and coordinate with project managers and SAPMs to allocate and extend positions with country concurrence.
  • Assist to track and monitor the funding status of all FMS manpower positions.
  • Conduct successful collaborations with many different Air Force centers for concurrence with multiple positions across the United States.
  • Assist with LOA line management and LOA FMS budget development, financial tracking, deliverables execution, and interface with senior USG FMS representatives as required.
  • Assist with the preparation of P&A data, LOA data, and budgetary ROM estimates for new FMS programs and follow-on support cases.
  • Assist to develop, maintain, and present manpower data to include benchmark for future LOAs, tracking current programs, and suggesting necessary changes to maintain level of service.
  • Assist to input, retrieve, interpret data to/from various Government databases, and shall serve as program office POC, expert/advisor on manpower-related issues/ policies/ directives to include manpower current regulations and guidelines, manpower status, projections, and improvement process.
  • Compile and analyze historical data and advise on future projections related to creation of new LOAs.
  • Assist to document meetings, plans, and discussions with U.S. and foreign parties.
  • Assist with organizing foreign travel.
  • Accomplish OCONUS and CONUS travel in support of F-16 program meetings, reviews, audits, and other activities held at U.S. and foreign government and Contractor facilities.

Requirements

  • Minimum of an active Secret security clearance.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related field and up to three years of experience in the respective technical/professional discipline being performed
  • OR, five years of directly related experience with proper certifications
  • Minimum of three years of FMS project management experience

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Short Term & Long Term Disability
  • Training & Development

title: Maintenance Operative
description:
About us

Founded in 2013, Almero Student has grown steadily to become a trusted name in student accommodation across the UK. Our mission is to build strong relationships with our students by providing safe, affordable, and well-managed living spaces where they can study, sleep, make friends, and enjoy the culture of their chosen city.

With over 2000 rooms throughout the UK, we operate in key cities including Bristol, Oxford, London, Exeter, Leeds, Manchester, Nottingham and Birmingham offering a variety of affordable, well-managed accommodation while providing the highest standards for students.

The Role

As a Maintenance Operative, you will play a key role in maintaining the property to a high standard, ensuring a safe, compliant, and well-maintained living environment for our residents. This will be achieved through the timely completion of reactive maintenance tasks and close collaboration with the Senior Property Manager to meet all building, health, and safety requirements, with additional support from the Head of Compliance and Facilities. You will deliver excellent customer service to residents while carrying out works efficiently and in line with agreed budgets.

What You Will be Doing

  • Identify and rectify day-to-day maintenance tasks, including but not limited to plumbing, carpentry, painting, and gardening

  • Carry out daily building walks to ensure communal areas, grounds, plant rooms, storerooms, and bin stores are well maintained, free from excess rubbish, and free of hazards

  • Ensure the bin stores are kept tidy and prepared for collection

  • Assist on-site contractors to ensure completion of work and health and safety procedures are followed

  • Conduct daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly statutory compliance checks as required

  • Maintain Fire and Water Log books in line with compliance requirements

  • Assess, report, and action end-of-tenancy turnaround maintenance

title: Windows Infrastructure & Application Migration Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Windows Infrastructure & Application Migration Engineer based in India.

This role is designed for an experienced infrastructure engineer who can lead complex Windows platform migrations and application modernization initiatives.
You will support the transition of critical business applications and reporting environments to secure, supported server platforms.
The position requires strong collaboration across infrastructure, database, security, network, and application teams.
You will play a key role in ensuring smooth migrations, reliable deployments, and minimal operational disruption.
The ideal candidate combines hands-on Windows administration expertise with automation, troubleshooting, and application deployment skills.
This is an opportunity to contribute to large-scale technology transformation projects in a structured and fast-paced environment.

Accountabilities:

The Windows Infrastructure & Application Migration Engineer will be responsible for executing end-to-end migration activities, supporting infrastructure modernization, and ensuring application stability throughout the transition process.

  • Provision, configure, and maintain Windows Server environments following enterprise infrastructure standards.
  • Install, configure, and manage IIS components, including application pools, websites, SSL certificates, and web server configurations.
  • Migrate and validate Finance Portal and ASP.NET/.NET applications to updated server environments.
  • Perform SQL Server and SSRS migration activities, including reports, subscriptions, service accounts, and encryption key transfers.
  • Configure application environments across Development, Testing, Disaster Recovery, and Production stages.
  • Support infrastructure changes including DNS updates, firewall configurations, hostname modifications, and connectivity validation.
  • Develop PowerShell automation scripts to improve server builds, deployments, and validation processes.
  • Execute SIT, UAT, production cutovers, rollback planning, and post-deployment verification activities.
  • Troubleshoot migration challenges, compatibility issues, and deployment failures to ensure successful delivery.
  • Support production stabilization, hypercare activities, and retirement of legacy server environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional technical teams to coordinate migration activities and resolve operational risks.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate brings strong experience in Windows infrastructure, application migration, and enterprise deployment environments, with the ability to manage complex technical activities independently.

    • Proven experience administering, configuring, migrating, and supporting Windows Server environments.
    • Hands-on expertise with IIS administration and hosting web applications on Windows platforms.
    • Strong knowledge of ASP.NET and .NET Framework applications, including deployment, configuration, troubleshooting, and migration processes.
    • Experience upgrading and supporting SQL Server and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) environments.
    • Demonstrated experience managing application migrations and deployments across multiple environments.
    • Strong understanding of infrastructure components such as DNS, networking, firewall rules, and production cutover processes.
    • Experience developing PowerShell scripts for automation, deployment, and operational validation.
    • Familiarity with SIT/UAT testing processes, rollback planning, and migration support activities.
    • Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills.
    • Ability to manage multiple migration activities while maintaining attention to detail and delivery quality.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills when working with technical and business stakeholders.
    • Ability to work effectively under tight deadlines in regulated and fast-moving environments.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to contribute to large-scale infrastructure modernization and application transformation projects.
      • Remote work flexibility with the ability to collaborate with distributed technical teams.
      • Exposure to enterprise technologies across Windows, .NET, SQL Server, IIS, and cloud-ready environments.
      • Opportunity to work on complex migration initiatives with significant business impact.
      • Professional growth through collaboration with experienced engineering and technology teams.
      • Dynamic environment focused on innovation, reliability, and continuous improvement.

Job description

At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.

What you’ll do

AlixPartners, a leading global consulting firm, is searching for a Technology, Media & Telecommunications (TMT) Partner who is passionate about delivering high value, complex opportunities. AlixPartners counsels owners, boards and CEOs in solving their most complex, highest value opportunities.

The Technology, Media & Telecommunications (TMT) practice partners with leading technology companies, semiconductor manufacturers, electronics and component suppliers, contract manufacturers, and other high-tech organizations to solve their most critical business challenges. Our teams work alongside leadership to drive growth, improve performance, optimize operations, strengthen supply chains, accelerate innovation, and create sustainable value in rapidly evolving and increasingly complex markets.

As semiconductor companies continue to navigate technological innovation, capital-intensive investments, supply chain complexity, and evolving customer demands, AlixPartners is seeking a Partner with a strong track record serving semiconductor, electronic equipment, electronic components, and broader high-tech clients, coupled with deep expertise in supply chain transformation and operational performance. This Partner will help clients navigate challenges across the semiconductor value chain, improve supply chain resilience and efficiency, optimize capital-intensive operations, enhance product and technology development processes, and unlock sustainable competitive advantage. They will also play a key role in expanding AlixPartners' capabilities and market presence across the semiconductor and broader high-tech ecosystem.

These leaders are recognized experts in their respective fields, using their skills and experience to build measurable, better outcomes for our clients. You will be the primary contact for our clients, leading projects and client engagements on the ground, analyzing corporate performance, driving cost reductions, revenue growth and profitability improvement when it matters. As part of our collaborative team, you will have the opportunity to achieve exceptional results in our high energy environment, with continuous opportunities to pursue your professional development, career interests, and growth aspirations.

This is a full time Partner position in the Americas. Relocation assistance is not available.

The following is an example of the requirements and expectations of a Partner at AlixPartners, not an exhaustive list of required activities, duties or responsibilities.

What you’ll need

  • Minimum 18+ years of consulting experience or equivalent experience in the TMT industry.
  • 5+ years of TMT consulting experience in a professional services Firm environment preferred.
  • Deep expertise in the semiconductor industry, electronic equipment, electronic components, electronic contract manufacturing, or broader high-tech sectors.
  • Proven experience across the semiconductor / high-tech value chain, with a strong understanding of product development, sourcing, manufacturing, supply chain, and operational performance.
  • Significant experience leading large-scale supply chain transformation initiatives, with particular emphasis on capital-intensive operations, network design, manufacturing, capacity planning, and supply chain resilience.
  • Demonstrated expertise in high-tech supply chain management, digital supply networks (DSN), and end-to-end operational transformation.
  • A solid track record of building and developing new client relationships with public, private and private equity backed organizations which lead to successful client engagements.
  • Proven ability to identify opportunities to deepen client relationships and ways in which we can support clients based on one’s expertise, leadership, and outstanding results on engagements.
  • Track record leading business development and working in collaboration with C-Suite, funds, and financial institutions.
  • Proven track record in leading all aspects of engagements, such as restructurings, liquidations, receiverships and judicial managements.
  • Can run day-to-day operations of a project, navigate disruption, manage project commercials and staffing, and mitigate risks on the project, in coordination with Partner & MD.
  • High energy style, flexible and adaptive, with the ability to work well in a very fast-paced environment.
  • Understands and adapts to complex client environments and situations. Skilled at defining, communicating, motivating and inspiring change at executive levels and across the broader community of stakeholders.
  • Views problems from the ‘big picture POV’, recognizing critical areas to drive into more detail. Quickly structures approaches to solve complex problems. Balanced and flexible, anticipates and changes direction as necessary.
  • Synthesizes information rapidly and applies good business discernment driving quickly to deep insights into possible impacts and solutions.
  • Articulate and persuasive communicator who commands the room, handles executive and difficult audiences well. Readily adapts style and message appropriately to audience and circumstance. Excellent at impromptu communication under pressure.
  • Extraordinary customer service and interpersonal skills. Engenders client confidence and trust with executives at all levels. Builds counseling relationships with clients and peers.
  • Analytical, adept at quickly defining, aligning and scaling data modeling & management approach with the client needs. Ensures 80/20 approach to rapidly draw conclusions. Skilled and quickly identifying anomalies, inconsistencies, errors and conclusions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering or foreign equivalent. Master’s degree and/or certification in related specialty area(s) preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Willingness to work outside of normal U.S. business hours, and in particular as unique projects/needs arise.
  • Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday.
  • Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners’ Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization.

The firm offers a comprehensive benefits program including health, vision, dental, disability, 401K, tuition reimbursement, identity theft protection, and mental wellness support. Employees will also receive a generous paid leave policy including vacation/personal time starting at 7.34 hours per pay period, sick time up to 80 hours annually, parental leave and twelve holidays.

The salary range for this role takes into account a number of factors and is between $230,000/year - $410,000/year with potential eligibility for an annual discretionary bonus.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or disability. title: SOCIAL- OG SUNDHEDSASSISTENTELEV MED TILSKUD - forventet start 11.01.2027
description:
Om jobbet:
Er du allerede uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper, men drømmer om at uddanne dig til social- og sundhedsassistent, så har du nu mulighed for at søge om at tage uddannelsen med et tilskud til elevlønnen. Dette er muligt så længe, der fortsat er midler til det i puljen jf. den indgåede aftale med FOA.

For at kunne få tilskud til elevlønnen skal disse betingelse være opfyldt:

  • at du er uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper
  • at du umiddelbart op til uddannelsesstart har mere end 2 års sammenhængende ansættelse i enten Sundhed og Omsorg eller Sociale Forhold og Beskæftigelse i Aarhus Kommune
  • at du er bevilget orlov til uddannelse som social- og sundhedsassistent
  • at du søger via dette interne opslag om en uddannelsesaftale med Aarhus Kommune til merit-uddannelse som social- og sundhedsassistent.
Som SOSU i Aarhus er du medskaber af det vigtigste i verden: At gøre en forskel i et andet menneskes liv. Bliv en vigtig del af livet i Aarhus - bliv SOSU.

Du kommer til at arbejde med en professionel og helhedsorienteret sygepleje og rehabilitering i det nære og sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen.
Uddannelsen består af både skole- og praktikperioder. Skoledelen foregår på SOSU Østjylland.

Vi tilbyder et spændende uddannelsesforløb med:

  • Professionelle og engagererede praktikvejledere og kolleger, der sammen sørger for at du under dit praktikforløb modtager velkvalificeret vejledning og udvikler de nødvendige kompetencer.
  • Tværfagligt samarbejde med andre sundhedsfaglige grupper.
  • Mulighed for DigiTech
  • Gode muligheder for job efter endt uddannelse.
En elevstilling i Danmarks andenstørste kommune giver mange udviklingsmuligheder både under uddannelse og efterfølgende. Du kan f.eks. bruge uddannelsen som springbræt til bl.a. sygeplejerske, fysioterapeut eller ergoterapeut.

Din profil:
Du skal have bestået social- og sundhedshjælperuddannelsen.

Som elev i Aarhus Kommune forventer vi, at du har lyst til at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt. Du kan lide at arbejde med mennesker, og du ønsker at gøre en forskel for andre.

  • Du trives med udvikling og læring, har en positiv indstilling til andre mennesker og evner at indgår i et konstruktivt samarbejde.
  • Det falder dig naturligt at reflektere over din faglige og personlige udvikling.
  • Du har ressourcerne til at bevare ro og overblik i en til tider hektisk hverdag.
  • Du er indstillet på at arbejde hen imod at være en central professionel og autoriseret sundhedsperson.
Vi lægger vægt på dine formuleringsevner, punktlighed, interaktion med andre og din evne til at reflektere.

Ansøgning:
Ansøgningsfrist er den 18.10.2026. Der kan ikke søges efter ansøgningsfristens udløb.
Klik på ”søg stillingen” for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes.

Inden du udfylder skemaet, skal du have følgende dokumenter klar:

  • Opdateret CV– Du skal bruge denne skabelon, og uploade til din ansøgning CV skabelon
  • Din motiverede ansøgning
  • SOSU-hjælperbevis
  • Dokumentation på godkendelse til orlov fra nærmeste leder
  • Dokumentation på standpunkts- eller eksamenskarakter
  • Realkompetencevurdering (RKV), hvis du har en. Har du ikke en RKV, så skal du ikke foretage dig yderligere
  • Er du ikke dansk statsborger, skal du vedhæfte din opholdstilladelse eller seneste bekræftelse fra Udlændingestyrelsen på ansøgning om ophold
I din motiverede ansøgning skal du skrive (max. 1 side), hvor du besvarer følgende spørgsmål:

  1. Fortæl kort om dig selv, og hvad du er god til
  2. Hvad har motiveret dig til at søge denne uddannelse?
  3. Hvordan kan dine erfaringer gavne dig i uddannelsesforløbet?
Til samtalen vil vi tale om de ting du har skrevet i din ansøgning. Herudover vil vi komme ind på overvejelser om arbejdstider og balancen mellem arbejds- og privatliv.

Først når du har modtaget kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Vi forventer at afvikle jobsamtaler i uge 46.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Stillingen ønskes tiltrådt 11.01.2027.
Din ugentlige arbejdstid er gennemsnitlig 37 timer, hvor du primært vil arbejde i dagvagter samt enkelte weekendvagter og eventuelt aftenvagter.
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst. Du får elevløn under hele uddannelsesforløbet. Er du over 25 år ved uddannelsesstart får du voksenelevløn.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til Uddannelsesteamet på mail: udd-team@mso.aarhus.dk eller på telefon 51576616. Telefontid er mellem klokken 9-12.

I Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg har vi en generel politik om, at der ved ansættelser indhentes referencer og evt. straffeattest. Du må derfor forvente at blive anmodet herom, hvis vi tilbyder dig stillingen.
Vi gør opmærksom på, at der i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen vil blive foretaget opslag i vores referenceregister. Referenceregisteret omfatter tidligere medarbejdere i Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg, der er blevet bortvist grundet væsentlig misligholdelse af ansættelsesforholdet.

Om Sundhed og Omsorg og Aarhus Kommune:
Sundhed og Omsorg (MSO) i Aarhus Kommune arbejder med omsorg for ældre og sundhed for alle borgere.

Aarhus Kommune betragter mangfoldighed som en ressource og opfordrer derfor alle - uanset alder, køn, handicap, livsstil, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold - til at ansøge stillingen.
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus til en god by for alle. Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Checkpoint Aalborg søger timelønnet rådgiver
description:
Kan du skabe et trygt rum fuld af positiv energi? Og kan du tale fordomsfrit om køn, krop, seksualitet og sex? Så kan vi bruge dig som rådgiver i Checkpoint.

I Checkpoint arbejder vi med forebyggelse, test og rådgivning. Vores målgrupper er unge mellem 15 og 29 år, LGBT+ personer, og personer i risiko for hiv. Vi tilbyder test for hiv, syfilis, hepatitis C, klamydia og gonorré samt rådgivning og samtaler om sexsygdomme og seksuel sundhed i trygge rammer.

Checkpoint er en del af AIDS-Fondet og vi har klinikker i hele landet. Vi søger en rådgiver, der kan starte medio september 2026, og har lyst til at blive en del af vores lille team i Checkpoint Aalborg.

Dine opgaver i Checkpoint:

  • At teste og rådgive vores brugere.

  • At bidrage til kvalitetssikring og udvikling i Checkpoint.

  • At deltage i supervision, personalemøder og uddannelsesdage, hvor vi sammen bliver klogere.

Det vi forventer af dig:

  • At du er god i samtalen og formår at skabe et trygt rum for brugerne i Checkpoint.

  • At du har interesse for seksuel sundhed, forebyggelse og rådgivning.

  • Du er måske i gang med en sundhedsuddannelse eller anden relevant uddannelse.

Dette er ikke et krav, da vi lægger vægt på, at du har kompetencer inden for rådgivning og samtale.

  • Du er struktureret og har et godt overblik.

  • Anvender dansk og engelsk som arbejdssprog.

Stillingen er oplagt som studiejob, da vagterne i Checkpoint er mandage og tirsdage fra kl. 15:45-18:45. Vi forventer at du kan tage cirka 3 vagter om måneden. Stillingen er aflønnet.

Checkpoint Aalborg har lokaler i Jernbanegade 14, 9000 Aalborg.

Om Checkpoint

Vi sørger for at du kommer godt fra start, og du vil derfor indgå i et oplæringsforløb med løbende sparring og supervision. Derudover vil du blive en del af et fællesskab på ca. 60 Checkpoint-medarbejdere, der mødes en gang årligt til uddannelsesdag.

Du kan derfor forvente en arbejdsplads med højt til loftet og frihed under ansvar. Du kommer til at arbejde i et miljø præget af god trivsel og godt humør, en uformel omgangstone, og stor faglighed og professionalisme i relation til kernemålgrupper og vision.

Du kan læse mere om os her: Seksuel sundhed for dig - Checkpoint

Ansøgning:

Send din ansøgning og CV senest torsdag den 27. august.

Ansøgning og CV sendes på mail til job@aidsfondet.dk Skriv “Checkpoint Aalborg” i emnefeltet.

Vi forventer at holde samtaler onsdag den 2. september.

Du kan få yderligere oplysninger ved at kontakte klinikansvarlig Louise Petersen på tlf. 88 33 56 12 eller på mail: louisep@aidsfondet.dk

title: Physical Therapy Aide - Gilbert (East), AZ
description:

At Athletico, we believe in the power of support – because a little help can lead to extraordinary achievements. Physical therapy isn’t just about recovery; it’s about transformation. Our team thrives on providing life-changing care for our patients, and we know that achieving this begins with taking care of our own.

Our mission is simple yet powerful: Extraordinary people improving lives.

Position Summary: The Rehabilitation Aide (equivalent to rehabilitation technician and physical therapy aide positions) will assist the Patient Experience Coordinator and clinicians by performing requested administrative and clinical duties. They will greet patients as they arrive to the clinic and work alongside the physical therapists as well as the physical therapist assistants during patient treatment. These duties will be conducted in compliance with state practice act requirements.

title: Timelærer til Akademiuddannelsen i Ledelse
description:
Vil du være med til at uddanne fremtidens ledere til det danske arbejdsmarked – og brænder du for at formidle faglighed i spændingsfeltet mellem teori, metode og praksis? Så er det netop dig, vi står og mangler.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være undervisning, vejledning og eksamination af studerende på Akademiuddannelsen i Ledelse.

Du kan læse om uddannelsen her Akademiuddannelsen i Ledelse

Din profil

Som underviser på Akademiuddannelsen i Ledelse er det afgørende, at du formår at omsætte dit fagområdes teorier og metoder til praksisnær undervisning. Med udgangspunkt i læringsmålene skal du kunne koble fagmodulernes indhold til de studerendes hverdag og behov, så undervisningen bliver både relevant og udbytterig.

Da målgruppen er sammensat, er det vigtigt, at du kan tilpasse din undervisning til forskellige typer af studerende. Du skal selvstændigt kunne udvikle, tilrettelægge og justere dine læringsaktiviteter, så de matcher de studerendes forskellige udgangspunkter og behov.

Derfor ser vi gerne, at du:

  • har stærke og dokumenterede underviserkompetencer inden for ledelse, gerne fra en formel uddannelseskontekst og solid erfaring med vejledning af studerende i forbindelse med opgaver og eksamener.
  • har solid ledelsesteoretisk viden og relevant praksiserfaring fra et lederjob – og kan kombinere viden og erfaring.
  • er en dygtig kommunikator – både mundtligt og skriftligt.
  • er en stærk facilitator og mødeleder.
  • har gode digitale kompetencer.
  • har kvalifikationer på min. diplom eller bachelorniveau.

Ansættelse

Du bliver ansat den 1. oktober 2026 eller efter aftale.

Ansættelsen som timelærer kan maksimalt være 3 år og den årlige arbejdstid kan ikke overstige 500 timer. Det konkrete antal timer samt opgaver aftales før hvert semester.

Opgaverne afhænger af antallet af tilmeldinger for hvert semester. Dit samlede timeforbrug vil typisk ligge på 300-500 timer om året. Da undervisningen foregår på en deltidsuddannelse, skal du være indstillet på, at timerne planlægges over hele hverdage.

Ansættelsen er tidsbegrænset i op til 3 år og sker i henhold til Cirkulære om overenskomst for eksterne lektorer og timelærere ved professionshøjskoler, Danmarks Medie- og Journalisthøjskole, erhvervsakademiker og maritime uddannelsesinstitutioner m.fl. under Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet (Akademikernes forhandlingsområde) eller Cirkulære om overenskomst for eksterne lektorer og timelærere ved professionshøjskoler, Danmarks Medie- og Journalisthøjskole og erhvervsakademiker m.fl. under Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet.

Dit primære arbejdssted vil være UCL, Seebladsgade 1, 5000 Odense C. Arbejdsstedet kan dog variere, da vi varetager opgaver i hele UCL's dækningsområde i Region Syddanmark samt på UCL's øvrige matrikler, herunder på Boulevarden i Vejle.

Vil du vide mere?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte uddannelsesleder Jon Bloch Skipper på mail jbsk@ucl.dk og telefon 2025 3628.

Ansøgning

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send os din ansøgning, CV, dokumentation for uddannelse og erfaring samt andre relevante bilag senest fredag den 28. august 2026. Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 37.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Senior Associate, Solvency and Capital Reporting
description:
Fortitude Reinsurance Company Ltd. (Fortitude Re) is one of the world’s leading providers of legacy reinsurance solutions. They work with the world’s leading insurance companies to help them execute comprehensive, transformational solutions for legacy Life & Annuity and P&C lines. Fortitude Re manages a general account of approximately $111 billion across life, annuity, and property & casualty insurance products. The company takes a long-term view on growth and is proud to be backed by a consortium of sophisticated institutional investors led by The Carlyle Group and T&D Insurance Group. Incorporated under the laws of Bermuda on January 1, 2017, Fortitude Re’s roots in the insurance industry and the experience of their leadership go back many decades. Fortitude Re’s leadership team has an average industry tenure of over 20 years, and an impressive track record of successfully managing the most complex legacy liabilities. Their deep insurance experience and proprietary risk modeling capabilities allow them to structure bespoke transactions that benefit both insurance companies and their policyholders. Fortitude Re continues to strengthen its ability to pursue further growth and provide innovative solutions for the global insurance industry. Click here for more information about Fortitude Re.

The Senior Associate, Solvency and Capital Reporting candidate will be a member of the Fortitude Re Capital Management team, which serves the company by reporting and monitoring capital in alignment of regulatory reporting, strategic planning, and market expansion needs of Fortitude Re. The role will be a key team member, supporting the Economic Balance Sheet (EBS) and Bermuda Solvency Capital Requirements (BSCR) reporting. The position reports to the Bermuda-based Vice President, Solvency and Capital Reporting and is expected to work closely with departments across the organization including actuarial, accounting, investments and risk management teams. This role will be based in our Bermuda office on a hybrid basis.

What You Will Do:

  • Responsible for the preparation and peer reviews of the quarterly EBS and BSCR filings for Fortitude’s Group and Bermuda insurance entities.

  • Serve as a key member of the Solvency and Capital Reporting Team to other teams within the Company.

  • Work cross-functionally and collaboratively with finance, investments and actuarial teams for data needs and reconciliations to report and analyze solvency positions.

  • Lead the preparation of quarterly management deck slides to be presented to the executive committee to summarize results.

  • Prepare journal entries for the EBS general accounting system and reconcile/maintain reports to ensure the ledger agrees to reported results.

  • Perform quarterly analysis for changes to the solvency positions and key metrics for management review.

  • Support all finance and capital activities as part of the annual EBS and BSCR filings including, regulatory approvals and disclosures.

  • Interpret and explain regulatory rules to various internal functional areas and stakeholders.

  • Monitor and evaluate emerging developments with Bermuda statutory rules and regulations.

  • Execute controls and peer reviews as designed as part of the control framework and recommend/implement control improvements as necessary.

  • Assist with the maintenance of the control environment to meet the requirements as defined by the Company’s Internal Controls over Finance Reporting (ICFR) Program

  • Assist in the evaluation of new business and preparation of proforma BSCR filings and required documentation in order to execute new transactions.

  • Maintain accounting policy documentation regarding the company’s interpretation of the EBS reporting guidelines. Recommend and execute improvements as necessary.

  • The position will be located in the Fortitude Re office in Bermuda. Minimal travel is expected (0%-10%).

What You Will Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in accounting, mathematics, economics, or related fields.

  • Professional designation of CPA or equivalent.

  • 4+ years of experience, working within insurance or a Big 4 accounting firm, with concentration in capital reporting (Solvency II or BSCR) and Bermuda Monetary Authority filings.

  • Working knowledge of accounting and financial processes including risk and financial controls.

  • Working knowledge of investments and insurance products.

  • Excellent attention to detail, analytical skills, and the ability to adopt a creative approach to solving complex process problems.

  • Ability to manage multiple work assignments and meet time commitments.

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Life insurance experience is considered an asset.

#LI-Hybrid

At Fortitude Re, our strength has always come from our people. Our success is deeply rooted in our ability to embrace the unique attributes, perspectives and experiences of every individual within our company. Fostering a culture of inclusion and belonging where everyone—regardless of background, race, religion, sexual orientation or gender identity—feels valued and respected is a foundation of our culture.

We are committed to being an equal opportunity employer and evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, diversity of thought and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Check us out on YouTube: About Fortitude Re (youtube.com)

By submitting your application, you agree that Fortitude Re may collect your personal data for recruiting purposes. For more on how we handle your personal data, please review our Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: Endoscopy Tech
description:
Where You’ll Work

CHI Health Immanuel, located in North Omaha just off of I-680 on 72nd Street, offers a full-service hospital, cancer center, rehabilitation center, specialty spine hospital and more. For well over a century, our commitment to serve our community inspires our staff to provide the highest quality of care to all who we have the privilege to serve.

Job Summary and Responsibilities

As an Endoscopy Tech, you will provide crucial technical support during endoscopic procedures, ensuring patient safety and efficiency.Every day you will meticulously prepare, maintain, and sterile process endoscopy equipment, assist physicians during procedures, and prepare rooms while maintaining accurate documentation.To be successful, you will demonstrate strong technical proficiency, meticulous attention to detail in sterile processing, and collaborative skills in a fast-paced clinical setting, contributing to positive patient outcomes.

Performs endoscopy tasks and functions that are performed with other members of the endoscopy team that includes:

Performs tasks as directed by the physician and nurse during the procedure.

  • Performs duties according to department specific expectations as identified and assigned.

Job Requirements

  • High School Graduate General Studies or High School GED General Studies
  • Graduates who are willing to do on the job training with a structured competency regimen.
  • Basic Life Support - CPR

title: D425 Artificial Intelligence (AI) Program Representative
description:
Overview

Position Summary:

Electric Boat is seeking a self-starter who is highly organized, energized by new technology, and motivated by coordinating meaningful, cross-functional work. As an AI Program Representative, you won’t just administer our AI governance process; you’ll help scale it, strengthen it, and evolve it so the company can safely and effectively expand its use of artificial intelligence. You’ll partner closely with the AI Working Group, engineering teams, business functions, IT, and leadership to ensure that our AI initiatives are well structured, responsibly implemented, and aligned with enterprise strategies. If you enjoy coordinating multiple stakeholders, project management, building organizational processes, and working with emerging technologies, this role offers a unique opportunity to help shape the future of AI at Electric Boat. This role will support Groton Shipyard, New London and Quonset Point locations and require local travel.

Responsibilities:

The AI Program Representative will serve as the centralized point of contact and lead for a new AI Center of Excellence. Responsibilities include:

Scale and Strengthen AI Governance

  • Lead day-to-day execution of EB’s AI governance process, including intake, evaluation, prioritization, and risk assessment of potential AI use cases.
  • Identify gaps, inefficiencies, and bottlenecks and drive improvements that allow the governance process to scale effectively as AI adoption grows.
  • Maintain and expand governance materials including AI MDDs, risk evaluation templates, workflows, and guidance documents.
  • Promote responsible AI practices and ensure alignment with cybersecurity, data governance, and corporate policy.

Coordinate Projects and Keep Work Moving

  • Manage a growing portfolio of AI projects across shipyard, shipboard, design & engineering, and business operations domains.
  • Work with teams to define scope, understand data and technology requirements, and identify risks early.
  • Track schedules, budgets, milestones, and deliver consistent monthly updates to leadership.
  • Support resourcing by coordinating internal staffing and collaborating with external partners when applicable.

Connect Teams and Build Organizational Momentum

  • Serve as the central point of contact for AI-related coordination across EB.
  • Facilitate communication among engineering, design, IT, operations, and business functions to maintain alignment and clarity.
  • Support workforce development through mentoring, guidance, and helping integrate AI literacy into training conversations.

Drive Growth, Innovation, and Continuous Improvement

  • Help the company identify infrastructure, tooling, training, and process needs to support wider AI adoption.
  • Drive improvements to workflows, communication channels, evaluation criteria, and documentation that enable smoother scaling of AI initiatives.
  • Support departmental and enterprise-level improvement initiatives linked to responsible and effective AI adoption.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management or Business.
  • Minimum 5 years' of experience in engineering, data science, project management, software, or other technical coordination roles.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Security clearance through the Department of Defense

Preferred:
