title: Porter
description:
We have a fantastic Porter / Groundskeeper opportunity available!

Weinstein Properties, headquartered in Richmond, Virginia owns and manages over 60 apartment communities in Virginia, North Carolina, Texas, Tennessee, and Georgia. Still owned and operated by the Weinstein family after 70+ years, our continued success is attributed to our hands on approach to daily operations and our focus on the customer experience.

Location: The Bowery at Southside

Schedule: Monday – Friday 8am-5pm. 40 hours per week!

Pay: $16.50 per hour plus quarterly bonuses (several holidays off paid, even your birthday is a paid day off!)

Who should apply?

This role is ideal for someone who is reliable, detail-oriented, self-motivated, and takes pride in their work. Porters are essential members of our team, keeping our communities clean, beautiful, and welcoming. At Weinstein Properties, we do things differently. We invest in people, not just resumes. We believe in training talent from the ground up.

Ideal Characteristics of Successful Porters

  • Reliability & Punctuality: Shows up on time, dependable, and trustworthy.
  • Independence & Initiative: Works well independently, is a self-starter, and takes initiative to go beyond assigned tasks.
  • Attention to Detail: Notices issues proactively and maintains a clean, well-kept appearance of the community.
  • Strong Work Ethic: Keeps busy, completes tasks thoroughly, and doesn’t shy away from dirty or repetitive jobs.
  • Team Player: Communicates and collaborates well with maintenance and leasing teams; helps out when needed without hesitation.
  • Positive Attitude & Pride in Work: Takes pride in maintaining the property and contributes to community appearance.
  • Adaptable & Versatile: Willing to take on various responsibilities such as light painting, housekeeping tasks, or supporting maintenance as needed.
  • Growth Mindset: Open to learning new skills, with potential to grow into maintenance tech or other roles.

Things Candidates Should Know Before Starting

  • You will get dirty: Tasks include picking up trash, cleaning pet waste stations, trashing out apartments, and other potentially unpleasant (but necessary) duties.
  • Repetition is part of the job: Many tasks (like picking up litter and pet waste) are daily, recurring responsibilities.
  • Opportunity for Growth: Team members with a great attitude and willingness to learn can grow into more advanced roles in maintenance.
  • This is a physically demanding role:. This position requires prolonged periods of standing and walking while performing tasks, frequently lifting and carrying items weighing up to 50 pounds or more, using hand tools and operating equipment (including backpack blowers, power washers), operating golf carts/trailers, frequently bending and stooping for planting, weeding and maintenance of outdoor spaces, and working in conditions with loud noise levels at times. This position also requires working outdoors year-round in potentially inclement weather conditions (i.e. heat, cold, rain, humidity). The person in this position must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation.

Weinstein Properties is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
​
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Sr Software Engineer to join the Platform Ops team (Platform Engineering) and enable developer productivity by building and improving developer tooling and environments, and by improving other productivity tools around observability. Our team builds the shared systems and workflows engineers rely on every day—internal developer environments and self-serve tooling that makes the recommended way to ship changes the easiest way. This is a platform tooling role with a focus is on reusable capabilities and self-service workflows adopted across teams.

You’ll also help develop AI-based workflows for productivity and efficiency, including automation that improves infrastructure operations (for example, faster triage, automated runbook steps, and better self-service for common issues). You’ll prioritize the highest-impact problems by looking at where time is being lost today (slow builds, flaky tests, manual release steps, repetitive operational work) and turning that into concrete projects. You’ll set clear success metrics up front and use them to guide design decisions and rollouts.

Expect to partner closely with engineering teams to drive adoption, document changes, and iterate based on feedback. You’ll drive cross-team work across internal tooling, developer environments, observability, and reliability, focusing on measurable improvements (for example: shorter lead time, fewer incidents, and faster recovery). You’ll add automation and enable developer workflows across all three major cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and GCP).

Over time, you’ll own medium-sized projects end-to-end: identify the highest-friction workflows with partner teams, build and ship improvements, roll them out safely, and iterate based on adoption and measurable outcomes (for example: faster builds, fewer flaky tests, shorter time to debug, and less operational toil). You’ll collaborate closely with Platform Engineering, Release Engineering, Security, and product engineering teams to make improvements that are easy to adopt and maintain.

What You’ll Do

  • Build internal tools and services in Python and/or Go
  • Build tooling for our internal developer platform (self-service workflows, shared patterns, developer-facing interfaces)

title: ZOHO UI/UX Developer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a ZOHO UI/UX Developer based in Canada.

This role offers the opportunity to design intuitive and engaging digital experiences within a powerful business application ecosystem.
You will combine UI/UX expertise with technical knowledge to create solutions that improve usability and support business objectives.
Working closely with product and development teams, you will transform user needs into polished, functional interfaces.
The position requires creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to balance design principles with technical requirements.
You will contribute to improving workflows, enhancing user satisfaction, and delivering high-quality application experiences.
This is an ideal opportunity for a skilled UI/UX professional who enjoys working with low-code platforms and innovative digital solutions.

Accountabilities:

The ZOHO UI/UX Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing user interfaces and experiences across business applications. The role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that are visually appealing, functional, and aligned with user expectations.

  • Design and develop user interfaces and user experiences within the ZOHO ecosystem.
  • Create intuitive, efficient, and visually engaging application workflows that improve user interactions.
  • Collaborate with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into effective design solutions.
  • Develop prototypes, wireframes, and interface concepts using modern design tools.
  • Customize and enhance applications using ZOHO Creator, ZOHO CRM, ZOHO Desk, and related platforms.
  • Apply front-end development skills including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ZML, and ZOHO Canvas to create responsive experiences.
  • Ensure designs align with usability principles, business objectives, and technical capabilities.
  • Identify user experience challenges and propose creative, practical solutions.
  • Maintain high standards of visual quality, consistency, and attention to detail across interfaces.
  • Communicate design decisions clearly and collaborate effectively throughout the development lifecycle.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong UI/UX design capabilities with technical expertise in ZOHO applications and front-end technologies. They should be comfortable working independently while collaborating with product and engineering teams.

    • Proven experience designing user interfaces and user experiences for digital applications.
    • Strong proficiency with ZOHO Creator, ZOHO CRM, ZOHO Desk, and other ZOHO applications.
    • Solid knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ZML, and ZOHO Canvas.
    • Experience using prototyping and design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch.
    • Strong UI/UX design portfolio demonstrating creativity, usability, and attention to detail.
    • Ability to analyze complex requirements and create user-friendly solutions.
    • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain design concepts and decisions.
    • Strong problem-solving skills and a creative approach to overcoming design challenges.
    • Experience with low-code/no-code development platforms is preferred.
    • Familiarity with front-end frameworks such as React or Angular is a plus.
    • UI/UX design or ZOHO development certification is an advantage.

      • Benefits:

      • Flexible remote work opportunity.
      • Part-time position with adaptable working arrangements.
      • Opportunity to work on innovative business application solutions.
      • Exposure to UI/UX design, automation, and low-code development environments.
      • Collaborative work environment with product and technical teams.

description:

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. Role Description:

We are looking for an independent, dedicated Staff Machine Learning Engineer to join the Visual Computing Group (VCG) and contribute to redefining the world of game play and live streaming via advanced R&D. VCG’s mission is to design and deploy advanced neural networks and machine learning (ML) for game rendering and streaming systems of SIE that exceed the state-of-the-art in runtime efficiency, visual quality and latency.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Develop and improve core generative models for graphics and video processing for a variety of applications, such as live video streaming, game rendering, etc.
  • Research and prototyping of new methods for graphics or video enhancement, and data generation pipelines from generative models
  • Collaborate with team members on drafting publications and patent submissions
  • Participate and assist the team in core R&D work with other teams within Sony Interactive Entertainment

  • PhD or MSc in Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Graphics or a related field, or equivalent skills evidenced by work experience in the specific domain of the post
  • 7+ years of experience in demonstrable research experience in industry or academia
  • Strong background in: TensorFlow or PyTorch; Python and packages/libraries related to computer vision or graphics; evidenced by the development of advanced applications in image/video/graphics processing or computer vision (minimum 7 years),
  • Evidence of leading technical developments by several publications in top-tier conferences like CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, SIGGRAPH or similar

(i) neural network architectures, evidenced (for example) by knowledge of how to formulate and test advanced loss functions in neural network design;

(ii) design and test of advanced convolutional, recurrent, transformer-based, diffusion-based or other neural network architectures in a task-specific manner;

(iii) some experience in training, validation and evaluation of deep neural network models on large datasets, evidenced by experience in using Python libraries like HDF5 or similar

Some experience with 3D engines such as Unreal or Unity; in particular, generation of datasets, extraction of G-buffers, motion vectors, etc.

Our client is seeking an experienced Business Continuity Manager to build and lead an enterprise-wide Business Continuity Program from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity for a strategic, hands-on leader who enjoys creating structure, partnering across the business, and driving organizational resilience.

You'll work closely with executive leadership, IT, Risk Management, and operational teams to establish business continuity governance, develop recovery strategies, and ensure critical business functions remain resilient in a fast-paced, high-volume operational environment.

This role offers the opportunity to shape the organization's long-term continuity strategy while influencing key business decisions across multiple locations.

Responsibilities

  • Build, implement, and mature an enterprise-wide Business Continuity Program from the ground up.

  • Establish business continuity governance, policies, standards, and best practices.

  • Conduct Business Impact Analyses (BIAs) to identify critical business processes and recovery priorities.

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance business continuity plans across business units.

  • Partner with IT, Risk Management, Operations, and business leaders to align continuity strategies with organizational objectives.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to support disaster recovery planning and third-party resilience initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience conducting Business Impact Analyses (BIAs), developing continuity plans, facilitating continuity testing, and establishing program governance.

  • Proven ability to influence executive leadership and collaborate across IT, Risk Management, and business operations without direct authority.

Why You'll Love This Opportunity

title: Assistant Director of Multilingual Learners
description:
About Mastery:
Founded in 2001, Mastery Schools is a public charter network of 23 K-12 schools in Philadelphia and Camden, serving more than 14,000 students.
At Mastery, we’re on a mission to provide all students with the academic and personal skills they need to succeed after graduation and pursue their dreams. Student achievement is not just a goal for our organization; it's the reason we exist, and every member of our team is dedicated to securing student success. We are also committed to pursuing equity, actively disrupting systemic racism, and addressing the disparities that limit our students' choices.
Our culture is built on respect, service, and the belief that the success of our students, their families, and the communities we serve will help us achieve our mission. We foster a positive, open, and inclusive environment where honesty, humor, and continuous improvement are celebrated.
Join us in creating a model urban school district that serves all students with excellence. Together, we can make a lasting impact.

Position Summary:
The Assistant Director of Multilingual Learners (ADoML) will support Mastery Schools’ campuses in implementing and coordinating effective classroom instruction and initiatives for our Multilingual Learner population. The ADoML will play a pivotal role in bridging the work of the central office academic team with its implementation at the school level. In addition, the ADoML will ensure that timely and efficient data and information flow between schools and central office teams. The ADoML will have a variety of ongoing, individual projects, including teacher and leader coaching, professional development, coordination, data dissemination, and compliance project management. The ADoML will report directly to the Senior Director of Multilingual Education.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Coach Assistant Principals to develop their ESL teachers and ensure strong Multilingual Learner data driven supports across all settings
  • Coach ESL teachers to implement evidenced based teaching practices
  • Manage a team of centrally deployed Multi-Campus ESL teachers to provide services to Multilingual Learners in schools with small populations, including coaching and evaluation
  • Coordinate school to central office communication, developing efficient systems to collect feedback on network supports and strategy
  • Develop systems to ensure functional central office departments are informed of federal and state English Language Development policy and their implications on how Local Education Agencies (LEAs) serve their Multilingual Learner student population
  • Collect, analyze, and share out Multilingual Learner data from multiple Mastery campuses
  • Maintain accurate files and documents related to Multilingual Learners as required by federal and state policy
  • Research, purchase and/or develop classroom resources, curriculum and equipment specifically for classrooms and the needs of Multilingual Learners
  • Coordinate, develop and present professional development trainings for Multilingual Learner staff throughout the year, as well as onboarding and training at the beginning of the year
  • Provide school facing, family and community facing workshops – all intended to inform participants and the network on best practice, policy, and values of all stakeholders
  • Support schools in and develop Multilingual Learner programming for students with unique needs
  • Support schools in administering state mandated assessments to students across the network
  • Manage a variety of projects, inclusive of compliance related projects, at the school and network level, as needed
  • Other duties as may be required to ensure central office supports are effective and our schools and students are successful

    • Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated expertise in a variety of Multilingual Learner and Bilingual service models
  • Proven ability to use data-driven instruction to support student achievement
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Experience developing instructional and compliance manuals and other supplemental documents
  • Expertise in training others to implement research-based practices related to Multilingual Learners
  • Experience developing Language Instruction Educational Plans (LIEPs) and/or other state-mandated and content specific plans
  • Expertise of instructional strategies to promote language acquisition across content areas
  • Ability to interpret and communicate federal and state policy that holds implications on how LEAs serve students and their families
  • Be detail oriented and highly organized
  • Excellent listening, verbal, and written communication skills

    • Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required; Master’s degree preferred
  • A minimum of five (5) years of teaching experience in multilingual learner services is required.
  • Experience providing instructional coaching, feedback, and professional development to educators.
  • Previous people management or team leadership experience preferred.
  • Experience teaching in an under-resourced or underserved communities school setting is preferred
  • Experience working with school leaders and presenting workshops in the content area is preferred

    • Other Requirements:

  • Ability to physically perform the essential duties of the role as outlined above, and to work in the environmental conditions required, such as traveling to network campuses, monitoring and interacting with students, in-person facilitation of trainings, etc;
  • This role may require frequent travel between multiple locations. Reliable transportation is essential to fulfill job responsibilities

    • Salary and Bonus Information:

  • External candidates hired for this role are eligible for a $3,000 signing bonus as well as up to $5,000 for relocation expenses!
  • The Assistant Director of Multilingual Learners at Mastery can expect a starting salary between $96,000 to $107,500 based on education and experience, with opportunities for growth as your career progresses. Each offer is made in alignment with Mastery’s compensation philosophy and commitment to pay equity, ensuring fairness and consistency across our team.
    • Mastery's Benefits Package:
    We offer a full benefits program and opportunities for professional growth. Some of our most popular benefits include our 403(b) retirement plan for PA employees (with a 5% match from Mastery for full-time employees), enrollment in the State of New Jersey Pension Plan for NJ employees, a robust Employee Assistance Program, mental health and counseling programs, an annual Professional Development Fund, and discounts and perks at a myriad of retailers, travel organizations, insurance providers, and so much more, as well as access to the HealthAdvocate Helpdesk to help you navigate various benefits-related topics. Please go here to see all of our Benefits offerings!

    As you plan to make Mastery your new work home, please feel free to review our calendar here. We like to think our calendar is a benefit of working here too!

Mastery may consider an equivalent combination of knowledge, skills, education, and experience to meet minimum qualifications. title: Smed til hydraulik og maskinmontage i Randers NØ
description:
Er du smed og vil du have ordentlig løn og fast værkstedshverdag?

Vi mangler en smed til hydraulik og maskinmontage i Randers NØ.

Du lander på et produktionsværksted, hvor smedearbejde, bearbejdning og montage ligger tæt på hinanden. Opgaverne går primært mod industrien, og der arbejdes med alt fra enkeltdele til maskinmontage. Der er flere fagligheder omkring dig i hverdagen, så du bliver en del af et hold hvor tingene bliver løst i fællesskab.

Du skal kunne tage fat i forarbejdet, få emnerne gjort klar og være med når hydraulik og montage skal spille. Det er en stilling for dig der kan lide værkstedshverdag, hvor præcision og praktisk problemløsning fylder mere end fine ord.

Det får du

Løn: 205-240 kr. i timen

Arbejdsområde: Randers NØ

Kolleger: Cirka 45 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Forarbejde, hydraulik og maskinmontage

Din hverdag

Du får emner ind til forarbejde, bearbejder dem og sender dem videre til montage eller tager selv del i monteringen. Når hydraulik fylder, handler det om at få komponenter og maskindele til at passe sammen, så næste trin ikke står stille.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Klargør og bearbejder emner før montage
  • Arbejder med hydraulik og maskinmontage
  • Svejser og monterer emner i rustfrit stål og aluminium
  • Skærer, bukker og tilpasser metaldele i produktionen
  • Reparerer og vedligeholder tekniske anlæg og maskindele

Hvis noget ikke passer i første hug, siger du til og får det løst sammen med folkene omkring dig. Det er værkstedshverdag for en smed der hellere vil have hænderne i emnerne end snakke om dem.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 3 års erfaring som smed
  • Har kørekort
  • Kan arbejde sikkert med forarbejde, bearbejdning og montage
  • Trives i et værksted hvor opgaver løses i hold
  • Møder stabilt og siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet hydraulik eller maskinmontage før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan tage ansvar for dit arbejde og få tingene gjort ordentligt.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Tag fat nu - vi skal bruge en smed mere i Randers NØ, og det kunne sagtens være dig.

description:

We have an exciting opportunity for a full-time, Unit Secretary to join Ramapo Ridge. Ramapo Ridge is a 58-bed inpatient psychiatric hospital licensed by the State of New Jersey and accredited by The Joint Commission (TJC). The Unit Secretary will be responsible for the clerical functions in the unit and acts as a receptionist. The purpose of this position is to assist the Charge Nurse in the smooth functioning of the unit. The Unit Secretary supports the unit philosophy and works collaboratively with the Charge Nurse, Executive Assistant and the Nurse Executive. Must have the flexibility, personal integrity and be able to work effectively with personnel from all departments. Demonstrates an understanding of, and embraces, the mission statement of Christian Health.

Competencies:

  • Ensures that all visitors identify themselves and signs in the visitors in the Log Book.
  • Follows established safety precautions in the performance of all duties.
  • Monitors, searches and records all packages brought to and leaving the unit.
  • Ensures that the daily time schedules correspond to the N.O. schedules and takes corrective action.
  • Maintains an appointment book and ensures that the scheduling is done in a timely fashion.
  • Ensures that all visitors are monitored prior to entering the unit.
  • Ensures there are new charts for prospective patients to be available 24 hours a day.
  • Meets with the Charge Nurse or her designee on a daily basis to plan for the day.
  • Operates equipment in a safe manner.
  • Ensures that ordering is done prior to staff running out of supplies and equipment on appropriate ordering forms.
  • Catalog and non-catalog orders are done in a timely manner within the budget allotments.
  • Ensures that the refrigerator has been checked for outdated supplies and undated open containers and are disposed of.
  • Ensures that there are par level supplies on Level 2 at all times.
  • Ensures that there is coordination of patient appointments with other departments and works with the RRPH driver.
  • Makes the required changes on the communication and patient boards.
  • Ensures that messages are taken clearly and are logged for the appropriate person.
  • Adds to the Census Book all admissions and discharges for each 24 hours.
  • Charges the appropriate supplies, treatments, on the wand system.
  • Checks the Census Sheets and the Census book and ensures that they correspond.
  • Before leaving the work area at the end of the day, stores all equipment and supplies appropriately.
  • Refers calls to appropriate persons while maintaining patient confidentiality.
  • Follows established non-smoking regulations.
  • Writes up the escort and transport requisitions recording the length of the escort, time of day, and the number of staff accompanying the patient.
  • Transcribes the appointments and consultations onto the Communication board.
  • Maintains the confidentiality of all patient care information.
  • Ensures that there are sufficient supplies in the refrigerator and in the dining room for the number of patients on the unit for the next 24 hours and for the weekends.
  • Answers the telephone promptly identifying the facility, unit, and the name of the person answering.
  • Works collaboratively and under the supervision of the Executive Assistant on daily and weekly time sheets.
  • Utilizes equipment that one is trained for.
  • Assists the Charge Nurse or her designee in tabulating the acuity system and delivers the information by the specified time.
  • Checks the Treatment Room and Clean Room each day to ensure supplies are present.
  • Maintains Sign-Out sheets for patients.
  • Attends ongoing education in the area of Unit Secretary.
  • Attends and participates in the mandatory in-services.
  • Reports any infectious diseases or contacts to the Employee Health Nurse.
  • Can identify the whereabouts of the Safety Manual.
  • Reports safety violations.
  • Knows the location of MSDS Manual.
  • Makes out maintenance work orders under the direction of the Charge Nurse and ensures that they have been signed by the Nurse Executive.
  • Participates in the Unit-Based Quality assessment duties.
  • Can identify the whereabouts of Exposure Plan, Infection Control, Fire & Disaster Plans.

Schedule: 3:00pm-11:00pm, Monday - Friday, no weekends.

title: Project Superintendent
description:
More information about this job

Overview

The Superintendent will direct activities of workers concerned with construction of buildings, dams, highways, pipelines, or other construction projects by performing their duties personally or through subordinate supervisors. Responsible for the overall direction, coordination and evaluation of units. Confers with and directs supervisory personnel and subcontractors engaged in planning and executing work procedures, interpreting specifications, and coordinating various phases of construction to prevent delays. Expected to be a dedicated and available employee. Must learn and understand all safety hazards related to the work and learn to safely and effectively use or operate work related tools and equipment. Will be required to work in a plant operations or construction jobsite setting.

Responsibilities

*The following are intended as general illustrations of the work in this job class and are not all-inclusive for this position.

  • Preserve profit
  • Implement company safety policies
  • Study specifications to plan procedures for construction on basis of starting and completion times and staffing requirements for each phase of construction
  • Assemble members of organization (supervisory, clerical, engineering, and other workers) at start of project
  • Order procurement of tools and materials to be delivered at specified times to conform to work schedules
  • Confer with supervisory personnel and labor representatives to resolve complaints and grievances within work force
  • Confer with supervisory and engineering personnel and inspectors and suppliers of tools and materials to resolve construction problems and improve construction methods
  • Inspect work in progress to ensure that workmanship conforms to specifications and the adherence to construction schedule
  • Prepare or review reports on progress, materials used and costs, and adjusts work schedules as indicated by reports
  • Direct workers concerned with major maintenance or reconditioning projects for existing installations
  • Develop and maintain effective relationships with subcontractors, owners, designers, etc.
  • Assist project management in monthly cost projections
  • Conduct superintendent meetings
  • Hire and develop superintendents
  • Coordinate warranty work, punch out, vacations, and field coverage between all sites
  • Communicate between divisions
  • Coordinate with project management and area safety supervisors to manage accidents/incidents
  • Communicate and coordinate subcontractors to operate at the highest level and meet Cajun’s expectations
  • Assist other craft workers as needed

Qualifications

Physical

  • Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs., but may occasionally lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Hearing and comprehension is necessary for giving and receiving directions
  • Will need to perform sedentary to heavy work
  • Will operate office equipment of all types
  • Climb and maintain balance on steel/wood framework, stairs, ladders and scaffolds
  • Required to use hands to grasp, lift, handle, carry or feel objects on a frequent basis
  • Position may require prolonged bending/twisting, walking, reaching overhead, squatting, sitting or standing and lifting
  • Must be able to manipulate and traverse uneven terrain, ladders, and multi-floor buildings with no elevator
  • Must be able to walk on uneven surfaces, muddy conditions, loose rock, loose/soft sand, etc.
  • Will be exposed to adverse weather conditions (Heat, Cold, Rain, Etc.)
  • Vision requirements include close vision, distance vision, and ability to adjust focus
  • Ability to drive cars/trucks as needed

Mental

  • Must have the ability to communicate effectively with management/ supervision and field workers
  • Talking and reading & writing comprehension is necessary for giving and receiving directions to perform work and/or safety policy
  • Ability to use math/complete calculations
  • Work at various tempos, and concentrate amid distractions
  • Decision making skills necessary
  • Detail-oriented; must be able to remember, examine, and observe details
  • Strong time management skills
  • Requires strong leadership and motivational skills and ability to serve as a mentor

title: Sterilassistenter til Den Fælles Sterilcentral
description:
Vil du være med til at sikre, at Region Hovedstadens patienter bliver opereret til tiden med sterile instrumenter af højeste kvalitet?

Vil du arbejde i en af verdens mest automatiserede sterilcentraler sammen med engagerede og dygtige kollegaer?

Trives du med faste rutiner, høj kvalitet og et stærkt fællesskab på aftenvagt?

Så er det måske dig, vi søger som sterilassistent i Den Fælles Sterilcentral (DFS).

Om stillingen
Vi tilbyder en fuldtidsstilling i et spændende og udviklende miljø med fokus på kvalitet, flow og patientsikkerhed.

Stillingen er fast aftenvagt med arbejdstid kl. 15.00-23.00 og har tjenestested på Herlev matrikel.

Som ny medarbejder gennemgår du et struktureret oplæringsforløb, der kombinerer teori og praksis. Du bliver tilknyttet en mentor, som sikrer en tryg og grundig introduktion i de første 8 uger. Herefter er der mulighed for løbende kompetenceudvikling.

Kompetenceudviklingsforløbet indeholder blandt andet:

  • Fordybelse i genbehandlingsprocessen, herunder vask, pakning og sterilisering
  • Betjening af vaskemaskiner og autoklaver
  • Introduktion til automatisering (AGV'er, robotter m.m.)
  • Mikrobiologi og infektionshygiejne
  • Instrumentlære, pleje og vedligeholdelse
  • Dokumentation og sporbarhed via T-DOC
  • Dokumentation af afvigelser
  • Grundlæggende operationsforståelse
  • Arbejdsmiljø og sikkerhed
Om dig
Vi søger en kollega med enten sundhedsfaglig eller teknisk baggrund, for eksempel:

  • Operationstekniker
  • SOSU-assistent
  • Tandklinikassistent eller tandtekniker
  • Industrioperatør
  • Erfaring fra medicinalindustrien, levnedsmiddelproduktion eller lignende kvalitetsstyrede miljøer
Det vigtigste er, at du er grundig, kvalitetsbevidst og har lyst til at lære.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • er motiveret for at indgå i et længerevarende læringsforløb
  • har IT-kendskab på brugerniveau
  • har teknisk flair og forståelse for automatiserede processer
  • har forståelse for kvalitetsstyrede arbejdsgange
  • arbejder struktureret og har god ordenssans
  • kan fordybe dig i opgaverne
  • trives i teams og samarbejde på tværs af faggrupper
  • behersker mundtlig og skriftlig dansk
Om os
Den Fælles Sterilcentral består af to identiske enheder, én på Rigshospitalet og én på Herlev matrikel. Sammen forsyner vi hele Region Hovedstaden med sterile kirurgiske instrumenter.

I DFS genbehandler vi kirurgiske instrumenter i et tæt samspil mellem manuelle og fuldautomatiske processer. Avanceret robotteknologi betyder, at vores sterilcentraler er blandt de mest automatiserede i verden.

Sektion for Genbehandling varetager alle genbehandlingsprocesser i DFS. Sterilassistenterne håndterer dagligt mange forskellige instrumentbakker samt betjener maskiner og anvender IT-systemer, der er nøje tilpasset det enkelte udstyr.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Fast aftenvagt (15.00-23.00)

  • Fuldtidsstilling
  • Weekendvagt hver 4. uge eller efter aftale
  • Tjenestested: Herlev matrikel
  • Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt eller efter aftale
  • Røgfri arbejdsplads
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelse sker i henhold til nedenstående overenskomst. Startlønnen kan variere afhængigt af din anciennitet, erfaring, uddannelse samt arbejdsstedets geografiske placering.

Overenskomst:
Overenskomst vedr. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår for social- og sundhedspersonale - 32.03.1

Overenskomst for Specialarbejdere, faglærte gartnere, faglærte brolæggere, faglærte struktører, faglærte murere og instruktører/holdledere m.fl. ansat i regioner - 34.03.1

Stilling(er):
Sterilassistent

Udover startlønnen kan du have:

  • ret til tillæg efter lokale forhåndsaftaler.
  • ret til særydelser, fx tillæg for aften-, nat- og weekendarbejde.
  • mulighed for at forhandle individuelle tillæg afhængigt af stillingen samt din erfaring og dine kvalifikationer.
Vil du vide mere?
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Sani Iqbal
Enhedschef og Kvalitetschef for Produktionen

E-mail: sani.iqbal@regionh.dk

Sådan søger du
Send din ansøgning, CV og relevante uddannelsesdokumenter via linket i annoncen.

Der afholdes løbende ansættelsessamtaler, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

title: Project Manager – Application Development
description:

title: Product Manager, Your Private Chef
description:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the role

Your Private Chef is CookUnity's premium, personalized chef meal service, currently moving from pilot to scale. We're looking for a Product Manager to own YPC end-to-end and to also support the B2B product team as a generalist on other initiatives when needed.

Responsibilities

  • Own the YPC roadmap: subscriber personalization, wellness menu verticals (GLP-1, Everyday Wellness, Fitness Fuel, Healthy Heart, Blood Sugar Balance, Kids), and menu recommendation logic.
  • Own the chef and recipe pipeline: chef onboarding, recipe intake, tagging, and QA.
  • Work with kitchen and vendor partners on ingredient sourcing, costs, and kitchen tooling.
  • Manage pricing tiers (standard, premium, extra premium) and unit economics.
  • Support the B2B product team more broadly — Smart Fridges, partnerships, integrations — as a generalist when capacity is needed.
  • Bring structure to a fast-moving, early-stage product as it expands into new markets.

What success looks like

  • YPC has a clear backlog, fewer manual workarounds, and measurable improvements in retention and CSAT.
  • The chef/recipe pipeline scales without sacrificing quality or personalization.
  • Pricing and vendor economics are transparent and defensible as the product scales.
  • Teams have clarity on what we're building, why, and what success means.
  • Leadership trusts you with increasingly complex, cross-functional problem spaces.

What we're looking for

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager.
  • Comfortable owning a product end to end, from strategy to execution.
  • Strong communicator, works well across stakeholders, engineering, design, ops, and CX.
  • Business-minded: cares about retention, margin, and outcomes.

Strong plus

  • Passion for wellness, nutrition, or the food-is-medicine space.
  • Experience with subscription, personalization, or recommendation-driven products.
  • Experience with marketplace/vendor management or culinary/hospitality products.
  • Experience taking a product from pilot to multi-market scale.
  • Startup or high-growth environment experience.

Benefits

💸 Get paid in USD

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want

⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date

🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays

🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider

🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical

🐣 Paid Family leave

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises

🧘🏽‍♀️ Flexible benefits, your way: a prepaid card you can use on wellness, learning, food, and more.

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

  • Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.
  • We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.
  • We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

title: Security Specialist - Security Ops Analyst
description:
Overview

AMERICAN SYSTEMS is an employee-owned federal government contractor supporting national priority programs through our strategic solutions in the areas of Information Technology, Test & Evaluation, Program Mission Support, Engineering & Analysis, and Training.

Responsibilities

As The Security Specialist Security Operations Analyst, you will:

  • Apply structured analysis, business modeling, and process evaluation to improve security operations and leadership decision-making.
  • Examine workflows, workloads, performance data, trends, dependencies, and recurring issues across multiple security areas.
  • Develop analytical products that strengthen situational awareness, identify opportunities for improvement, and support planning, prioritization, and resource decisions.
  • By combining security-domain knowledge with quantitative and qualitative analysis, the Security Specialist Security Operations Analyst helps leaders understand operational conditions and evaluate potential courses of action.
  • Maintain defensible methods, communicates findings clearly, and tracks whether recommended changes produce the intended operational results.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Analyze security workflows, workload data, performance indicators, trends, and recurring operational issues.
  • Develop business models, simulations, scenarios, and other structured analyses to support security planning and decisions.
  • Evaluate process effectiveness and identify bottlenecks, control gaps, resource constraints, and improvement opportunities.
  • Prepare analytical reports, visual summaries, briefings, decision papers, and recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Maintain data sets, assumptions, methodologies, and supporting documentation used in recurring security analysis.
  • Coordinate with security specialists and operational teams to validate data, interpret findings, and assess practical effects.
  • Monitor implementation outcomes and measure whether approved process changes improve performance or reduce risk.
  • Provide timely analytical support for emerging requirements, leadership data calls, and operational planning activities

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree from an accredited college or university in a relevant discipline and 10 years of directly relevant experience; or a bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline plus 14 years of directly related work experience.
  • Specialized experience with business modeling and simulation
  • Specialized experience with flag-officer level briefings and senior-level interface
  • Three years’ general security experience
  • Experience must include support to Special Access Program and Sensitive Compartmented Information environments
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate effectively across Government, contractor, and external stakeholders; prepare briefings, reports, standard operating procedures, and official correspondence; and lead a team in fast paced classified environments.
  • Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility; must be able to meet any applicable Special Access Program eligibility requirements identified by the Government.

Pay Transparency Statement

AMERICAN SYSTEMS is committed to pay transparency for our applicants and employee-owners. The salary range for this position is USD $132,500.00/Yr. - USD $221,300.00/Yr. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors permitted by law. AMERICAN SYSTEMS provides for the welfare of its employees and their dependents through a comprehensive benefits program by offering healthcare benefits, paid leave, retirement plans, insurance programs, and education and training assistance.

title: Litigation Assistant
description:
At Morgan & Morgan, the work we do matters. For millions of Americans, we’re their last line of defense against insurance companies, large corporations or defective goods. From attorneys in all 50 states, to client support staff, creative marketing to operations teams, every member of our firm has a key role to play in the winning fight for consumer rights. Our over 6,000 employees are all united by one mission: For the People.

Summary

We are seeking a qualified Litigation Assistant to join our team. As a Litigation Assistant, you will be responsible for managing the law firm's day-to-day operations, including carrying out administrative services and supporting the legal team. This position's ideal candidate has a strong work ethic, exceptional problem-solving skills, and comfortable working in a fast-paced dynamic workplace.

Responsibilities

  • Perform administrative duties (scheduling calendar hearings and deadlines, organize case files, manage logistics)
  • Maintain pleadings and discovery indexes
  • Organize exhibits, documents, evidence, briefs, and appendices
  • Implement and improve upon administrative processes for more efficient workflow.
  • Collect, examine, and organize evidence and other legal documents for attorney review and case preparation
  • Draft and proofread correspondence and legal documents, such as pleadings and contracts
  • Research regulations, laws, and legal articles to assist with the preparation of reports, case files, and legal advice
  • Manage client billing by preparing, finalizing, and sending out bills, as well as resolving billing issues in cooperation with the billing attorney
  • Communicate with clients and witnesses to schedule meetings, interviews, and depositions
  • Manage, organize, and maintain documents in paper or electronic filing systems
  • Performs other related duties as assigned to meet the needs of the business

Qualification

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED) required
  • Associates degree in paralegal studies, a paralegal certificate, or a bachelor's degree is preferred
  • Bilingual English and Spanish (preferred)
  • At least 2 years of experience as an administrative assistant (preferably in a law firm or in a corporate legal department), legal assistant, legal secretary, or paralegal
  • Experience in Personal Injury, WC, Premises, or other injury related practice areas. (preferred)
  • Must possess the ability to multi-task, prioritize, handle a fast-paced environment, and manage workload with a great attitude and minimal supervision
  • Great written and communication skills, be proficient in calendar depositions, mediation, and hearings
  • Applicable knowledge of motions, discovery, evidence, litigation documentation, court rules, and procedures, practices, etc.
  • Highly organized with the ability to juggle multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong writing and communication skills along with attention to detail
  • Extensive computer and database expertise, Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and type no less than 35 wpm
  • Remote and/or hybrid not eligible

title: Chatbot Developer (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord) - Freelance
description:

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Bot Developer, you'll design, build, and refine messaging bots for one or more messaging platforms, including WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and similar platforms — for use cases such as customer service, appointment booking, order taking, content delivery, moderation, and automated notifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build bots for one or more messaging platforms, such as WhatsApp (Business API / Cloud API), Telegram (Bot API), Discord, Slack and similar messaging platforms.
  • Design and implement conversational flows, dialogue state, and fallback handling.
  • Integrate bots with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) for natural language responses where appropriate.
  • Connect bots to backend services, databases, CRMs, and third-party APIs (booking systems, payment, content sources).
  • Handle webhooks, rate limits, and platform-specific message formats (interactive messages, buttons, media, templates).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor bot implementations to improve correctness, reliability, maintainability, and graceful error handling.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, and recovery so bots stay healthy in production.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience backend, integration, automation, or bot development experience (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in bot development, messaging platform integrations, and building reliable conversational workflows. We are looking for specialists who can design and maintain production-ready bots, work confidently with APIs, webhooks, and backend services, and build stable, user-friendly bot experiences. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience building bots for at least one major messaging platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or similar) is required
  • Strong command of Python or Node.js for backend bot logic.
  • Solid experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and async request handling.
  • Experience with relational or NoSQL databases for storing conversation state and user data.
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and prompt design for conversational use is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of platform-specific limits, message templates, and approval flows (e.g., WhatsApp template messages).
  • Experience with hosting and deployment (Docker, serverless, VPS, or PaaS)

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to bot reliability — no silent failures, no broken flows.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to design and ship complete bots independently.
  • Portfolio or examples of bots you've built (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $30 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

We are committed to supporting your success in both your professional and personal lives.

Position Overview

QinetiQ US is seeking highly qualified ServiceNow Developer to assist with a critical Department of War client located in the Chantilly, VA area. Candidates should be willing to work onsite within a team of 4-6 developers to mentor, train and lead the implementation of crticial ServiceNow functions agency wide.

The ServiceNow Senior Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing complex technical solutions on the organization’s ServiceNow platform. This role acts as a primary technical subject matter expert, translating business requirements into scalable, efficient, and secure workflows and applications. The Senior Developer plays a critical role in mentoring junior developers, establishing coding best practices, managing advanced integrations, and ensuring the overall health and architectural integrity of the platform while operating within an Agile framework.

Responsibilities

Technical Solution Design & Advanced Development

  • Design, build, and customize ServiceNow applications and modules (e.g., ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM) using advanced scripting (JavaScript, GlideRecord, GlideSystem, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes).
  • Develop and enhance Service Portals using HTML, CSS, AngularJS, and Bootstrap.
  • Translate business concepts and functional requirements into robust, scalable technical designs and implementation plans.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement effective performance optimizations.

System Integration & Architecture

  • Architect and implement secure integrations between ServiceNow and external third-party systems using REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, and Integration Hub.
  • Maintain data integrity and mapping during integrations, ensuring optimal system performance and minimizing technical debt.
  • Assist in defining and maintaining the long-term architectural roadmap for the platform.

Code Quality & Mentorship

  • Conduct rigorous code reviews for peer and junior developers to ensure adherence to ServiceNow best practices, security standards, and internal guidelines.
  • Mentor and guide junior developers and administrators, fostering a culture of continuous technical learning and high-quality delivery.
  • Act as a technical escalation point for complex development challenges.

Change Governance & Deployment

  • Participate in the Configuration Control Board (CCB) as a technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) to evaluate the technical feasibility and impact of proposed changes.
  • Manage complex deployments using Update Sets, CI/CD pipelines, and ServiceNow Application Repository, ensuring smooth transitions from lower environments to Production.

title: Koordinerende arbejdsmiljøinspektør til Operativ Støttekommando i Brabrand
company: Forsvarsministeriet Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelsen ved Sødalsparken
description:
Har du stærke faglige visioner, og formår du at skabe resultater og følgeskab på tværs af en kompleks organisation? Operativ Støttekommando søger en visionær koordinerende arbejdsmiljøinspektør til en nyoprettet stilling i Sødalsparken i Brabrand ved Aarhus. Her får du en unik nøglerolle, hvor du gennem netværksledelse og faglig sparring skal harmonisere, styrke og strømline arbejdsmiljøindsatsen på tværs af vores underliggende myndigheder.

Om os

Operativ Støttekommando er en nyoprettet myndighed under Forsvarskommandoen. Kommandoens kerneopgave er, at sikre tværgående koordination og effektiv operativ understøttelse, inden for logistik, sundhed og vedligeholdelse.

Med den samlede ekspertise fra de fire underliggende myndigheder, sikrer Operativ Støttekommando, at Forsvarets operative enheder altid har den nødvendige støtte og de rette ressourcer til at løse deres opgaver – både i nationalt beredskab og i internationale operationer. Sammenhængen mellem effektiv understøttelse og operativ udførelse er vores kerneopgave og forudsætningen for Forsvarets kampkraft.

Vi har hovedsæde i Brabrand ved Aarhus, og stillingen som koordinerende arbejdsmiljøinspektør er placeret i Ledelsessekretariatet, som består af et forkontor, et sekretariat, et kommunikationsteam, samt garnisonens støtteelement.

Du vil blive en del af et nyt tværfagligt team, bestående af både civile- og militære medarbejdere, og sammen med dine nye kollegaer, får du mulighed for aktivt at sætte retningen og være med til at forme kulturen i afdelingen og i Operativ Støttekommando. Med vores forskellige fagligheder og ekspertiser, håndterer vi en bred vifte af opgaver, der alle bidrager til at sikre målrettet og kompetent støtte til den øverste ledelse.

Om stillingen

Som koordinerende arbejdsmiljøinspektør har du det overordnede faglige ansvar for, at binde arbejdsmiljøindsatsen sammen på tværs af de fire underliggende myndigheder og tjenester.

Da funktionen er ny, får du en nøglerolle i at opbygge- og drive et stærkt fagligt netværk. Du koordinerer indsatsen gennem faglig sparring, koordinering, processtyring og harmonisering af arbejdsmiljøarbejdet.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

  • Etablere og drive arbejdsmiljønetværk: Facilitere og lede et fast koordinationsforum for arbejdsmiljøinspektørerne ved Forsvarets Sundhedskapacitet, Forsvarets Vedligeholdelsestjeneste, Joint Movement and Transportation Organization og Forsvarets Forsyningstjeneste for at sikre erfaringsudveksling og faglig synergi.
  • Harmonisere og standardisere: Sikre ensartede standarder og metoder for APV-processer, risikovurderinger og ulykkesregistrering, på tværs af de fire enheder.
  • Sikre strategisk ledelsesrapportering: Opsamle, analysere og konsolidere arbejdsmiljødata fra enhederne, og omsætte det til ét samlet status- og trusselsbillede direkte som beslutningsstøtte til direktionen i Operativ Støttekommando.
  • Drive tværgående initiativer: Lede fælles, overordnede indsatser (f.eks. forebyggelse af arbejdsulykker, tværgående kemikalie- og logistiksikkerhed eller psykiske arbejdsmiljøkampagner).
  • Være bindeled til Forsvarets Center for Arbejdsmiljø: Sikre, at koncerndirektiver og overordnede strategier implementeres strømlinet og meningsfuldt i vores struktur.
  • Arbejdsmiljø i staben: Samtidig med den koordinerende funktion, får du mulighed for hands-on som arbejdsmiljøinspektør for staben i Operativ Støttekommando.
Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant akademisk uddannelsesbaggrund, kombineret med solid praktisk erfaring inden for strategisk arbejdsmiljøarbejde. Derudover vægter vi følgende kvalifikationer højt:

  • Erfaring med netværks- og matrixledelse: Du har dokumenteret succes med at lede og koordinere faglige specialister, der organisatorisk refererer til andre chefer. Du formår at skabe følgeskab via dialog, tillid og stærk faglig autoritet.
  • Gode relationelle kompetencer: Arbejdet foregår i tæt samarbejde med mange dele af Forsvaret, hvorfor evnen til at samarbejde på tværs og inddrage relevante parter i opgaveløsningen er essentiel for at lykkes i stillingen. Du skal kunne navigere sikkert på tværs af organisatoriske niveauer, have stærke kommunikative evner og være god til at omsætte information til beslutningsstøtte.
  • Stærke analytiske og formidlende evner: Du kan gennemskue komplekse data, ulykkestendenser og lovkrav, og du formår at omsætte akademisk analyse til jordnære, handlingsorienterede indstillinger til en myndighedsledelse.
  • Gennemslagskraft og diplomati: Du navigerer ubesværet i et politisk og organisatorisk komplekst miljø og kan samarbejde på tværs af både civile- og militære strukturer.
  • Uddannelse: Du har gennemført den lovpligtige arbejdsmiljøuddannelse og har et dybtgående kendskab til arbejdsmiljølovgivningen. Kendskab til Forsvarets organisation eller logistiske strukturer er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
  • Proaktiv: Du bliver en del af nyoprettet myndighed og sektion, og det er derfor vigtigt, at du har en proaktiv tilgang og at du trives med at arbejde i et miljø, hvor ikke alt er fastlagt på forhånd, og hvor du selv er med til at forme arbejdsgange og processer.
Vi kan tilbyde en spændende og udfordrende nøglestilling i en af Forsvarets centrale kommandoer. Du får stor indflydelse på, at forme din egen hverdag og rammerne for den nye funktion. Din daglige arbejdsplads bliver i Sødalsparken i Aarhus (Brabrand), hvor du bliver en del af et professionelt og engageret arbejdsmiljø i moderne rammer.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademikeroverenskomsten).

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Arbejdsstedet er i Brabrand.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Kontakt og ansøgning

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Major Nicolai Falk Lauritsen på telefon 3266 5953.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Rasmus Kunzendorf på telefon 2926 3785 eller på mail pkom-rku@mil.dk.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 9. august 2026 og samtaler forventes afholdt i uge 34. Stillingen er til besættelse hurtigst muligt.

Du søger stillingen via linket, og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og kopi af uddannelsesbevis. Vær opmærksom på, at bilag skal tilføjes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Operativ Støttekommando

Operativ Støttekommando er en stab, der planlægger, koordinerer og delvist styrer logistiske operationer på tværs af Forsvaret og udvikler det logistiske område og set-up i takt med Forsvarets udvikling.

En række funktioner er centraliseret under staben, f.eks. koordination af lærlinge og elevuddannelser på tværs af Operativ Støttekommandos enheder, personaleadministration og kommunikationsområdet. Staben er primært placeret i Brabrand ved Aarhus.

Staben består af et Ledelsessekretariat, en Administrations- og Personelafdeling, en Logistik og C2IS afdeling, en Operationsafdeling, en Planlægningsafdeling, en Policy- og Uddannelsesafdeling samt en Efterretningssektion.

Operativ Støttekommando består, ud over staben, af fire myndigheder med egne, særegne opgaver: Forsvarets Vedligeholdelsestjeneste, Forsvarets Sundhedskapacitet, Forsvarets Forsyningstjeneste og Joint Movement and Transportation Organization.

title: Security Specialist - PERSEC LEAD
description:

AMERICAN SYSTEMS is an employee-owned federal government contractor supporting national priority programs through our strategic solutions in the areas of Information Technology, Test & Evaluation, Program Mission Support, Engineering & Analysis, and Training.

Responsibilities

As The Security Specialist PERSEC Lead, you will:

title: House Supervisor
description:
Position Summary:

The role of Community Living House Supervisor is responsible for the oversight of their assigned house within the Community Living department, the supervision of the house staff, providing direct support to the staff and supported people within those houses or areas and the coordination of services and aspects of the supported persons’ lives in their house.

In a manner consistent with supporting The Arc NCR Mission Statement the Community Living House Supervisor shall do the following:

  • Actively participate in hiring process to include interviews, career fairs, and new hire orientation.
  • Oversee staff training to ensure compliance to include annual training, CMT, Person Specific Trainings and Med Errors.
  • Ensure new staff are trained on IP’s and BSP’s within 2 weeks and signature sheet submitted.
  • Schedule and complete new employee peer training checklist and submit to HR.
  • Hold monthly team meetings and supervisions with all DSP staff.
  • Shadow/observe, coach, and give feedback to DSP’s while visiting homes. This includes reviewing start/end of shift, administering medications, morning/evening routines, etc.
  • 24/7 On call responsibilities from supported people, families, and staff.
  • Manage staff schedules, manage callouts coverage shifts when necessary.
  • Ensure all staff are trained on wheelchair accessible vehicles where applicable.
  • Collaborate with HR and Safety to review Drivers Alerts and ensure completion of next steps.
  • Review ICM daily for task completion, medication verifications and errors, and documentation is entered by end of shift.
  • Submit weekly paperwork every Monday by noon.
  • Complete and submit house inspections by the 5th of each month.
  • Support QE in investigations, staff for meetings, and house reviews.
  • Review and sign completed fire drill for accuracy no later than the 5th of the month.
  • Communicate with the Program Manager via phone call of any urgent care visits, hospitalizations, vehicle accidents, major staffing issues or concerns and police, fire or ambulance involvement or any calls to 911.
  • Seek support from HR regarding mediations, corrective actions, and terminations.
  • Timely response to emails from HR, Finance, QE, Psych, Development, DSP’s, and their AD/Director throughout the day.
  • Review communication book to ensure proper documentation and initial.
  • Review IP books to ensure Ips/PIP’s are present.
  • Review PMOF book in home to make sure that current PMOF and/or scripts are available.
  • Attend medical appointments as necessary.
  • Complete 45 Day Review within 2 weeks of the nurse’s visit and submit to the program manager and program specialist via email.
  • Ensure RMA’s and PMOF’s are filed correctly.
  • Ensure emergency packets are up to date with current PMOF’s and face sheets.
  • Confirm same day delivery of medications from pharmacy for hospital and urgent care discharges.
  • Review cycle filled medications monthly.
  • Review and sign off on all grocery receipts, PUF receipts (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, and special requests) to ensure funds were used appropriately and submitted by the designated due date.
  • Assist with spending of start-up funds for new supported persons.
  • Work with Benefits Manager to ensure that individuals attend Housing or SSA appointments.
  • Ensure all individuals ID’s are current.
  • Ensure Activity Plans are submitted at least two weeks in advance for planned activity and 30 days in advance for any vacations and proper documentation is attached.
  • Attend individual Pre-IP and IP meeting as necessary and ensure staff is trained on new IPs within 20 days after the IP meeting and signatures are submitted to the Advocacy Specialist.
  • Collaborate with day program staff when emergency issues arise.
  • Undertake other duties as assigned, including special projects and cross-program development.

title: Youth Sports & Fitness Coach (Hamilton County / Northside)
description:
Amazing Athletes is seeking a Youth Sports & Fitness Coach to join our team. Our company is the largest multi-sport enrichment program in the country, designed for children ages 2-12 years old to have fun through positive movement experiences, with a focus on meeting their motor-development milestones. Our instructors teach the fundamentals of 10 different sports in a non-competitive environment, while also incorporating lessons about nutrition and muscle groups to enhance motor skills and physical literacy.

As a Youth Sports & Fitness Coach, you will have the opportunity to work with children and help them develop their physical skills in a fun and supportive environment. You will be responsible for delivering sports lessons to children of all abilities and ages, which include soccer, hockey, volleyball, basketball, tennis, lacrosse, football, track and field, baseball, and golf. Additionally, you will be leading games, drills and obstacle courses that are designed to challenge and excite the children in each class. You do not have to have experience in any of these sports. We are not trying to develop the next pro athlete, we're trying to get kids excited about moving their bodies and development a love of sports and fitness.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a rapidly growing company that is dedicated to helping children develop a love for physical activity and healthy lifestyles. We've been in the Indianapolis area for over 20 years. We are a mobile company that travels to a school or center to provide the class.

AM programs tend to work with ages 2 - 6. Midday programs tend to work with 3 - 12. Afterschool programs are pre K - 2nd grade.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver high-energy, engaging sports lessons to children ages 2-12 years old
  • Teach the fundamentals of 10 different sports in a non-competitive environment
  • Incorporate lessons about nutrition and muscle groups to enhance motor skills and physical literacy
  • Lead games, drills and obstacle courses that are designed to challenge and excite the children in each class
  • Ensure the safety of the children during classes
  • Maintain a positive and fun learning environment
  • Communicate effectively with parents and guardians about their child's progress

Requirements

  • Experience working with children, preferably age 2 - 6, in a coaching or teaching capacity
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to engage children and keep them motivated and focused
  • Willingness to be flexible
  • Availability to work flexible hours.
  • Must have reliable transportation and be willing to drive up to 30 minutes to a site.

Benefits

Coaches are provided with all the training, equipment and coaches shirts to successfully teach a 30 - 35 minute class. For this class, pay ranges between $19 and 22 per class, depending on experience. Our coaches generally teach 15 - 30 classes a week, depending on their schedule and availability. We do have current openings at the higher end of this range of classes. We offer paid training, and on 1/1/27 you are eligible for our 3% match retirement plan.

title: Chatbot Developer (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord) - Freelance
description:

In this role, you'll use your bot engineering expertise, conversational design skills, and quality-focused approach to build reliable, useful bots and messaging integrations that deliver a great user experience. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience building messaging bots, working with platform APIs and webhooks, and implementing conversational logic.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Bot Developer, you'll design, build, and refine messaging bots for one or more messaging platforms, including WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and similar platforms — for use cases such as customer service, appointment booking, order taking, content delivery, moderation, and automated notifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build bots for one or more messaging platforms, such as WhatsApp (Business API / Cloud API), Telegram (Bot API), Discord, Slack and similar messaging platforms.
  • Design and implement conversational flows, dialogue state, and fallback handling.
  • Integrate bots with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) for natural language responses where appropriate.
  • Connect bots to backend services, databases, CRMs, and third-party APIs (booking systems, payment, content sources).
  • Handle webhooks, rate limits, and platform-specific message formats (interactive messages, buttons, media, templates).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor bot implementations to improve correctness, reliability, maintainability, and graceful error handling.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, and recovery so bots stay healthy in production.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience backend, integration, automation, or bot development experience (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in bot development, messaging platform integrations, and building reliable conversational workflows. We are looking for specialists who can design and maintain production-ready bots, work confidently with APIs, webhooks, and backend services, and build stable, user-friendly bot experiences. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience building bots for at least one major messaging platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or similar) is required
  • Strong command of Python or Node.js for backend bot logic.
  • Solid experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and async request handling.
  • Experience with relational or NoSQL databases for storing conversation state and user data.
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and prompt design for conversational use is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of platform-specific limits, message templates, and approval flows (e.g., WhatsApp template messages).
  • Experience with hosting and deployment (Docker, serverless, VPS, or PaaS)

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to bot reliability — no silent failures, no broken flows.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to design and ship complete bots independently.
  • Portfolio or examples of bots you've built (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $35 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.
