title: Revenue Cycle Associate
description:
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

Our Operations team is looking for a Revenue Cycle Associate. The Revenue Cycle Associate is responsible for ensuring the financial health of Talkspace through meticulous revenue cycle support. With a focus on organization and efficiency, they adeptly organize and process claims into the database, maintaining a high standard of accuracy. This includes keeping records of all processed claims and invoices to ensure compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and policies governing claims and billing.

In collaboration with internal team members, the Revenue Cycle Associate works closely to resolve billing issues, contributing to a streamlined process that facilitates efficient and accurate billing practices. Additionally, they foster collaboration among team members and various departments, ultimately contributing to the timely reimbursement and overall financial success of Talkspace.

What You'll Do

  • Revenue Cycle Support
    • Organize and process claims into our database, ensuring accuracy and efficiency.
    • Maintain accurate records of all claims and invoices processed.
    • Ensure compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and policies related to claims and billing.
    • Support a streamlined process for efficient and accurate billing.
  • Team Collaboration
    • Work closely with internal team members to resolve billing issues and ensure timely reimbursement for Talkspace.
    • Communicate effectively with team members and other departments.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

About You

  • Bachelor's Degree in accounting, finance, or related work-experience.
  • Experience with electronic claims processing and/or billing software.
  • Proficient in Google Suite
  • 2+ years of experience in billing and accounting is preferred.
  • Healthcare experience, experience with medical billing codes and terminology is preferred.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans
  • Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
  • 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%
  • Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
  • Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care
  • PTO and Remote First Environment
  • Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
  • Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The hourly rate for this role is between $22.00.

Why Talkspace

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We strongly encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

title: Full-Time Work Crew Supervisor
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Work Crew Site Supervisor

In Person at our New York City office

The Opportunity

Anticipated deadline to submit application: August 14th, 2026 before 12pm EST. Position may close early if application limit is met. Apply promptly for full consideration.

We’re looking for a Site Supervisor to help us live our mission to prepare people with recent criminal convictions for securing employment each year.

Site Supervisors support, supervise, and train work crews of 5-10 individuals, creating an uplifting work environment that ensures team member safety, providing on-the-job coaching, encouraging and empowering team members to seize each opportunity for building knowledge and skills, and balancing engagement and accountability across the crew.

This role is perfect for you if you enjoy a non-traditional workspace, like being on your feet, and love being outdoors. Ideally, you have experience teaching, coaching, mentoring or motivating youth or groups of adults as we know you’ll be able to make a real impact in our participants’ lives. You’ll help create greater stability for our participants as they get back on their feet.

Please note: Site Supervisor work hours are typically 7:00AM-3:30PM (M-F) with the work conducted outside in all weather conditions. Weekly overtime is built into the role.

Who We Are

The Center for Employment Opportunities (CEO) provides employment services to people recently released from incarceration. Across the United States, 8,000-9,000 people participate in CEO each year, transitioning to employment that supports themselves, their families, and their communities.

What began as a demonstration project of the Vera Institute of Justice in the 1970s to address employment barriers facing the formerly incarcerated following release in New York City has grown into the leading reentry employment organization in the country, where over 30,000 formerly incarcerated individuals have secured full-time employment since 1996.

Who You Are

  • You have strong organizational skills and can delegate, prioritize, and manage your team’s time effectively to meet project deadlines; you operate under pressure with ease
  • You pride yourself in your ability to communicate and resolve conflicts effectively with individuals of varying backgrounds and experiences. You recognize the value of continuous communication, looping others into project status and any arising challenges
  • You have a proven track record of leading teams to achieve success
  • You enjoy supporting others to solve routine challenges; personally you’re mechanically inclined, able to diagnose issues with equipment and propose solutions to solve/address
  • You’re deeply passionate about and committed to social justice
  • You’re respectful, fair, and patient
  • You believe in hard work, efficient and friendly customer service, and teamwork and collaboration to drive results
  • You exercise compassion toward the team you’re leading and balance this with a straightforward approach that ensures you meet the needs of your customers
  • You foster strong team spirit and enjoy providing 1:1 support to team members who may need a little extra encouragement

The Nitty Gritty Qualifications

  • Valid driver’s license with good driving record
  • Must be able to: Consistently lift and move objects up to 75 pounds; stand, kneel, bend, and climb in order to complete projects; work outdoors; walk or stand for long periods of time; drive a 12 passenger van with an attached trailer; operate a smartphone
  • Previous safety training preferable, though training will be provided to hired candidate

Additional Responsibilities

Key responsibilities of the Site Supervisor include but are not limited to:

  • Leading a work crew in public beautification projects: litter abatement, landscaping, and sometimes other projects.
  • Comply with company time and attendance (T&A) processes, which includes ensuring that participants accurately record their work time, ensuring that participants receive any required rest breaks and meal periods, and timely reviewing and approving participant time records on a daily basis.
  • Ensuring customers’ work orders are completed to a high standard on a daily basis
  • Establishing and maintaining positive staff morale through modeling sound leadership and teamwork
  • Assigning job duties to crew members and setting reasonable goals for completion
  • Monitoring crew members on job performance and productivity, providing appropriate feedback and/or additional training as needed
  • Maintaining line of sight of all participants
  • Maintaining a safe, secure, and healthy work environment by following and enforcing standards and procedures and complying with legal regulations and by reporting any matters that threaten the smooth operation of the training crew to your supervisor
  • Completing any necessary daily reporting tasks
  • Special projects and related duties as assigned

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $20.3297/hr. In an effort to be both equitable and transparent, CEO's compensation philosophy considers a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, internal equity, and home office location in making a final determination on our salary offer. Daily overtime is possible with a rate of $30.49455/hr.

We recognize that salary is a part of the overall compensation package and also provide a comprehensive benefits package, including medical and dental coverage, as well as professional development opportunities and training, including regular training opportunities in Motivational Interviewing (MI). MI is one evidence-based skill that reentry and human service professionals can utilize when supporting participants to achieve their goals.

We also offer paid parental leave, participation in a retirement plan, sick and vacation leave, paid holidays and more. We are a workplace that promotes continual learning and teamwork, offering lunch and learns, team outings, holiday gatherings and more for our staff.

More About Us

Center for Employment Opportunities believes that everyone deserves the chance to shape a stronger future for themselves, their families, and their communities. People who are justice involved are highly encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels. CEO is committed to the CROWN Act, and creating an open space where our employees can present as their true authentic selves.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without unlawful discrimination based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, gender, gender identity, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, military status, prior record of arrest or conviction, citizenship status, current employment status, caregiver status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. We value diverse experiences, including with regard to educational background and justice system contact.

Please note that due to the volume of resumes received, we are unable to contact each applicant regarding the status of each position or reply to candidates' inquiries via phone or email.

title: Senior Project Manager - Building Automation / HVAC Controls
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager – Building Automation / HVAC Controls to lead commercial and industrial building automation projects from preconstruction and planning through installation, commissioning, and final closeout.

This position is responsible for managing project schedules, budgets, procurement, field coordination, subcontractors, and client relationships while ensuring successful delivery of complex BAS, DDC, and HVAC controls projects.

The ideal candidate has a strong technical understanding of building automation and commercial HVAC systems combined with proven project management experience. This role is well suited for someone who can coordinate controls technicians, programmers, engineers, subcontractors, and customers while maintaining ownership of project financials, schedules, and overall execution.

Responsibilities

  • Manage multiple building automation and HVAC controls projects from initial planning through commissioning and closeout.
  • Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, labor forecasts, procurement plans, and project execution strategies.
  • Coordinate controls technicians, programmers, engineers, subcontractors, vendors, and other field personnel.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, general contractors, mechanical contractors, engineers, and other project stakeholders.
  • Review project specifications, control drawings, sequences of operation, submittals, RFIs, change orders, and contract documents.
  • Coordinate installation, programming, startup, testing, commissioning, and system turnover activities.
  • Monitor project costs, labor utilization, forecasts, billing, change orders, and overall project profitability.
  • Identify schedule, technical, procurement, and field-related risks and implement solutions to keep projects on track.
  • Coordinate purchasing and delivery of controllers, sensors, actuators, valves, panels, and other controls equipment.
  • Lead project meetings and provide regular updates regarding schedules, milestones, financial performance, and potential risks.
  • Work closely with field technicians and programmers to resolve technical and installation challenges.
  • Ensure projects comply with contract requirements, engineering specifications, safety standards, and company quality expectations.
  • Manage project documentation, commissioning requirements, punch lists, customer training, and final closeout.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, contractors, vendors, and project partners.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of project management experience in building automation, HVAC controls, or a closely related industry.
  • Strong experience managing BAS, DDC, HVAC controls, or energy management system projects.
  • Working knowledge of commercial HVAC equipment, control systems, low-voltage applications, and building automation architecture.
  • Ability to read and interpret control drawings, electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, sequences of operation, specifications, and construction documents.
  • Experience managing projects from planning through installation, startup, commissioning, and final turnover.
  • Strong understanding of project budgeting, forecasting, scheduling, procurement, change orders, and cost control.
  • Experience coordinating controls technicians, programmers, subcontractors, vendors, and other project personnel.
  • Strong technical problem-solving skills with the ability to understand controls, communications, wiring, and HVAC-related issues.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, client management, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and relevant construction or project management software.
  • Valid driver's license with the ability to travel to regional project sites as required.
  • Direct project management experience is required; technician or field experience alone without project ownership will not be sufficient.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience.
  • Ongoing technical training and professional development.
  • Opportunity to lead a diverse portfolio of commercial and industrial building automation projects.
  • Collaborative environment with experienced controls and HVAC professionals.
  • Long-term career growth and advancement opportunities.
  • Additional company-sponsored benefits available.

title: Klinikassistenter med administrativ funktion i Kontaktcentret i Børne- og Ungdomstandplejen i Københavns Kommune
description:
Er du uddannet klinikassistent med minimum et års erfaring med administrativ funktion fra tandplejen? Vil du arbejde med telefonisk borgerkontakt og administrative opgaver? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

Hvilke opgaver skal du løse?

  • Besvare telefonopkald fra primært patienter og deres forældre: Ca. 50 % af din arbejdstid vil bestå af håndtering af opkald fra borgere. Der er telefontid i tidsrummet kl. 7.45-12.00. Akutte telefoniske henvendelser skal besvares i hele tandplejens åbningstid kl. 8.00-15.00. Børne- og Ungdomstandplejen har et moderne telefonsystem, som understøtter opgaveløsningen. Tandplejen har en målsætning om, at indgående opkald i gennemsnit skal besvares inden for en ventetid på maksimalt to minutter. Herudover forventes det, at størstedelen af opkaldene straks afklares og hermed afsluttes uden yderligere sagsbehandling.
  • Administrative opgaver: I ca. 40 % af din arbejdstid skal der løses faste administrative opgaver i relation til bl.a. behandlernes aftalebøger, håndtering af mails til klinikken, indhentelse af samtykke m.v. Disse opgaver er klart beskrevet i kontorprocedurer for at sikre ensretning i tandplejen samt overholdelse af gældende lovgivning.
  • Andre administrative opgaver: Disse administrative opgaver vil udgøre de resterende 10 % af din arbejdstid. Opgaverne tildeles til kontaktcenterets personale typisk fra Tandplejens ledelse og fra klinikkerne. De vil være af varierende karakter og herved også med forskellige løsninger.
Hvorfor arbejde hos os?
Du kommer til at arbejde i Tandplejens Kontaktcenter, som er beliggende i Saxogade på Vesterbro. Kontaktcenterets opgaver administreres og koordineres primært af 1. klinikassistent, Annette.

Kontaktcentret bemandes udelukkende af uddannede klinikassistenter, som dagligt varetager telefoniske og administrative opgaver med tandfagligt fokus. Der vil være et bredt samarbejde med både de andre klinikker i Tandplejen, men også med eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Der er 18 fuldtidsansatte klinikassistenter i Kontaktcentret til at løse de ovennævnte opgaver. Da I er mange i Kontaktcentret, er der mulighed for samarbejde og sparring om løsningen af opgaverne.

Kontaktcentret består af et kontormiljø med mindre kontorer fra 1-mands kontorer op til 4-mands kontorer. Der er i indretningen lagt vægt på at opnå så gode akustiske forhold som muligt, og lydniveauet blandt kollegaerne er konstant i fokus.

Du vil ikke have en fast kontorarbejdsplads, da vi lægger vægt på, at alle kan arbejde sammen med alle, derfor roterer personalet mellem de kontorarbejdspladser, der er til rådighed i Kontaktcentret. Du skal samarbejde tæt med 1. klinikassistent, Annette og superbruger, Caroline samt resten af teamet, for at sikre sammenhæng, solid produktivitet samt en ensartet og høj kvalitet i opgaveløsningen.

Stillingen rummer ikke traditionelt receptionsarbejde med direkte patientkontakt, da patienterne tjekker ind via sundhedskort i venteværelserne på klinikkerne. Der er ikke mulighed for, at borgerne fysisk kan møde op i Kontaktcentret.

Tandplejen i Københavns kommune har en central administration, som supporterer klinikkerne og Kontaktcentret ved fx IT-udfordringer, klagesagsbehandling, HR, lovgivning m.v. Du vil derfor altid kunne finde sparring og hjælp i organisationen.

Kompetencer
En forståelse for driften bag en generel tandklinik, vil være en klar fordel i løsningen af opgaverne, da du bl.a. skal være medvirkende til at skabe høj produktivitet ved rationel bookning af aftalebøgerne med effektivt flow.

Herudover skal du være klar til at varetage opgaven med telefonien, hvor en vis grad af uforudsigelighed altid vil være til stede. En venlig og imødekommende tilgang til alle opkald er en nødvendighed, og du skal have en evne til at indgå i konstruktiv dialog selv i de sværere samtaler. Du skal også kunne besvare opkald fra engelsktalende borgere.

Løsningen af størstedelen af de administrative opgaver skal udføres efter klart fastsatte rammer, og det forventes at du følger disse. Du skal altså kunne arbejde struktureret inden for de allerede fastsatte rammer. I nogle af de særlige administrative opgaver, som også skal håndteres, forventes det, at du kan udtænke gode løsninger.

Har du erfaring med Børne- og Ungdomstandplejen, vil det være en fordel.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og inden for rammerne af lokal løndannelse.

Når du arbejder i Børne- og Ungdomstandplejen, vil din arbejdstid sædvanligvis være i tidsrummet kl. 7.46-15.10. Ud over fem ugers ferie og fem feriefridage holder tandplejen lukket yderligere 20 dage om året. Disse 20 lukkedage opspares ved en reducering i din månedlige løn.

Vi søger klinikassistenter til faste og tidsbegrænsede stillinger på 37 timer om ugen.

Stillingerne er til besættelse pr. 1. september 2026 eller snarest derefter.

I forbindelse med ansættelse indhenter vi reference samt straffe- og børneattest.

Yderligere oplysninger
Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingerne, er du velkommen til at rette henvendelse til ledende tandlæge Tina Koerner Melby på 24 79 38 55.

Er du nysgerrig på at læse mere om Børne- og Ungdomstandplejen i København, så besøg , hvor du kan læse mere om Tandplejens tilbud til byens børn og unge og vores interne organisering.

Du bedes vedlægge CV og evt. dokumentation, og i din ansøgning give dit bud på, hvorfor du er den rette til at løse de tre grundlæggende arbejdsopgaver, som stillingen rummer.

Søg stillingen via linket senest onsdag den 19. august 2026
Vi forventer at holde samtaler mandag den 24. august.

title: Socialfaglig medarbejder til socialpsykiatriske opgangsfællesskaber
description:
Tiltrædelse

1. november 2026 eller snarest muligt

Vil du være med til at skabe et hverdagsliv med håb, muligheder og udvikling for mennesker med psykiske udfordringer?

Holbæk Kommunes socialpsykiatriske opgangsfællesskaber på Markedspladsen og Lundestrædet søger en engageret og fagligt stærk socialfaglig medarbejder til en fast stilling på 37 timer ugentligt.

Hos os bliver du en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor relationer, faglighed og udvikling går hånd i hånd. Vi arbejder med afsæt i en recoveryorienteret og rehabiliterende tilgang, hvor borgernes ønsker, drømme og ressourcer er omdrejningspunktet for indsatsen.

Om opgangsfællesskaberne

Opgangsfællesskaberne er et botilbud efter servicelovens § 85 for voksne borgere med psykiske udfordringer. Borgerne bor i egne lejligheder og modtager individuel socialpædagogisk støtte med fokus på mestring af eget liv og deltagelse i fællesskabet.

Vi tror på, at alle mennesker kan udvikle sig, når de mødes med respekt, anerkendelse og troen på deres egne ressourcer.

Som socialfaglig medarbejder vil du blandt andet:

  • Støtte borgerne i at skabe struktur og mestring i hverdagen.
  • Arbejde med udvikling af sociale kompetencer, netværk og relationer.
  • Understøtte borgernes fokus på sundhed, trivsel og hverdagsliv.
  • Arbejde ud fra borgernes indsatsmål og delmål.
  • Dokumentere faglige indsatser og progression.
  • Bidrage til at skabe et trygt og udviklende bomiljø.
  • Indgå i tværfagligt samarbejde med kolleger, myndighedsrådgivere, behandlingspsykiatri, pårørende og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

Der er tale om en fuldtidsstilling i skiftende vagter, herunder dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde efter gældende vagtplan.

title: Voksenunderviser til Røde Kors på Udrejsecenter Kærshovedgård
description:
Vil du bruge dine undervisningskompetencer til at gøre en forskel for mennesker i en kompleks livssituation?

Røde Kors søger en engageret voksenunderviser, som motiveres af at arbejde med voksne mennesker med forskellige kulturelle og sproglige baggrunde.

Udrejsecenter Kærshovedgård er drevet af Danmarks Fængsler, mens Røde Kors varetager en række støttende opgaver på centret.

Vi arbejder tværfagligt og med en handleplansbaseret tilgang, hvor fokus er at støtte den enkelte beboers udvikling og trivsel. Hos os bliver du en del af et tværfagligt team, hvor undervisning er med til at skabe struktur, motivation og mulighed for at vedligeholde og udvikle beboernes personlige og faglige kompetencer.

Læs mere om Røde Kors’ opgaver på Udrejsecenter Kærshovedgård her.



Om arbejdsopgaverne
Som voksenunderviser får du en vigtig rolle i at skabe et inkluderende læringsmiljø, hvor den enkelte mødes med respekt, anerkendelse og faglighed.

Du vil være ansvarlig for at planlægge, gennemføre og evaluere undervisning samt vejlede, rådgive og motivere beboerne, så de kan vedligeholde og udvikle deres personlige og faglige færdigheder. Undervisningen tilrettelægges med afsæt i beboernes forskellige forudsætninger og behov og sker i tæt samarbejde med centerets øvrige faggrupper.

Udover undervisningen vil dine opgaver også bestå i, sammen med dine kollegaer, at skabe en indholdsrig og meningsfuld hverdag for beboerne, blandt andet gennem planlægning og gennemførelse af fritidsaktiviteter.



Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Udvikle, planlægge, undervise og evaluere undervisningsforløb målrettet voksne beboere på udrejsecenteret
  • Samarbejde med centerets øvrige faggrupper samt eksterne samarbejdspartnere
  • Udvikle, planlægge og deltage i afholdelse af fritidsaktiviteter for beboerne.


Vi søger en kollega, der er psykisk robust og kan bevare ro, overblik og faglighed - også når arbejdet er følelsesmæssigt krævende.

Hverdagen på Udrejsecenter Kærshovedgård er præget af beboere, som ofte befinder sig i en langvarig og usikker livssituation. Mange oplever frustration, håbløshed og mistrivsel, og det kan sætte sit præg på stemningen og relationerne i hverdagen.

Derfor er det vigtigt, at du har mental styrke og udholdenhed. Du skal kunne rumme mennesker i svære livssituationer uden at miste dit professionelle ståsted og samtidig kunne bevare engagement, struktur og overskud - også når forandringer sker langsomt eller helt udebliver.

Du skal kunne acceptere, at du ikke kan løse alle problemer, men stadig se værdien i at gøre en positiv forskel i de møder og den hverdag, du er en del af.



Derudover lægger vi vægt på:

  • Psykisk robusthed - du kan bevare ro, overblik og faglighed i et følelsesmæssigt krævende arbejdsmiljø
  • Mental udholdenhed - du trives i et arbejde, hvor udvikling kan være langsom, og hvor motivation og håb hos beboerne kan være begrænset
  • Konflikthåndtering - du kan forebygge, nedtrappe og håndtere konflikter på en rolig og professionel måde
  • Samarbejdsevner - du bidrager aktivt til et stærkt tværfagligt samarbejde og bruger kollegial sparring konstruktivt
  • Professionel dømmekraft og integritet - du kan sætte klare grænser, træffe velovervejede beslutninger og fastholde en respektfuld og konsekvent tilgang.


Vi tilbyder
Hos Røde Kors bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads med et stærkt humanitært værdigrundlag, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og respekt for det enkelte menneske er fundamentet for vores arbejde.

Du får mulighed for at bringe dine undervisningskompetencer i spil i en særlig kontekst og blive en del af et engageret tværfagligt fællesskab, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at skabe de bedst mulige rammer for beboerne.



Det praktiske
Overenskomst: Du bliver ansat efter overenskomst med DLF (Staten)
Arbejdstid: 37 timer om ugen med en lang dag til kl. 20.
Kørekort: Nødvendigt
Tiltrædelse: 1. oktober 2026
Arbejdssted: Kærshovedgård 17, 7430 Ikast
Referencer: Ved tilbud om ansættelse skal du fremvise en privat straffeattest. Ansættelsen er derudover betinget af Danmarks Fængslers sikkerhedsgodkendelse.
Ansøgning: Stillingen kan kun søges via vores online rekrutteringssystem ved at klikke på linket ”Søg jobbet”. Ved tekniske udfordringer kontakt support@hr-manager.dk
Ansøgningsfrist: 20. august 2026. Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kontakt Centerleder Ken Rinder på mail krs@redcross.dk
Ansættelsessamtaler: Vi forventer at afholde ansættelsessamtaler løbende og i uge 35.

title: Creative Strategist for EU DTC Company (Remote, EMEA/LATAM)
description:
About Paired

Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that specializes in pairing remote work with top-tier talent!
We are dedicated to connecting talented individuals with remarkable companies in need of their skills. Our goal is to create fulfilling job opportunities for professionals around the world.

Our client
They're a fast-growing DTC eCommerce brand that believes creative is the biggest lever for profitable growth. Their marketing strategy is built on rapid experimentation, consumer insights, and performance-driven creative that scales across paid social channels.

We're looking for a Creative Strategist who thrives at the intersection of creativity and data. This role is responsible for owning the paid social experimentation process—from research and ideation to briefing, performance analysis, and creative iteration.

If you're passionate about uncovering winning ad angles, translating performance data into creative direction, and building systems that consistently produce winning ads, we'd love to meet you.

The Role

As their Creative Strategist, you'll own the entire paid social creative testing pipeline.

You'll identify new opportunities through competitor, consumer, and trend research, develop hypotheses, write detailed creative briefs, and collaborate with internal teams and external partners to bring ideas to life.

Success in this role is measured by the quality and impact of your experiments—not the volume of content alone.

You'll work closely with Performance Marketing, Influencer Marketing, Organic Social, CRM, designers, video editors, content creators, and external agencies to continuously improve creative performance across Meta and TikTok

What Will You Do

Paid Social Creative Strategy

    • Own the end-to-end paid social experimentation process.
    • Develop creative concepts based on performance data and customer insights.
    • Build and manage a structured testing roadmap.
    • Prioritize creative experiments based on business impact.
    • Continuously improve paid social performance through iterative testing.

Creative Brief Development

    • Produce 10+ high-quality creative experiment briefs per week.
    • Write clear, actionable briefs for:
      • Video Editors
      • Graphic Designers
      • UGC Creators
      • Content Creators
      • Influencers

Ensure every brief includes strategic direction, messaging, hooks, target audience, creative references, and testing objectives.

Performance Analysis

  • Analyze creative performance across:
  • ROAS
  • CPA
  • CTR
  • Hook Rate
  • Hold Rate
  • Conversion Rate
  • Messaging
  • Creative Formats
  • Talent Performance
  • Audience Segments
  • Landing Page Alignment

Translate insights into actionable recommendations and future creative tests.

Research & Insights

  • Conduct ongoing competitor research.
  • Monitor emerging creative trends across Meta and TikTok.
  • Analyze customer feedback and market insights.
  • Identify new hooks, offers, messaging angles, and creative opportunities.
  • Stay ahead of platform and consumer behavior changes.

    Creative Production Management
  • Partner with internal creative teams throughout production.
  • Manage relationships with external creative agencies.
  • Coordinate UGC production through platforms such as Trybe.
  • Ensure creative assets are delivered on time and aligned with strategic objectives.

Requirements

Must Have

  • 3+ years of experience in Creative Strategy, Performance Marketing, or Paid Social within a DTC or eCommerce environment.
  • Proven experience developing creative strategies for Meta and TikTok campaigns.
  • Strong understanding of direct-response advertising and social-first creative.
  • Experience analyzing campaign performance and translating data into creative direction.
  • Experience writing detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and content creators.
  • Deep understanding of UGC and performance creative best practices.
  • Experience managing creative agencies and/or UGC production platforms.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple experiments simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with subscription-based eCommerce brands.
  • Familiarity with creative research tools and Meta Ad Library.
  • Understanding of landing page optimization and creative-to-funnel alignment.
  • Experience with project management platforms such as ClickUp, Asana, or Monday.com.
  • AI tools experience for creative ideation and research (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity).

Success Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Maintaining a minimum 25% creative hit rate against defined performance benchmarks.
  • Delivering 10+ high-quality creative experiment briefs per week.
  • Consistently improving creative performance through data-driven iterations.
  • Producing clear weekly reports covering:
  • Experiment output
  • Creative hit rate
  • Key learnings
  • Performance insights
  • Next testing priorities
  • Building a repeatable experimentation process that drives continuous improvement across paid social campaigns.

Benefits

  • Own the creative strategy behind high-performing paid social campaigns.
  • Work with a collaborative, data-driven growth team.
  • Influence creative decisions that directly impact business performance.
  • High ownership, autonomy, and visibility.
  • Fast-paced environment where experimentation and innovation are encouraged.
  • Opportunity to shape and scale the creative testing function as the business grows.
  • 100% remote role, work with a truly international team
  • Competitive pay and bonuses

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil inkludere undervisning i ovenstående fag samt deltagelse i f.eks. teammøder, tværfagligt samarbejde, klasseteams m.m.

Vi tilbyder dig:

· Et inspirerende arbejdsmiljø med mange fagligheder og samarbejdsmuligheder

· Adgang til kurser og efteruddannelse, så du udvikler dig fagligt

· Mulighed for at præge og udvikle din arbejdsplads og opgaver

· Arbejde på en skole med mange forskellige uddannelser

· En varieret og meningsfuld hverdag

Dine kompetencer/kvalifikationer:

Vi forventer, at du har en relevant kandidatuddannelse og gerne undervisningserfaring.

· Du brænder for undervisning og for arbejdet med unge mennesker

· Du er en reflekterende praktiker, der formidler dit fag med høj pædagogisk kvalitet

Tiltrædelse sker pr. 1. september 2026 eller hurtigst muligt. Ansættelsen er tidsbegrænset og løber frem til 31/12 2026 med eventuel mulighed for forlængelse.

Cirkulære af 12. februar 2025 om overenskomst for lærere og pædagogiske ledere ved gymnasieskoler mv. mellem Finansministeriet og Gymnasieskolernes Lærerforening med virkning fra 1. april 2025 (. 018-25).

Løn vil som udgangspunkt følge statens regler om timeansatte under Gymnasieskolernes Lærerforening.

Afhængig af ancienniteten vil timelønnen være placeret mellem kr. 212,00 og kr. 276,00 pr. time.

Arbejdstid: Deltid. Omfanget vil være afhængigt af fagkombination.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed AI Engineer

Build end-to-end products on a solid data foundation, with AI as a force multiplier.

Data Practice | Remote (India) | Senior

About TechTorch

At TechTorch, we’re building the future of intelligent work. Our mission is to help companies design, build, and deploy AI agents that automate complex, real-world workflows — delivering reliability, measurable ROI, and massive efficiency gains.

Here, you won’t just be playing with prompts or running endless proofs of concept. You’ll ship production-grade AI systems that solve real problems across industries.

You’ll join a hands-on, fast-moving, ownership-driven team that thrives on building quickly, iterating fast, and seeing results in days — not months.

About the Practice

TechTorch's Data Practice sits at the intersection of enterprise data and applied AI. We design and build AI-native systems that don't just analyze the past — they actively drive decisions. Our work spans data infrastructure and pipelines, intelligent automation, and full-stack AI applications across industries.

We work the way the best client-delivery teams now operate: small teams, deep ownership, no hand-offs at boundaries. We take problems from a client whiteboard to production, and we let AI do the heavy lifting wherever it earns its place.

The Role

We're looking for an engineer who builds across the full stack and owns the data underneath it. You can sit in a client session, shape the architecture, design the data foundation, and ship the application that runs on top of it — without handing off at the boundaries.

The work spans client delivery and internal accelerator development. You map the problem, structure the solution, and own the outcome from end to end. AI coding agents are central to how we build — not a novelty, but the daily layer that lets a small team cover a lot of ground.

What You'll Do

  • Own work end to end — from discovery and solution shaping through system design, build, and production deployment.

  • Design and build the data foundation: data models, schema design, dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and slowly changing dimensions (SCD) that hold up in production.

  • Build full-stack applications on top of that foundation — Python/FastAPI services and Next.js frontends that make data and AI workflows usable.

  • Use AI coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent) as a primary build accelerator to move from spec to working software quickly, without sacrificing judgment or quality.

  • Design and build AI capabilities where they fit — RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and LLM-in-the-loop processing — and compose them via MCP servers, Skills, and Plugins.

  • Orchestrate pipelines and automation with tools like Airflow, Dagster/Prefect, Celery, or Temporal — choosing the right tool for the job.

  • Stand up and own CI/CD and cloud deployments on AWS and Azure.

  • Translate ambiguous client requirements into clear designs and communicate trade-offs to both technical and business audiences.

  • Contribute reusable accelerators and technical assets back to the Data Practice.

Must Have

We're looking for genuine production depth across data engineering and full-stack development — not surface familiarity with either.

Data Engineering Foundation

  • Data modeling and schema design — dimensional modeling, normalization trade-offs, and EDW/warehouse schema design you can defend.

  • Hands-on data pipeline experience — ETL/ELT design across batch and incremental loads, built and maintained in production (not just SQL scripts on a schedule).

  • Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD) and change-data handling — knows the patterns and when each applies.

  • dbt Experience— modular SQL transformations, tests, documentation, and incremental strategies.

  • Advanced SQL and at least one modern data platform in depth (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, or a comparable cloud warehouse/lakehouse).

  • Data quality thinking — testing, validation, and lineage treated as first-class, not afterthoughts.

Full-Stack AI Product Development

  • Python as a primary language — services, automation, and data work alike.

  • FastAPI — async REST API design, dependency injection, testing.

  • A modern frontend, ideally Next.js — component architecture, SSR, state management, and real UX sensibility.

  • PostgreSQL — schema design, query optimization, indexing.

  • System design — can architect from a blank page: services, boundaries, trade-offs, and scale.

  • AI-paired engineering — uses an agentic coding tool (Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable) as a genuine daily workflow accelerator, and can speak concretely to how.

  • CI/CD and cloud deployment ownership on AWS or Azure, without heavy support.

Ways of Working

  • Comfortable in client-facing delivery — can represent TechTorch technically and translate between business and engineering.

  • Customer-first mindset — anchors decisions in what the stakeholder is actually trying to accomplish, and can move fluidly between the engineer's view and the business owner's in the same conversation.

  • End-to-end ownership instinct — takes a problem from discovery to production and owns the outcome, rather than passing it along at each handoff.

Nice to Have

Not required to apply — but these are the things that make a candidate stand out.

Standout differentiator — Commercial data fluency: Experience evaluating how commercial data flows across CRM (ideally Salesforce) and ERP (ideally NetSuite) from opportunity to order to invoice, with the ability to diagnose, document, and resolve inconsistencies.

  • Agentic AI depth — LangGraph or comparable: multi-agent coordination, tool use, memory, and state management.

  • RAG engineering — retrieval strategies, vector stores, chunking, re-ranking, and evaluation.

  • Experience in a consulting or client-delivery environment, or a forward-deployed / embedded engineering role.

  • Workflow orchestration breadth across multiple tools (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Temporal, ADF, Databricks Workflows).

  • Streaming data patterns — Kafka, Spark Streaming, or Flink.

  • Vector databases — Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or pgvector.

  • Experiment tracking — MLflow, Weights & Biases, or similar.

  • Contributions to open-source AI or data tooling, or to internal accelerators and frameworks.

  • Multi-cloud or hybrid cloud architecture exposure.

You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You're comfortable designing a data model in the morning and shipping a FastAPI + Next.js feature on top of it in the afternoon.

  • You treat an AI coding agent as a force multiplier — you've genuinely changed how you build, not just turned on autocomplete.

  • You can explain an SCD strategy to an engineer and a data-quality risk to a business stakeholder in the same conversation.

  • You've shipped real things in production — not just demos or PoCs.

  • You're opinionated about system and data design, and can back it up.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote.

  • Semi-annual team offsites — we come together in person at least twice a year to connect, recharge, and do the work that's better face-to-face.

  • High-autonomy, high-ownership work across the full arc of real client problems — not toy datasets or boxed-in tickets.

  • A team that takes AI tooling seriously and expects you to use it, not just name-drop it.

  • Access to the full modern data and AI stack — no one-tool shops.

  • Room to grow toward data architecture, platform leadership, or AI engineering depth, depending on where you want to take it.

title: Legal Escalations Specialist, CS Operations
description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

As a Legal Escalation Specialist, you will work within the Customer Support Department and be part of the Legal Escalation Team - a highly committed, “hands-on” team that provides the second line of support for different types of queries.

The main team’s objectives include handling external legal requests from authorities and internal escalations related to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), as well as other legal and privacy topics.

Moreover, the Legal Escalations Team owns and contributes to various projects related to members’ safety on the platform, creates and optimises internal processes and in general contributes to ensuring the company’s legal compliance.

In this position, you’ll

  • Reply to the requests received from law enforcement authorities, consumer rights, and other institutions
  • Take care of internal escalations related to legal, GDPR, and privacy topics, and provide legal guidance
  • Co-own, drive and co-create policies, processes and procedures related to legal requests, escalations and members’ safety
  • Own or contribute to projects (e.g. new legal policies/processes, various projects related to members’ safety or new features)
  • Collaborate with internal teams (e.g. other Member Support, Legal team, Product teams)
  • Co-create your team’s routines, cooperation framework, share information, and ways of knowledge expansion
  • Contribute to setting goals and managing the team's performance

About you

  • Fluent in English, any other European languages would be a great asset
  • Prior experience in customer support, handling legal and/or police requests, escalations, and project management would be an advantage
  • Able to handle multiple tasks efficiently and make quick, informed decisions
  • Strong verbal communication and negotiation skills to make your point and successfully pitch your ideas
  • Able to take ownership of your tasks and projects
  • Strong time management, planning, and organisational skills
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Able to work in a team environment as well as independently
  • Willing and open to looking for and learning new skills, techniques, and tactics
  • Able to gather and share best practices

Work perks

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 working days of holiday
  • Access to all the tools & tech needed for work
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Private health insurance
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation
  • A dog-friendly office
  • In Vilnius office: gym & in-house meals at friendly prices
  • In Kaunas office: a monthly lunch allowance, and a once-a-week provided in-house lunch and breakfast

Working at Vinted

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

Hybrid Work

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

Equal Opportunity

The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

The gross monthly salary range for this position is:
€1.917—€2.592 EUR

description:

title: AI Business Automation Engineer
description:
WHAT IS BOX?

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

WHY BOX NEEDS YOU

You will work on problems that matter to the company, with executive air cover to actually change how things run. You will get to put modern AI into production behind real workflows, not demos. And you will do it inside an IT organization that treats engineering excellence, security, and business outcomes as the same job — not competing ones.

We are looking for an AI Business Automation Engineer to embed directly with functional Subject Matter Experts across Box — Finance, Legal, People, GTM, Customer Success, and beyond — to identify business processes ripe for reinvention and rebuild them with an AI-first mindset. You will sit shoulder-to-shoulder with the people doing the work, deeply understand their workflows, and then design, prototype, and deliver the technical solutions that transform how those teams operate.

This role lives inside IT and carries the full weight of our infrastructure, data, integration, automation, and information security standards. The work spans the stack: one week you may be wiring an AI agent into a Finance close process, the next you may be redesigning a Legal intake workflow as an agentic system, and the next standing up a secure data pipeline so a GTM team can automate customer intelligence workflows. If you are energized by the intersection of business problems, modern AI, and pragmatic engineering — and you want your code in production, not in slideware — this is the role.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Partner directly with functional SMEs to map current-state processes, identify friction and waste, and co-design AI-first reinventions that materially change how the work gets done.
  • Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications, architecture diagrams, and delivery plans, then build the agentic solution end-to-end alongside teammates and senior engineers.
  • Prototype rapidly using Python and modern AI tooling (LLM APIs, RAG patterns, agent frameworks, workflow orchestration) to validate ideas before scaling them into production.
  • Build and maintain integrations between Box’s core SaaS systems (Box, Workday, Salesforce, NetSuite, Atlassian, BigQuery, etc.) using APIs, iPaaS platforms, and custom services.
  • Design and implement automations that retire manual work, replace brittle scripts, and unlock capacity for the business.
  • Own the data plumbing — pipelines, models, access patterns — that makes AI solutions trustworthy and operable.
  • Apply security, privacy, and compliance controls from day one: data classification, least-privilege access, secrets management, auditability, and responsible AI guardrails.
  • Operate what you build: monitoring, runbooks, incident response, and continuous improvement based on real usage.
  • Evangelize what’s possible. Bring SMEs along the journey so they become co-owners of the AI-first future, not passive recipients of it.

WHO YOU ARE

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

  • 2-3+ years of hands-on engineering experience in IT or software engineering roles, with a track record of shipping production code that real users depend on.
  • Deep experience with agentic coding platforms like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, as well as experience building custom agents that leverage MCP servers and CLIs
  • Working proficiency in Python (or equivalent in Go, TypeScript, Java) — you write clean, tested, maintainable code and are comfortable contributing to a real codebase, not just notebooks.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into technical specs and delivered software. You can write a clear design doc, build the thing, and explain it to a non-technical partner.
  • Working knowledge across several of the following, with depth in at least one: cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred), data engineering (SQL, warehouses, pipelines), integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks, event-driven, iPaaS like Workato/SnapLogic), automation tooling, and IAM.
  • Familiarity with information security fundamentals — authn/authz, encryption, secrets handling, and safe data practices — and a willingness to learn what it takes to build systems that pass an audit.
  • Hands-on experience applying modern AI to real problems: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or building at least one AI-driven workflow, prototype, or agent.
  • Experience with agent frameworks (LangGraph, OpenAI Agent SDK, Claude Agent SDK, etc.), MCP, or building tool-using systems at scale.
  • Strong product instincts and a bias for shipping. You know when to deliver a thin slice and learn versus when to invest in something more durable.
  • Excellent communication skills. You build trust with non-technical partners and write specs, docs, and updates that travel without you in the room.

Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week.Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.

At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. If you are head-over-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!

title: Technician Plant Quality Lab
description:

Advanced Drainage Systems is a leading manufacturer of stormwater and onsite septic wastewater solutions, committed to sustainability and innovation. Responsibilities

The Plant Quality Lab Technician is responsible for Lab Quality pipe evaluations, implementing quality methods and protocol in accordance with ADS, and industry standards as well as customer requirements at a specific plant location. This person must demonstrate excellent leadership skills and work coherently with the plant management team. This position will require flexibility to work 40+ hours a week plus weekends as required. The Plant Quality Lab Technician must also have the flexibility to work various shifts if needed. The Plant Quality Lab Technician reports directly to the Plant Manager for day to day plant responsibilities. The Plant Manager will conduct the annual review session.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Respond to field complaints/visit customer locations

Inclusive and Creative Work Culture: ADS fosters a culture of passion, innovation, and continuous improvement, empowering employees to shape industry-leading solutions. title: Studentermedhjælpere til Direktionssekretariatet på Statens Serum Institut
description:
Kunne du tænke dig at arbejde med spændende og alsidige opgaver inden for jura, politik og direktionsbetjening? Og vil du være en del af en arbejdsplads med et stærkt fagligt miljø, gode og engagerede kollegaer samt en uformel omgangstone? Så er det måske noget for dig at blive studentermedhjælper i Direktionssekretariatet på Statens Serum Institut (SSI), hvor vi lige nu søger 1 studentermedhjælper

Din hverdag hos os

Vi lægger vægt på tillid, ansvar og samarbejde, hvilket selvfølgelig også gælder vores studentermedhjælpere. Du vil derfor få stor indflydelse på, hvordan du vil løse og prioritere dine opgaver, ligesom du løbende vil tildeles større selvstændigt ansvar. Du vil få en hverdag med stor kontaktflade i Direktionssekretariatet, og du vil derudover skulle indhente bidrag til opgaveløsningen fra vores kollegaer på instituttet og eksterne samarbejdspartnere. Der er altid mulighed for sparring med ledelse og kollegaer.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil være varierende og bl.a. bestå i:

  • Håndtering af borgerhenvendelser
  • Behandling af aktindsigtssager
  • Direktions- og departementsbetjening
  • Forberedelse, afvikling og opfølgning af møder
  • Journalisering af egne og sektionens sager
  • Udarbejdelse af notater, præsentationer, interne procedurer mv.
  • Div. praktiske og administrative opgaver, fx print af mødematerialer, forplejning, planlægning og afvikling af arrangementer, afhentning af gæster i vores reception og lignende.
Organisatorisk bliver du en del af sektionen Direktionssekretariatet og vil ud over ovennævnte opgaver også indgå i sekretariatets øvrige opgaveløsning eller bidrage til opgaver i afdelingens andre sektioner.

Din uddannelse, erfaring og personlige kvalifikationer

Du er i gang med en relevant videregående uddannelse og har minimum 2 år tilbage af dit studie. Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra offentlig administration og gerne inden for ledelses- eller departementsbetjening, men det er ikke et krav.

Vi lægger desuden vægt på, at du tager initiativ, har evne og lyst til at samarbejde med mange faggrupper og at du kan omstille dig til skiftende fokusområder og varierende arbejdsopgaver. Du er proaktiv og selvstændig ift. din opgavevaretagelse, men ved også, hvornår du har brug for at bede om hjælp og sparring.

Vi tilbyder

Vi tilbyder et spændende og udfordrende job hos SSI, der er internationalt anerkendt for at løse væsentlige nationale og globale sundhedsopgaver. På SSI prioriteres faglig udvikling og sparring højt. Du vil opleve at du kan være med til at gøre en positiv forskel for SSI’s dygtige medarbejdere og bidrage til en organisation, der arbejder med vigtige samfundsdagsordener som antimikrobiel resistens, smitsomme sygdomme, beredskab og forskning – alt sammen med det formål at styrke folkesundheden og skabe værdi for samfundet.

Vores hverdag er præget af mange forskellige opgaver, åbne døre og et stærkt og bredt samarbejde.

SSI har en velfungerende personaleforening og idrætsforening (IK-SERA) med holdtræning og motionslokaler, fredagsbar og forskellige sociale arrangementer – og Campus rummer endda både en tennisbane og egen børneinstitution.

SSI er placeret centralt beliggende i København med gode offentlige transportmuligheder (bus og metro) og har fri parkering på området.

Om Direktionssekretariatet

Du bliver en del af afdelingen Direktionssekretariatet, som har til hovedopgave at understøtte SSI’s faglige områder bedst muligt og medvirke til realisering af SSI’s mission om at forebygge og bekæmpe infektionssygdomme og medfødte sygdomme gennem forskning, overvågning, diagnostik og rådgivning.

Direktionssekretariatet er bl.a. ansvarlig for instituttets juridiske arbejde, understøttelse af forsknings- og fondsaktiviteter, departementsbetjening, strategiarbejde og kommunikation, herunder presse, hjemmeside, sociale medier og intranet.

I Direktionssekretariatet sætter vi stor pris på at have en uformel omgangstone, et godt kollegaskab og sammenhold, hvor vi hjælper hinanden.

Vi har fælles morgenmad en gang om måneden og deltager i sociale arrangementer på SSI såsom sommerfest, oktoberfest og julefrokost.

Vi er ca. 25 ansatte i afdelingen, og du bliver en del af en sektion med fem faste medarbejdere, to studentermedhjælpere og en sektionsleder.

Om ansættelsen

Der er tale om et genopslag. Vi forventer, at du kan arbejde ca. 15 timer om ugen i gennemsnit. Vi er fleksible i eksamensperioder.

Kontakt os gerne

Få mere at vide om stillingen ved at ringe til specialkonsulent Frederikke Kjær Ramsby på tlf. 3268 3748, PA/chefkonsulent Tine Skovmøller på tlf. 32683258 eller sektionsleder Mathilde Winkel Madsen på tlf. 3268 8596.

Er du interesseret?

Klik på "søg stillingen" og send os din ansøgning med CV og eksamensbevis. Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt i uge 35 og 36. Du kan læse mere om os på vores hjemmeside

title: Deep Learning Researcher

title: Rekrutteringskonsulenter til Rekruttering Køge Bugt
description:
Rekrutteringskonsulenter til Rekruttering Køge Bugt (2 stillinger)

Vil du være med til at udvikle fremtidens virksomhedsservice – på tværs af to kommuner?

Rekruttering Køge Bugt (REKB) søger to rekrutteringskonsulenter til et nyt tværkommunalt team, der skal omsætte en ambitiøs strategi til konkrete resultater for virksomheder og borgere i Køge og Stevns Kommuner.

Stillingerne oprettes som led i implementeringen af den nye strategi "Sammen om virksomhedsservice og job". Strategien sætter retningen for et styrket samarbejde mellem virksomheder, borgere og beskæftigelsesindsatsen med fokus på rekruttering, opkvalificering, partnerskaber og udviklingen af fremtidens arbejdsstyrke.

Du bliver en del af et nyetableret team på seks medarbejdere. Du får derfor en unik mulighed for at være med til at forme både kulturen, samarbejdet og den faglige retning i enheden.

I efteråret vil en væsentlig del af arbejdet bestå i at omsætte strategiens ambitioner til konkrete arbejdsgange, aktiviteter og samarbejdsformer. Vi søger derfor kolleger, der både kan skabe resultater her og nu og samtidig motiveres af udviklingsarbejde og forandring.

Kerneopgaven

Kernen i jobbet er at skabe stærke relationer til virksomhederne i Køge og Stevns Kommuner og omsætte deres behov til konkrete beskæftigelsesløsninger.

Du skal være nysgerrig på virksomhedernes forretning, forstå deres aktuelle og fremtidige behov for arbejdskraft og sammen med virksomhederne finde løsninger, der både skaber værdi for virksomheden og åbner muligheder for borgere.

En stor del af din hverdag vil derfor bestå af:

  • virksomhedsbesøg og relations opbygning
  • dialog med arbejdsgivere og samarbejdspartnere
  • afdækning af virksomhedernes arbejdskraft- og kompetencebehov
  • rekruttering og matching mellem virksomheder og kandidater
  • udvikling af samarbejder om praktik, opkvalificering, voksenlærlinge og virksomhedsrettede forløb
  • koordinering med kolleger på tværs af beskæftigelsesindsatsen

Samtidig bliver du en vigtig medspiller i arbejdet med at udvikle og implementere den nye strategi, så virksomhederne oplever en koordineret, værdiskabende og langsigtet virksomhedsservice.

Dine opgaver

Som rekrutteringskonsulent bliver du en del af virksomhedernes samlede indgang til beskæftigelsesindsatsen i Køge og Stevns.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • understøtte virksomhedernes rekruttering og adgang til arbejdskraft
  • udvikle og vedligeholde langsigtede samarbejder og partnerskaber
  • identificere aktuelle og fremtidige behov for kompetencer og arbejdskraft
  • arbejde med opkvalificering, voksenlærlingeordninger og virksomhedsrettede indsatser
  • skabe bro mellem virksomheder, borgere, uddannelsesinstitutioner og kommunale afdelinger
  • bidrage til aktiviteter, netværk og arrangementer, der styrker samarbejdet mellem virksomheder og borgere
  • dokumentere og dele viden om virksomhedernes behov og udviklingen på arbejdsmarkedet
  • bidrage til udviklingen af fælles arbejdsgange og metoder i det nye team.

Vi søger dig, der

  • har erfaring med virksomhedsservice, beskæftigelsesindsats, salg, rådgivning eller erhvervssamarbejde
  • er stærk til relations opbygning og trives med at være ude blandt virksomhederne
  • arbejder struktureret og kan omsætte behov til konkrete løsninger
  • har flair for samarbejde og koordinering på tværs af fagområder
  • er nysgerrig på arbejdsmarkedets udvikling og virksomhedernes vilkår
  • trives i et miljø, hvor ikke alle svar er givet på forhånd
  • har lyst til at være med til at udvikle en ny enhed og nye måder at samarbejde på.

Vi tilbyder

Hos os får du mulighed for at være med til at udvikle en virksomhedsservice, hvor samarbejdet mellem to kommuner skaber større værdi end hver for sig.

Du bliver en del af et ambitiøst fagligt miljø med høj grad af selvstændighed, hvor vi deler viden, udvikler nye løsninger og hjælper hinanden med at lykkes.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • en central rolle i udviklingen af fremtidens virksomhedsservice
  • et stærkt tværkommunalt samarbejde mellem Køge og Stevns Kommuner
  • engagerede kolleger med høj faglighed og fokus på udvikling
  • stor frihed og ansvar i opgaveløsningen
  • et tæt samarbejde med virksomheder, uddannelsesinstitutioner og erhvervsnetværk
  • mulighed for at sætte dit præg på både den strategiske og den daglige udvikling af virksomhedsindsatsen.

Om Rekruttering Køge Bugt

Rekruttering Køge Bugt er et samarbejde mellem Køge og Stevns Kommuner. Enheden arbejder for at sikre virksomhederne adgang til kvalificeret arbejdskraft og samtidig skabe nye muligheder for borgere gennem rekruttering, opkvalificering, partnerskaber og virksomhedsrettede aktiviteter. Samtidig fungerer REKB som beskæftigelsesindsatsens arbejdsmarkedsfaglige videncenter. Vi indsamler viden om virksomhedernes behov og arbejdsmarkedets udvikling og omsætter den til handling sammen med vores kolleger.

Du kan læse mere om strategien på dette link.

Arbejdssted

REKB er organisatorisk placeret i Køge Kommune, men arbejdsdagen vil foregå flere steder. Du vil have arbejdsdage i vores lokaler i Ølby, på Køge Rådhus, på Stevns Rådhus og ude hos virksomhederne. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du trives i en mobil og udadvendt rolle.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsesform: Fuldtid

Tiltrædelse: 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest muligt herefter

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår: Efter gældende overenskomst

Ansøgningsfrist: 23. august 2026, kl. 22.00

Samtaler afholdes: 26. august 2026

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Afdelingsleder Christian Mejdahl Petersen på tlf. 51152864 eller mail christian.mejdahl.petersen@koege.dk.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Bager/kok til kantine i Aarhus
description:
Elsker du at bage og er du god til at få brød og kager til at spille?

Og er du typen, der både kan få smagen til at sidde lige i skabet – og samtidig holde hovedet koldt i en travl hverdag?

Ja?!

Så har vi et job, du ikke må gå glip af👇🏼

Vi leder nemlig efter en bager, eller kok med stærke bagekompetencer, til en af vores kantiner i Aarhus C - en der brænder du for den godt bagværk , og trives i et professionelt køkken med god stemning og et højt fagligt niveau.

Hvad går jobbet ud på?

Du bliver en vigtig del af et team på fem personer, Vi laver alt fra bunden og har fokus på både smag, kvalitet og bæredygtighed. Du får en varieret hverdag med både produktion, service og mulighed for at præge menuerne med dine idéer og dit håndværk. Vi hjælpes om opvasken og rengøringen i køkkenet. Du arbejder mandag til fredag, hovedsageligt aften og nat.

Dine vigtigste opgaver:

  • Tilberede dagens natmad og tage ansvar for produktionen af vores lækre brød og kager – vi laver alt fra bunden
  • Bidrage med idéer og kreativitet til menuer og retter
  • Sørge for, at egenkontrol, råvarer og køkkendrift spiller
  • Tage aktiv del i det gode samarbejde i køkkenet – vi løfter i flok
  • Møde gæsterne med god energi og være med til at skabe en varm og indbydende kantine

Hvem er du?

Du er fagligt stolt, madglad og god til mennesker. Du har erfaring fra kantine, restaurant eller storkøkken – og du trives i en hverdag, hvor der både skal laves mad og tænkes i løsninger.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet bager eller kok
  • Elsker at lave mad og har en stor passion for at bage
  • Har styr på egenkontrol og struktur
  • Er god til at samarbejde og bidrager til god stemning i køkkenet
  • Har en positiv og fleksibel tilgang – også når det går stærkt
  • Yder en fantastisk service

Hvad får du hos os?

  • Søde kollegaer, der både griner og arbejder sammen – og som alle elsker mad
  • Et job med fri i weekenden og arbejdstid mandag til fredag, hovedsageligt aften og nat
  • En arbejdsplads med ordentlighed, humor og plads til at være sig selv
  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling gennem kurser, workshops og masser af ledersparring
  • En hverdag, hvor du er med til at give folk dagens bedste pause

Hvem er vi?

Vi udvikler og driver kantiner i 100 danske virksomheder og kontorhuse rundt om i hele landet.

For mange mennesker er vi dagens højdepunkt – det øjeblik, som virksomhedens medarbejdere glæder sig til, og som på godt og ondt, har stærke holdninger til. Mad har nemlig en fantastisk evne til at sætte samtaler i gang og skabe fællesskaber.

Med et skarpt fokus på ordentlighed og ansvarlighed arbejder vi hver dag for at give vores gæster den bedste pause, der kan mærkes og som forhåbentlig gør en positiv forskel i deres liv.

Lyder det interessant?

Så send os dit CV og et par ord om, hvem du er. Jo før, jo bedre – vi holder samtaler løbende.

De bedste hilsner,

Inge, Helle - og verdens bedste køkkenteam

title: Senior Motion Designer
description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

Please Note: This is a 100% in-office position based out of our HQ office in NYC.

The Creative Studio is responsible for creating design, brand identities, and marketing campaigns that support our agents and elevate Compass and its affiliate brands. We partner across the business to bring strategic initiatives to life with the highest level of creative excellence.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Motion Designer with exceptional craft, sharp typography, and systematic brand thinking. Partnering with Creative Directors, Producers, and Marketing leads, you’ll translate static identities into fluid motion: storyboarding marketing campaigns, animating high-impact product launches, and building scalable motion systems that elevate our brand across every touchpoint.

At Compass You Will:

  • Bring Marketing Campaigns to Life: Spearhead motion design and execution for high-impact brand campaigns, regional brokerage promotions, and national marketing initiatives. You will own projects from concept, storyboarding, and style frames through to final animation, rendering, and compositing.
  • Build Tools to Empower Our Agents & Internal Teams: Build scalable motion systems, dynamic video templates, and customizable social assets that empower agents and our brokerages to market themselves and their listings with premium polish.
  • Bring Product Launches to Life: Partner with Creative Director, Producers and product teams to translate new feature releases and software tools into engaging, story-driven product launch videos and animations that clearly communicate value to our network.
  • Elevate Brand & Motion Systems: Maintain visual excellence across all moving assets, pushing the boundaries of typography, timing, transitions, and animation to keep the Compass aesthetic ahead of the industry.
  • Thrive in a Fast-Paced Studio: Excel in a high-volume, collaborative environment where stunning aesthetics, brand consistency, and rapid execution go hand in hand.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience: 4–5+ years in motion design with a portfolio spanning brand campaigns, sizzle reels, and product launches. Proven ability to build clean files, dynamic templates, and scalable motion systems.
  • Technical Toolkit: Advanced proficiency in After Effects (animation, compositing, templates), Premiere Pro (editing), and Figma (UI/UX manipulation).
  • Design & Storytelling: Exceptional editorial pacing, composition, typography, and visual brand execution.
  • Communication: Ability to pitch motion concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with non-technical partners and clients.
  • Agility: Thrives in fast-paced environments: managing multiple active briefs and delivering polished work under tight deadlines.
  • Generative AI (Plus): Hands-on experience with GenAI tools (e.g., Midjourney, Flora, Higgsfield) for concepting and asset creation is a major plus.

Compensation & Perks

  • Salary Range: Base pay of $90,000 - $103,000 annually (varies based on experience and skills). Bonuses and restricted stock units (RSUs) may be provided as part of the total package.
  • Incentive Programs: Eligible cash, equity, or commission participation.
  • Time Off & Leave: Paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and dedicated recharge leave.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, tele-health, dental, and vision coverage; 401(k) plan; FSAs; life & disability insurance.
  • Family Support: Maven (new parent support), Carrot (fertility benefits), and UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network).
  • Perks: Commuter program, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and pet insurance.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a portfolio link and demo reel (required) showcasing your ability to build scalable motion design systems (templates, toolkits, and modular assets for marketing campaigns and product launches), logo animations, and examples of strong graphic design fundamentals (typography, layout, and visual brand collateral).

Perks that You Need to Know About:

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

Do your best work, be your authentic self.
At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive. Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”) Notice to Applicants:
Please read the California Employee Privacy Notice (“CA Privacy Notice”) regarding Sunnyside* and its affiliate Cresco Labs’ policies pertaining to the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information. This CA Privacy Notice supplements the information contained in the Sunnyside* Privacy Policy and applies to California resident employees and job applicants. Applicants with disabilities may access this notice in an alternative format by contacting CCPAnotice@crescolabs.com
Reporting a Scam:

Cresco Labs is aware of fictitious employment offers being circulated from various sources. Many of these schemes consist of an alleged offer of employment with Cresco Labs with the intention of gaining personal information, including payment and/or banking information. Be aware that fraudulent job offers and correspondence may appear legitimate: they may feature a Cresco Labs logo, they may appear to originate from an official-looking email address or web site, or they may be sent by individuals purporting to represent Cresco Labs or an entity which includes the word Cresco Labs in its name.

Please note that Cresco Labs does not ask for payment or personal banking information as a condition of employment. Any personal information is requested for payroll or state badging purposes only. Applications can be securely submitted through our career’s pages.
We are working diligently to block this from happening. Beware if an offer of employment looks too good to be true. Never divulge personal and banking information or send money if you are unsure of the authenticity of an email or other communication in the name of Cresco Labs.
If you are in doubt, please contact us at Report-a-spam@crescolabs.com with questions.
