title: Developmental Disabilities Professional
description:
Our Company

All Ways Caring HomeCare

Overview

The Developmental Disabilities Professional (DDP) provides clinical, programmatic, and quality oversight for services delivered to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities (I/DD). This position ensures services are person-centered, compliant with DBHDD and waiver requirements, and aligned with each individual's Individual Support Plan (ISP). The DDP serves as a subject matter expert to agency leadership and direct support staff by providing guidance, training, risk assessment, quality improvement support, and service oversight. The position requires regular interaction with participants, staff, interdisciplinary teams, and external stakeholders to promote positive outcomes and ensure health, safety, and quality of care.

This is a hybrid position, candidate must be ok working from home and traveling within the region.

External Job Description

  • Provide oversight and consultation for services and supports delivered to individuals receiving waiver-funded services.
  • Ensure services are delivered in accordance with DBHDD requirements, agency policies, and person-centered practices.
  • Participate in quality improvement and risk management activities to evaluate service effectiveness and identify opportunities for enhancement.
  • Assess participant, programmatic, and organizational risks and recommend strategies to improve health, safety, and service quality.
  • Participate in the development, review, and implementation of Individual Support Plans (ISPs) and related service strategies.
  • Schedule, facilitate, and actively participate in pre-ISP meetings and interdisciplinary planning discussions.
  • Monitor participant progress toward established goals and recommend modifications to services or supports as needed.
  • Review assessments and evaluations, including health, behavioral, functional, and therapeutic assessments, to support service planning and delivery.
  • Oversee the implementation and effectiveness of behavior support plans, crisis plans, and other high-intensity support services, when applicable.
  • Identify participants requiring additional medical, behavioral, therapeutic, or social supports and make recommendations accordingly.
  • Provide training, coaching, and technical guidance to Direct Support Professionals (DSPs) and agency staff regarding person-centered service delivery and implementation of ISP goals.
  • Develop, coordinate, or oversee staff training programs related to participant support needs, agency requirements, and regulatory standards.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant documentation of participant contacts, consultations, assessments, meetings, and service oversight activities
  • Support corrective action planning and provide technical assistance related to regulatory reviews, audits, and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with participants, families, guardians, providers, clinicians, community partners, and agency leadership to ensure coordinated service delivery.
  • Complete all required training, certifications, and continuing education requirements established by DBHDD and the organization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Psychology, Human Services, Special Education, Nursing, or a related field required; equivalent experience may be considered where permitted by DBHDD requirements.
  • Minimum five (5) years of experience supporting individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities (I/DD), behavioral health, or related human services populations preferred.
  • Must meet all DBHDD requirements to serve as a Developmental Disabilities Professional (DDP).
  • Valid Driver’s License.
  • Must complete and maintain all DBHDD-required DDP registrations and certifications.
  • Complete required first-year DDP training, including Person-Centered Individual Service Planning, Supports Intensity Scale (SIS) Overview, and Health Risk Screening Tool (HRST) training.
  • Complete a minimum of eight (8) hours of annual developmental disability-specific continuing education as required by DBHDD.
  • Complete all additional annual training requirements established by the organization and regulatory agencies.
  • Demonstrates sound decision-making based on available information and applies appropriate judgment within the role.
  • Manages and prioritizes multiple tasks and communication channels while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Communicates clearly and professionally in both oral and written formats.
  • Collaborates effectively with employees and individuals across all departments and levels; builds positive working relationships while maintaining a flexible leadership and communication style as needed.
  • Adapts to changing priorities, processes, or environments and learns new tasks as needed.
  • Works effectively with minimal supervision and takes ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Maintains professional conduct during routine and challenging interactions.
  • Performs well in high-pressure situations and environments and manages reports appropriately and effectively in such situations and environments.
  • Responds constructively to conflict, customer concerns, or high-pressure interactions using appropriate job-specific techniques.
  • Working knowledge of Federal, State, and local regulations concerning services to individuals with intellectual and/or other developmental disabilities.
  • Travel within the assigned service area to conduct participant visits, staff consultations, assessments, and quality reviews.

About our Line of Business

All Ways Caring HomeCare delivers quality, compassionate, and individualized care and support that helps people in need of assistance stay at home – all while maximizing their dignity, privacy, and independence. Whether recovering from illness, injury, or surgery, living with a chronic disability, or dealing with the natural process of aging, services are tailored to meet the individual needs of people of all ages, physical conditions, and cognitive abilities. All Ways Caring HomeCare services include personal care and homemaking programs, professional nursing, older adult care management, Alzheimer’s/dementia care, respite care, and other programs. For more information, please visit www.allwayscaring.com. Follow us on Facebook and LinkedIn.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

  • Excellent attention to detail combined with strong communication skills for clear documentation and reporting

Desired Qualifications (nice to have):

  • Strong knowledge of quality systems including ISO 9001, ISO 13485, HACCP, FDA regulations, and CGMP standards
  • Familiarity with quality management software such as Calypso

title: Akademiker/Specialkonsulent til lægemiddelberedskab og forsyningssikkerhed
description:
Vil du være med til at sikre Danmarks adgang til lægemidler – også i krisetider?

I Lægemiddelstyrelsen søger vi en engageret akademiker/specialkonsulent, der vil være med til at styrke det nationale lægemiddelberedskab og sikre forsyningen af vigtige lægemidler. Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt team med stor samfundsmæssig betydning og mulighed for at præge et område i hastig udvikling.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Ansvarlig for planlægning, aktivering og evaluering af Lægemiddelberedskabet
  • Udarbejde analyser inkl. datatræk i krydsfeltet mellem lægemiddelforsyning og -beredskab
  • Deltage i tværgående arbejdsgrupper på lægemiddelområdet både nationalt og internationalt
  • Koordinere og besvare bestillinger fra Sundheds- og kirkeministeret samt andre aktører
Din hverdag hos os
Du vil få en central rolle i at analysere den nationale og internationale udvikling inden for lægemiddelforsyning og bidrage til at styrke det danske lægemiddelberedskab. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Udarbejde situationsoverblik og beslutningsgrundlag baseret på bl.a. kliniskevurderinger og datatræk
  • Projektledelse og deltagelse i strategiske projekter og samarbejder på lægemiddelområdet
  • Håndtering af data og samkøre oplysninger på tværs af flere forskelllige oversigter og IT-systemer
  • Udarbejde processer og vejledninger internt og eksternt til at understøtte lægemiddelsektoren
  • Besvarelse af politiske bestillinger og formidling af komplekse data
Opgaverne er mangeartede og du skal have lyst til at kaste dig ud i nye områder, hvis der opstå behov for en ny retning og hurtig håndtering.

Der er stor politisk bevågenhed på området og vi arbejder tæt sammen med andre styrelser, regioner, kommuner og europæiske samarbejdspartnere for at sikre, at der er adgang til nødvendige lægemidler – også i krisesituationer.

Du bliver en del af et team, der arbejder selvstændigt og på tværs af styrelsen. Vi lægger vægt på faglighed, samarbejde og en god arbejdskultur med plads til både professionalisme og humor.

Din uddannelse, erfaring og personlige kvalifikationer

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for sundhedsvidenskab f.eks. farmaci eller folkesundhedsvidenskab
  • Har betydelig erfaring indenfor lægemiddelsektoren med viden om forsyningsveje, lægemidler mm.
  • Har erfaring med datahåndtering, analyser, projektarbejde og/eller politisk betjening.
  • Er nysgerrig, struktureret og god til at samarbejde med mange forskellige interessenter.
  • Har gode skriftlige og mundtlige kommunikationsevner – og kan omsætte komplekse informationer til klare budskaber.
  • Trives i foranderlige rammer og med høj grad af selvledelse.
Vi tilbyder

  • At gøre en konkret forskel for borgernes adgang til lægemidler både i fredstid og under kriser
  • Mulighed for internationalt arbejde på et spændende og dynamisk område med stor national og international bevågenhed
  • Indflydelse på samfundskritiske beslutninger med stort råderum og mulighed for at præge retning og indhold
  • Tværfaglig samarbejde med dygtige kollegaer, uformel kultur og gode udviklingsmuligheder.
  • En familievenlig arbejdsplads med fleksible arbejdstider, mulighed for hjemmearbejde og forståelse for balancen mellem arbejdsliv og privatliv
  • Et inkluderende arbejdsmiljø med fokus på psykologisk tryghed, hvor forskellighed ses som en styrke.
  • Gode rammer og en fantastisk udsigt udover Københavns havn og by.
En kollega i dit måske kommende team:
"Jeg oplever stor åbenhed og interesse fra mine kollegaer. Det betyder, at man hurtigt lærer folk at kende."

Om Beredskab og Forsyning
Enhedens opgaver er bl.a. håndtering af forsyningsvanskeligheder, ansøgning om udleveringstilladelser, beredskab og apotekerdrift. Enheden består af 2 sektioner, hvor du bliver en del af sektionen Beredskab & Forsyningsovervågning. Sektionen består af 22 medarbejdere fordelt på 2 teams. Du bliver en del af teamet Beredskab & Tværgående Samarbejde, som består af 9 medarbejdere med direkte reference til Sektionslederen.

Læs mere om os og vores arbejde på Lægemiddelstyrelsen.dk.

Om ansættelsen
Du bliver ansat efter gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og akademikere i staten (AC-overenskomsten).

Stillinger kræver, at du bliver sikkerhedsgodkendt af PET umiddelbart efter ansættelsen.

I Lægemiddelstyrelsen træffer vi afgørelser i myndighedssager, og det er vigtigt for os, at man ikke kan stille spørgsmål ved vores habilitet. Derfor er det en forudsætning, at du ikke ejer aktier, anparter, andele eller lignende i en lægemiddel- og/eller medicovirksomhed. Du har dog en vis periode til at sælge dem, hvis du i dag ejer såkaldte medarbejderaktier i en lægemiddel- og/eller medicovirksomhed.

Kontakt os gerne
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at ringe til Mette Veje på +45 21395810 eller Jeanne Majland +45 20921203

Du kan læse mere om os og vores opgaver på Lægemiddelstyrelsen.dk.

Er du interesseret?
Lyder det som noget for dig? Så glæder vi os til at læse din ansøgning senest den 25. august 2025. Klik på "søg stillingen" og send os din ansøgning med CV og eksamensbevis Vi regner med at holde ansættelsessamtaler i uge 36-37.

title: Contract - Senior Associate/Scientist – Analytical Development
description:
Job Summary:

Revance (a Crown Laboratory Company) is seeking a Sr. Associate Scientist to contribute to our Analytical Development team. The Sr. Associate Scientist will participate in a team responsible for all aspects of method development, qualification, and execution for the characterization of complex biologics. This position requires hands-on laboratory experience working with analytical techniques for testing of drug substance and drug product to provide phase appropriate analytical development in support of clinical programs to commercial registration and post approval improvements for Revance projects.

This is an on-site, technical laboratory-based position that involves development, validation, and execution of analytical methods for testing of biologics. The ideal candidate will be expected to work collaboratively and cross-functionally with Process Development, R&D, Formulation Development, QC, and other technical groups by providing analytical testing support.

This role is a contractor-based position with a minimum contract timing of 6 months.

Responsibilities/Essential Duties:

  • Execute technical analytical methodologies to support development and validation of test methods.
  • Author and review analytical methods, protocols, reports, and other technical documents, including instrument qualification and change control.
  • Operate and maintain (as well as overseeing the installation of) sophisticated analytical instrumentation and associated computer control systems.
  • Be part of a team that establishes, maintains, and improves technical operations and project outcomes in the Analytical Development area.
  • Provide support for laboratory operations – inventory tracking, reagent preparation, sample management, and documentation review.
  • Execute analytical and biological methods ensuring compliance with applicable ICH guidelines and global regulations.
  • Ensure adherence to GMPs, GLPs, GCPs and GDPs where required.
  • Interact with contract manufacturers and contract testing laboratories.
  • Provide support as required for regulatory submissions.
  • Train other qualified staff to ensure effective execution of roles and responsibilities.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Experience performing basic analytical assay techniques such as absorbance and fluorescence plate-based assays, immunoassays (AlphaLISA, ELISA, SPR, and western blot), SoloVPE, and SDS-PAGE/CE-SDS.
  • Familiarity in interpreting data from common characterization techniques such as HPLC, AUC, SEC-MALS, MFI, DLS, and CD.
  • Experience developing/authoring protocols, methods, and SOPs.
  • Ability to communicate technically and strategically across technical and operational activities and work collaboratively to ensure successful execution.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Working knowledge of statistics; R, Python, Graphpad, JMP or other statistical tools preferred.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously, demonstrating organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, proactive and driven individual with an interest in experimental design and development.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in biological sciences or related field with 3+ years of progressive experience in the biotechnology or biopharmaceutical industry.
  • PhD with minimal industry experience may be considered.
  • Bachelor’s degree in biological sciences or related field with 5+ years of progressive experience in the biotechnology or biopharmaceutical industry.
  • Outstanding academic achievements may be considered in combination with industry experience.
  • Strong experience with immunoassays is highly desired, HPLC experience is a plus.
  • Experience working in a GMP setting is preferred.
  • Knowledge of SoftmaxPro and/or Empower is a plus.
  • Experience in drafting protocols, methods, and/or procedures.
  • Experience or working knowledge of neurotoxin therapeutic development.
  • Experience in performing change control, deviation, laboratory investigation, and/or other quality records.

  • Collaborate with your team members and engineering leaders to design new services and components using our Request For Comments (RFC) process.
  • Coach and mentor less experienced team members, positively changing the trajectory of the team to increase the overall effectiveness and efficiency of the team.
  • Lead product initiatives from discovery to delivery, working closely with the product and operational teams to ensure everyone is on the same page.
  • In line with our 'You build it, you own it' philosophy, we expect you to take full ownership of the products you build, embracing both their development and ongoing maintenance.

About you:

  • You have extensive experience in developing complex software systems. We mainly work with Python, but it is also ok if you are more comfortable with other OOP languages.
  • Experience in FinTech, banking, or another closely related sector, with a strong understanding of financial systems and building within a regulated environment.
  • Since you will work side by side with colleagues from different countries, you will be able to communicate clearly and concisely your ideas in English, both written and spoken.
  • You are adept at both constructing and managing services. As such, you should have proficiency in establishing standard APIs, incorporating monitoring systems and alerting services, along with a strong expertise in integrating external systems.

Participation in an on-call rotation will be occasionally required to ensure 24/7 system reliability and response to critical incidents.

title: Executive | Aerospace & Defense
description:
Job description

At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honoring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.

AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.

What you’ll do

AlixPartners, a leading global consulting firm, is searching for an Aerospace & Defense Partner who is passionate about delivering high value, complex opportunities. AlixPartners counsels owners, boards and CEOs in solving their most complex, highest value opportunities.

The Aerospace & Defense practice serves clients across the aerospace, defense, commercial aviation, space, defense technology, and broader industrial ecosystem, helping leadership teams solve high-impact challenges related to growth, performance improvement, operational excellence, digital transformation, and value creation.

The rapid adoption of Artificial Intelligence across the aerospace and defense sector has created significant demand for leaders who can combine deep technical credibility with industry expertise, which is why we’re seeking a Partner with a strong foundation in AI, data science, and machine learning, coupled with meaningful experience delivering AI-enabled transformations within Aerospace & Defense. This Partner will help clients identify, design, and implement AI solutions that improve decision-making, optimize operations, enhance engineering and manufacturing performance, strengthen supply chain resiliency, unlock commercial opportunities, and create sustainable competitive advantage. They will also play a key role in shaping and scaling AlixPartners' AI capabilities within the Aerospace & Defense practice.

These leaders are recognized experts in their respective fields, using their skills and experience to build measurable, better outcomes for our clients. You will be the primary contact for our clients, leading projects and client engagements on the ground, analyzing corporate performance, driving cost reductions, revenue growth and profitability improvement when it matters. As part of our collaborative team, you will have the opportunity to achieve exceptional results in our high energy environment, with continuous opportunities to pursue your professional development, career interests, and growth aspirations.

This is a full time Partner position in the Americas. Relocation assistance is not available.

The following is an example of the requirements and expectations of a Partner at AlixPartners, not an exhaustive list of required activities, duties or responsibilities.

What you’ll need

  • Minimum 18+ years of consulting experience or equivalent experience in the Aerospace & Defense industry.
  • 5+ years of Aerospace & Defense consulting experience in a professional services Firm environment preferred.
  • 5+ years of meaningful AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, or data science experience.
  • A solid track record of building and developing new client relationships with public, private and private equity backed organizations which lead to successful client engagements.
  • Proven ability to identify opportunities to deepen client relationships and ways in which we can support clients based on one’s expertise, leadership, and outstanding results on engagements.
  • Track record leading business development and working in collaboration with C-Suite, funds, and financial institutions.
  • Proven track record in leading all aspects of engagements, such as restructurings, liquidations, receiverships and judicial managements.
  • Can run day-to-day operations of a project, navigate disruption, manage project commercials and staffing, and mitigate risks on the project, in coordination with Partner & MD.
  • High energy style, flexible and adaptive, with the ability to work well in a very fast-paced environment.
  • Understands and adapts to complex client environments and situations. Skilled at defining, communicating, motivating and inspiring change at executive levels and across the broader community of stakeholders.
  • Views problems from the ‘big picture POV’, recognizing critical areas to drive into more detail. Quickly structures approaches to solve complex problems. Balanced and flexible, anticipates and changes direction as necessary.
  • Synthesizes information rapidly and applies good business discernment driving quickly to deep insights into possible impacts and solutions.
  • Articulate and persuasive communicator who commands the room, handles executive and difficult audiences well. Readily adapts style and message appropriately to audience and circumstance. Excellent at impromptu communication under pressure.
  • Extraordinary customer service and interpersonal skills. Engenders client confidence and trust with executives at all levels. Builds counseling relationships with clients and peers.
  • Analytical, adept at quickly defining, aligning and scaling data modeling & management approach with the client needs. Ensures 80/20 approach to rapidly draw conclusions. Skilled and quickly identifying anomalies, inconsistencies, errors and conclusions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering or foreign equivalent. Master’s degree and/or certification in related specialty area(s) preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Willingness to work outside of normal U.S. business hours, and in particular as unique projects/needs arise.
  • Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday.
  • Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners’ Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization.

The firm offers a comprehensive benefits program including health, vision, dental, disability, 401K, tuition reimbursement, identity theft protection, and mental wellness support. Employees will also receive a generous paid leave policy including vacation/personal time starting at 7.34 hours per pay period, sick time up to 80 hours annually, parental leave and twelve holidays.

The salary range for this role takes into account a number of factors and is between $230,000/year - $410,000/year with potential eligibility for an annual discretionary bonus.

AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or disability. AlixPartners is a proud Gold award-winning Veteran Friendly Employer.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role:

We are seeking an Analytics Engineer to own and execute the vision for our data transformation layer. You will be at the heart of our data platform, which processes hundreds of millions of events daily from a wide array of sources, including transactional databases, API logs, CRMs, payment systems, and marketing platforms.

You will join our 100% remote team and work closely with Data Engineers (who manage data ingestion) and Data Scientists and Business Users (who consume your data models). Your primary responsibility will be to use dbt and Trino on our GCP-based, open-source data infrastructure to build robust, scalable data models. These models are critical for stakeholders across the company—from finance and operations to the executive team—and are delivered via BI tools, reports, and reverse ETL systems.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the Transformation Layer: Design, build, and maintain scalable data models using dbt and SQL to support diverse business needs, from monthly financial reporting to near-real-time operational metrics.
  • Set Technical Standards: Establish and enforce best practices for data modeling, development, testing, and monitoring to ensure data quality, integrity (up to cent-level precision), and discoverability.
  • Enable Stakeholders: Collaborate directly with finance, operations, customer success, and marketing teams to understand their requirements and deliver reliable data products.
  • Integrate and Deliver: Create repeatable patterns for integrating our data models with BI tools and reverse ETL processes, enabling consistent metric reporting across the business.
  • Ensure Quality: Champion high standards for development, including robust change management, source control, code reviews, and data monitoring as our products and data evolve.

What You Need (Must-Haves):

  • 4+ years of experience in analytics engineering or data engineering with a strong focus on the "T" (transformation) in ELT.
  • Proven track record of owning data products end-to-end, applying analytics and data engineering best practices to ensure data quality, scalability, and robust data models.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and collaborating with stakeholders to define requirements; able to take ownership with minimal oversight in a fast-paced environment.

title: Senior Project Manager - Building Automation / HVAC Controls
description:

This position is responsible for overseeing project schedules, budgets, procurement, field operations, subcontractors, and client relationships while ensuring the successful delivery of complex building automation, DDC, and HVAC controls projects.

This role requires someone who can effectively coordinate controls technicians, programmers, engineers, contractors, and customers while maintaining ownership of project financials, schedules, quality, and overall execution.

Responsibilities

Requirements

  • 5+ years of project management experience in building automation, HVAC controls, or a closely related field.

  • Strong understanding of commercial HVAC equipment, building automation architecture, DDC controls, and low-voltage control systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret control drawings, electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, sequences of operation, specifications, and construction documents.
  • Experience managing projects from initial planning through installation, startup, commissioning, and final turnover.
  • Strong knowledge of project budgeting, forecasting, scheduling, procurement, change orders, and cost control.
  • Experience coordinating controls technicians, programmers, subcontractors, vendors, and other project personnel.
  • Strong technical and problem-solving skills with the ability to understand controls, communication networks, wiring, and HVAC-related issues.
  • Excellent leadership, client communication, organizational, and relationship-management skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and relevant construction or project management software.
  • Valid driver's license with the ability to travel to regional project sites as required.

Benefits

title: Ernæringsassistent, kok eller køkkenfaglig medarbejder til Børnekompasset i Valby
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe madglæde for de yngste børn – og samtidig have stor frihed i dit arbejde?

Vi søger en engageret ernæringsassistent, kok eller anden køkkenfaglig medarbejder til vores produktionskøkken i Månehuset. Stillingen er på 30 timer om ugen med tiltrædelse snarest muligt.

Om stillingen
Du bliver eneansvarlig for køkkenet i Månehuset, hvor du hver dag laver mad til 48 vuggestuebørn fordelt på fire stuer. Det betyder, at du har ansvaret for den daglige drift af køkkenet og stor frihed til selv at planlægge din arbejdsdag.

Du arbejder alene i køkkenet og skal derfor trives med et selvstændigt ansvar. Til gengæld bliver du en vigtig del af huset med et tæt samarbejde med de pædagogiske medarbejdere omkring børnenes måltider og hverdag. Derudover bliver du en del af et køkkenfællesskab med de øvrige køkkenmedarbejdere i Børnekompassets tre afdelinger, hvor der er mulighed for faglig sparring og videndeling.

Arbejdstiden kan ligge i tidsrummet mellem kl. 6.30 og 15.00.

Dine opgaver

  • Lave morgenmad, frokost og mellemmåltider med fokus på smag, kvalitet og ernæring
  • Planlægge madplaner og bestille varer
  • Varetage egenkontrol og sikre høj køkkenhygiejne
  • Klare opvask og lettere rengøring i køkkenet
  • Samarbejde med det pædagogiske personale om gode måltidsoplevelser.
Hvem er vi?
Børnekompasset er en integreret daginstitution med tre matrikler i Valby og produktionskøkken på alle adresser. Vi ser måltidet som en vigtig del af børnenes trivsel, læring og fællesskab. Vi arbejder med høj økologiprocent, sæsonens råvarer, bæredygtighed, mindre madspild og hjemmelavet mad fra bunden. Vi følger Fødevarestyrelsens anbefalinger og Københavns Kommunes retningslinjer.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • er uddannet ernæringsassistent, kok eller har tilsvarende erfaring
  • kan lave velsmagende mad til mange mennesker
  • arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret
  • har fokus på kvalitet, smag og gode råvarer
  • har hygiejnebevis og erfaring med egenkontrol
  • kan anvende IT til indkøb og menuplanlægning
  • har lyst til at være en del af hverdagen i et hus fyldt med børn
Hos os får du

  • et moderne produktionskøkken
  • stor selvstændighed og ansvar for dit eget køkken
  • ingen aften-, weekend- eller helligdagsarbejde
  • et tæt samarbejde med engagerede pædagogiske kolleger
  • faglig sparring med de øvrige køkkenmedarbejdere i Børnekompasset og klyngens køkkennetværk
  • kurser i Kvantum samt løbende kompetenceudvikling gennem bl.a. Meyers Madhus
Løn og ansættelse
Stillingen er på 30 timer ugentligt. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og indenfor rammerne af lokal løndannelse. Ansættelse kan være pr. 1. september 2026, 1. oktober 2026 eller efter aftale.

Vi indhenter børne- og straffeattest og tager referencer i forbindelse med ansættelse.

Mere information
Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte pædagogisk leder Jesper Juhl på 21 33 68 64.

Søg via linket senest tirsdag den 18. august 2026
Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

title: Assistant Chef
description:
St John’s Home has been providing quality and compassionate care to seniors for over 60 years and is transitioning to a nursing home.

The Assistant Chef supports the Chef in preparing safe, nutritious and appetising meals for residents. This includes assisting with daily kitchen operations, special and texture-modified diets, food safety, stock control and supervision of kitchen staff. The Assistant Chef deputises for the Chef and oversees kitchen operations in his absence.

Duties and Responsibilities

· Prepare and cook meals according to approved menus, recipes, portions and schedules.

· Prepare special, therapeutic and texture-modified meals accurately based on diet instructions.

· Coordinate with dietitian, speech therapist, nursing and care teams to meet residents’ dietary, nutritional and swallowing needs.

· Assist the Chef with daily food production and ensure meals are served on time.

· Check food quality, taste, presentation, consistency and portioning before service.

· Comply with food safety, hygiene, sanitation and safe food-handling procedures.

· Monitor food temperatures and maintain accurate kitchen and food-safety records.

· Keep workstations, utensils, equipment, stores and kitchen areas clean, organised and safe.

· Restrict kitchen access to authorised personnel in line with food-safety and hygiene requirements.

· Receive supplies, Donation-in-kind food items, check quality and quantity, rotate stock, store items properly and assist with stock takes.

· Keep halal catered meals (if any) separate from non-halal meals during receiving, storage, handling and service.

· Minimise food wastage and use ingredients, equipment and utilities responsibly.

· Dispose of leftover food using the compost machine in line with food-waste procedures.

· Guidecooks and kitchen assistants when assigned, including on-the-job training in cooking and hygiene practices.

· Report food-safety concerns, shortages, equipment faults and operational issues promptly to the Chef.

· Comply with infection-control and workplace safety requirements, including incident and near-miss reporting.

· Support resident events, special meals, menu improvements and food-related feedback follow-up.

· Deputise for the Chef and oversee kitchen operations in his absence, including production, supervision, compliance, ordering and liaison with departments.

· Support contingency meal arrangements during equipment breakdowns, supply disruptions or outbreak situations.

· Maintain residents’ confidentiality and treat residents, visitors and colleagues with courtesy, dignity and respect.

· Follow the Home’s protocols and SOPs, and participate in audits when required.

· Perform other kitchen-related duties assigned by the Chef or management.

Requirements

· Minimum 5 years’ hands-on cooking experience in a commercial, institutional or large-scale kitchen.

· Experience in nursing home, healthcare, eldercare or institutional catering is an advantage.

· Relevant culinary or catering qualification preferred; strong practical experience maybe considered.

· Valid WSQ Food Safety Course Level 1 certificate or equivalent recognised food-hygiene certification.

· Food Hygiene Officer or Food Safety Management System certification is an advantage.

· Able to cook in large quantities while maintaining consistent quality, portions and presentation.

· Basic understanding of elderly nutrition, food allergies, special diets and texture-modified meals is preferred.

· Good knowledge of kitchen hygiene, sanitation, food storage and safe food handling.

· Able to guide junior kitchen staff and work effectively with the Chef, care staff and other departments.

· Able to lead kitchen operations independently in the Chef’s absence.

· Reliable, organised and able to work independently in a fast-paced kitchen environment.

· Able to perform physically demanding kitchen duties and work shifts, weekends and public holidays when required.

· Basic communication and record-keeping skills.

title: Project Manager
description:
*Remote within Mexico

The Project Manager is responsible for leading customer implementation projects that deploy Arcos software solutions in alignment with customer business objectives, operational requirements, and agreed scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations. This role manages the full implementation lifecycle, including discovery, planning, requirements coordination, solution configuration, integrations, data migration, testing, user acceptance, go-live readiness, stabilization, and transition to support. The Technical Project Manager serves as the primary coordination point between customer stakeholders and Arcos Professional Services, Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales teams, translating customer needs into actionable technical plans, managing risks and dependencies, and driving clear communication to ensure successful implementation outcomes and long-term customer adoption.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • This is intended as an outline of the essential functions of the position. Actual metrics that measure job performance are set forth in separate performance management documentation.

  • Leading project teams using Arcos standard project management practices

  • Developing project management artifacts including project charters, scopes of work, budgets, work plans, risk logs, communication plans, status reports, change requests and other project deliverables.

  • Monitor customer contracts to ensure compliance with the agreed scope of work.

  • Act as the main point of contact and subject matter expert for PMO standards, governance processes, and implementation delivery tools.

  • Serve as the single point of contact for all project-related issues and correspondence.

  • Review new implementation projects with sales staff to identify customer stakeholders, project team members, scope considerations, technical dependencies, and special requirements.

  • Manage multiple simultaneous medium implementations or two to three large implementation projects.

  • Direct and coordinate activities of project personnel to ensure projects progress on schedule and within prescribed budgets.

  • Prepare status reports and review other reports and status updates prepared by project personnel. Modify schedules or plans, as required. Prepare project reports for management, clients, and others.

  • Engage regularly with the Arcos Engineering department to ensure development requirements are finalized and delivery dates are planned and remain on track.

  • Monitor project profitability and burndown status and understand how to take corrective action if a project is off budget.

  • Serve as a liaison between customers, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales to translate business outcomes into clear requirements, solution designs, project plans, risks, and delivery decisions.

  • Partner with technical teams to validate configuration, integration, reporting, security, data migration, testing, and release-readiness activities; identify delivery risks early

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

  • Individual in this position should have:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university or equivalent skill set and experience

  • A minimum of four years of relevant experience, including management experience, is required; five or more years of project or program management experience leading multiple large projects is recommended.

  • Extensive practical experience in product or software implementations.

  • Formal training in or experience with project management practices:

  • Project Management Professional Certification Preferred o Business unit experience, with sensitivity and commitment to business problem solving

  • Technical management experience in a dynamic high-technology environment

  • Superior analytical, written, oral communication, and facilitation skills.

  • Strong understanding of consulting and software as a service (“SaaS”) business concepts, operations, and processes

  • Ability to read, analyze and interpret general business documents, technical procedures and customer reference materials.

  • Demonstrated competency in strategic thinking and leadership with strong abilities in relationship management

  • Demonstrated leadership of multidiscipline, high-performance work teams/groups

  • Successfully developed and implemented new technology

  • Demonstrated competency in project management and the execution of multiple large projects

  • Successfully developed and implemented new work processes or process improvements

  • Gained experience working with customers to develop solutions to highly complex large scale business problems

  • Reasoning ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and work with abstract and concrete variables.

  • Proven ability to lead SaaS implementation projects from discovery through design, configuration, integration, testing, UAT, go-live, stabilization, and post-launch optimization.

  • Strong ability to translate complex technical concepts for business and executive audiences, and to translate business problems into actionable requirements for Product, Engineering, and implementation teams.

  • Experience identifying and creating AI and automation opportunities, Power BI creation and development, estimating business value, defining success measures, and guiding adoption in a way that improves productivity, quality, scalability, and customer outcomes.

  • Comfort using Microsoft 365, Copilot and other AI-enabled productivity tools, Salesforce, collaboration platforms, and project management systems to improve transparency, follow-through, and delivery consistency.

title: Lager- og logistikmedarbejder til elektromotorer og gear i Fredericia
description:
Vil du have fast arbejde, hold på gulvet og lager med tempo?

Vi mangler en lager og logistikmedarbejder i Fredericia.

Du lander på et teknisk lager, hvor varerne skal plukkes, pakkes og sendes korrekt afsted. Varerne er blandt andet elektromotorer, gear og reservedele, så det er ikke bare papkasser uden betydning. Der er fart på forsendelserne, fordi kunderne ofte skal bruge delene hurtigt.

Det er et job for dig, der kan lide orden i reolerne og styr på tallene. Du arbejder sammen med andre på lageret, men du skal også selv kunne tage ansvar for at få dine opgaver lukket ordentligt. Når lagerstyring og optælling spiller, kan resten af huset levere som lovet.

Det får du

Løn: 170-220 kr. i timen

Arbejdsområde: Fredericia og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 15 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Forsendelse, pluk og lagerstyring

Din hverdag

Dagen drejer sig om at få varer plukket, pakket og sendt korrekt. Du arbejder med lagerstyring og optælling, så beholdningen stemmer, og forsendelserne kan komme afsted til tiden.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Håndterer forsendelser og gør varer klar til afsendelse
  • Plukker og pakker varer til kunder og interne opgaver
  • Holder lagerstyring og optælling opdateret
  • Modtager varer og får dem placeret rigtigt på lageret

Når en forsendelse haster, er det vigtigt at du kan holde hovedet koldt og få detaljerne med. Små fejl på lageret kan hurtigt blive til bøvl for kunden, så her tæller ordentlighed i det daglige.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du behøver ikke kunne alt. Men du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine aftaler.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har et par års erfaring fra lager, forsendelse eller pluk og pak
  • Kan holde styr på lageroptælling og vareplacering
  • Møder stabilt og tager fat
  • Arbejder ordentligt sammen med kollegerne

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet teknisk lager før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan lide en hverdag hvor orden, tempo og ansvar hænger sammen.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

title: FRA UFAGLÆRT TIL FAGLÆRT - SOSU-UDDANNELSERNE. START 18.01.2027
description:
Er du ufaglært og allerede ansat ved Sundhed og Omsorg, Aarhus Kommune og drømmer om at uddanne dig til SOSU-hjælper eller SOSU-assistent, så er dette det rigtige stillingsopslag for dig.

Om jobbet:
Som SOSU i Aarhus er du medskaber af det vigtigste i verden: At gøre en forskel i et andet menneskes liv. Bliv en vigtig del af livet i Aarhus - bliv SOSU.

Med en SOSU-uddannelse bliver du faguddannet, og med ny viden kan du påtage dig nye og spændende arbejdsopgaver indenfor SOSU-faget. Helt ekstraordinært er du garanteret ansættelse i Sundhed og Omsorg efter endt uddannelse.

Du kommer til at arbejde med en professionel og helhedsorienteret sygepleje og rehabilitering i det nære og sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen.
Uddannelsen består af både skole- og oplæringsperioder. Skoleperioderne foregår på SOSU Østjylland.

Vi tilbyder et spændende uddannelsesforløb med:

  • Professionelle og engagererede praktikvejledere og kolleger, der sammen sørger for at du under dit praktikforløb modtager velkvalificeret vejledning og udvikler de nødvendige kompetencer.
  • Tværfagligt samarbejde med andre sundhedsfaglige grupper.
  • Mulighed for DigiTech (kun for social- og sundhedsassistentelever)
  • Garanti for job efter endt uddannelse.
En elevstilling i Danmarks andenstørste kommune giver mange udviklingsmuligheder både under uddannelse og efterfølgende. Du kan f.eks. bruge uddannelsen som springbræt til bl.a. sygeplejerske, fysioterapeut eller ergoterapeut.

Krav for at kunne starte på uddannelsesforløbet i projekt Ufaglært til faglært
Du skal som minimum opfylde følgende:

  • Har været ansat i mindst ½ år i Sundhed og Omsorg, Aarhus Kommune og fortsætter ansættelsen indtil uddannelsesstart.
  • Arbejder i gennemsnit mindst 25 timer pr. uge i Sundhed og Omsorg.
  • Har bestået dansk og matematik 9. eller 10. klasse med mindst karakteren 2.
  • Har haft en afklarende samtale med din daglige leder om muligheden for deltagelse i uddannelsestilbuddet.
Din profil:
Som elev i Aarhus Kommune forventer vi, at du har lyst til at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt. Du kan lide at arbejde med mennesker, og du ønsker at gøre en forskel for andre.

  • Du trives med udvikling og læring, har en positiv indstilling til andre mennesker og evner at indgår i et konstruktivt samarbejde.
  • Det falder dig naturligt at reflektere over din faglige og personlige udvikling.
  • Du har ressourcerne til at bevare ro og overblik i en til tider hektisk hverdag.
  • Du er indstillet på at arbejde hen imod at være en central professionel og autoriseret sundhedsperson.
Vi lægger vægt på dine formuleringsevner, punktlighed, interaktion med andre og din evne til at reflektere.

Ansøgning
Ansøgningsfrist er den 18.10.2026. Der kan ikke søges efter ansøgningsfristens udløb.
Klik på ”Søg stillingen” for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes.

Inden du udfylder skemaet, skal du have følgende dokumenter klar:

  • Opdateret CV– Du skal bruge denne skabelon, og uploade til din ansøgning CV skabelon
  • Din motiverede ansøgning
  • Bekræftelseserklæring og vurderingsskema fra din leder - Uddannelsestilbud - Fra ufaglært til faglært - AarhusIntra (aarhuskommune.dk)
  • Dokumentation på standpunkts- eller eksamenskarakter.
  • Realkompetencevurdering (RKV), hvis du har en.
  • Er du ikke dansk statsborger, skal du vedhæfte din opholdstilladelse eller seneste bekræftelse fra Udlændingestyrelsen på ansøgning om ophold.
I din motiverede ansøgning skal du skrive (max. 1 side), hvor du besvarer følgende spørgsmål:

  1. Fortæl kort om dig selv, og hvad du er god til
  2. Hvad har motiveret dig til at søge denne uddannelse?
  3. Hvordan kan dine erfaringer gavne dig i uddannelsesforløbet?
Til samtalen vil vi tale om de ting du har skrevet i din ansøgning. Herudover vil vi komme ind på overvejelser om arbejdstider og balancen mellem arbejds- og privatliv.

For at kunne starte på Grundforløb 2, er det vigtigt at du også husker at søge om optagelse hos SOSU-Østjylland, via .

Først når du har modtaget kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Vi forventer at afvikle jobsamtaler i uge 46

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

title: Superintendent
description:
B&S Site Development is a fast‑growing leader in large‑parcel, mission‑critical site development, delivering complex, time‑sensitive civil construction projects for some of the world’s most demanding clients. Since 2003, we’ve built a reputation for precision, speed, and accountability—transforming large tracts of land into fully prepared e‑infrastructure sites through heavy civil expertise, disciplined project management, and a culture of ownership at every level. Our multi‑regional operations are supported by offices in Columbus, Ohio; Manassas, Virginia; Richmond, Virginia; South Hill, Virginia; and Atlanta, Georgia, enabling us to scale rapidly while maintaining exceptional execution standards.

At B&S, we believe in developing talent from within, fostering a culture where driven individuals can build long‑term careers. Whether in the field or the office, our teams are united by a shared commitment to innovation, safety, and delivering exceptional results for our clients.

Role Description

Superintendents are responsible for managing the field operations across multiple active job sites. The role requires advanced knowledge of heavy civil construction, strong leadership capabilities, and a proactive approach to solving problems. The Superintendent will be responsible for project execution, safety, scheduling, coordination of subcontractors, and ensuring projects stay on time and within budget.

Superintendent Responsibilities:

• Oversee all daily site operations and ensure project milestones are met.

• Coordinate and schedule crews, subcontractors, equipment, and materials.

• Review and interpret construction drawings, plans, and specifications.

• Ensure work is performed according to design, budget, schedule, and quality standards.

• Monitor safety compliance and conduct regular safety meetings and inspections.

• Communicate daily with project managers regarding progress, issues, and solutions.

• Lead and mentor foremen and field crews to promote productivity and accountability.

• Manage inspections, testing, and documentation required by municipalities or clients.

• Identify potential risks or delays and implement corrective actions.

• Maintain accurate records including daily reports, timecards, and material logs.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in site development or heavy civil construction.

• 3+ years of supervisory experience as a Superintendent or similar leadership role.

• Proficient in reading and interpreting civil plans and construction documents.

• Strong understanding of grading, utility installation, stormwater management, and paving.

• Knowledge of construction safety protocols and OSHA regulations.

• Ability to lead and motivate field personnel effectively.

• Excellent organizational, scheduling, and problem-solving skills.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Competency in basic computer applications (Microsoft Office, project management software).

• Valid driver’s license.

• OSHA 30 Certification strongly preferred.

Why join us:

  • Competitive Salary & Benefits: We offer a competitive salary along with health insurance, retirement plans, and performance bonuses.
  • Career Advancement: We are committed to the growth and development of our employees, offering training programs and opportunities for career progression.
  • Challenging and Rewarding Work: Lead diverse and impactful projects that challenge your skills and expertise.
  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Work with the latest machinery and technology in the construction industry.
  • Strong Safety Culture: We prioritize the safety and well-being of our employees with regular training and strict safety protocols.

What we offer:

  • Health, Life, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Plan – Matching up to 6% Fully Vested Day ONE!
  • Paid Time Off (PTO), Parental Leave, Paid Pregnancy Medical Leave
  • Paid Holidays

title: Technician
description:

Our unique turnkey services help reduce harmful emissions, improve plant performance, and extend the life of valuable industrial equipment and infrastructure. We are a people-centric organization with employees committed to safety, integrity, and accountability.

About the Position

Groome Industrial Service Group is seeking dedicated individuals in St. Louis, MO to join our team as Technicians with CDL. This role involves traveling from our MO location to power generation plants throughout the region, where you will receive training to de-slag large utility boilers using explosives.

Why work for Groome Industrial Service Group?

  • Competitive wages

  • Completing all related paperwork.

  • Vision requirements include close and distance vision.
  • Physical demand level (PDL) ranges from Medium to Very Heavy; willingness to fulfill all demand levels is essential.
  • Ability to lift 90 pounds.

What does it take to work for Groome Industrial Service Group?

  • CDL Class A license required.
  • Basic mechanical skills required.
  • Must be at least 21 years old with a valid driver’s license.
  • No felony or family violence convictions.
  • No DWI convictions in the last 5 years.
  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Reliable transportation and residence within an hour of our MO office.
  • Willingness to be on call 24/7.
  • Must pass a pre-employment physical, drug screen, and background check.

title: Meteorologist
description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. (NYSE: TGNA) helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

WCNC-TV Charlotte in NBC is looking for a dynamic and engaging Meteorologist to join our passionate team. This position is responsible for preparing and delivering accurate weather reports on-air and online in a conversational manner. The key responsibility is the ability to gather and analyze information and alert our audiences about what’s going to happen with weather in their community. We are looking for a team player who can help with every aspect of meteorology, from forecasting, to preparing graphics, to reporting in the field, you will be an integral part of severe weather coverage, and reaching our consumers not only on TV, but online and on social media. The ideal candidate embraces new technology and is willing to explore new ways to present the weather story. As a central member of the WX department, the ideal candidate is a team player who participates in brainstorming and planning for future shows, including important weather events and explainers.

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and deliver severe weather updates, interrupting regular programming as necessary.

  • Fill in on other shifts when necessary.

  • Update website and interact with viewers on social media platforms daily
  • Perform special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Make public appearances

Requirements:

  • BA/BS degree in Meteorology, Geoscience or Atmospheric Science.

title: Software Engineer, AI/Agents
description:
American farmers have made tremendous technology advancements through hardware improvements and investments in precision agriculture. However, when it comes to the back-office, most farms are decades behind, relying on spreadsheets, filing cabinets, and decades-old on-prem software to recruit, manage, and pay their workforce. Seso is addressing this problem by modernizing the back-office for the farm.

Our mission is to build the premier platform for agribusiness to hire and manage their workforce and improve the lives of agricultural workers. We are addressing American farmers’ biggest pain point - access to qualified labor - through a software-enabled labor solution that automates the H-2A visa. Our comprehensive HR platform streamlines and automates the hiring process for farms and seamlessly integrates their efforts across recruitment, onboarding, payroll, and insurance while providing workers access to financial services for the first time.

Seso has raised over $60M from Tier I investors including Index, Founders Fund, and Mary Meeker at Bond, and has been recognized with awards including Forbes Rising Stars and Andreessen Horowitz's American Dynamism 50.

About the role:
Seso is building the first modern payroll and workforce platform for agriculture, an industry that's been ignored by every other HR/payroll company because it's "too hard." We're growing fast, and we're looking for an engineer who's genuinely AI-native: not someone bolting a chatbot onto a product, but someone who thinks in agents, evals, and production ML systems as a default way of building software. We’ve shipped our first agents, and need a true thought partner to help level up our game.

What you'll do

  • Design and ship production AI agents that are core to the product experience (not prototypes, not demos)
  • Work across our stack (TypeScript, Node.js/React) to build features end-to-end
  • Bring ML/AI judgment to product decisions as in, where agents make sense, where they don't, and how to make them reliable in production
  • Move fast in a startup environment where you'll own real ambiguity and be empowered to push the boundaries

Must-haves

  • Hands-on ML background and/or real experience building and shipping production AI agents (not just API calls to a model: non-trivial agent design, evals, and reliability work at scale)
  • Strong TypeScript experience
  • 2+ years of professional software development experience

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with LangGraph/LangChain or similar agent frameworks
  • Node.js/React stack experience
  • Forward-deployed engineering (FDE) experience and comfort being customer-facing - translating real-world problems into shipped solutions
  • 3–5+ years of professional development experience
  • Based in San Francisco (preferred)

Comp range: $160,000 - $220,000 annually

We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors to determine your personal top of market. We rely on market indicators to determine compensation and consider your specific job related skills and experience for accuracy. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary and will also be dependent on your location.

Diversity is more than a commitment at Seso, it is the foundation of what we do. We pride ourselves on building the premier platform that serves agribusiness and improves the lives of agricultural workers. We believe in diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ethnicity, national origin and all the other fascinating characteristics that make us all feel welcome.

title: ZOHO UI/UX Developer

This role offers the opportunity to design intuitive and engaging digital experiences within a powerful business application ecosystem.
You will combine UI/UX expertise with technical knowledge to create solutions that improve usability and support business objectives.
Working closely with product and development teams, you will transform user needs into polished, functional interfaces.
The position requires creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to balance design principles with technical requirements.
You will contribute to improving workflows, enhancing user satisfaction, and delivering high-quality application experiences.
This is an ideal opportunity for a skilled UI/UX professional who enjoys working with low-code platforms and innovative digital solutions.

Accountabilities:

The ZOHO UI/UX Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing user interfaces and experiences across business applications. The role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that are visually appealing, functional, and aligned with user expectations.

  • Design and develop user interfaces and user experiences within the ZOHO ecosystem.
  • Create intuitive, efficient, and visually engaging application workflows that improve user interactions.
  • Collaborate with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into effective design solutions.
  • Develop prototypes, wireframes, and interface concepts using modern design tools.
  • Customize and enhance applications using ZOHO Creator, ZOHO CRM, ZOHO Desk, and related platforms.
  • Apply front-end development skills including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ZML, and ZOHO Canvas to create responsive experiences.
  • Ensure designs align with usability principles, business objectives, and technical capabilities.
  • Identify user experience challenges and propose creative, practical solutions.
  • Maintain high standards of visual quality, consistency, and attention to detail across interfaces.
  • Communicate design decisions clearly and collaborate effectively throughout the development lifecycle.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong UI/UX design capabilities with technical expertise in ZOHO applications and front-end technologies. They should be comfortable working independently while collaborating with product and engineering teams.

    • Proven experience designing user interfaces and user experiences for digital applications.
    • Strong proficiency with ZOHO Creator, ZOHO CRM, ZOHO Desk, and other ZOHO applications.
    • Solid knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ZML, and ZOHO Canvas.
    • Experience using prototyping and design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch.
    • Strong UI/UX design portfolio demonstrating creativity, usability, and attention to detail.
    • Ability to analyze complex requirements and create user-friendly solutions.
    • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain design concepts and decisions.
    • Strong problem-solving skills and a creative approach to overcoming design challenges.
    • Experience with low-code/no-code development platforms is preferred.
    • Familiarity with front-end frameworks such as React or Angular is a plus.
    • UI/UX design or ZOHO development certification is an advantage.

      • Benefits:

      • Flexible remote work opportunity.
      • Part-time position with adaptable working arrangements.
      • Opportunity to work on innovative business application solutions.
      • Exposure to UI/UX design, automation, and low-code development environments.
      • Collaborative work environment with product and technical teams.

title: Lærer til specialiseret skoletilbud
description:
Lærer til specialiseret skoletilbud

Brænder du for undervisning af børn med særlige behov?

Astrup Skole søger pr. 01.10.2026 en dygtig lærer, der ønsker at være del af et stærkt og fagligt velfunderet hold, hvor læring, nærvær og fællesskab er i centrum. Der er tale om en fast stilling på fuld tid.

Målgruppe: Astrup Skole er Mariagerfjord Kommunes specialskole for elever med vidtgående generelle indlæringsvanskeligheder. Målgruppen spænder fra børn med faglige og sociale udfordringer til elever med multiple funktionsnedsættelser, fx inden for det kommunikative, relationelle, perceptuelle, motoriske, fysiske eller psykiske område.

Astrup skole: På skolen trives over 70 fantastiske elever i alderen 6-17 år, fordelt i mindre klasser, hvor der er plads til nærvær, læring og fællesskab. Bag dem står et engageret og fagligt stærkt hold bestående af lærere, pædagoger, pædagogmedhjælpere, pædagogstuderende, sekretærer, rengøringsassistenter, en servicemedarbejder samt skolens ledelse, der hver dag arbejder for at skabe de bedste rammer for elevernes læring og trivsel.

Vi søger en lærer, der:

  • Har en læreruddannelse og gerne erfaring med specialpædagogik
  • Brænder for at undervise elever med særlige behov
  • Kan undervise i en bred vifte af folkeskolens fag
  • Kan arbejde struktureret og tilpasse indsatsen til den enkelte elev
  • Ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger
  • Udviser ro, tålmodighed og tydelighed – også i uforudsigelige situationer
  • Er robust og fleksibel i forhold til hverdagens mangeartede opgaver og udfordringer
  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og en anerkendende tilgang til både elever og kollegaer
  • Er åben og har en nysgerrig tilgang til læringsperspektivet: Du har øje for de små succeser og evner at tilpasse dine tilgange og metoder ud fra den enkelte elevs behov og forudsætninger
  • Kan indgå i et tæt og forpligtende teamsamarbejde - ”Dét, vi aftaler, er også dét, vi gør!”
  • Kan indgå i et tæt samarbejde med eksterne samarbejdspartnere
  • Ser forældresamarbejdet som en helt central ressource
  • Vil bidrage til at gøre Astrup Skole til en endnu mere attraktiv arbejdsplads

Vi tilbyder:

  • En meningsfuld stilling på en skole, hvor faglighed og udvikling vægtes højt
  • En skole, hvor vi ser læring og trivsel som hinandens forudsætninger
  • Et fællesskab med dygtige kollegaer, som brænder for undervisning og specialpædagogik
  • Mulighed for kompetenceudvikling
  • Gode arbejdsvilkår og en arbejdsplads med fokus på trivsel
  • Faglige udfordringer
  • En arbejdsplads med høj grad af ansvar og medbestemmelse – hvor initiativer og ideer er velkomne, og hvor løsninger findes i dialog
  • En arbejdsplads med et fundament, der bygger på tillid og ordentlighed
  • En arbejdsplads med plads til humor

På Astrup Skole bliver du en del af et fagligt stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi ansætter medarbejdere til at arbejde professionelt med børns læring og trivsel – med udgangspunkt i egen faglighed og i et tæt, forpligtende samarbejde.
Vi tror på, at det professionelle fællesskab og den enkelte medarbejders faglige bidrag er afgørende for, at børn kan udvikle sig og trives.

Yderligere information

For yderligere information kan du besøge skolens hjemmeside , eller kontakte afdelingsleder Heidi Sloth Christensen på tlf. 97114904 eller skoleleder Peter Munk Hangaard på tlf. 97114901

Ansøgningsfrist: fredag den 21. august 2026. kl. 12.00.

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes tirsdag d. 25. august 2026.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er på 37 timer pr. uge med tiltrædelse pr. 1/10-2026.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold efter gældende overenskomst.

Der vil blive indhentet straffe- og børneattest inden evt. ansættelse.

Der vil ligeledes blive indhentet reference efter nærmere aftale inden evt. ansættelse.

Om Mariagerfjord Kommune
Mariagerfjord Kommune er en af Danmarks smukkeste kommuner med en unik og varieret natur ved skov, strand og fjord. Vi ligger centralt mellem Aalborg og Aarhus og er på den måde et bindeled mellem Nordjylland og resten af landet. Vores mål er klart: Vi vil mere, og der er plads til flere. Derfor har vi fokus på at skabe de bedste rammer for vores cirka 42.000 borgere, for vores erhvervsliv og for udviklingen af kommunen.

I Mariagerfjord Kommune ønsker vi, at alle vores 3.400 medarbejdere oplever sig som en vigtig del af fællesskabet. Vi har frihed til at bringe vores kompetencer og ideer i spil, så vi løser kerneopgaven bedst muligt og gør en forskel for vores borgere. Vi har fokus på psykologisk tryghed og viser respekt for hinandens forskelligheder. Alle tager vi et medansvar for fællesskabet og opgaven, og derfor lægger vi også stor vægt på et velfungerende samarbejde i MED-organisationen.

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle interesserede ansøgere til at søge job hos os, uanset personlig baggrund.

title: Director, Executive Communications
description:
Who We Are

Authentic Brands Group (Authentic) is a leading sports, media, entertainment and lifestyle platform. As the owner of some of the most iconic and beloved intellectual property in the world, Authentic acquires and invests in brands to create long-term value for all of its stakeholders.
A digital-first, asset-light platform, Authentic sits at the intersection of culture, commerce and technology. It brings brands to life and cultivates fandom through powerful storytelling, premium content and unforgettable live experiences. Together with nearly 2,000 best-in-class licensing partners across 150 countries and an expansive distribution network, Authentic’s brands drive more than $38 billion in annual systemwide retail sales worldwide.

Why Authentic

You’ll be able to access the resources and scale, while leveraging innovative technology and nimble environment. What we’re saying is, this isn’t your average day job. If you’re hungry to drive ideas into action and own your career, let’s chat. Our team is rapidly innovating to evolve and define the future of our brands. With the help of some of the brightest minds in retail, marketing, licensing, legal and more, we are building the intersection of digital and experiential marketing to help achieve that mission. We reimagine, evolve and transform brands! At Authentic, we foster an inclusive workplace where diversity of thought and expertise drive competitive advantage. Our global teams are built by go-getters who contribute unique perspectives and push the boundaries of creativity and innovation. Headquartered in New York City, Authentic has offices in major metropolitan cities including Los Angeles and Miami, as well as Toronto, Mexico City, London, and Shanghai.

What You'll Do

Authentic is seeking a sharp, creative, and highly attuned communications professional to join the company as Director, Executive Communications. This role sits within Corporate Communications and is responsible for shaping executive visibility, content strategy, and distribution across Authentic's leadership team, with primary responsibility for the Founder and Executive Chairman.

Reporting directly to the Head of Corporate Communications, you'll serve as an on-the-ground partner, identifying meaningful moments to develop content that advances both individual executive platforms and Authentic's broader business priorities. Approximately 70% of the role will focus on the Founder and Executive Chairman, with the remaining time dedicated to supporting executive communications and strategic counsel across the broader Executive Committee.

This is a highly visible individual contributor role. The Director will own both the strategy and execution of executive communications, partnering with internal teams and external creative resources to deliver high-impact content and thought leadership.

What You'll Be Working On

Founder & Executive Chairman Communications

  • Develop and execute executive visibility strategies aligned with Authentic's corporate communications priorities.
  • Serve as the primary communications partner to the Founder and Executive Chairman while supporting broader executive positioning initiatives across the leadership team.
  • Identify opportunities to amplify Authentic's business priorities through executive storytelling.
  • Own and shape the Founder and Executive Chairman's brand across all channels by:
    • Ensuring consistency, authenticity, and alignment with Authentic's broader business and cultural vision.
    • Securing and executing high-impact speaking engagements, media opportunities, and social content.

Broader Executive Communications

  • While the Founder and Executive Chairman will be your primary executive partner, you'll also collaborate with the Executive Committee to provide strategic communications counsel and support key corporate initiatives.
  • Partner with senior leaders to develop executive messaging that advances Authentic's corporate narrative and business priorities, with a primary focus on external communications.

Content Strategy & Social Media

  • Develop and execute executive communications strategies across multiple channels, balancing long-term planning with day-to-day execution.
  • Write and produce compelling content, including social media posts, talking points, messaging, and executive thought leadership.
  • Deliver a steady pipeline of dynamic content aligned with Authentic's corporate narrative that engages the Founder and Executive Chairman's audiences across LinkedIn, Instagram, and other key platforms.
  • Identify opportunities for engagement and proactively create content that supports business growth.
  • Monitor social performance through reporting and analytics, using insights to continuously optimize reach and impact.
  • Partner with Authentic's internal content team and external freelancers to produce high-quality creative assets when appropriate.

Conferences, Events & Executive Visibility

  • Prepare and manage briefing materials and talking points for speaking engagements, interviews, panels, and thought leadership opportunities.
  • Partner cross-functionally to support executive visibility around key company milestones, activations, announcements, and strategic initiatives.
  • Coordinate with photographers, creative partners, and other external service providers to execute best-in-class executive visibility initiatives.

Must Haves

  • Proven ability to translate business strategy into compelling executive narratives across multiple channels.
  • 7–10 years of experience supporting high-profile individuals and/or senior executives within a talent agency, entertainment company, or corporate environment.
  • Experience in executive communications, corporate communications, content strategy, executive brand development, or related fields.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills with the ability to move seamlessly between strategy and execution.
  • Outstanding judgment, executive presence, and the ability to build trusted relationships with senior leaders.
  • Experience navigating high-stakes, high-profile environments—both corporate and cultural.
  • Self-starter with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities while collaborating effectively across teams.
  • Flexibility to travel approximately monthly to support executive engagements and company initiatives.
  • Availability to work outside of traditional business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed. This is an "always-on" communications role supporting executive visibility and social media.
  • High degree of discretion and the ability to maintain confidentiality regarding sensitive information.

Why This Role

This is a unique opportunity to shape the voice and visibility of Authentic's Founder and Executive Chairman while partnering with the Executive Committee to elevate executive communications across the company. You'll play a critical role in advancing Authentic's corporate narrative, influencing how the company's leaders engage with employees, partners, media, and the broader marketplace.

Primary Location Salary Range:

$110,000 - $140,000
