project meetings (Hand-Off Meeting, Kick-Off Meeting, etc.) with appropriate parties in a timely manner.• Negotiate and prepare vendor and subcontractor agreements in alignment with project estimates.• Evaluate submittals to ensure they reflect the contract drawings, specifications.• Coordinate quality assurance and quality control with appropriate personnel to meet company and project requirements.• Responsible for managing the coordination of project’s scope through the Building Information Management Department with assistance from the appropriate quality control personnel and project supervision.• Perform the financial set up of the project including equipment, labor, materials, other direct job costs, and subcontracts for leadership approval.• Conduct monthly project cost reviews, capturing any deviations from the financial setup or schedule early while keeping all project team members and leadership informed to aid in beating project schedule and budgetary goals.• Manage the project’s Accounts Receivables by developing the pay applications schedule of value to ensure timely and accurate billings and collection of our payments to maintain a positive cash position.• Manage the project’s Accounts Payables by working with the Accounting and Legal Departments to ensure that subcontractors and vendors are paid in a timely fashion and all risks associated with payments are mitigated.• Responsible for obtaining and coordinating appropriate lien waivers, state notifications, tax documentation, and permits for the project.• Responsible for ensuring the project’s budget and scope are always aligned through the change management process.• Daily project requirements include but not limited to: attend jobsites meetings, schedule deliveries, perform project site documentation, review jobsite labor reports with supervision, tool/equipment rental requisition, coordinate job progress, material and consumables requisitions, preparation and tracking Desired:

As an Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) for classified systems at General Dynamics Mission Systems, you will ensure the security and integrity of classified information systems. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to implement and maintain robust security measures. In this role, you will develop, implement, and maintain security policies and procedures, conduct risk assessments, and manage security-related documentation. You will monitor and evaluate system compliance with security requirements, provide guidance on information security best practices, and ensure adherence to government and industry standards. Additionally, you will perform security audits, manage incident response activities, and collaborate with other security professionals to address and mitigate security risks. This role requires excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment. Are you ready to make a difference?

What you’ll experience:

  • Technologies that aren’t just top-notch, they’re often top-secret
  • A team of bold thinkers committed to exploring what’s next
  • Opportunities to gain new knowledge - as it’s discovered

What you bring to the table:

  • Experience developing System Security Plans (SSP) and all supporting Assessment and Authorization documentation such as Security Assessment Reports, SCTM’s and POA&M’s
  • Experience with eMASS and Service NOW (SNOW) risk management and compliance automation tools
  • Experience with various system security assessment/hardening tools - SCAP Compliance Checker, STIG Viewer, ACAS/Nessus, etc
  • Trained and proficient in Assured File Transfer (AFT) procedures
  • Self-starter with the ability to operate independently with minimal supervision
  • Department of Defense Secret clearance required at time of hire and Top Secret obtainable within a reasonable time frame based on requirements.

What sets you apart:

  • Outstanding communications skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team throughout the system life cycle
  • DoD 8570 or 8140 Certification meeting IAM Level II (e.g., CISSP, CAP, etc.)
  • Demonstrated comprehensive knowledge of the NISPOM-DAAG, NIST SP 800-53, and NIST 800-171

The qualified candidate shall:

  • Execute or support the execution of A&A activities, including development of required security documentation, including items such as System Security Plans, Security Assessment Reports, SCTM’s and POA&M’s
  • Perform weekly system audit reviews, media reviews, hardware/software configuration management
  • Execute security testing and evaluation to ensure correct implementation of security controls
  • Support the assessment and mitigation of vulnerabilities throughout a systems life cycle
  • Conduct IA security education training for all system users on appropriate risk mitigation strategies
  • Perform incident response and cleanup actions, when necessary, per company or customer directions
  • Ensure systems are operated, maintained, and disposed of in accordance with internal security policies and procedures outlined in the System Security Plan (SSP)

• Must be able to obtain a Secret Clearance

• Identifies opportunities to apply AI for continuous improvement and innovation

Salary Note

title: Sjældent udbudt fuldtidsstilling som pædagog i skole og HFO
description:
Det er ikke hver dag, vi slår en fuldtidsstilling op på skole- og fritidsområdet – men nu har du chancen.

HFO1 Ålerusen på Hillerød Vest Skolen, afdeling Ålholm, søger en uddannet pædagog til en fuldtidsstilling med opgaver i både skole og HFO. Stillingen indeholder 8 timer i skoledelen, hvor du bliver tilknyttet en af vores skønne 1. klasser. Her får du en vigtig rolle som en central voksen, der skaber sammenhæng, tryghed og trivsel i børnenes hverdag.
Stillingen ønskes besat senest 1. oktober 2026.

Hvem er vi?
Vi er en stor HFO med mange børn og engagerede medarbejdere. Du bliver en del af en afdeling med 1. og 2. årgang, hvor omkring 140 børn og 9 dedikerede kolleger hver dag arbejder sammen om at skabe et trygt, udviklende og inkluderende miljø.
Hos os er fællesskabet omdrejningspunktet – både for børn og voksne. Vi arbejder målrettet med NEST-pædagogikken og anvender dens metoder og værktøjer aktivt i hverdagen, så alle børn oplever sig som værdifulde deltagere i fællesskabet.
Vores arbejdsfællesskab er præget af humor, faglig nysgerrighed og lyst til udvikling. Samtidig værner vi om vores mange traditioner, som blandt andet tæller rollespilsuge, det årlige stafetløb, Talent Show, julehyggedag og meget mere. Her er plads til både leg, læring og store grin.

Vi søger dig, der
  • brænder for fællesskaber og tror på, at alle børn har ret til at høre til
  • trives i et tæt samarbejde og bidrager positivt til relationer med børn, forældre og kolleger
  • arbejder struktureret og samtidig kan navigere i en levende og omskiftelig hverdag
  • er en tydelig, nærværende og tryg voksen, der møder børnene med varme, nysgerrighed og faglighed

Vi tilbyder
  • et stærkt og nærværende kollegafællesskab, hvor vi løfter i flok
  • en varieret hverdag med opgaver i både skole og HFO
  • et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på trivsel, faglighed og udvikling – for både børn og voksne
  • mulighed for at sætte dine kompetencer i spil og bidrage til udviklingen af vores pædagogiske praksis

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst. Ved ansættelse indhentes straffe- og børneattest.

Vil du vide mere?
Du er velkommen til at kontakte HFO-leder Irina Kirina på telefon 72 32 74 60.
Vi tilbyder også gerne en rundvisning, så du kan opleve vores hverdag og møde nogle af de mennesker, du måske snart skal arbejde sammen med.

Ansøgningsfrist
Torsdag den 20. august 2026

Ansættelsessamtaler
Onsdag den 26. august 2026 kl. 09.00-12.00

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

Ansøgningen sendes elektronisk via linket

Hos os er det ikke kun arbejdet, der tæller, men også menneskene bag.

I fællesskab gør vi hver dag en forskel for kommunens mere end 54.000 borgere, og vi sætter pris på det helt særlige bidrag, som du kommer med. Vi er stolte af at gå nye veje og sammen finde løsninger på de udfordringer, som møder os. Hillerød Kommune er en fleksibel arbejdsplads, hvor vi tror på værdien af både forskellighed og sammenhold. Det er vigtigt, at alle føler sig anerkendt og respekteret, for hos os er arbejdsglæde en forudsætning for den gode kvalitet og tilfredse borgere.

title: JCO Partner Nation Integrator
description:
About the Role
As a JCO Partner Nation Integrator, you serve as the primary coordinator and subject matter expert for integrating Partner Nations into the Joint Commercial Operations (JCO) enterprise. This role manages the full lifecycle of Partner Nation engagement, from initial induction planning through agreement execution, exercise coordination, and sustained liaison support, ensuring Partner Nation equities are represented across JCO operations and stakeholder forums.

Why This Role Matters
The Partner Nation Integrator strengthens the JCO mission by expanding coalition participation and enabling burden-sharing across the joint and international space enterprise. This position ensures Partner Nations are properly onboarded, resourced, and represented, while maintaining the agreements, training pipelines, and working relationships that allow commercial and coalition capabilities to be integrated into joint military decision-making.

This role offers an opportunity to shape how Partner Nations are brought into and sustained within the JCO, directly influencing coalition space integration, security cooperation outcomes, and the JCO's relationships with Combatant Commands, Service Components, and allied space organizations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate, draft, and manage Acquisition and Cross-Servicing Agreement (ACSA) transactions with JCO Partner Nations, including educating partners on ACSA requirements, drafting and coordinating transaction forms, tracking Equal Value Exchange (EVE) execution, processing annual renewals, and maintaining accurate records in AGATRs.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and inputs to USSF Component Field Commands (C-FLDCOMs) on JCO-relevant Operations, Activities, and Investments (OAIs), and represent JCO interests in regional Space Domain Working Groups (SDWGs) and CCMD Space Security Cooperation Resourcing Working Groups.
  • Support development and implementation of Significant Security Cooperation Initiatives (SSCIs), advising on capabilities, sensor locations, security, and military utility, and serving as the coordination point between integrators and engineering teams for detailed assessments.
  • Support Partner Nation planning for initial space operations, cadre development, and all-domain integration strategy, and facilitate Partner Nation sensor and data integration into the JCO.
  • Coordinate Partner Nation participation in CCMD, USSF C-FLDCOM, and JCO-sponsored exercises, including bilateral and multilateral cooperative events, and assist in coordinating L2H HVA training with Partner Nations.
  • Coordinate security cooperation cases involving the JCO — including AFSAT non-tuition MASLs, Building Partner Capacity (BPC), SSCI, Section 333, and Foreign Military Sales (FMS) cases — with Partner Nations and appropriate stakeholders.
  • Lead induction of new Partner Nations into the JCO when authorized, establishing induction plans, delivering JCO mission overviews, and coordinating with U.S. entities (USSPACECOM, CCMDs, SPACEFOR Components) to validate and prioritize candidate nations.
  • Serve as liaison to Regional Combatant Commands, SPACEFOR Components, NATO, U.S. Country Teams/Embassies, JIST, and Partner Nation space organizations, and review CCMD and C-FLDCOM plans involving Partner Nations.
  • Coordinate JCO operator training (P&D, TacSRT, EMSO) and plan and execute JCO National Cell Certification as required.
  • Support recurring JCO governance forums, including Battle Rhythm Events, Futures Battle Rhythm, the Ops Review Panel, and the Global Staff Meeting, particularly issues requiring Partner Nation coordination.
  • Represent JCO Partner Nation equities at international conferences (e.g., AMOS, Space Symposium, Space Conference of the Americas) and support JCO tours and visits, international academic program engagement, and international defense research and development touchpoints.
  • Develop talking points and coordinate positions for USSPACECOM, Space Force Components, CCMDs, and OSW-P regarding JCO interactions with Partner Nations.
  • Maintain working knowledge of JCO operational currency and proficiency, observe JCO Live Flys to maintain situational awareness, and work with Regional Coordinators to support effective daily regional operations capacity.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience working security cooperation agreements or authorities such as ACSA, Foreign Military Sales (FMS), Building Partner Capacity (BPC), or Section 333 cases.
  • Demonstrated experience in international partner engagement, security cooperation, or coalition/space security cooperation environments.
  • Working knowledge of space operations concepts and joint/coalition space integration.
  • Experience serving as a liaison across Combatant Commands, Service Components, or interagency and international partners, including NATO or U.S. Country Teams/Embassies.
  • Superior written and oral communication skills, including the ability to draft formal agreements, talking points, and briefings for senior military and civilian stakeholders.
  • Highly motivated self-starter capable of independent execution across multiple concurrent stakeholder relationships.
  • Ability to travel in support of exercises, conferences, and Partner Nation engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with the JCO, USSPACECOM, U.S. Space Force, and their Component relationships.
  • Experience with AGATRs or similar agreement-tracking and management systems.
  • Experience with Space Operations.
  • Prior experience in joint or coalition exercise planning and execution.
  • Regional expertise or foreign language proficiency relevant to an assigned Partner Nation portfolio.
  • Experience supporting Security Cooperation resourcing or working groups at the CCMD or Component level.
  • Experience working in joint and interagency environments, including operation centers across multiple levels of government.

Experience and Education

Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of experience in security cooperation, international affairs, or space/joint operations preferred.

Salary Range (CO)
$160,000—$200,000 USD

Clearance Requirement: This position may require the ability to obtain a TS/SCI Clearance. To be eligible for a security clearance, U.S. citizenship is required, and an employee must agree to participate in a background screen and credit check. Eligibility for a TS/SCI Clearance will be assessed as part of the onboarding process or based on programmatic needs.

About Bluestaq
At Bluestaq, we build secure data platforms that matter for space missions, national defense, healthcare systems, and commercial innovation. Founded in 2018, we've become a leader in enterprise software and secure data management by staying focused on what counts: modern architecture, operational excellence, and mission impact.

We're engineers, problem-solvers, and builders who take the mission seriously, but not ourselves. We automate the repeatable, question the status quo, and design systems that are as reliable as they are scalable. Whether we're supporting space, defense systems, or healthcare advancements, we build with the same principles: cloud-native solutions, security by design, and relentless simplicity.

Relocation: This position does not offer relocation. Candidates must live in the immediate area or relocate at their own expense.

Date the Position Closes: Applications will be accepted for 60 days beyond the posting date, or until the position is filled, whichever comes first.

Bluestaq is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees on the basis age 40 and over, color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, military or veteran status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by state or local law.

title: Senior Engineer I/II, Drug Discovery Platform
description:
Your Impact at LILA

We're building an AI-driven drug discovery factory that closes the loop between computational design and wet-lab experiment in days instead of months. The bottleneck for that loop is data: every compound designed, synthesized, QC'd, and tested needs to be registered, tracked, and surfaced back to our AI Scientists with low latency and high fidelity.

As the Senior Engineer for the Drug Discovery Platform, you will own the data backbone that makes this closed loop possible: the molecule queue, the compound registration system, the synthesis constraints, and the experimental result capture pipelines that feed back into our predictive models. Your work will directly determine how fast our AI learns from each cycle, and therefore how fast we deliver new medicines.

What You'll Be Building

  • Molecule Queue: Design and operate the shared queue that brokers compounds between AI Scientists and the Make-Test platform, including the status state machine, batch grouping, priority semantics, and the read/write contracts both sides depend on.
  • Compound & Structure Registration: Build the canonical molecule registry, including SMILES/InChI normalization, stereochemistry handling, salt/parent resolution, duplicate detection, and stable internal IDs (e.g., LILA-NNN) that every downstream system can rely on.
  • Lab Instrument Integration: Build pipelines that ingest data from ChemSpeed automated synthesis, QC instruments (LCMS, NMR), and bioassay readers, capturing identity, purity, dose-response curves, IC50/EC50, ADMET measurements, and selectivity panels into a queryable store.
  • Synthesis Constraints & Inventory: Maintain the live state that the Batch Assembly AI reads each cycle, covering building-block inventory, advanced precursors, ChemSpeed capacity, stock alerts, and chemistry-specific constraints (reaction types, step budgets, solvent compatibility).
  • Reliability & Observability: Own data quality, lineage, schema evolution, and SLAs for the closed-loop cycle time target of a few days from computational proposal to experimental truth.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Chemistry, Computational Biology, or a related field, and 5+ years building data platforms in production, ideally including some exposure to scientific or lab-generated data.
  • Platform Engineering: Designed and shipped data platform components from the ground up (ingestion frameworks, registries, storage abstractions, and orchestration); fluent in backend production APIs/services, Python and SQL and writes production-quality code.
  • Database & Schema Design: Production experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases, schema design for evolving scientific data, and query optimization; comfortable across structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.
  • Lab/Scientific Data Fluency: Comfortable modeling chemical and biological data (structures, reactions, assays, dose-response, batches), and the messy reality of experimental measurements (replicates, censored values, failed runs).
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Experience with AWS and containerized deployment (Kubernetes).
  • AI-Assisted Development: Proficient with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) and incorporates them effectively into day-to-day engineering work.

Bonus Points For

  • Cheminformatics: Hands-on with RDKit, OpenEye, or equivalent (structure standardization, registration, and search).
  • Compound Registration Systems: Direct experience building or operating a corporate compound registry (CDD Vault, Dotmatics, Benchling Registry, or similar), or building one from scratch.
  • ELN/LIMS Integration: Familiarity with electronic lab notebooks, LIMS, and instrument data formats (mzML, AnIML, vendor-specific).
  • Workflow Orchestration: Experience with Flyte, Airflow, Dagster, or Temporal, especially for long-running scientific pipelines.
  • Lakehouse Patterns: Modern table formats (Iceberg, Delta Lake, Hudi) and columnar processing (DuckDB, Polars, Spark).
  • Automation/Robotics Data: Experience capturing data from automated synthesis platforms (ChemSpeed, Chemspeed SWING, Opentrons) or HTS readers.
  • Domain Background: Prior work in pharma, biotech, or academic drug discovery; familiarity with SAR, ADMET, IC50/EC50, and DEL screening.
  • Agentic/LLM Workflows: Experience building data infrastructure that serves agentic and LLM-driven workflows, with an understanding of the retrieval, latency, and grounding constraints automated systems impose.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range
$148,000—$240,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

title: Er du socialpædagog og vil du opleve, hvordan aktivitetsbaseret behandling kan forandre liv for retspsykiatriske patienter? Så søger Sct. Hans’ tværfaglige rehabiliteringsteam DIG!
description:
Vi tilbyder en socialpædagogstilling i vores engagerede team, hvor patienternes meningsfulde aktiviteter altid er i centrum.

På Psykiatrisk Center Sct. Hans har vi været igennem en spændende omorganisering af vores Tværfaglige Rehabiliteringsteam, som behandler psykiatriske patienter med en retslig foranstaltning. Vi er et etableret team i rivende udvikling både fagligt og kollegialt og vores store fokus er at facilitere og udvikle et behandlingstilbud med høj faglig kvalitet.

Derfor søger vil lige nu en pædagog, som har mod på at være en del af rejsen ved at være nysgerrig på vores patienters særlige udfordringer og kan se det oplagte i at kunne tilbyde meningsfulde behandlingsaktiviteter som et samlet team.



Hvilken slags behandling udfører vi i Afdeling R? Patientforløbene i Afdeling R er komplekse og bevæger i spændingsfeltet mellem behandlingspsykiatri, psykiatriloven og straffeloven.

Helt overordnet er formålet med patienternes indlæggelse i Afdeling R at give dem den bedst mulige psykiatriske behandling og forebygge ny kriminalitet gennem en sundhedsfaglig indsats. Vi arbejder på – gennem en tværfaglig indsats – at opbygge et recovery-orienteret behandlingsforløb, hvor miljøet er tillidsbaseret, inddragende og med respekt for patientens ønsker og behov.



Det Tværfaglige Rehabiliteringsteam og din rolle I det Tværfaglige Rehabiliteringsteam (i daglig tale TRT) er kerneopgaven at stå for behandlingsaktiviteter individuelt og i grupper – både i fællesområder i vores lukkede retspsykiatriske afdeling kaldt ”Udsigten” og i afsnittene med afsæt i en rehabiliterings- og recoveryorienteret tilgang.

Som en del af TRT kommer du til at indgå i en tværfaglig aktivitetsbaseret indsats på tværs af afsnittene, og du vil have en særlig tilknytning til vores to åbne afsnit, hvor du vil være tilknyttet tre dage om ugen. Her vil du have fokus på de individuelle og fælles aktivitetsbaseret behandlingsforløb med patienterne i samarbejde med afsnittenes personale. Du vil ydermere varetage behandlingsaktiviteter til vores patienter i Udsigten – den lukkede retspsykiatriske afdeling.

Vi arbejder helhedsorienteret, hvilket kræver flerfaglighed, hvorfor det er vigtigt, at du stoler på din egen faglighed og kan formidle dine monofaglige betragtninger og samtidig er motiveret for og ser styrken i at arbejde tværfagligt

Dine opgaver bliver bl.a. at:

  • Facilitere og udvikle behandlingsaktiviteter i grupper i fællesområder – både fysiske aktiviteter såsom fitness, fodbold, badminton bassin m.m, men også aktiviteter som wellness, yoga og værksted.
  • Stå for individuelle aktivitetsbaserede behandlingsforløb, hvor du bringer din monofaglighed i spil.
  • Facilitere og udvikle miljøterapeutiske aktiviteter som fx ture ud af huset, fælles arrangementer osv.
Læs mere om TRT på vores hjemmeside:



Hvem er du? Det er vigtigt for os, at du er omstillingsparat i din tilgang til arbejdet, og at du kan se fordelen i at være med til at bygge noget nyt op.

Denne stilling er oplagt for dig, hvis du:

  • er god til at opbygge tillidsfulde relationer og trives med lange patientforløb, hvor der er tid til fordybelse.
  • er motiveret for at arbejde med en kompleks patientgruppe, der kræver tålmodighed.
  • kan lide en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor du både har relation til bestemte afsnit og samtidig arbejder på tværs af afsnit og fagligheder.
  • ser patientens ressourcer og får dem i spil.
  • har stærke kommunikations- og samarbejdsevner, som du kan lide at bringe i spil over for både patienter og kolleger.
Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med psykiatri og rehabiliterende indsatser – men det er ikke et krav. Vi forventer ikke, at du kan alt, men vi forventer, at du er er engageret og motiveret for at facilitere meningsfulde aktiviteter for vores patienter.



Dine løn- og ansættelsesvilkår Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen i blandede vagter. Dagvagterne ligger i tidsrummet 09-17, og aftenvagterne i 14-22, samt i weekenden i tidsrummet 9-17 hver 3. uge.

Du ansættes i henhold til overenskomst for socialpædagogisk personale ved døgninstitutioner med lønindplacering som socialpædagog.

Døgnafsnittet er døgndækket, og du vil derfor blive planlagt med blandede vagter i overensstemmelse med reglerne i den gældende arbejdstidsaftale i overenskomsten.

Vi ønsker, at du starter hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.



Er stillingen noget for dig? Så send os gerne din ansøgning med det samme, så vi kan lære dig bedre at kende.

Send ansøgning, CV og relevante uddannelsespapirer via linket her på siden.

title: Windows Infrastructure & Application Migration Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Windows Infrastructure & Application Migration Engineer based in United States.

This role is designed for an experienced infrastructure engineer who can lead complex Windows platform migrations and application modernization initiatives.
You will support the transition of critical business applications and reporting environments to secure, supported server platforms.
The position requires strong collaboration across infrastructure, database, security, network, and application teams.
You will play a key role in ensuring smooth migrations, reliable deployments, and minimal operational disruption.
The ideal candidate combines hands-on Windows administration expertise with automation, troubleshooting, and application deployment skills.
This is an opportunity to contribute to large-scale technology transformation projects in a structured and fast-paced environment.

Accountabilities:

The Windows Infrastructure & Application Migration Engineer will be responsible for executing end-to-end migration activities, supporting infrastructure modernization, and ensuring application stability throughout the transition process.

  • Provision, configure, and maintain Windows Server environments following enterprise infrastructure standards.
  • Install, configure, and manage IIS components, including application pools, websites, SSL certificates, and web server configurations.
  • Migrate and validate Finance Portal and ASP.NET/.NET applications to updated server environments.
  • Perform SQL Server and SSRS migration activities, including reports, subscriptions, service accounts, and encryption key transfers.
  • Configure application environments across Development, Testing, Disaster Recovery, and Production stages.
  • Support infrastructure changes including DNS updates, firewall configurations, hostname modifications, and connectivity validation.
  • Develop PowerShell automation scripts to improve server builds, deployments, and validation processes.
  • Execute SIT, UAT, production cutovers, rollback planning, and post-deployment verification activities.
  • Troubleshoot migration challenges, compatibility issues, and deployment failures to ensure successful delivery.
  • Support production stabilization, hypercare activities, and retirement of legacy server environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional technical teams to coordinate migration activities and resolve operational risks.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate brings strong experience in Windows infrastructure, application migration, and enterprise deployment environments, with the ability to manage complex technical activities independently.

    • Proven experience administering, configuring, migrating, and supporting Windows Server environments.
    • Hands-on expertise with IIS administration and hosting web applications on Windows platforms.
    • Strong knowledge of ASP.NET and .NET Framework applications, including deployment, configuration, troubleshooting, and migration processes.
    • Experience upgrading and supporting SQL Server and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) environments.
    • Demonstrated experience managing application migrations and deployments across multiple environments.
    • Strong understanding of infrastructure components such as DNS, networking, firewall rules, and production cutover processes.
    • Experience developing PowerShell scripts for automation, deployment, and operational validation.
    • Familiarity with SIT/UAT testing processes, rollback planning, and migration support activities.
    • Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills.
    • Ability to manage multiple migration activities while maintaining attention to detail and delivery quality.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills when working with technical and business stakeholders.
    • Ability to work effectively under tight deadlines in regulated and fast-moving environments.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to contribute to large-scale infrastructure modernization and application transformation projects.
      • Remote work flexibility with the ability to collaborate with distributed technical teams.
      • Exposure to enterprise technologies across Windows, .NET, SQL Server, IIS, and cloud-ready environments.
      • Opportunity to work on complex migration initiatives with significant business impact.
      • Professional growth through collaboration with experienced engineering and technology teams.
      • Dynamic environment focused on innovation, reliability, and continuous improvement.

title: 2027 MBA Summer Associate - Capital & Ventures
description:
Momentum is a respected collection of independent companies, including PMG, Koddi, Further. We serve as a premier global business transformation partner for over 125 of the Fortune 500 brands. With 1,400 global employees and $5B in media spend under management, we foster a fast-growing, values-driven, people-first environment where you can thrive.

Our portfolio of companies partners with some of the world’s most iconic and ambitious brands. We combine scalability with a solutions-oriented approach to deliver fast-paced, innovative results for our customers while creating meaningful growth opportunities for our teams.

If you are looking for opportunities to grow in your career and are passionate about being at the forefront of data and technology, and driving rapid innovation in the future of commerce, we would love to talk with you about joining Momentum.

We believe that a culture of belonging, inclusion, and diversity is key to empowering our team members to thrive both personally and professionally. Living out our values is not just a goal; it's a daily practice! For more information, please visit .

The Opportunity

Momentum is continually evaluating opportunities to invest in, acquire, and grow businesses that strengthen our portfolio. As our MBA Summer Associate, Capital & Ventures, you'll work alongside senior leadership to evaluate new investment opportunities, support strategic transactions, and help drive value creation across our portfolio. This is an MBA internship taking place in summer 2027.

This isn't a traditional internship or a support role. You'll contribute to market and competitive analyses, assess acquisition opportunities, develop investment recommendations, and support strategic initiatives that influence how Momentum grows. From researching emerging markets to helping evaluate potential investments, you'll gain exposure to the strategic and financial decisions that shape our business.

You'll leave the summer with meaningful ownership, exposure to executive leadership, and tangible accomplishments that extend well beyond a typical internship experience.

What You'll Do

Projects will be defined and scoped collaboratively but may include:

  • Conducting industry, market, and competitive research to identify investment opportunities and emerging trends.
  • Building and maintaining market intelligence, deal pipeline trackers, and investment research to support strategic decision-making.
  • Assisting in the development of business cases, investment memoranda, and executive presentations.
  • Analyzing financial and operational data to identify growth opportunities and investment risks.
  • Supporting due diligence efforts by coordinating research, organizing documentation, and synthesizing findings for senior leadership.
  • Identifying inefficiencies in deal sourcing, diligence, and reporting processes, and driving improvements.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams across Finance, Strategy & Operations, and Portfolio Companies to evaluate strategic initiatives.

Qualifications

We're looking for someone who:

  • Is currently enrolled in a full-time MBA program (graduating between Winter 2027 and Spring 2028)
  • Enjoys evaluating businesses, markets, and investment opportunities using both quantitative and qualitative analysis.
  • Is intellectually curious and comfortable solving ambiguous business problems with structured thinking.
  • Can synthesize complex information into clear, executive-ready presentations and recommendations.
  • Thrives in collaborative environments and enjoys working across multiple teams.
  • Has a GPA of 3.5 or above.
  • Is based in or willing to relocate to Dallas for the summer (full-time, five days per week on-site).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Has approximately 2-4 years of full time experience in management consulting, corporate development, private equity, venture capital, strategic finance, or a related field.
  • Experience conducting market research, competitive analysis, or commercial due diligence.
  • Strong analytical skills, including financial modeling and business case development.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to streamline manual processes.
  • Familiarity with valuation methodologies, financial statement analysis, and M&A transaction processes.

  • Serve as a safety resource to the General Contractor, subcontractors, and project team
  • Mentor, coach, and train field personnel on OSHA standards, company policies, and industry best practices
  • Promote and sustain a positive safety culture through active engagement with workers and site leadership

  • Strong working knowledge of OSHA construction standards (29 CFR 1926)
  • Experience working in complex, fast-paced construction environments (data center or mission critical experience may be added as needed)

title: Bliv leder af vores lille, nære børnehus – vi søger en fagligt og relationelt stærk institutionsleder
description:
Har du en stærk pædagogisk faglighed? Kan du se dig selv sætte retningen for en privat daginstitution i rivende udvikling? Formår du at få andre omkring dig med på dine visionære idéer og tiltag?

Så er du måske den leder, vi søger i Børnehuset i Fredensgade.

Efter mange år er vores nuværende leder gået på velfortjent efterløn, og derfor søger vi en ny leder, som er nysgerrig og initiativrig — én, der motiverer andre, udfordrer vanetænkning og med hjertevarme skaber de rammer, der danner en tryg og god hverdag for vores børnegruppe i følgeskab med en erfaren og kompetent medarbejdergruppe.

Hvem er vi?

Vi er en hyggelig, mindre privat daginstitution med en vuggestue og to børnehavestuer. Du bliver en del af en lille, stærk personalegruppe med høj faglighed, der arbejder tæt sammen med forældrebestyrelsen og forældrene — altid med åbenhed og en god portion humor i hverdagen.

Børnehuset i Fredensgade er “det lille hus, hvor udvikling og læring er en leg”. Vi har rødder tilbage til 1869 og en stærk lokal forankring i Slagelse. Vi bygger på værdier som fællesskab, tryghed og nærvær – med et klart mål om at give børnene mod, fantasi og evner til at vokse ind i livet som aktive og nysgerrige samfundsborgere.


Læs mere om os på:

Dine vigtigste opgaver

  • Sætte en tydelig pædagogisk retning for børnehusets videre udvikling — som en nærværende leder, der skaber tryghed, gennemsigtighed og følgeskab, for både personale og forældregruppe
  • At være en faglig sparringspartner, der inspirerer og støtter personalet
  • Sikre en god og professionel dialog og stærke relationer med både børn, forældre og personale
  • Varetage økonomi, drift og administration, herunder løn, skemaer, ferieplanlægning og brug af IT-systemer, bl.a. Microsoft 365 erhverv
  • Samarbejde tæt med bestyrelsen og bidrage til at udvikle børnehusets profil i en privat ramme under politisk styrede vilkår

Vi drømmer om, at du er

  • Uddannet pædagog med erfaring fra praksis. Ledelseserfaring er ikke et krav – men du skal finde ledelse interessant, og så giver vi dig mulighed for at udvikle dig gennem kurser og lederfællesskaber
  • Tydelig, troværdig og nærværende — du kan kommunikere klart og skabe følgeskab
  • Visionær, nysgerrig og modig — du tør udfordre vanetænkning og bringe nye idéer i spil
  • Anerkendende, tillidsfuld og god til at lytte — du skaber et trygt arbejdsmiljø med frihed under ansvar
  • Stærk til at holde overblik, arbejde struktureret og håndtere drift, økonomi og IT

Vi tilbyder

  • Mulighed for at sætte retning og præge vores fremtid sammen med os som en institution i begyndelsen af vores rejse som privat dagtilbud
  • Et stærkt fællesskab blandt både personale og forældre, der er klar til at udvikle sig sammen med dig
  • Adgang til professionel ledelsesmæssig sparring, rådgivning og hjælp til administrative opgaver gennem vores medlemskab af Børneringen
  • Frihed under ansvar med plads til at bringe dine ideer og visioner i spil
  • Sundhedsforsikring gennem Falck Healthcare
  • Fleksibilitet i din hverdag med mulighed for en fast ugentlig hjemmearbejdsdag


Organiseret netværk

Institutionen er tilknyttet paraplyorganisationen Børneringen, og du vil som leder indgå i et stærkt ledernetværk med ca. 100 lederkollegaer, ligesom du altid kan trække på Børneringens konsulenter inden for løn, regnskab, personalejura, psykologordning og ledelsesrådgivning.


Læs mere om Børneringen på deres hjemmeside


Derudover er der lokale ledernetværk i Slagelse, som det forventes, at du deltager i.

title: Senior Developer, CI Architecture
description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We are seeking a Senior Developer for our CI Architecture team. The team’s mission is to enable fast, reliable, low-friction CI/CD workflows for developers (and increasingly, for agents) by owning CI pipeline architecture patterns, CI developer experience, and application-layer performance improvements.

This is not a “runner infra” role. You’ll work at the intersection of build systems, test architecture, workflow design, and developer tooling—partnering closely with CI Platform (runners/orchestration/caching/observability) and with product engineering teams (codebases, build targets, test suites).

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

  • Experience designing or evolving CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred)

  • Hands-on ability to improve build and test performance (e.g., compilation caching strategies, dependency optimization, parallelization, test sharding/partitioning).

  • Deep familiarity with multi-platform build/test (macOS, Windows, Linux) and constraints of each environment.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with demonstrated systems thinking.

  • Practical debugging skills: you can isolate bottlenecks, reason from logs/metrics, and drive fixes across multiple layers.

  • Comfort collaborating across teams and codebases; ability to influence without direct ownership.

Bonus points for:

  • Knowledge of building systems/toolchains relevant to our ecosystem (e.g., Rust, Node/pnpm, mobile toolchains).

  • Experience building internal tooling (CLI tools, workflow generators, reusable actions/workflows).

  • Experience working with observability data (e.g., Datadog CI metrics) to drive ongoing performance improvements.

What you can expect:

  • Define and evolve reference CI architectures for GitHub Actions across Product Engineering (job decomposition/parallelization, caching & artifact strategy, test partitioning/execution, multi-platform builds).

  • Partner with teams to redesign slow or fragile pipelines; lead time-boxed engagements with measurable outcomes (e.g., reduce P90 pipeline time by X%, cut rerun rate by Y%).

  • Improve CI developer experience:

    • Make failures easier to diagnose and fix (clearer signals, better ergonomics, fewer "Opaque processes").

    • Build tooling/abstractions/templates so best practices are the default path.

  • Drive application-layer performance optimization:

    • Build/compilation strategies, dependency management, and toolchain performance.

    • Test architecture improvements and flake reduction in partnership with service/app owners.

  • Establish observability → action loops:

    • Translate CI metrics into actionable architectural changes (queue vs execution time, stage-level regressions, flaky rate).

    • Help teams interpret signals and prioritize the highest-leverage fixes.

  • Co-develop “golden workflows & guardrails” with CI Platform:

    • EUX CI Architecture focuses on usability and patterns.

    • CI Platform focuses on enforcement capability, secure defaults, and platform primitives.

  • Working style

    • Outcome-driven and pragmatic: you’ll prioritize changes that deliver sustained wins, not just local optimizations.

    • Developer-empathetic: you care about feedback loops, failure clarity, and making the “right thing” easy.

    • Collaborative: you partner tightly with CI Platform and product teams, with clear ownership boundaries.

title: Støtte og Vejledning Guldborgsund søger socialpædagog
description:
Pr. 1. oktober 2026 eller hurtigst muligt derefter søges en socialpædagog på 37 timer om ugen eller efter aftale

  • Vil du yde forebyggende, udviklende og stabiliserende indsatser til borgere med kognitive udfordringer såvel som psykiske problemstillinger?

  • Er du Socialpædagog og vil du være med til at udvikle Støtte & Vejledning såvel som din egen stilling?

Så er det måske dig Socialpædagogisk Støtte ,Thorsensvej 11b, 4800 Nykøbing Falster søger.

Recovery og den rehabiliterende tilgang

I Støtte & Vejledning, Guldborgsund kommune har vi en ambition om, at praksis skal være funderet i den recovery orienteret og den rehabiliterende tilgang, hvorfor du kan forvente kompetenceudvikling indenfor dette. Du skal gennem denne tilgang arbejde målrettet med at løse Guldborgsund kommunes kerneopgave som er:

”Vi skal styrke borgernes muligheder for at mestre egen tilværelse, og i samarbejde med borgerne, sikre at alle indgår i relevante fællesskaber”

Ræk mig lige samarbejdet

I Støtte & Vejledning, Guldborgsund kommune er vi alle ansat til 2 ting

  • at levere faglighed og
  • at levere professionelt samarbejde.

Vi tror på, at gode faglige resultater skabes af fagpersoner, der er dygtige til at samarbejde.

Det professionelle samarbejde er en kompetence, som er funderet på et fælles mindset, hvor indstilling er alt. Den tænkning, der stemples ind med afgør, hvad vi kan sammen og dermed hvilken kvalitet borgeren i sidste ende oplever.

Du vil blive introduceret til Ræk mig lige samarbejdet, de dyder og det fælles sprog, som danner mindset for samarbejdet i hele Centeret for Trivsel og social indsats.

Jobbeskrivelse.

Du vil komme til at arbejde med en bred vifte af vejledning og støtteopgaver med voksne borgere der har komplekse problematikker f.eks.

  • Generelt udviklingshæmmet og Kognitive udfordringer
  • Autisme spektrum forstyrrelser
  • Psykiske udfordringer
  • Lavt selvværd og ensomhed
  • kriminalitet og misbrug


Dine opgaver består blandt andet i at støtte borgeren ift. den visiterede indsats efter SEL §85, med det formål at forbedre borgerens funktionsniveau eller forebygge at den enkeltes situation forværres. Dette kan f.eks. foregå ved støttende samtaler, praktisk støtte og vejledning i ex. ADL. støtte ved behandlinger, lægebesøg ol.

I Støtte & Vejledning arbejdes der blandt andet med gruppe-bostøtte, som tager udgangspunkt i borgerens bevilligede indsatsmål (en medarbejder samler flere borgere og støtter dem i at f.eks. handle ind, en dag om ugen).

Da vi håber at få pædagogstuderende, vil der være en forventning om, at du kan tage den studerende med ud i det daglige arbejde.

Forventninger til dig

  • Vi lægger stor vægt på både dine faglige og relationelle kompetencer, da de fleste opgaver løses i samarbejde med borgeren, kollegaer i teamet såvel som med tværfaglige samarbejdspartnere.
  • At du blandt andet har viden om udviklingshæmmede, psykisk sårbarhed, sociale udfordringer og kan omsætte faglig viden og personlig erfaring til praksis.
  • At du kan reflektere over egen og andres praksis
  • At du er aktivt deltagende ift. borgersamarbejdet, på møder, kurser, udd. mv.
  • At du er fleksibel og kan strukturere dine arbejdsopgaver med udgangspunkt i borgerens behov og aktiviteter
  • At du har erfaring eller kendskab med at yde støtte via gruppe-bostøtte vil være dejligt
  • At du har kendskab til Nexus vil være en fordel samt det at dokumentere ud fra indsatmål.
  • At du laver den skriftlige dokumentation i samarbejde med borgeren.
  • At du har humor og kan bruge din humor konstruktivt både overfor kollegaer såvel som borgerne
  • At du er indstillet på at cykle i Byzone (der er sat cykler til rådighed). Kørsel udenfor Byzone foregår fortrinsvis i bil, hvorfor kørekort og egen bil til rådighed vil være en nødvendighed. Organisationen har 6 biler til rådighed, som forventes booket til længere kørsler.

Vi kan tilbyde

  • En spændende arbejdsplads med fokus på høj faglighed og personlig udvikling
  • En høj grad af selvtilrettelæggelse og selvstændighed i opgaveløsningen
  • Dygtige, engagerede og super seje kolleger
  • Kompetenceudvikling, faglig sparring og Supervision

Ansættelsesvilkår: Efter gældende overenskomst, 37 timer om ugen.

Arbejdstid kan ligge mellem 7.00 – 20.00 og der skal forventes vagter i weekend/helligdag ved behov.

Mere information: Afdelingsleder Ulla Houldcroft telefon 2518 0446

Socialpædagog Chris Josephsen telefon 2518 1844

Ansøgningsfrist: Fredag den 28. august 2026 inden kl. 12.00

Samtaler finder sted: Torsdag den 10. september 2026

title: Familiebehandler til Forebyggelse & Indsats, Odder Kommune
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe stærke fællesskaber og bedre muligheder for børn, unge og familier i Odder Kommune? Motiveres du af at arbejde med konkrete forandringer i tæt samarbejde med familier, kolleger og civilsamfund? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

Vi søger en engageret, velfunderet og erfaren familiebehandler til en fast stilling 37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse 01.10.2026.

Hvem er vi ?

Forebyggelse & Indsats er en afdeling med 25 medarbejdere, der løser mange forskelligartede opgaver – fra tidligt forebyggende indsatser til rusmiddelbehandling. Den ledige stilling er i familiebehandlerteamet, hvor vi leverer indsatser efter Barnets Lov på både individ- og gruppeniveau.

Du vil blive en del af en afdeling, hvor forandrings- og udviklingsvindene vejrer, og hvor vi er i fuld gang med at kvalificere vores organisering og praksis. Vi leder derfor efter en kollega, der er villig til at lære og samtidig lære fra sig. Vi har fokus på mål, progression og effekt i indsatserne, og kerneopgaven løses i forpligtende fællesskaber med fokus på tillid, dialog og samarbejde. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes sammen – både med borgerne og på tværs af fagligheder. Vi arbejder målrettet med at styrke borgernes ressourcer, livsduelighed og muligheder for deltagelse i fællesskaber. Vi tror på, at borgerne skal mødes med anerkendelse og respekt, og at varige løsninger bedst skabes i samarbejde med den enkelte og dennes netværk. Vi arbejder ud fra et fælles ansvar for kerneopgaven og med en ambition om at gøre en reel forskel – hver dag.

Din profil

Din hverdag kommer til at være alsidig og omskiftelig med fokus på familierne og deres behov. Vi arbejder ud fra en ressourcefokuseret tilgang, hvor hele familiens situation tages i betragtning i planlægningen af indsatsen. Dette betyder, at du skal trives med at arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig ser værdien i at være en del af et team. Vi lægger desuden vægt på, at du har gode samarbejdsevner, at du er fagligt velfunderet, stabil og har evnen til at arbejde helhedsorienteret i din tilgang til familierne. Du vil opleve udpræget grad af fleksibilitet og tillid til udførelsen og planlægningen af dit arbejde, da vi som arbejdsplads finder det værdifuldt og nødvendigt. Af samme grund leder vi efter en fleksibel kollega, der kan agere og vurdere på egen hånd og er indstillet på at arbejde med fleksible arbejdstider.

Hvad skal jeg lave ?

Stillingen indeholder både individuelle og gruppebaserede indsatser samt et tæt samarbejde med både interne og eksterne aktører – herunder civilsamfund.

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. være:

  • Tidligt forebyggende samtaler med børn, unge og familier
  • Planlægning, gennemførelse og evaluering af gruppeforløb for børn, unge og/eller forældre
  • Individuelle familiebehandlingsforløb med fokus på mål og systematisk opfølgning på progression
  • Praktisk pædagogisk støtte
  • Tæt samarbejde med myndighedsrådgivere og øvrige samarbejdspartnere
  • Samarbejde med civilsamfund med henblik på at understøtte deltagelse i fællesskaber
  • Deltagelse i netværksmøder og tværgående indsatser
  • Dokumentation og journalføring
Vores forventninger til dig

  • Har socialfaglig, pædagogisk eller psykologisk grunduddannelse
  • Har solid erfaring med familiebehandling og arbejdet med børn, unge og familier i udsatte positioner
  • Har indgående viden om neurodivergente lidelser (særligt ADHD/ADD og autisme)
  • Kan arbejde systematisk med mål, progression og dokumentation
  • Har erfaring med eller kompetencer indenfor facilitering af gruppeforløb
  • Har stærke relationskompetencer og formår at skabe tillid i samarbejdet med familier og samarbejdspartnere
  • Har kørekort (B) og egen bil
  • Kan indgå aktivt i tværfaglige fællesskaber og bidrage til et åbent og respektfuldt samarbejdsmiljø
  • Vil bidrage aktivt til en hverdag med plads til grin og en uhøjtidelig tone
Vi kan tilbyde

  • Et arbejdsfællesskab kendetegnet ved tillid, nysgerrighed og et højt fagligt niveau
  • Mulighed for at arbejde med både individuelle og gruppebaserede indsatser
  • Fokus på udvikling af samarbejdet med civilsamfund og familiernes deltagelse i fællesskaber
  • Supervision og kompetenceudvikling
Ansættelse

Stillingen er til besættelse 01.10.2026. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst.

Ansøgning

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 23.august, og ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt d. 27.august.

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved telefonisk henvendelse til leder Thomas Hansen (5164 9388) eller familiebehandler Nikolaj Huus Kamstrup (3084 3428).

description:
Company Overview

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

#LI-Hybrid

Team Overview

We are looking for a Merchant Operations Intern to support the Brazil food delivery team. You will assist with daily campaign execution, data tracking, trend monitoring, and cross-functional coordinationto improve activity performance.

weekly/monthlyreportswith insights. · Insight Collection & Content Support: Collect merchant registration data, trending topics, and social signals to support campaign ideation; assist with basic copywriting and contentassets. · Cross-functional Collaboration: Communicate and coordinate with Product, Marketing, User growth, and other teams to support smooth campaign execution and logistics. · Data Analysis & Performance Evaluation: Support data collection and analysis on key metrics (sell-through rate, conversion, ROl, etc.), and provide data-based insights for campaign optimization.

EEO Statement

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.
  • We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.

title: Social- og sundhedsassistentelev - start på GF2 med gymnasial uddannelse d. 24.11.2026
description:
Er du over 25 år, har en nordisk gymnasial uddannelse og drømmer du om at uddanne dig til SOSU-assistent, så har du mulighed for at blive ansat med løn allerede på grundforløb 2.

Om jobbet:
Som SOSU i Aarhus er du medskaber af det vigtigste i verden: At gøre en forskel i et andet menneskes liv. Bliv en vigtig del af livet i Aarhus - bliv SOSU.

Du kommer til at arbejde med en professionel og helhedsorienteret sygepleje og rehabilitering i det nære og sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen.
Uddannelsen består af både skole- og oplæringsperioder. Skoleperioderne foregår på SOSU Østjylland.

Vi tilbyder et spændende uddannelsesforløb med:

  • Professionelle og engagererede praktikvejledere og kolleger, der sammen sørger for at du under dit praktikforløb modtager velkvalificeret vejledning og udvikler de nødvendige kompetencer.
  • Tværfagligt samarbejde med andre sundhedsfaglige grupper.
  • Mulighed for DigiTech
  • Gode muligheder for job efter endt uddannelse.
En elevstilling i Danmarks andenstørste kommune giver mange udviklingsmuligheder både under uddannelse og efterfølgende. Du kan f.eks. bruge uddannelsen som springbræt til bl.a. sygeplejerske, fysioterapeut eller ergoterapeut.

Din profil:
Du skal være fyldt 25 år inden start på uddannelse, og have en nordisk gymnasial uddannelse.

Som elev i Aarhus Kommune forventer vi, at du har lyst til at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt. Du kan lide at arbejde med mennesker, og du ønsker at gøre en forskel for andre.
Du trives med udvikling og læring, har en positiv indstilling til andre mennesker og evner at indgår i et konstruktivt samarbejde.
Det falder dig naturligt at reflektere over din faglige og personlige udvikling.
Du har ressourcerne til at bevare ro og overblik i en til tider hektisk hverdag.
Du er indstillet på at arbejde hen imod at være en central professionel og autoriseret sundhedsperson

Ansøgning
Ansøgningsfristen er den 27.09.2026. Der kan ikke søges efter ansøgningsfristens udløb.
Klik på ”Søg stillingen” for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes.

Inden du udfylder skemaet, skal du have følgende dokumenter klar:

  • Opdateret CV– Du skal bruge denne skabelon, og uploade til din ansøgning CV skabelon
  • Din motiverede ansøgning
  • Dokumentation for nordisk gymnasial uddannelse
  • Dokumentation på at du har søgt ind på SOSU Østjylland, og har fået afkortet dit grundforløb 2
  • Er du ikke dansk statsborger, skal du vedhæfte din opholdstilladelse eller senest bekræftelse fra Udlændingestyrelsen på ansøgning om ophold
I din motiverede ansøgning skal du skrive (max. 1 side), hvor du besvarer følgende spørgsmål:

  • Fortæl kort om dig selv, og hvad du er god til
  • Hvad har motiveret dig til at søge denne uddannelse?
  • Hvordan kan dine erfaringer gavne dig i uddannelsesforløbet?
Til samtalen vil vi tale om de ting du har skrevet i din ansøgning. Herudover vil vi komme ind på overvejelser om arbejdstider og balancen mellem arbejds- og privatliv.

For at kunne starte på Grundforløb 2, er det vigtigt at du også husker at søge om optagelse hos SOSU-Østjylland, via www.optagelse.dk.

Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Vi forventer, at samtalerne finder sted i uge 43

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Stillingen ønskes tiltrådt 24.11.2026.
Din ugentlige arbejdstid er gennemsnitlig 37 timer, hvor du primært vil arbejde i dagvagter samt have enkelte weekendvagter og eventuelt aftenvagter.
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst. Du får voksenelevløn under hele uddannelsesforløbet.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til Uddannelsesteamet på mail: udd-team@mso.aarhus.dk eller på telefon 51576616. Telefontid er mellem klokken 9-12

Om Sundhed og Omsorg og Aarhus Kommune:
Sundhed og Omsorg (MSO) i Aarhus Kommune arbejder med omsorg for ældre og sundhed for alle borgere.

Aarhus Kommune betragter mangfoldighed som en ressource og opfordrer derfor alle - uanset alder, køn, handicap, livsstil, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold - til at ansøge stillingen.
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus til en god by for alle. Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Founding Content Strategist
description:
About Edra

Edra is solving one of the hardest problems in enterprise AI: AI models are generic but company processes are specific. We build AI agents that learn how processes actually run, and then run their operations.

We're a Series A startup, backed by Sequoia and other leading VC firms, led by Co-Founders who created and led Forward Deployed AI Engineering at Palantir, and we're growing our team in New York and London. We're a deeply technical team of engineers, AI researchers, and strategists with a high bar for talent and a shared belief that exceptional people are the foundation of everything great we'll build.

We’re hiring for a critical role

We’re looking for someone who thinks like a founder, writes like an editor, and ships like an operator.

Edra's work is outpacing its story. Our launch out of stealth resonated and real enterprise customers are in production. But the external presence has been uneven since launch, and the mission—making expertise scalable and preserving institutional knowledge—doesn't yet have the public articulation it deserves.

This is the role that builds that. It sits between the founders, customers, team, and public, and produces clarity where it matters most. It’s not marketing, not PR, and most importantly, it’s not strategy without execution.

The opportunity

Most organizations run on judgment that's never been written down. Edra captures how work actually happens and makes that knowledge structured, editable, and executable. Experts become authors; operators become directors; institutional judgment becomes durable infrastructure. We are building a company and product around the belief that operational knowledge is the next thing that becomes software infrastructure, and this role defines how we talk about that to the world.

In your first three months, you’ll establish the function and the cadence: revive the public presence, build the voice of the founders, ship the first customer stories, and articulate the category-defining language.

What you'll own

  • Public cadence. Own the rhythm: define it, own the calendar, ship regularly and on time, and don't let the company go quiet.

  • Industry engagement. Shape Edra’s perspective on trending industry conversations, and make sure we’re engaged in the right threads, discussions, and debates.

  • Founder voice. Extend Eugen and Yannis's voices to the world: long-form pieces, talks, podcasts, and more. Every piece compounds—recruiting, customer education, market credibility.

  • Customer storytelling. Edra's best artifact is our customers' work. Find those stories, draw them out, and ship them at a cadence that builds trust without exhausting anyone.

  • Recruiting narrative. Make Edra's culture and engineering philosophy legible to the people who'd thrive here, before they ever apply.

  • Category definition. Partner with the founders to shape how Edra is understood—the company defining a new paradigm, not "another AI startup."

What we're looking for

  • You've done work that mattered at a serious company, ideally partnering with founders or other key leaders at moments of inflection.

  • You ship—both high volume and high quality. You produce the brief, edit yourself, and don't wait for a team to deliver output.

  • You’re online and engaged in the AI community. You have perspectives on industry thought leaders and where Edra fits in, and you’ve thought about what we need to post, engage with, or respond to before you even get to the office in the morning (whether on X/Twitter, LinkedIn, or elsewhere).

  • You write across formats with taste, and you can distinguish authentic founder voice from corporate boilerplate.

  • You hold technical depth without writing code. Comfort with white-box AI, continual learning, and agentic execution is a plus.

  • You're allergic to slop—no corporate PR, no committee-shaped voice, and nothing that reads like it was written by an LLM.

Learn More About Edra

  • Watch our Series A announcement video

  • Read our blog post from our launch

  • Learn more about what we're building

Compensation & Benefits

Edra offers generous compensation and benefits in both New York & London:

  • Competitive base salary & meaningful equity

  • Top tier health, dental, & vision plans:

    • Top plans with 100% premium coverage in the US (and a One Medical membership)

    • Private medical & dental coverage in the UK

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Lunch provided in office most days, snacks & drinks too

  • A stipend to set up your workspace

A Few Details

We work together in person five days a week from our offices in the West Village (New York) and Holborn (London).

Edra is an equal opportunity employer and we encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. Edra does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Lead Application Security Engineer ID71664

title: Program Manager
description:
About Blue Water Thinking

Guided by our principles of value generation, continuous innovation, customer-centricity, and vested collaboration, Blue Water Thinking proudly supports our Federal clients in achieving their Agency goals.

Founded by a decorated twenty-eight year Veteran of the United States Army, Blue Water Thinking understands and supports the mission of our Nation's war fighters, Veterans, their families and caretakers.

Leveraging our executive team's military experience and private and public sector consulting expertise, Blue Water Thinking takes an integrated "one-team" approach and brings to bear best-fit solutions, thought leadership, and grit to meet our client's transformational needs.

Fueled by our values of integrity, respect, professionalism, stewardship and customer service, the Blue Water Thinking team understands the power of the human connection, collaboration, humility and loyalty to one another, our clients and industry partners.

Lastly, our formula for success is simple: Build something good, take care of our people, keep our clients satisfied, nurture our work ethic and reputation, build long-lasting partnerships, enjoy what we do and give back as much as possible.

Job Description:

Blue Water Thinking is seeking an experienced and dedicated Program Manager to support a large project at the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). The Program Manager will oversee execution across multiple integrated workstreams, including program planning, federal oversight and audit response, recommendation management, acquisition risk governance, performance measurement and reporting, control environment improvements, strategic assessments, executive communications, and change management. The successful candidate will combine disciplined program leadership with deep knowledge of federal acquisition management, acquisition risk management, and oversight-driven transformation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the contractor’s functional expert and day-to-day program management lead, maintaining proactive and responsive communication with the Contracting Officer’s Representative, Government program leadership, senior executives, and other client stakeholders.
  • Lead and coordinate contractor personnel across all task areas, establishing clear roles, work plans, priorities, schedules, dependencies, and accountability for timely, high-quality performance.
  • Oversee development, maintenance, and execution of the program management plan, including the integrated schedule, milestones, staffing, resource allocation, risks, issues, quality assurance, and performance controls.
  • Manage contract execution and administration, including deliverable tracking, financial and labor-hour monitoring, staffing and vacancy management, compliance with task order requirements, change control, and support for contract modifications and closeout.
  • Direct preparation of recurring task reports, status briefings, monthly progress reports, quarterly accomplishment reports, and period closeout reports, ensuring accurate reporting of accomplishments, planned activities, expenditures, risks, issues, and personnel status.
  • Provide leadership for federal acquisition management and oversight activities, including strategic action planning, recurring external reporting, recommendation response packages, progress updates, closure requests, and long-term program improvement and exit-readiness strategies.
  • Coordinate input and facilitate collaboration across federal organizations, acquisition subject matter experts, cross-functional workgroups, governance bodies, and other internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure alignment of program activities and deliverables with applicable federal acquisition requirements, internal control standards, enterprise risk management practices, the Federal Acquisition Regulation, and relevant agency policies and governance issuances.
  • Oversee integrated tracking and resolution of oversight recommendations, audit findings, corrective actions, risk signals, and cross-portfolio interdependencies, elevating barriers and recommending practical mitigation strategies to client leadership.
  • Guide development of executive-level briefings, decision materials, strategic assessments, performance metrics, dashboards, and other technical products that clearly communicate findings, progress, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Monitor program performance against scope, schedule, budget, quality, and outcome expectations; identify trends and improvement opportunities; and implement corrective actions to enhance delivery effectiveness.
  • Promote a collaborative, client-focused team environment and ensure all work products are accurate, consistent, actionable, and suitable for senior executive, oversight, audit, Congressional, and other external audiences.

This position operates on a hybrid work schedule. Remote performance may be permitted consistent with client policy and Government approval; the Program Manager must be available to attend deliverable reviews, governance sessions, and senior leadership briefings at federal facilities in the Washington, D.C. area as directed.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Minimum of ten (10) years of experience in federal acquisition management, acquisition risk management, or federal program management.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience supporting federal oversight, audit, accountability, or performance-improvement activities, including direct experience supporting Government Accountability Office engagements or comparable federal review processes.
  • Experience supporting major federal program offices or organizational components; Department of Veterans Affairs experience is strongly preferred.
  • Significant experience developing strategic action plans, responding to oversight recommendations, preparing progress updates and closure packages, and engaging with federal audit or oversight bodies.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and coordinating complex work across senior leadership, program offices, functional experts, and external oversight stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of federal acquisition management and acquisition risk management processes, governance, internal controls, corrective action management, and performance measurement.
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to develop and present concise, decision-ready materials for senior executive audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish program governance, integrated schedules, reporting processes, risk and issue management, quality controls, and resource management practices.
  • Detail-oriented, highly organized, strategic, proactive, and able to manage multiple high-priority deliverables under tight deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in business, public administration, acquisition management, program management, risk management, or a related field.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  • Experience within a federal acquisition, program management, enterprise risk, internal control, or oversight organization.
  • Experience standing up or maturing a program management office, integrated risk management capability, governance structure, corrective action program, or enterprise performance reporting function.
  • Experience with executive dashboards, recommendation and corrective-action tracking systems, SharePoint-based collaboration environments, and data-driven performance reporting.

Eligibility:

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain the required federal public trust clearance for this role.

Compensation:

Salary for this position is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, location, the candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements.

Salary range: $140,000 - $165,000.

Blue Water Thinking offers a comprehensive benefits package including health insurance (medical, dental, and vision), paid time off, federal holidays, and a matching 401K plan.

Reasonable Accommodation for Applicants

Blue Water Thinking is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and hiring process. If you require a reasonable accommodation to search for a position, complete an application, or participate in the interview process, please contact Resource Management at resourcemanagement@bw-thinking.com. Requests for accommodation will be handled promptly and confidentially in accordance with applicable law.

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity.

Blue Water Thinking is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We recruit, hire, train, and promote qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
