title: Senior UKG Functional Consultant (Workforce Management)
description:
Position Title

Senior UKG Functional Consultant –Workforce Management

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior UKGFunctional Consultant to lead the configuration and optimisation of the UKGWorkforce Management solution. The consultant will be responsible for designing, configuring, testing, and supporting workforce management processes, including employee scheduling, workflow approvals, document generation, security, and business process automation.

The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, HR, Payroll, and IT teams to deliver scalable and efficient workforce management solutions aligned with business requirements and industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Workforce Management

  • Configure and maintain UKG Workforce Management modules.
  • Design and configure employee scheduling and rostering.
  • Configure shift patterns, work rules, pay rules, and scheduling policies.
  • Support leave, availability, and time management processes.

Workflow Configuration

  • Configure workflow approvals for HR and workforce management transactions.
  • Design approval hierarchies and routing rules.
  • Configure notifications, alerts, and escalations.
  • Troubleshoot workflow issues and recommend improvements.

Document Generation

  • Configure document and letter templates.
  • Generate employment-related documents such as contracts, roster notifications, and employee correspondence.
  • Ensure document templates comply with organisational standards.

System Configuration

  • Configure organisational structures, locations, departments, jobs, and security roles.
  • Configure business rules and validation rules.
  • Maintain system configuration documentation.
  • Perform configuration migration across environments.

Testing & Support

  • Prepare test scenarios and execute functional testing.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Investigate and resolve production issues.
  • Provide post-implementation support.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Gather and analyse business requirements.
  • Translate business requirements into UKG solutions.
  • Conduct workshops with business users.
  • Deliver end-user training and knowledge transfer.

Continuous Improvement

  • Recommend system enhancements.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation.
  • Ensure solutions align with UKG best practices.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of UKG (formerly Kronos) implementation and configuration experience.
  • Strong experience with UKG Workforce Management.
  • Experience configuring:
  • Scheduling and Rostering
  • Workflow Approvals
  • Time & Attendance
  • Employee Self-Service (ESS)
  • Manager Self-Service (MSS)
  • Security Roles
  • Business Rules
  • Notifications
  • Document Generation
  • Experience supporting HR and Payroll business processes.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Experience preparing functional specifications and solution documentation.
  • Experience conducting testing and UAT.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with UKG Pro Workforce Management or UKG Ready.
  • Experience integrating UKG with HRIS and Payroll systems.
  • Knowledge of REST APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience working in retail, healthcare, logistics, or large workforce environments.
  • Agile project delivery experience.

Key Deliverables

  • Configure workforce scheduling and rostering.
  • Configure workflow approvals and notifications.
  • Configure document generation templates.
  • Support end-to-end system testing.
  • Produce configuration documentation.
  • Support production deployment.
  • Provide knowledge transfer to business and support teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Human Resources, or a related field (preferred).
  • UKG certifications are highly desirable.
  • Relevant HRIS or Workforce Management certifications are advantageous.

Preferred Consultant Profile

The ideal consultant will have end-to-end UKG implementation experience and be capable of independently configuring workforce scheduling, approval workflows, and document generation while engaging effectively with business stakeholders. They should be able to translate business requirements into practical UKG solutions, lead workshops, support testing and deployment, and provide post-go-live support with minimal supervision.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Overview

  • Role: Product Designer
  • 5 days a week in NYC HQ
  • Base salary: $175k-$250k
  • Equity: Competitive initial equity package + refreshers
  • 5+ years of experience

About Pillar

Pillar is building the next-generation commodity risk management stack for the $10T physical economy. We combine real-time market data with AI-powered exposure modeling and automated trade generation to arm operators with precise protection from volatility. From instant execution to continuous monitoring, alerts, and recommendations, Pillar turns complex market risk into a fully managed, always-on hedging engine.

We were founded in 2023 by the youngest macro market-maker at Barclays and a trading systems engineer at Coinbase, and have raised over $20M in capital from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Crucible Capital, Neo, DST Global, and more.

The Role

We’re hiring a Product Designer to help define what modern commodity risk software should look and feel like.

At Pillar, design means making an exceptionally complex domain clear, fast, and intuitive for people with different roles, levels of market expertise, and ways of working. You’ll own critical product experiences from ambiguous problem through shipped solution, working directly with founders, engineers, and customers.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for a designer with great taste, strong product judgment, and an eye for the tiny details that determine how a product feels. You should be equally comfortable thinking in systems, learning complex workflows, prototyping quickly, and refining an interaction until it is excellent.

What You’ll Do

  • Own core product experiences end-to-end—from customer research and early concepts through polished UI, launch, and iteration
  • Learn complex commodity risk workflows and turn them into one clear, intuitive experience across diverse users, workflows, and domains
  • Work directly with founders, engineers, and customers to define product direction and translate real operating needs into shipped solutions
  • Solve ambiguity through making, using Figma and AI tools to rapidly prototype, test, and validate ideas
  • Design thoughtful AI-native interactions that balance automation with clarity, trust, and user control
  • Build Pillar’s design system and uphold a high craft bar across information architecture, dense workflows, typography, spacing, and interaction feel

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of product design experience, ideally working on B2B software, fintech, or other complex products
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking, interaction design, systems thinking, and polished visual execution
  • Great taste and attention to feel: strong instincts about what makes a product clear, beautiful, and satisfying down to the smallest detail
  • Comfort with complexity and range: the curiosity to master difficult workflows and create a coherent experience for users with different needs and expertise
  • A maker’s approach to ambiguity: you move quickly and independently by sketching, prototyping, testing, and iterating
  • A track record of taking products from concept to production, with strong Figma and design-system skills and clear cross-functional communication

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing fintech, trading, commodity, risk-management, or data-heavy products
  • Experience with real-time interfaces, data visualization, or decision-support tools
  • Experience building or maintaining a design system for a growing product
  • Experience conducting customer interviews and usability research in a complex domain
  • You’ve coded and shipped full-stack applications or working prototypes and are comfortable using Git

Benefits

  • 💰 Competitive Salary & Equity
  • 📈 401(k) Program
  • ⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • ⌚ Unlimited PTO and Flexible Hours
  • 🍣 Paid lunch, coffee, snacks, and dinner if you’re staying late
  • 🏋️ Monthly Gym Stipend
  • 🌄 Regular Team Off-Sites

title: Community Living Coach
description:
Position Summary:

The role of Community Living Coach-DSP is responsible for ensuring that our supported people are served in an integrated, dignified, and respectful environment and receive necessary supports in order to be active in their chosen environments and communities. These supports will be provided with dignity and respect according to their personal preferences, and in accordance with the agency’s policies, procedures, mission, and philosophy, as well as those of the State of Maryland/Federal, mandated laws, policies, and regulations.

Position Responsibilities:

In a manner consistent with supporting The Arc NCR Mission Statement the Community Living Coach-DSP shall do the following:

  • Agrees to uphold the mission of the organization by empowering the people supported to live, work, and thrive in the desired manner, and the person-centered philosophy.

  • Assist our supported people with personal care such as toileting, feeding, hygiene, etc., as needed.

  • Assist our supported people with daily living skills such as meal planning & preparation, shopping, grooming, job skills, home maintenance & cleaning, etc.

  • If applicable, guide our supported people in following specific dietary guidelines.

  • Assist and set the example for our supported people with understanding good hygiene, appropriate dress, and proper social interaction while in their home, out in the community, or in work settings.

  • Assist with scheduling and transporting our supported people to community events, socials, worksites, and other appointments.

  • Maintain residence and ensure a clean and safe environment for our supported people and other staff members.

  • Complete daily documentation, including but not limited to communication logs, medication logs, and behavioral logs.

  • If applicable, administer medications timely to all individuals supported and notify nursing staff of any concerns.

  • Assist our supported people with financial guidance such as budgeting, planning, banking, and related documentation.

  • Assists in developing, guiding, and executing supported person(s) Plans (IPs).

  • Reviews and follows all Behavioral Plans (BPs).

  • Reports any instances of abuse and neglect immediately.

  • Complete any Incident Reports in a timely manner necessary to document instances serious in nature.

  • Assist in the peer training of new team members.

  • Understands and agrees to work with supported persons and/or locations not regularly assigned; being open to receiving the required training to do so.

  • Maintains all required training and certification for the position.

  • Agrees to follow all department and agency policies and procedures and to do so in a respectful and positive manner.

  • Undertake other duties as assigned, including special projects and cross-program development.

title: Køkkenchef med gastronomisk førertrøje til kantine i Storkøbenhavn
description:
Har du lige så gode gastronomiske og ledelsesmæssige færdigheder, som en cykelrytter i Tour de France har på en cykel op ad Alpe d'Huez?

Vi søger en erfaren og kvalitetsbevidst, gastronomisk stærk køkkenchef, som kan stå i spidsen for en ny kantine i Storkøbenhavn, til 37 timer om ugen. Du vil som køkkenchef få det fulde ansvar for den daglige ledelse af teamet, hvor I sammen skal sikre at vores gæster får dagens bedste smagfulde oplevelse. Herudover skal i producere hvad der ellers er behov for til mødeservice og mersalg for husets gæster.

Hos SERWIZ skal du formå at håndtere frit valg at økologiske råvarer fra den øverste kvalitetshylde, sæson og oprindelse. Så skal vi nok sikre at understøtte den kulinariske profil. Herudover kræver rollen at du er god til at skabe relationer og kundekontakt, og at du med din servicevenlige adfærd, præger dine medarbejdere i samme positive retning.

Dine arbejdsopgaver bliver blandt andet:

  • Produktion af mad
  • Styring af økonomi
  • Indkøb af råvarer
  • Menuplanlægning
  • Egenkontrol
  • Kontrol af økologi- og bæredygtighedsregnskaber
  • Medarbejderledelse og udvikling (med support fra nærmeste leder og HR)
  • Mersalg
Som køkkenchef i SERWIZ bliver du en del af et stort team af andre gastronomiske genier, hvor der er rig mulighed for sparring på tværs af landet og hvor du kan udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt.

Din profil
For at lykkedes i jobbet skal du være en madglad vidensbank, som har et gastronomisk mindset og erfaring fra lignende stillinger. Du sætter en ære i at gøre tingene ordentlig og æstetisk, og af natur er du ambitiøs, målrettet og vedholdende i alt hvad du laver. Du er udviklende, innovativ, og er med på tidens trends. Vi ønsker at du er en inspirator for dine medarbejdere, tager ansvar for opgaverne, har en solid økonomisk forståelse og gode kommunikative evner. Du skal være synlig blandt gæsterne og overfor dine medarbejdere, men mest af alt så drives du af passionen for den gastronomiske verden. Sidst men ikke mindst, skal du kunne lide at indgå i nye relationer så vi får et godt samarbejde med kunden.

Vi tilbyder
Du bliver del af en virksomhed i vækst, fuld af godt humør og gode kollegaer. Til rollen tilbydes du løn, som modsvarer stillingens krav og dine kompetencer, pension, sundhedspakke og ikke mindst markedets bedste kantine.

Om SERWIZ
SERWIZ er en ejerledet, dansk virksomhed, som leverer Soft FM og catering af høj kvalitet. Vi har 2000 medarbejdere, kunder i hele Danmark og nærmer os DKK 1 mia. i årlig omsætning.

Med et stærkt værdisæt som fundament - ’Being bold, Doing good, Taking care’ – tør SERWIZ udfordre status quo og skubbe til grænserne for, hvordan man i vores branche kan arbejde bæredygtigt, transparent og digitalt. Det er vores mål at skabe ikke bare tilfredse, men glade kunder. Det opnår vi ved at være engagerede og nærværende i udførelsen af vores services og gennem tæt samarbejde med vores kunder, hvor vi taler åbent om udfordringer, muligheder og succeser. Vi er medlem af Servicebranchens Arbejdsgiverforening under DI, og vores medarbejdere har overenskomster og ordnede arbejdsforhold.

Ansøgning
Er du den gastronomiske førertrøje vi leder efter? Så søg hurtigst muligt. Vi behandler ansøgningerne løbende.

title: Børnenes Ø søger pædagogmedhjælpere, Støtte timer til stue (tidsbegrænset) og praktisk medhjælper til frokostordning.
description:
Børnenes Ø søger pædagogmedhjælpere, Støtte timer til stue (tidsbegrænset) og praktisk medhjælper til frokostordning.

Er du klar til at blive en del af et levende og mangfoldigt hus, hvor børn, unge, ældre og familier mødes i hverdagen?
Børnenes Ø – vores daginstitution i Generationernes Hus – søger:

Pædagogmedhjælpere – både til vores vuggestuegrupper og børnehavegrupper (32 til 37 timer)

Pædagogmedhjælper til at understøtte på stue med særlige støtte, tidsbegrænset stilling i børnehaven (18 timer pr uge)

En praktisk medhjælper – til anretning og afrydning af frokostmåltider (18 timer pr uge).

Skriv hvilken stilling du søger i toppen af din ansøgning.

Om jobbet:

Vil du med ombord?
Børnenes Ø søger engagerede og nysgerrige pædagogmedhjælpere!

Da flere af vores pædagogmedhjælpere skal videre i livet, så er vi på udkig efter flere.

Kom med ombord som pædagogmedhjælper i Børnenes Ø – et dagtilbud for børn i alderen 0–6 år, beliggende i det unikke Generationernes Hus. Her bor og lever børn, unge, ældre og familier side om side, og vi arbejder aktivt med fællesskab og relationer på tværs af generationer.

Huset er moderne og vi er godt i gang med at opbygge en stærk fælles kultur i huset. Hvis du kan stå fast i både regn og blæst – og nyde roen på en vindstille dag – så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Derudover leder vi efter en støtteperson på 18 timer, som vil være tilknyttet en enkelt stue samt en praktisk medhjælper på 18 timer.

Som praktisk medhjælper skal du anrette og rydde op efter børnenes frokostmåltider. Husk at angive i ansøgningen, hvilken stilling du søger.

Dine opgaver og muligheder:

En unik mulighed for at være med til at præge hverdagen og bidrage til fællesskabet i både institutionen og huset som helhed.

En høj grad af medindflydelse og ansvar i arbejdet med vores vigtigste opgave: børnene og samarbejdet med deres forældre.

Indsigt i pædagogisk arbejde med børn fra 0–6 år og mulighed for at deltage i aktiviteter som musik, motorik og kreative lege.

En hverdag præget af samarbejde, fleksibilitet og fællesskab – både i stuen og på tværs af huset.

Som husassistent er arbejdstiden mandag-fredag 9:30-13:00 er dine opgaver:

Anrette og servere frokost til børnene

Afrydning og opvask efter måltidet

Forberedelse af praktiske opgaver til næste dag

Sikre at stuerne få måltiderne til tiden

Tage ansvar for madbestilling på sigt

Du vil ofte arbejde selvstændigt, så det er vigtigt, at du trives med at tage ansvar og skabe struktur i dine opgaver.

Ansvarlig for hygiejne og rengøring i anretter køkkenet

Om Børnenes Ø

Vi består af 5 vuggestuegrupper og 3 børnehavegrupper.

Vi er en del af Generationernes Hus på Aarhus Ø – et levende hus med mange muligheder.

Du kan læse mere på vores hjemmeside:

Din profil til medhjælper stillingerne:

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Har lyst til at arbejde med børn i alderen 0–6 år i enten vuggestue eller børnehave.

Har en interesse i at arbejde med børn og det pædagogiske felt.

Er igangsættende og kreativ i forhold til aktiviteter og leg gennem hele dagen.

Kan være en tydelig og positiv rollemodel for børnene.

Bevarer ro og overblik – også i en travl hverdag.

Udviser initiativ, ansvarlighed, engagement og struktur.

Kan se dig selv som en del af huset i minimum ét år – gerne længere.

Er åben for faglig og personlig vejledning fra institutionens pædagoger.

Trives i et fællesskab og ønsker at være en aktiv del af et stort hus, hvor samarbejde på tværs vægtes højt – både i stuen og i hele Generationernes Hus.

Har lyst til at indgå i dialog med både forældre og husets øvrige beboere.

Bidrager med god energi og deler ud af din arbejdsglæde.

Har blik for trivsel, lethed og et godt arbejdsmiljø sammen med kollegaerne.

Tager ansvar for praktiske opgaver – fx opslag og billeder på AULA samt andre daglige gøremål i huset.

Derfor skal du vælge os

Generationernes Hus er et enestående og banebrydende projekt – det første af sin slags i Danmark. Som pædagogmedhjælper eller praktisk medhjælper hos os får du en unik mulighed for at være med til at forme hverdagen og udvikle en ny måde at tænke fællesskab og velfærd på.

Du bliver en del af et ambitiøst pionerprojekt, hvor du får medindflydelse på, hvordan vi i dagtilbuddet realiserer visionen og udvikler organisationen. Du vil opleve en alsidig og meningsfuld hverdag, hvor du kan sætte dit præg på opgaveløsningen og være med til at skabe noget helt særligt – sammen med børn, kollegaer og beboere i huset.

Om Generationernes Hus

Generationernes Hus er et moderne byggeri på Aarhus Ø og et nytænkende bud på, hvordan flere generationer kan leve og trives under samme tag. Huset er opført i samarbejde mellem fire bygherrer, som hver bidrager med forskellige bolig- og velfærdstilbud:

Magistratsafdelingen for Børn og Unge – dagtilbud med plads til 140 børn i alderen 0–6 år

Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg – 100 plejeboliger og 100 ældreboliger

Magistratsafdelingen for Sociale forhold og Beskæftigelse – 24 handicapboliger

Brabrand Boligforening – 40 ungdomsboliger og 40 familieboliger

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Stillingerne ønskes tiltrådt omkring 1-9-2026.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold efter gældende overenskomst og efter konkret forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Hvis du vil vide mere:

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til institutionen Børnenes Ø, Pædagogisk leder Bodil Hulgaard på telefon 41855936.

Ansøgning:

Vi beder dig om at gør det tydeligt i toppen af din ansøgning, hvilken af stillingerne, du søger

Ansøgningsfrist d.14.08.2026 kl.9.00

Klik på ”søg jobbet” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Vi modtager kun ansøgninger som er sendt online.

Der vil blive afviklet samtaler mandag den 19-8-2026. Mellem kl.08:00 –15:30 - vi indkalder løbene

Sted: Generationernes Hus, Thit Jensensgade 11a – 11c, 8000 Aarhus C, mødested vil være v/hovedindgangen til Generationernes Hus.

Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Membership Service Officer, APAC
description:
About GWEC

Global Wind Energy Council (GWEC) is the international trade association representing the entire wind energy value chain, uniting 1,500+ companies, organisations and institutions across 80+ countries. Together with our members, national associations and partners, we work to ensure wind power fulfils its role as a key solution to today's energy and climate challenges. Headquartered in Lisbon, with regional offices across Africa, Asia, India, Latin America and MENA, GWEC brings the supply chain together to shape policy and accelerate wind energy deployment worldwide.

About the Role

GWEC We are looking for an exceptionally service-minded Membership Coordinator / Membership Service Officer to join our APAC team — a fantastic opportunity for a young, energetic go-getter who wants a career at the heart of the global energy transition while doing what they do best: making people feel genuinely cared for. You will be the friendly, responsive face of GWEC for members across Asia-Pacific, ensuring they feel valued, supported and fully engaged in GWEC's activities, regionally and globally. Service needs to be hardwired into your DNA — you notice what people need before they ask.

Key Responsibilities

  • First point of contact for GWEC members across APAC — responding promptly and warmly to every query.
  • Build genuine, trusted relationships with member companies, driving satisfaction, retention and engagement.
  • Travel extensively across APAC to support country managers in delivering member events and initiatives.
  • Partner with the global team so APAC members stay connected to GWEC's worldwide network and resources.
  • Onboard new members and guide them through GWEC's offerings for a great experience from day one.
  • Maintain accurate membership records; track engagement, renewals and satisfaction across the region.
  • Capture member feedback and champion members' needs with the Head of Membership and Head of APAC.
  • Support seamless member experiences at GWEC and partner events, from logistics to on-the-ground support.

What we're looking for

  • A genuine, hardwired passion for service — real pride in going above and beyond for others.
  • A warm, responsive style; a natural relationship-builder and true people pleaser.
  • Energy and a can-do attitude — a young go-getter ready to grow fast within a global organisation.
  • Strong organisational skills; comfortable juggling many relationships and priorities.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for extensive regional travel; based in, or willing to relocate to, Singapore or Vietnam.
  • Fluent English; additional regional languages an advantage.
  • A real belief in the role wind energy can play in building a better, cleaner world.
  • Membership, customer service or events experience is a plus, but attitude and heart matter most.

What we offer

You'll join a small, passionate, truly global team at the centre of the energy transition — with exposure to the companies and policymakers shaping the wind industry, and real ownership of member relationships that matter.

How to apply

Please send your CV and a short cover note telling us why you're the service-minded go-getter we're looking for to opportunities@gwec.net, with the subject line: “Membership Service Officer, APAC."

Only candidates invited for an interview will be contacted. Applicants should be available to start work in September 2026.

title: Senior Backend Engineer(Mobile Platform)
description:
About the Team & Mission

Mobile Platform Engineering 팀은 모바일 서비스와 차량을 연결하여 SDV(Software Defined Vehicle) 시대의 새로운 서비스 영역을 만들어가는 팀입니다.

소프트웨어 플랫폼으로 진화하는 차량과 사용자의 일상을 잇는 접점을 설계하며, 모바일과 차량 어느 쪽에서든 끊김 없이 이어지는 경험을 제공하는 백엔드 플랫폼을 개발하고 운영합니다.

모바일-차량 연동 서비스의 설계부터 개발, 운영, 품질 개선까지 주도해 나갈 백엔드 엔지니어를 찾고 있습니다.

Responsibilities

  • 모바일-차량 연동 서비스 개발: 스마트폰과 차량을 연결하는 커넥티드 서비스의 백엔드 시스템을 설계하고 개발합니다.

  • SDV 기반 서비스 플랫폼 구축 및 운영: 차량, 모바일, 클라우드에 걸친 서비스가 안정적으로 동작하도록 확장성 있는 백엔드 플랫폼을 구축하고 운영합니다.

  • 대규모 트래픽 대응 API 개발 및 운영: 대규모 차량·모바일 클라이언트의 요청을 안정적으로 처리하는 API 및 서빙 시스템을 개발하고 운영합니다.

  • 서비스 안정성 및 품질 관리: 운영 로그와 지표를 지속적으로 모니터링하고, 장애 대응 및 자동화된 품질 관리 체계를 통해 서비스 안정성을 끊임없이 개선합니다.

  • 기술 리딩 및 시스템 개선: 팀 내 설계 리뷰와 기술 의사결정에 참여하며, 복잡한 문제를 재사용 가능하고 확장성 있는 시스템 개선으로 연결합니다.

Qualifications

  • Spring Boot(Kotlin/Java), Go 등을 기반으로 한 백엔드 서비스 설계, 개발, 운영 경력 7년 이상이신 분

  • Production traffic을 받는 API/backend service를 설계하고 운영해 보신 분

  • 로그와 지표를 기반으로 서비스 문제의 원인을 분석하고 개선해 보신 분

  • OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect 등 인증/인가 표준 프로토콜에 대한 이해

  • 초기 설계, 구조화, 표준화, 운영 안정성 개선을 주도해 보신 분

Preferred Qualifications

  • WebSocket, gRPC Streaming, MQTT 등 stateful한 커넥션 기반의 실시간 통신 서비스 개발 경험

  • Spring Boot 기반 대규모 서비스 개발 및 운영 경험

  • Go 기반 고성능 서버 개발 경험

  • AWS, Kubernetes, Helm 기반 서비스 운영 경험

  • MSA 환경에서의 서비스 설계 및 운영 경험

  • 차량 커넥티드 서비스, IoT, 디바이스 연동 서비스 개발 경험

  • 다국어/다지역(글로벌) 서비스 경험

  • 기술 리딩, 설계 리뷰, 주니어 멘토링 경험

Interview Process

  1. 서류 전형

  2. 코딩·과제 테스트

  3. 1차 면접 (화상, 1시간 내외)

  4. 2차 면접 (대면 혹은 화상, 3시간 내외)

Additional Information

  • 지원서 접수 중 오류가 발생하거나 기타 문의 사항이 있을 경우, recruit@42dot.ai로 문의해 주시기 바랍니다.

  • 장애인 고용 촉진 및 직업재활법에 따라 장애인 등록증 소지자를 우대합니다.

title: Senior Director, Revenue Cycle Management
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Director, Revenue Cycle Management based in United States.

This executive-level role provides strategic leadership over the full revenue cycle function, driving operational excellence and financial performance across the organization.
The position focuses on building scalable processes across authorizations, billing, accounts receivable, collections, and payer operations.
You will use data-driven insights to improve revenue outcomes, strengthen compliance, and optimize financial workflows.
The ideal candidate will combine healthcare revenue expertise with strong leadership skills to guide teams and influence cross-functional initiatives.
This role plays a critical part in improving operational efficiency, protecting revenue streams, and supporting long-term organizational growth.
You will collaborate with clinical, finance, compliance, and operational stakeholders in a remote environment focused on innovation and continuous improvement.

Accountabilities:

The Senior Director, Revenue Cycle Management will oversee the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of revenue operations while ensuring financial accuracy, regulatory compliance, and strong team performance.

  • Provide executive leadership for the full revenue cycle lifecycle, including authorizations, billing operations, accounts receivable, collections, and payment processes.
  • Develop and implement strategies to reduce days in accounts receivable, improve cash flow, and maximize collection performance.
  • Ensure accuracy and integrity across payment postings, adjustments, reconciliations, and financial reporting processes.
  • Design and optimize authorization workflows to prevent revenue leakage and support uninterrupted patient care.
  • Partner with clinical, finance, and compliance teams to align operational processes with payer requirements and organizational objectives.
  • Oversee private-pay invoicing and collection strategies while maintaining a positive and supportive financial experience for families.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for payer disputes, reimbursement challenges, underpayment trends, and policy changes.
  • Ensure compliance with CPT coding, modifiers, payer-specific billing requirements, and healthcare revenue regulations.
  • Establish executive-level revenue cycle KPIs, including clean claim rates, first-pass resolution, denial trends, and collection performance metrics.
  • Leverage reporting tools, EHR data, and business intelligence insights to identify improvement opportunities and optimize operational decisions.
  • Lead denial prevention strategies, appeals processes, and recovery initiatives to protect organizational revenue.
  • Drive automation initiatives, system enhancements, and technology improvements across revenue cycle operations.
  • Manage change initiatives related to payer updates, system implementations, and operational improvements.
  • Mentor, develop, and lead billing and authorization teams while fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate brings extensive healthcare revenue cycle leadership experience, strong analytical capabilities, and a proven ability to optimize complex billing and reimbursement operations.

    • Minimum of five years of healthcare, hospital, billing, and collections experience in a supervisory or leadership capacity.
    • Strong understanding of healthcare revenue cycle operations, including authorizations, physician billing, claims management, and collections.
    • Experience managing Medicaid billing processes for primary and secondary reimbursement.
    • Familiarity with ABA healthcare operations is preferred.
    • Experience with CentralReach or similar healthcare management platforms is a plus.
    • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, healthcare, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience considered.
    • Strong knowledge of billing software, EHR systems, spreadsheet tools, and reporting platforms.
    • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategic initiatives aligned with organizational goals.
    • Proven leadership skills with experience coaching, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams.
    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to review financial data, identify trends, and create operational forecasts.
    • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills when working with executives, payers, regulatory organizations, clinicians, and patients.
    • Strong organizational abilities with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
    • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment.
    • Commitment to professionalism, confidentiality, ethical practices, and HIPAA privacy and security requirements.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote opportunity available to candidates located in eligible U.S. states.
      • Opportunity to lead high-impact revenue cycle transformation initiatives.
      • Strategic leadership role with significant influence on financial performance and operational growth.
      • Collaborative environment working across clinical, financial, and operational teams.
      • Opportunity to improve healthcare delivery through stronger operational systems and processes.
      • Professional growth opportunities within a mission-driven organization.

title: Kok / Cater / ufaglært kok med erfaring søges til Restaurant The Grill i Maximum Aalborg
description:
MAXIMUM OG RESTAURANT THE GRILL AALBORG SØGER NETOP NU EN KOK / CATER / UFAGLÆRT KOK MED ERFARING

Vi søger en engageret, kvalitetsbevidst kok, cater eller ufaglært kok med køkkenerfaring, der samtidig kan arbejde i et højt tempo. Har du erfaring inden for køkkenbranchen, og vil du være med til at lave mad til de mange gæster, der dagligt besøger Maximum & The Grill?

Vi er en familierestaurant der stræber efter at levere de bedste buffeter, hvor alle aldersgrupper bliver præsenteret for både livretter, men også nye og spændende tilberedninger. Vi arbejder aktivt med både smag og det visuelle udtryk i vores buffeter.

Om jobbet:

Vi søger kok / cater / ufaglært kok med erfaring der er klar på nogle gode og spændende arbejdstimer i køkkenet. Du møder ind omkring middagstid og starter forberedelsen af alle retter til buffeten. Forretterne anrettes som små portionsanretninger der gør det lækkert og visuelt flot på buffeten. Hen på eftermiddagen møder køkkenmedhjælper/buffist ind og hjælper med det sidste, samt få opsat en fantastisk buffet. I løbet af aftenen er det kokkens og buffistens vigtigste opgaver at opretholde den flotte buffet samt lave et ”show” ved den store indendørs grill, hvor alt kød grilles og herefter skæres for overfor gæsten.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et spændende og alsidigt job, hvor vi garanterer at dagene ikke er ens.
  • Et arbejde med stort kollegialt fællesskab
  • Fantastiske personalegoder, der giver dig mulighed for at give dig selv og familien gode oplevelser i alle vores centre i Danmark.
  • Gode arbejdstider – som kok i køkkenet er dine arbejdsdage som regel med fyraften mellem kl. 20-22-tiden

Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

Vi arbejder hver dag med at lave gode gæsteoplevelser lige fra køkkenet til forlystelser, bar og restaurant. Vi er ét stort team der elsker at hjælpe hinanden for netop at levere de bedste gæsteoplevelser.

Om dig:

  • Du har erfaring som kok, cater, køkkenmedhjælper eller lignende
  • Du har en passion for god madlavning, og trives i et køkken hvor der til tider kan være fart over feltet, men hvor vi samtidig hjælper hinanden for at opnå et fælles mål.
  • Du er serviceminded og kan lide at have gæstekontakt
  • Du trives med skiftende arbejdstider og weekendarbejde
  • Du søger et arbejde hvor stemningen er god og humøret er højt
  • Du trives med at arbejde efter koncept

Køkkenuddannelse er ikke et krav, men selvfølgelig en fordel. Vi kan godt lide at arbejde med medarbejdere der har en passion for det de laver.

Lidt praktiske informationer

  • Fuldtid
  • Opstart efter aftale. Vi indkalder løbende udvalgte kandidater til samtale, så send din ansøgning allerede idag.
  • Løn efter kvalifikationer - med weekendtillæg.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

JKS rekrutterer inden for alle brancher og på alle niveauer, hvorfor du vil komme til at arbejde med kunder og vikarer til hele det danske erhvervsliv.
Din primære opgave vil være at servicere vores kunder i området. Her får du ansvaret for finde de helt rette kandidater til vores kunder, og dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. indbefatte:

  • Skrive stillingsopslag, og dele disse på forskellige medier
  • Screene kandidater og afholde samtaler
  • Matche kandidater med vores kunder - både i vikariater og rekrutteringer
  • Udarbejdelse af kandidatpræsentationer og referencetagning
  • Besvare telefonopkald fra kunder, kandidater og kolleger
Du vil få en arbejdstid, der hedder 08:00-16:00 mandag til torsdag og 08:00-15:30 om fredagen. Stillingen er en 37 timers stilling, men der skal forventes fleksibilitet i travle perioder.

Hvem er du?
Som udgangspunkt skal du have en kommercielt mindset, og se værdien i at bringe kunder og kandidater sammen. Du skal kunne arbejde med mange bolde i luften i højt tempo uden at tabe fokus, da vi i perioder har rigtig mange telefonopkald og opgaver, der skal lukkes asap. Det passer dig, at arbejde i et, til tider, meget hektisk arbejdsmiljø. Du har stærke administrative egenskaber krydret med struktur i din udførelse af opgaver.

Vigtigst af alt er, at du har en empatisk tilgang til mennesker, har gode kommunikative evner og derigennem kan føre en saglig dialog med både kolleger, kunder og kandidater.

Som person byder du ind med positivitet og godt humør. Du er udadvendt, dedikeret, struktureret og har en naturlig autoritet i din personlighed. Du er en holdspiller og sætter en ære i at spille dine kolleger gode, men du besidder også evnen til at kunne arbejde selvstændigt og kan træffe fornuftige beslutninger i en travl hverdag.

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Du har en god menneskelig indlevelsesevne
  • Du er pålidelig, ansvarsbevidst og har en udpræget ordenssans
  • Du har viljen til at gennemføre dine projekter inden for planlagt deadline
  • Du behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale
  • Erfaren IT-bruger
  • Du trives med at arbejde selvstændigt under ansvar
  • Du er omstillingsparat og kan bevare overblikket, også når tingene går rigtig stærk
  • Du har B-kørekort, samt bil til rådighed i dagligdagen. Dette er vigtigt i forhold til kundebesøg og lignende

Vi tilbyder
Kan du nikke genkendende til ovenstående, så har du mulighed for at blive en del af vores team i Kalundborg og derved komme til at arbejde i Danmarks største vikar- og rekrutteringsbureau med 40 afdelinger fordelt over hele landet.

  • Du vil blive en del af et team med en høj arbejdsmoral, hvor god energi og godt humør vægtes utrolig højt. Du samarbejder og sparrer løbende med dine kolleger, og du får en leder, der lytter til dig og værdsætter din indsats
  • Vi tilbyder et af landets største og stærkeste netværk
  • Årligt tilbyder vi intern konsulentuddannelse til dygtiggørelse af dine kompetencer
  • Vi tilbyder en lønpakke, der tager udgangspunkt i dine kvalifikationer samt pension, sundheds- og tandforsikring, frokost- og frugtordning
Ansøgning
Lyder ovenstående som jobbet for dig, så send meget gerne din ansøgning via Søg stillingen nedenfor.
Grundet persondataforordningen modtager vi ikke CV og ansøgning på mail.

Stillingen ønskes besat snarest muligt, hvorfor vi løbende indkalder til samtaler. Dog venter vi gerne på den helt rette kandidat.

Har du nogle spørgsmål til stillingen, er du altid velkommen til at kontakte Afdelingschef Nanna Olin på tlf. +45 59 55 07 53 eller HR-chef Kasper Reinhold på +45 61 63 07 35.

En del af dansk erhvervsliv siden 1995
JKS er Danmarks største vikar- og rekrutteringsbureau og fordelt over hele landet beskæftiger vi hver dag mere end 3.000 vikarmedarbejdere hos vores kunder.

JKS startede i Hvide Sande i 1995, da der i forbindelse med nedlukningen af et lokalt skibsbyggeri var ledige hænder, der skulle i arbejde. Hovedkontoret ligger i dag i Ringkøbing, og har fået selskab af 37 lokale kontorer fordelt i hele Danmark. Herudover har vi også kontorer i Norge, Sverige og Rumænien. Vi har siden starten været på danske hænder og er fortsat 100 % danskejet.

JKS består i dag, udover de mange tusinde vikarer, af 200 dedikerede medarbejdere, der hver dag møder ind for at hjælpe jobsøgende i arbejde og styrke vores kunders konkurrencekraft gennem fleksible og effektive bemandingsløsninger. Årligt har vi mere end 20.000 personer i arbejde i kortere eller længere tid.

Udover fleksible vikarløsninger hos JKS, hjælper vi også vores kunder med skræddersyede løsninger gennem de specialiserede brands Career (rekruttering, onboarding og outplacement), Shortlist (kandidattiltrækning, employer branding), Professionals (IT-, ingeniør og økonomikonsulenter på freelance-basis) samt Assistance (køkken- og kantinebemanding).

title: Healthcare Solutions Partner -United States
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius is hiring a driven and industry-savvy Healthcare Solutions Partner to join our growing Healthcare & Life Sciences (HCLS) team.

As a strategic connector between the Global Head of HCLS and regional Account Executives (AEs), you will play a pivotal role in accelerating go-to-market execution, deepening client engagement, and ensuring our cloud and AI solutions align with the business, scientific, and regulatory needs of the healthcare ecosystem.

Based in the US, you will manage strategic client relationships, identify and develop new business opportunities, and collaborate with partners — with a strong focus on the Digital Health, Medical Devices, and Medical Imaging segments.

Your ability to understand complex scientific and business challenges, craft tailored solutions, and thrive in a fast-moving, innovation-led environment will define your success. This role combines consultative selling, industry expertise, and commercial execution, helping customers unlock the full potential of the Nebius platform.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of Nebius and the value to our customers
  • Own and grow your territory:
    • Maintain and deliver against a strategic plan for region/territory.
    • Help AE’s qualify and prioritise opportunities through an HCLS and compliance lens.
    • Lead and support strategic discussions with Digital Health, Medical Device and Imaging companies.
  • Client Engagement:
    • Develop deep relationships with key stakeholders across the enterprise, positioning our AI and cloud solutions to address client-specific challenges.
    • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, driving engagement and long-term relationships.
    • Identify opportunities to apply AI/ML, HPC, and data platforms.
  • Deal Support & Sales Acceleration
    • Partner with Account Executives to shape account strategy, value messaging, and proposal content that will secure deals to meet revenue targets
    • Help qualify and prioritise opportunities through an HC&LS and compliance lens.
    • Support complex deal cycles where domain credibility and regulatory insight are critical.
  • Solution Selling:
    • Demonstrate the value of AI and cloud solutions through consultative selling, product demonstrations, and presentations.
  • Regional Representation:
    • Represent Nebius at regional and industry events, and customer meetings.
  • Market Knowledge:
    • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive landscape to position our solutions effectively.
  • Forecast with accuracy; progress deals through the Salesforce sales process and deliver against ACV / activity targets.

We expect you to have:

  • Proven Experience: 8+ years of experience in B2B sales, particularly in AI, cloud, or data infrastructure, with a clear hunter track record.
  • Passion and desire to work in a startup culture, directly impacting the growth of the company
  • Comfortable selling cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), AI solutions, and related technologies.
  • Strong commercial acumen: value mapping, negotiation, multi‑year deals, and exec-level‑ storytelling.
  • High energy, enthusiasm, and evidence of consistent growth vs. quota.
  • CRM Proficiency: Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar.
  • Ability to travel as needed.

It will be an added bonus and strong preference if you have:

  • 5–10 years in hospital, medical device, manufacturing, healthcare, pharma, biotech, or life sciences, ideally in healthcare, business, consulting, GTM, product, or pre-sales roles.
  • Deep understanding of European and UK healthcare systems, startups and their business processes, scientific data workflows, and regulatory frameworks.
  • Proven ability to communicate complex scientific and technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Previous experience in a high-growth, start-up environment ideally selling cloud, AI/ML or HPC solutions.
  • Exposure to SaaS models or cloud infrastructure sales.
  • Experience selling to mid-market or enterprise-level clients

Compensation

We offer competitive salaries, ranging from $233k-$295K OTE based on your experience.

Key employee benefits in the US:

  • Health insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.
  • 401(k) plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.
  • Parental leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.
  • Remote work reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.
  • Disability & life insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term and life insurance coverage.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range
$137,600—$172,000 USD

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: Pædagog søges til Seniorbofællesskabet Skriverensvej 4 i Holbæk
description:
Tiltrædelse

1. november 2026 eller snarest muligt.

Om os

Skriverensvej 4 er et socialpsykiatrisk seniorbofællesskab i Holbæk Kommune. Her bor ældre borgere med psykiske udfordringer, som støttes i at leve et meningsfuldt og selvstændigt liv på egne præmisser. Vi arbejder recoveryorienteret og med et stærkt fokus på relationer, faglig refleksion og respekt for den enkelte borgers ønsker, ressourcer og behov.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Støtte borgerne i deres hverdag med afsæt i en recoveryorienteret og rehabiliterende tilgang
  • Yde socialpædagogisk støtte og hjælp efter Servicelovens § 85 samt støtte til personlig pleje og praktisk hjælp efter Servicelovens § 83
  • Skabe struktur og trivsel sammen med borgerne
  • Etablere og vedligeholde professionelle relationer
  • Dokumentation og opfølgning på indsatser i relevante fagsystemer
  • Tværfagligt samarbejde med kolleger, pårørende og eksterne samarbejdspartnere
  • Medicinhåndtering efter gældende retningslinjer og kompetencer
  • Bidrage aktivt til den faglige udvikling på tilbuddet

Vi søger dig, der

  • Er uddannet pædagog
  • Gerne har erfaring inden for socialpsykiatri.
  • Har en anerkendende og relationskompetent tilgang til borgerne
  • Kan arbejde struktureret og reflekterende i komplekse situationer
  • Trives med både faste rutiner og uforudsigelige opgaver
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig bidrage aktivt til teamets fællesskab
  • Har gode skriftlige kompetencer og erfaring med dokumentation

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og fokus på kvalitet
  • Mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel for borgernes hverdag og livskvalitet
  • Kompetente og engagerede kolleger
  • Introduktion og oplæring tilpasset dine erfaringer
  • Løbende faglig sparring og mulighed for kompetenceudvikling
  • En arbejdsplads præget af tillid, samarbejde og arbejdsglæde

Arbejdstid

Der er tale om en fuldtidsstilling i skiftende vagter, herunder dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde efter gældende vagtplan.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV senest 24. august 2026. Vi forventer at afholde ansættelsessamtaler i uge 36. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Tilbudsleder Dorthe Møller Mogensen på mail dormm@holb.dk.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Vi er 4.800 engagerede kollegaer, der hver dag arbejder for at skabe god service og velfærd for vores ca. 75.000 borgere i Holbæk Kommune. Sammen bringer vi vores forskellige fagligheder i spil og skaber løsninger, der gør en reel forskel.

Vi lægger stor vægt på et godt arbejdsmiljø og på at udvikle vores medarbejdere - både fagligt og personligt.

I Holbæk Kommune arbejder vi aktivt for mangfoldige arbejdspladser, hvor der er plads til forskellighed. Alle kvalificerede ansøgere opfordres derfor til at søge stillingen - uanset køn, alder, handicap, etnicitet, politiske og religiøse overbevisninger eller seksuel orientering.

Holbæk Kommunes personalepolitik sætter rammen for vores værdier og måden, vi møder hinanden og borgerne på.

Læs mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde i Holbæk Kommune.

title: Off-Hwy Sales Engineer
description:
Overview

Horton, Inc. has an opening for an Off-Hwy Sales Engineer at our corporate headquarters in Roseville, Minnesota.

Position Summary:

The Industrial Sales Engineering position is a professional sales position that combines commercial expertise with engineering skills. It requires understanding of client needs and requirements to effectively design, apply, and sell Horton products. This position represents the company in sales and engineering activities focused on Oil & Gas customers. The Sales Engineer develops and maintains relationships, collects customer feedback, identifies new customers, persuade customers to buy and resolves conflicts. With general direction from the VP Sales- Off Highway, the Sales Engineer will develop sales and marketing plans to aggressively grow business with Oil & Gas OEM’s, channel partners, and end users, identify required resources, and partner effectively within Horton to meet and exceed sales goals.

Company Information:

As a global leader in thermal control for power systems, Horton offers a variety of technologies and industrial applications to operate at the optimal temperature - even in the most demanding conditions. For over 70 years, the organization has been an integral partner to companies worldwide providing innovative and reliable engine cooling solutions for heavy-duty vehicles and equipment. For more information on Horton, Inc. please visit our web site at www.hortonww.com.

Responsibilities

Off-Hwy Sales Engineer Job Responsibilities:

  • Retains and develops existing Engine OEM’s and Distributors:
    • Ensures customers are fully informed regarding products, pricing, and relevant innovations pricing using personal visits, telephone calls, social media and other means as appropriate.
    • Employs value selling to match products to requirements and is a steward of the Company’s profitability, determining initial and subsequent price levels that provide for long-term relationships that are mutually beneficial.
    • Engages with the CRM system (Microsoft Dynamics) to document site visits, customer commitments, and to manage the opportunity funnel.
    • Maintains a high level of visibility with customers to review current and future needs, observe product applications, obtain competitive information needed by marketing and engineering to develop new products or features, and to identify and pursue opportunities.
    • Concentrates on retaining existing clients by taking action to ensure their satisfaction with service, quality, and price.
  • Prospects and recruits new customers for Horton products:
    • Identifies candidates by networking with current customers, using the CRM database, leveraging marketing resources, and attending trade shows.
    • Qualifies and prioritizes candidates based on potential value of Horton solutions, potential demand, and required time to close.
    • Aggressively secures initial projects to establish relationships and remains engaged to ensure customer satisfaction and future opportunities.
    • Develops and maintains a large funnel of prospects to maximize new customer acquisition.
    • Engages with the CRM system (Microsoft Dynamics) to document site visits, customer commitments, and to manage the opportunity funnel.
  • Develops personal relationships with client staff.
    • Creates social opportunities for interaction with client staff in order to build a relationship of trust and open communication.
    • Makes satisfaction of customers a personal priority, acting as an advocate for customer interests when issues of service or performance arise.
    • Mitigates client negative experiences by using relationships to communicate with clients and resolve problems before they result in loss of sales.
  • Networks within Horton to ensure customer satisfaction and maximize relationship value:
    • Teams effectively across functional boundaries to share information and develop timely and effective solutions for customer problems and to close opportunities.
    • Collaborates with application engineering to develop customized and tailored solutions that effectively address customer requirements and maximize value.
    • Provides VOC regarding customer perceptions and needs, focusing upon improvements that will enhance the value of our products or Horton as the supplier of choice.
    • Provides input on product development and design opportunities through frequent interaction and dialogue with company marketing and technical staff.

Qualifications

Off-Hwy Sales Engineer Qualifications:

  • Skills and knowledge consistent with a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent degree
    • Note: equivalent education equals 2 years of closely related experience for 1 year of education.
  • 2 or more years of successful customer-facing experience as an application engineer or sales representative
  • OEM or industrial application experience is preferred
  • Engine experience is strongly preferred
  • Requires 30-50% travel, primarily domestic with some potential for occasional international
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States. No Visa sponsorship provided now or in the future for this position.

Additional Information:

The estimated hiring range for this position is $95,000 - $130,000 per year plus bonus. Compensation will increase within the range based on experience and qualifications. We also offer a competitive benefits package including PTO, Company Paid Holidays, 401K, Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA, FSA, Life, AD&D, STD, LTD, Education Assistance, and a dynamic work environment.

To apply, qualified candidates should log onto https://careers-horton.icims.com.

Horton, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity employer. Veterans/Disabled

title: (1526) Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Manager
description:
Join Nortal for your next big adventure. We are seeking a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Manager to join our team, grow with us, and teach us a few things along the way.

Why join Nortal

  • Say Goodbye to Micromanagement: We champion autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values.
  • Outcomes Over Hours: We believe in a work model focused on impact, providing you with the flexibility to balance your professional success with your personal well-being.
  • Vibrant Community: Join our close-knit LATAM remote team and connect through tech talks, virtual coffee breaks, and team-building activities.
  • Support from Day One: Our People Care team is here to support you throughout your journey, from wellness check-ins to professional growth.

Our benefits ✨

  • Competitive USD salary.
  • 100% remote work: While you can work from anywhere, you’re always welcome to connect with teammates and grow your network at our coworking spaces across LATAM.
  • Paid off & national holidays: Take the time you need according to your country’s regulations while receiving your full salary.
  • Sick leave: Focus on your health without stress. Take the necessary time to recover and feel better.
  • Annual credit: Spend it on the perks you love to enhance your work-life balance.
  • Team-building activities: Join us for coffee breaks, tech talks, and after-work gatherings to bond with your Nortal family and feel part of our vibrant community.
  • Birthday off: Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family.

About the project

As a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Manager, you will own project plans end-to-end, keep delivery teams aligned to scope and timelines, and act as the primary point of contact for the client. The role carries direct accountability for risk management, quality assurance, task allocation, and progress reporting, and is expected to drive continuous process improvement across the engagement.

What you’ll do

  • Develop and execute comprehensive project plans, defining scope, objectives, deliverables, and timelines, and design effective strategies to reach project goals.
  • Keep delivery teams aligned to project objectives and deadlines, fostering a collaborative and synchronized way of working.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for the client, maintaining open, transparent communication to meet expectations throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Identify project risks early and put mitigation plans in place, resolving blockers promptly and escalating issues when needed.
  • Own project quality standards and confirm that all deliverables meet or exceed client expectations.
  • Allocate tasks across the team based on capacity and skill set.
  • Organize and facilitate sprints, contributing to solutioning discussions as needed.
  • Prepare regular progress reports, status updates, and documentation for internal and external stakeholders, keeping project records current.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and implement best practices to strengthen project management capability across the team.
  • Define and roll out delivery methodologies, including the tooling required to support them.
  • Drive on-time completion of tasks, keeping the team motivated toward project objectives while upholding service excellence.
  • Support the team throughout the project lifecycle, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Conduct project reviews, track progress, and report developments and key risks to the client.
  • Coordinate and communicate with other departments involved in current and upcoming projects.
  • Schedule, lead, and document client discovery and follow-up meetings.
  • Facilitate ongoing communication within the team to ensure successful, on-time project completion.

What makes you a great fit 🎯

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ Years of project management experience, with a track record of delivering projects on time and within budget.
  • 2+ Years of hands-on experience on Microsoft Dynamics 365 projects.
  • Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with proven ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proven experience working with Azure DevOps.

title: Lead, Finance Solutions, CorporateOS
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Corporate Technical team is responsible for building and optimizing the many systems and internal technologies that enable Anduril to accomplish its mission. Anduril’s supply chain, accounting, sales & growth, field maintenance, manufacturing, and many more teams rely on the technology built and maintained by us. We call this system-of-systems “CorpOS”. Within CorpOS lies a suite of digital software solutions aimed at solving the problems for our growth, finance, people teams that interplays heavily with our ArsenalOS solutions that enable Anduril’s engineering, production and sustainment departments.

ABOUT THE JOB

We're building the financial systems backbone that lets a fast-scaling manufacturing company move with the speed of a software startup and the rigor of a public company. As Finance Solutions Manager, you'll sit at the intersection of Finance, Operations, and Engineering—owning the platforms, data, and processes that turn raw operational activity into trustworthy financial insight. This is a builder's role:

  • You'll inherit ambiguity, systems that do and don't yet talk to each other, and a business growing faster than its tooling
  • Your mandate is to close that gap with scalable ERP workflows, clean cost and revenue data, and automation that replaces spreadsheets and manual reconciliation
  • You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with controllers, FP&A, supply chain, and data engineering—translating messy real-world requirements into systems that are auditable, performant, and built to last through the next order of magnitude of growth

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Own the design and continuous improvement of core finance systems—ERP (e.g., Oracle Fusion, NetSuite, SAP), cost accounting, and the data pipelines feeding FP&A and reporting
  • Partner with Finance and Operations stakeholders to gather requirements, then translate them into configured, tested, well-documented solutions rather than one-off workarounds
  • Lead cross-functional projects end to end: entity setups, cost and receipt accounting flows, work-order and inventory costing, order-to-cash and procure-to-pay improvements
  • Build the connective tissue between transactional systems and analytics—defining the data models, controls, and reconciliations that make month-end fast and the numbers defensible
  • Drive automation and self-service, cutting manual close tasks and giving finance partners direct access to reliable data
  • Establish standards for change management, testing, and documentation so the platform stays clean as the team scales
  • Act as the bridge between Finance and Engineering/Data teams, ensuring technical decisions reflect real accounting and operational needs
  • Mentor analysts and set the bar for how finance systems work gets done

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 12+ years in finance systems, finance operations, technical accounting, or a closely related field, including hands-on ownership of an ERP or financial platform
  • 5+ years of managing a group of product managers or business system analysts
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing finance solutions end to end—requirements through deployment and adoption—not just administering existing systems
  • Strong grounding in accounting fundamentals: general ledger, cost accounting, revenue, and the mechanics of a monthly close
  • Proven track record leading cross-functional projects across Finance, Operations, and technical teams
  • Comfort working with data at scale: SQL or equivalent, plus fluency reasoning about data models, reconciliations, and controls
  • A builder's mindset—able to operate in ambiguity, prioritize ruthlessly, and ship pragmatic solutions in a fast-changing environment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company (FAANG-scale or well-funded startup) and/or a manufacturing, hardware, or supply-chain-intensive business—ideally both
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud (SCM, Cost Management, Receipt Accounting) or comparable enterprise ERP modules
  • Familiarity with modern data platforms and analytics tooling (e.g., warehouses, Foundry, dbt, Looker/Tableau) and how they integrate with transactional finance systems
  • Exposure to manufacturing cost concepts—work-order costing, standard vs. actual cost, inventory valuation, and labor/overhead absorption
  • Experience standing up systems and processes for a company scaling through rapid headcount, entity, or geographic expansion
  • A background that blends technical depth with finance credibility—e.g., prior roles as a systems analyst, finance transformation lead, or controller-turned-systems-owner
US Salary Range
$191,000—$253,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:

    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. title: Electrician / Project Manager
description:
A well-established generator sales, installation, and service company is looking for a Project Manager to take ownership of residential and commercial standby generator projects from the first customer conversation through a completed, commissioned installation.

Leads arrive warm through the company’s network, referrals, and marketing. From there, the Project Manager consults with the homeowner or facility contact on what they are trying to protect and what the site will support, prepares and presents the quote, lines up the subcontractors, and manages the installation schedule through startup. The customer, the electrician, and the inspector all end up leaning on this person.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Work inbound leads and referrals across residential and commercial accounts in the territory; qualify the opportunity and consult with the customer on load requirements, equipment sizing, and fuel type.
  • Conduct site evaluations covering load calculations, service entrance conditions, transfer switch location, fuel supply, generator placement, and code or setback constraints.
  • Build, price, and present project quotes; follow up through the decision cycle and close the sale.
  • Source, schedule, and manage subcontractors — electrical, concrete, gas/propane, excavation, and crane as required — and hold them to scope, schedule, and quality.
  • Coordinate equipment orders, lead times, and delivery with suppliers and distributors.
  • Own the installation calendar and keep customers informed at every milestone from deposit to commissioning.
  • Manage permitting, utility coordination, and inspection scheduling with the authority having jurisdiction.
  • Track budget against actuals, handle change orders, and close projects out cleanly with documentation and warranty registration.
  • Serve as the single point of contact and accountable owner for every project in your pipeline.

Requirements

  • E-2 or E-1 electrical license strongly preferred; journeyman or master electrician credentials will also be considered.
  • Three or more years managing electrical, generator, or comparable construction and installation projects — residential, commercial, or both.
  • Working knowledge of standby generator systems, automatic transfer switches, load calculations, and applicable NEC requirements.
  • Demonstrated comfort quoting work and selling to end customers; this role carries revenue responsibility, not just execution.
  • Experience coordinating subcontractors and navigating permitting and inspection processes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication — you will be translating technical detail for homeowners and facility managers who do not speak the language.
  • Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Company Truck
  • Company Phone
  • Compensation: $80,000 - 95,000 salary
  • Variable Compensation Per Installation: $10,000 - 20,000+

title: Managing Geologist (MS/PhD)
description:
About Exponent

Exponent is the only premium engineering and scientific consulting firm with the depth and breadth of expertise to solve our clients’ most profoundly unique, unprecedented, and urgent challenges.

We are committed to engaging multidisciplinary teams of science, engineering, and regulatory experts to empower our clients with solutions that create a safer, healthier, more sustainable world. For over five decades, we've connected the lessons of past failures with tomorrow's solutions to advise clients as they innovate technologically complex products and processes, ensure the safety and health of their users, and address the challenges of sustainability.

Join our team of experts with degrees from top programs at over 500 universities and extensive experience spanning a variety of industries. At Exponent, you’ll contribute to the diverse pool of ideas, talents, backgrounds, and experiences that drives our collaborative teamwork and breakthrough insights. Plus, we help you grow your career through mentoring, sponsorship, and a culture of learning. Thanks for your interest in joining our team!

Key statistics:

  • 950+ Consultants
  • 640+ Ph.D.s
  • 90+ Disciplines
  • 30+ Offices globally

Our Opportunity

We are currently seeking a Senior Geologist for our Civil & Structural Engineering Practice in Oakland, CA; Los Angeles, CA; Bellevue, WA; Seattle; WA, Atlanta, GA; or New York, NY. In this role, you will work as part of a team responsible for providing professional services in the areas of engineering geology, remote sensing, GIS, mapping, and geophysics for a range of projects involving the investigation of the cause and extent of failures of geotechnical systems and the evaluation of natural hazards. This position will provide technically challenging work with excellent opportunities to grow within the firm.

You will be responsible for

  • Conducting field inspections and subsurface explorations (to determine causes of failure of geotechnical systems e.g. slopes, foundations, tunnels, levees, and dams).
  • Evaluating and characterizing site conditions (for root cause of failure analyses and conceptual mitigation design)
  • Creation of Geospatial models including GIS and subsurface models
  • Creation of topographic maps and thematic maps
  • Engage directly with clients regarding project strategy and deliverables including, but not limited to, presentation of findings in written and verbal formats
  • Performing peer review of geologic and geotechnical engineering documents
  • Evaluating construction claims
  • Leading project teams on the execution of project deliverables (field investigations, analyses, written and oral presentations of findings)
  • Developing project work with new and existing clients

You will have the following skills and qualifications

  • Ph.D. in geological sciences specializing in Engineering Geology, or a related field from an accredited university, plus 5 years of post-graduate experience
  • Alternatively, MS in Geological Sciences specializing in Engineering Geology, or a related field from an accredited university, plus 10 years of post-graduate experience
  • Licensure as a professional Geologist (PG) or Geophysicist (PGP) in at least one state is required.
  • Certification as Engineering Geologist (CEG) or Hydrogeologist (CHG) in at least one state, or the ability to obtain a certification within 2 years
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Demonstrated success in independently developing and managing client relationships
  • Attention to detail, dedication to quality and accuracy, desire to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Proven track record of effective leadership skills
  • Strong publication record in peer-reviewed journals or conference proceedings or demonstrated leadership or activity in professional societies
  • Record of excellent written and verbal communication skills

Applicants are encouraged to submit a CV with publications (feel free to include publications that are in review or pending) [not restricted to 1 page].

Life @ Exponent

To learn more about life at Exponent and our impact, please visit the following links:https://www.exponent.com/careers/life-exponenthttps://www.exponent.com/company/our-impact

Attracting, inspiring, developing, and rewarding exceptional people with diverse backgrounds and expertise are central to our corporate culture. Our diverse team allows us to provide better value to our clients and enjoy an enriched work environment.

Our firm is committed to offering a variety of programs and resources to support health and well-being. We believe that providing competitive benefits as well as compensation and recognition programs empowers our staff to do work that makes a difference.

Work Environment

At Exponent, we have found that in-person interactions deepen employee engagement and are crucial for development, for realizing the full potential of our talented and diverse teams, and for​ building a more inclusive workplace where all have a sense of belonging.
