title: Fast stilling som social- og sundhedsassistent til natte- og aftenvagt
description:
Sclerosehospitalet i Haslev søger social- og sundhedsassistent til nattevagter og aftenvagter

En fast stilling som social og sundhedsassistent er ledig med tiltrædelse 1.10.2026, eller tidligere. Stillingen er primært i nattevagt og med enkelte aftenvagter pr. måned og en gennemsnitlig ugentlig arbejdstid på 28 timer/uge.

Timerne kan fordeles efter nærmere aftale og i samarbejde med den anden faste nattevagt.

Ønsker du at arbejde i organisation, der værdsætter en stærk monofaglig identitet, hvor patienterne og deres behov er i centrum, og hvor anerkendelse og håb er væsentlige værdier?

Så er vi stedet for dig!

Sclerosehospitalerne tilbyder højt specialiseret rehabilitering til mennesker med sclerose. Det gælder både nye med sclerose og dem, der har levet med sygdommen i mange år. Vi arbejder helhedsorienteret ud fra patienternes livssituation, ønsker og behov.

Ligeledes vægtes det sammenhængende patientforløb og et godt samarbejde med primær sektor højt. Vi er en dynamisk organisation, der forandres i takt med patienternes behov og i sammenhæng med sundhedssystemet og samfundsudviklingen i det hele taget.

Dit kommende arbejds- og ansvarsområde

  • Sygepleje, såvel grundlæggende som mere kompleks, til patienter med sclerose; fra den nydiagnosticerede til patienten med svær fremskreden sclerose
  • I aftenvagt skal du, på skift med øvrige kollegaer, varetage funktionen som ansvarshavende. Som nattevagt er du altid ansvarshavende da du er alene på vagt.
  • Praktiske opgaver i fm. aften- og nattevagt

Personlige kvalifikationer

  • Er engageret, ansvarlig og hjælpsom
  • Kommunikerer anerkendende og konstruktivt
  • Har fokus på muligheder og løsninger
  • Trives med at arbejde såvel selvstændigt som i teams
  • Har lyst til læring og udvikling, og evner at implementere viden og nye tiltag i daglig praksis

Faglige Kvalifikationer

Vi søger en kollega, der

  • har fokus på høj faglighed, og aktivt bidrager til et godt og udviklende arbejdsmiljø.
  • har indsigt i og erfaring med rehabiliterende sygepleje
  • er fagligt velfunderet – og meget gerne med erfaring ift. rehabilitering og multisygdomme
  • har et godt overblik og forstår at planlægge og prioritere
  • dokumenterer præcist og effektivt
  • formår at bevare energi og overblik i løsning af opgaver
  • formår at udføre forflytninger og lejringer med tilgængelige hjælpemidler

Vi tilbyder dig:

  • Individuelt tilrettelagt introduktion og oplæring
  • Meningsfyldte opgaver på højt specialiseret niveau
  • Dygtige, hjælpsomme og engagerede kolleger
  • En dynamisk organisation, hvor patienterne og deres behov er i centrum, og hvor tilbuddene konstant udvikles i sammenhæng med det øvrige sundhedsvæsen
  • Fokus på værdier som håb, anerkendelse, høj faglighed, kvalitet, ordentlighed og effektivitet

Mødetider

Der er i nuværende rul 11 nattevagter og 3 aftenvagter pr. måned. Der er på nuværende tidspunkt 1 weekends arbejde hver 4. uge.

Lukkeperioder:

Fri i jul og nytår, til påske og en lukkeperiode om sommeren

Hospitalerne følger overenskomst mellem Danske Regioner og FOA

Ansøgningsfrist; Torsdag d. 20.8.26 kl. 12.

Ansættelsessamtaler finder sted på Sclerosehospitalet d. 24.8.26

For yderligere oplysninger kan du kontakte rehabiliteringsleder Elise Brink Vestergaard på telefon 78412511.

Om Sclerosehospitalerne

Sclerosehospitalerne er foreningsejede specialsygehuse efter Sundhedslovens § 79 og har driftsoverenskomst med Region Midtjylland.

Hospitalet i Haslev har ca. 85 medarbejdere og kapacitet til 46 indlagte patienter, hospitalet i Ry har ca. 70 medarbejdere og kapacitet til 36 indlagte patienter. Medarbejderne er sygeplejersker, social- og sundhedsassistenter, social- og sundhedshjælpere, ergoterapeuter, diætister, ernæringsterapeuter, fysioterapeuter, neurologer, neuropsykologer, psykologer samt medarbejdere i Service og Administration.

Læs mere på Sclerosehospitalerne.dk


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

title: Graduate Quant Researcher 2027 - Chicago
description:
Graduate Quant Researcher Program Chicago 2027

Maven Securities is a leading proprietary trading firm that leverages sophisticated technology and quantitative analysis to trade in global financial markets. We specialize in options and derivatives market making, where your skills can be directly applied to have a real impact.

At Maven, we believe exceptional careers are built deliberately. Our graduate program is designed for a small number of high-potential individuals each year, combining comprehensive training, real responsibility, and long-term development. We don’t hire large classes with the expectation that only a few will succeed, we invest in every individual who joins the team.

Program details:

  • Location: Chicago (based in London for training period)
  • Program start date: September 6th, 2027
  • Application deadline: Rolling basis

Base salary: $150,000-175,000 dependent on education and experience

You’ll begin with a structured 7-week training program in London, designed to prepare you for a career in quantitative research. This initial phase focuses on building the technical foundations and professional skills needed for the role, as well as forming crucial working relationships with your UK counterparts - both on the Graduate Program and more senior stakeholders.

Following training, you’ll return to Chicago and roll onto two project rotations, where you’ll continue to learn through hands-on experience. Maven offers a few days of leave to support this transition, as well as travel, accommodation and relocation support.

What you will be doing:

  • Design, evaluate and continuously improve our automated trading algorithms
  • Build quantitative pricing models, for example American Option Pricing and Volatility Modeling
  • Research and analyze trading data to find and test trading opportunities

How and what you will learn:

  • Progress through a structured onboarding program with clear learning milestones
  • Build your foundation through theory and exercise-led training, led by Maven’s Head of Technology Training & Graduates
  • Learn about financial markets, our platforms and specific quant research field for OMM, apply your academic research abilities and learn how to perform research on real-world data of varied volume and sampling frequency across a variety of domains
  • We will teach you how to use and master Maven’s in-house tools and systems. Maven utilizes the latest technology in order to meet and exceed our demanding business challenges
  • Attend regular check-ins with the Quant Researcher and Emerging Talent teams

Who you are:

Key criteria:

  • A Bachelor’s, Master’s or PhD student in applied mathematics, statistics, engineering or physics
  • Relevant programming experience in at least one language (Python, C++, C#)
  • Proactive interest in improving existing trading strategies and identifying new opportunities
  • Motivated for quantitative research, financial services and trading, with knowledge of financial markets
  • A willingness to adopt and utilise emerging AI technologies

We’re looking for someone who is:

  • An entrepreneurial thinker with the ability to generate ideas, take initiative and drive innovation
  • A critical problem solver and decision maker who can analyze situations, think clearly and make effective decisions
  • An agile learner who is able to quickly acquire knowledge, take on feedback, adapt and apply insights across different contexts
  • Able to synthesize information, resolve conflicting inputs, see the bigger picture, and translate complex information into actionable recommendations
  • Collaborative and influential, able to build trust, work effectively with others and positively impact the team
  • Results-focused and accountable, taking ownership and delivering outcomes reliably

Why Maven?:

  • Dedicated In-House Trainers: Gain the tools to succeed in a rapidly evolving market, where AI is integral to our strategy and daily operations. Our tailored curriculums are led by in-house experts and cover both technical and professional skills, as well as guidance on how to adopt AI best practices
  • Accelerate Your Career: Every permanent colleague receives a dedicated learning and development budget, full access to our online learning platform, and frequent training sessions led by our Maven experts
  • Proven Pathways: Benefit from our structured pipeline programs that set you up for long-term success. Around a quarter of Maven’s workforce joined through an Emerging Talent Program, with many staying from Spring Week through the Graduate Program and beyond
  • Supported to Succeed: We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can perform at your best. We offer recruitment support where needed, and employee resource groups that help build community across the firm
  • Grow with Guidance: Enjoy regular feedback, structured review points, and informal off-desk chats. Everyone in our Emerging Talent Programs is also paired with a Maven buddy for practical advice and day-to-day support
  • Make a Real Impact, Fast: From the start of the projects, you’ll be embedded in the team and learn directly from other Quant Researchers. After this, you’ll transition onto a permanent position within the team, where you’ll continue building upon the skills taught in the program

Please note:

  • We accept one application per candidate, per recruitment cycle
  • Visa sponsorship is available for selected roles, please see our FAQ page for details

Maven is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Benefits at Maven

As a graduate joining Maven, you’ll be eligible for a range of benefits, including:

  • 25 days of PTO plus US national holidays, which we encourage you to take
  • Private medical and dental cover, eye care support, life assurance, 401k or Roth retirement plans, and an Employee Assistance Program
  • Consideration for a discretionary annual bonus
  • An annual learning and development budget, alongside wider training and development opportunities
  • Wellness benefits, including free use of the building gym and access to ClassPass
  • Frequent social events, from welcome dinners and summer parties to company sports leagues and boat tours!
  • Daily breakfast in the office and a lunch allowance, plus snacks and drinks throughout the day
  • Enhanced family-friendly policies, including maternity, paternity, adoption, fertility and partner’s leave
  • Work in a forward-thinking environment where AI is integral to our strategy and daily operations

title: Security Specialist - Program Protection Lead

  • Prepare patients for radiologic procedures. Escort patients to dressing and x-ray rooms, provide verbal and/or written instructions and assist patients in positioning body parts to be radiographed. Explain procedures and observe patients to ensure patient care, safety and comfort during the x-ray exam
  • Operate radiologic equipment to produce images of the body for diagnostic purposes. Position radiologic equipment and adjust controls to set exposure time and distance according to specification of examination. Take x-rays following established radiologic requirements and regulations to ensure patient care and safety

  • Follow HIPAA guidelines and safety rules
  • Attend center staff meetings or huddles as required
  • Assist in maintaining a neat, clean, and orderly appearance throughout the facility
  • Complete any applicable training including but not limited to clinical competency training that occurs monthly.

title: R&D Project Lead
description:
DESOTEC is an international environmental services company helping to protect the planet with sustainable mobile filtration solutions for liquids and gases.
We have approximately 450 employees, united in Generation D, who are all committed to protecting the planet by promoting positive ecological changes across all sectors. Since 2026, DESOTEC has been part of EQT, an international Swedish investment group.
As an R&D Project Lead, you will play a key role in innovative projects that have a direct impact on our products, internal processes, customers, and strategy. Thanks to the wide variety of projects, you will have the opportunity to turn ideas into practical applications with a tangible environmental impact.
  • You develop and improve products
    You work on the development and validation of sustainable, high-performance solutions for a wide range of environmental challenges. This includes applications such as biogas purification, PFAS and VOC removal, odor control, soil remediation, and wastewater treatment.


  • You translate ideas into R&D strategies
    Together with your colleagues, you transform innovative ideas into tangible R&D projects that contribute to DESOTEC’s growth and sustainability ambitions.


  • You manage and coordinate impactful R&D projects
    You take ownership of R&D projects from concept to implementation. You create clear project plans, monitor priorities, deadlines, and milestones, and proactively identify technical risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks. As the central point of contact, you collaborate with the R&D team, colleagues from other departments, and external partners to successfully deliver projects that support DESOTEC’s objectives.


  • You connect R&D with the wider organization
    You ensure that research projects are aligned with the broader business strategy and communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders. You translate complex technical insights into clear, relevant information tailored to your audience. Rather than waiting for input, you proactively engage stakeholders and bring the right people together to drive projects forward.


  • You represent DESOTEC as a subject matter expert
    You help showcase DESOTEC’s expertise through presentations, customer visits, webinars, and technical information sheets. Together with your team, you share knowledge, inspire stakeholders, and contribute to building strong relationships with customers and partners.


  • You stay up to date with technological trends
    You are curious about emerging and competing technologies and continuously assess their relevance and potential applications for our business.

You are a driven professional with a passion for innovation and environmental technology. You combine strong analytical skills with a structured approach and enjoy taking ownership of your work. Through clear communication and natural leadership, you are able to engage colleagues, stakeholders, and partners in complex projects and innovative ideas.
  • You hold a Master’s degree in a scientific or technical field and have at least 3–5 years of relevant experience in R&D, innovation projects, or environmental technology.
  • Experience in environmental technology, water or air treatment, adsorption technology, analytical chemistry, or a related technical field is considered a strong asset.
  • You are fluent in Dutch and English; additional languages are a plus.
  • You combine a hands-on mentality with a strong eagerness to learn and a natural curiosity.
  • You take initiative, bring structure to your work, and are comfortable taking responsibility.
  • You thrive in a coordinating role and collaborate effectively with colleagues, stakeholders, and external partners.
  • You have strong analytical skills while keeping the practical, operational, and economic impact of your decisions in mind.
  • You are highly data-driven and comfortable working with data. You can extract valuable insights from research results and datasets and translate them into well-founded recommendations. Strong proficiency in Excel is essential.
  • You are willing to travel occasionally within Europe (approximately once every 2–3 months) for conferences, customer visits, and meetings with research and technology partners.

It goes without saying that you get a lot in return in exchange for your unbridled dedication and enthusiasm:

  • A competitive salary – We guarantee you a competitive base salary, depending on your experience.

  • Fringe benefits – To optimize your salary package, you can count on a smartphone with a mobile subscription, a generous net expense reimbursement, meal vouchers, group and hospitalization insurance (AG Insurance), a non-recurrent CAO90 bonus, two annual gross bonuses.

  • Flex Income Plan – You can convert part of your end-of-year bonus into benefits that suit your lifestyle, such as extra leave, multimedia, or a lease bike. This gives you the freedom to take control of your reward package and personalize it in a way that truly works for you, all within the applicable legal framework.

  • Work-life-balance / hybrid working – You work during flexible hours.

  • Time off to schedule freely – At DESOTEC there is no collective closure. You enjoy 29 paid vacation days and have the freedom to take 10 unpaid vacation days on top of that. This way you can increase your number of vacation days to 39 days!

  • Personal & professional growth – You will have every opportunity to immerse yourself in your new role, but also to grow personally and professionally through an extensive range of training courses.

  • Stay active & social – As an employee with a permanent contract, you can enjoy one free group sport lesson/activity per week at the Vision 21 gym in Roeselare, including activities like boxing, pilates, spinning, padel and more.

  • Discounts through partnerships – Through Benefits at Work you get discounts at Center Parcs, Zalando, bol.com, Krëfel, Decathlon and many more.

  • Fun and relaxation – You will regularly be invited to one of the many afterworks and other fun activities. Each team also gets a team building budget – it's up to you how you spend it!

  • Structured onboarding – We prepare a tailored onboarding plan for every new starter, ensuring a smooth integration into your team, tools, and DESOTEC’s mission from day one.

title: Software Engineer - Backend (Product Intelligence)
description:
About the role

The Product Intelligence Platform is an AI-driven system that transforms how Tesco handles product data at scale. The platform leverages multi-agent AI systems to automate product categorization, enrichment, and matching across a vast number of products on a weekly basis. Built on event-driven architecture using Kafka, the platform processes millions of events monthly through core AI capabilities. A Software Engineer in this team will help build and maintain these AI-powered capabilities using Java/Spring Boot and Python, develop scalable event-driven microservices on Azure Kubernetes Service, and work with LLMs to solve product intelligence challenges. The role suits someone who enjoys connecting AI technology, engineering, and practical business needs, and who wants to grow while contributing to a platform that impacts millions of customer interactions weekly.

What is in it for you

Hybrid working

We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about different flexible working options. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.

This role requires you to be based in or near Kraków, as you will spend 60% (3 days) of your week collaborating with colleagues at our office locations or local sites and the rest remotely.

Our benefits

Tesco is a diverse and exciting employer, dedicated to being #aplacetogeton, providing career-defining opportunities to all of our colleagues. If you choose to join our business, we will provide you with:

  • Up to 20% yearly salary bonus – based on both individual and business performance
  • Permanent contract from the go – as a sign of our trust in your abilities
  • Tax-deductible expenses (IP)
  • Private healthcare (LuxMed)
  • Cafeteria & Multisport
  • Additional 4 days of paid leave to support your well-being and family life
  • Increase in annual leave (from 20 to 25 days) for those not yet eligible for the full holiday entitlement
  • Learning opportunities – certified technical training and a learning platform (Udemy)
  • Back-to-school day – 1 day off for parents of primary school children
  • Fertility leave – up to 2 weeks of paid leave for IVF treatment
  • Sports activities with a personal trainer in the office
  • Referral bonus
  • MacBook as your work tool

If that sounds exciting, then we'd love to hear from you.

About us

Our culture

Our colleagues work with one goal in mind, helping to make every day a little better for our customers, colleagues and communities all over the world. No two customers are the same, neither are our colleagues.

At Tesco, we champion a balance that lets you thrive both in and out of work. Spend 60% of your week collaborating with colleagues at our office locations or local sites and the rest remotely. Whether you're just kicking off your career, juggling passions, or navigating big life events, we're here to support you.

Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. As a Disability Confident Employer, we’re committed to providing a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require.

What our colleagues like the most at Tesco:
  • We develop our own products
  • We make an impact; large scale of operation
  • Accountability and respect are given to us
  • We cooperate and support each other
  • There are great colleagues who are divided into small teams here
  • We can develop and learn new things
Mandatory Skills:
  • Solid experience with Java and Spring Boot for building enterprise-grade applications.
  • Basic knowledge of Python.
  • Good understanding of event-driven architectures and Apache Kafka.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes for container orchestration.
  • Working knowledge of databases, including PostgreSQL and NoSQL solutions.
  • Experience with RESTful API design and microservices architecture.
  • Understanding of software engineering best practices, including CI/CD, testing, and code review.
  • Comfort working with distributed systems.
Nice-to-Have Skills:
  • Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and prompt engineering.
  • Knowledge of vector databases and embedding technologies like PGVector.
  • Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and computer vision.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
  • Knowledge of the retail or e-commerce domain.
  • Experience with Couchbase or similar NoSQL databases.
  • Understanding of data quality and governance principles.
  • Previous experience building AI-powered applications.
  • Experience working with multi-agent systems

Unsure if you fit all the criteria? Apply and give us the chance to evaluate your potential – you could be the perfect fit!

title: Junior Digital Strategist_Internship
description:
Who We Are

VML, part of WPP, is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and human first, award-winning work for blue chip client partners including AstraZeneca, Colgate-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca-Cola Company, and Wendy's. WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit .

VML Health is a global leader in healthcare communications. Our mission is to create groundbreaking experiences that not only inform but truly transform and improve people's lives. Through a unique synergy of deep scientific expertise and cutting-edge creative solutions, we deliver impactful campaigns for leading pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare players worldwide. We believe that creativity is the driving force for generating significant change in the world of health.

THE ROLE

VML Health is looking for a Junior Digital Strategy Intern to join our team.

This internship is designed as a learning journey where you will work alongside senior digital strategist to understand how data, channel dynamics, and digital ecosystems come together to build impactful healthcare communication strategies.

If you have a strong passion for digital innovation, eagerness to learn, and an interest in understanding the full customer journey—from web and social media to CRM and live events—this role will offer you hands-on experience in a top-tier global agency environment.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Learn project management fundamentals by working closely with creative, medical, and technical teams, as well as external suppliers.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Educational Background: Degree (or ongoing Master’s) in Marketing, Digital Communication or a related field.
  • Passion for Digital: A genuine curiosity about digital marketing channels, omnichannel trends, and emerging technologies.
  • Analytical Mindset: Basic understanding of digital metrics and a desire to learn how to translate data into strategic insights.
  • Communication Skills: Good presentation skills and proficiency in building clear presentation decks (PowerPoint/Keynote).
  • Languages: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required, as you will work in an international environment.
  • Personal Attributes: Ambition, energy, curiosity, and an eager-to-learn, proactive attitude.

That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. title: Security Program Manager
description:
Want to learn more about The Scion Group? Check out our website.

We're hiring immediately!

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.

Scion is paving a path in student living and we are seeking a Security Program Manager to join us in executing our vision.

The Security Program Manager is responsible for the administration, implementation, and continuous improvement of security programs across Scion's national portfolio. Working under the strategic direction of the Corporate Director, Community Security, this position serves as the primary coordinator for enterprise security initiatives, operational compliance, vendor performance, incident tracking, program analytics, training administration, and security technology deployment.

This role transforms strategy into action by ensuring security programs are consistently executed, measured, documented, and improved across all communities. The Security Program Manager serves as an integrator of the Community Security Department and a trusted resource to property teams nationwide.

This position is office-based in Chicago.

Essential Responsibilities

Security Program Administration

  • Manage day-to-day administration of enterprise security programs and initiatives.
  • Integrate new security standards, policies, and procedures across the portfolio.
  • Maintain department documentation, program records, and compliance tracking systems.
  • Monitor program effectiveness and recommend operational improvements.

Incident Review & Case Management

  • Conduct preliminary reviews of incident reports and identify trends requiring attention.
  • Coordinate follow-up actions and corrective measures with property teams.
  • Develop incident summaries, executive dashboards, and trend analyses.
  • Support after-action reviews and lessons-learned processes following major incidents.

Vendor & Contract Management

  • Monitor vendor performance, service delivery, and compliance with contract requirements.
  • Track service levels, incident reporting quality, and operational expectations.
  • Coordinate vendor onboarding, training requirements, and performance evaluations.

Security Technology Management

  • Serve as department lead for security technology implementation and maintenance coordination.
  • Track deployment and effectiveness of surveillance systems, access control technologies, AI monitoring solutions, and security software platforms.
  • Coordinate technology pilots and enterprise rollouts.
  • Support evaluation of emerging technologies that improve resident safety and operational efficiency.

Training & Program Development

  • Develop operational guides, toolkits, and educational materials for property teams.
  • Support onboarding of new General Managers regarding security programs and expectations.
  • Assist with resident safety campaigns and awareness initiatives.

Data Analytics & Reporting

  • Collect, analyze, and interpret security-related data across the portfolio.
  • Develop quarterly security performance reports.
  • Track crime trends, incident metrics, program utilization, and operational performance indicators.
  • Maintain dashboards and visual reporting tools.
  • Provide actionable recommendations based on data analysis.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Property Operations, Facilities, Risk Management, Human Resources, and Legal teams to support security initiatives.
  • Provide operational support to Regional Managers and General Managers.
  • Serve as a resource for security-related questions and program implementation.
  • Support enterprise projects involving resident safety, crisis preparedness, and operational risk reduction.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, Security Management, Emergency Management, Public Administration, Business Administration, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in corporate security, law enforcement, emergency management, risk management, or program administration.
  • Experience managing multi-site programs, projects, or operations.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
  • Proficiency in data analysis, reporting tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience within student housing, multifamily housing, hospitality, higher education, or property management.
  • Experience managing third-party vendors or service providers.
  • Familiarity with physical security systems, access control, video surveillance, and incident management platforms.
  • Professional certifications such as CPP, PSP, CFE, PMP, or FEMA Incident Management credentials.

Your Benefits

  • FLSA Status Exempt
  • Discretionary annual bonus
  • Paid Time Off + Floating Holidays
  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • 401k Matching

title: Senior UI/UX Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer based in Brazil.

This role offers the opportunity to shape engaging digital experiences by improving product usability, visual consistency, and user satisfaction.
You will work on redesign initiatives and feature enhancements for a modern application environment.
The position requires a strong understanding of user-centered design, design systems, and scalable interface solutions.
Collaborating with product and technical teams, you will transform ideas and requirements into intuitive experiences.
You will contribute to refining existing workflows, improving user journeys, and maintaining high design standards.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced designer who thrives in fast-moving, remote, and collaborative environments.

Accountabilities:

The Senior UI/UX Designer will be responsible for enhancing product experiences through thoughtful design, research, and collaboration. The role focuses on improving existing features, maintaining design consistency, and delivering user-friendly interfaces within an established product ecosystem.

  • Quickly understand existing product workflows, user needs, and current design structures.
  • Redesign and enhance existing features to improve usability, accessibility, and overall user experience.
  • Translate product concepts, requirements, and business goals into clear and scalable UI/UX solutions.
  • Create high-quality interface designs while following established design systems and component libraries.
  • Ensure consistency in layouts, spacing, visual hierarchy, and interaction patterns.
  • Collaborate with product managers, developers, and stakeholders throughout the design process.
  • Participate in design reviews, discussions, and feedback sessions to refine solutions.
  • Maintain accurate design documentation, updates, and decision records.
  • Support continuous improvement of the product experience through user-focused design practices.
  • Work effectively within a remote environment using collaboration and project management tools.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate has strong experience in product design, a deep understanding of UI/UX principles, and the ability to quickly adapt to existing products and design systems. They should be comfortable collaborating with distributed teams and delivering high-quality designs under tight timelines.

    • Minimum 5 years of experience in UI/UX or product design roles.
    • Proven experience designing and improving applications built with Bubble or similar platforms.
    • Strong proficiency in design tools such as Figma and Adobe XD.
    • Solid understanding of UI/UX principles, user flows, layouts, and interaction design.
    • Experience working with design systems, reusable components, and structured design libraries.
    • Ability to quickly understand complex product requirements and existing workflows.
    • Strong attention to detail with a focus on polished, consistent user experiences.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in remote team environments.
    • Experience documenting design decisions and project outcomes.
    • Familiarity with no-code/low-code platforms beyond Bubble is a plus.
    • Understanding of product management workflows and agile development processes is preferred.
    • Previous experience working with startups or fast-paced technology teams is an advantage.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote work opportunity.
      • Flexible contract engagement with an international team.
      • Opportunity to contribute to meaningful product improvements and redesign projects.
      • Collaboration with cross-functional product and engineering professionals.
      • Exposure to modern UI/UX practices, design systems, and no-code application environments.
      • Opportunity to showcase expertise in a fast-paced digital product environment.

title: Relationsstærk pædagog til specialklasserne på Østervangsskolen
description:
Vi står og mangler en ny kollega til vores indskoling (0.-3. klasse) – måske er det dig, vi mangler?

Din hverdag vil bestå af timer i både SFO og skoledelen. Det vil sige at dine arbejdstider vil spænde mellem morgenåbner kl. 06.30 og eftermiddagsluk kl. 17.00. Hovedparten af timerne vil i kommende skoleår være i skoledelen.

På ØST tager vi udgangspunkt i den enkelte elev og gør os umage for at skabe en hverdag med struktur, tryghed og overblik.
Vi er et team, der tør stille spørgsmål, deler erfaringer, sparrer fagligt – og ikke mindst griner sammen undervejs.

Du vil i kommende skoleår indgå i et team i indskolingen sammen med yderligere 4 kollegaer hvor I, i fællesskab skaber rammerne for to dejlige klasser.

Vi ønsker en kollega, der rummer og favner de udfordringer som børnene har og heraf, i samarbejde med teamet, justerer hverdagen i indhold og form.

Hvem er vi
Østervangsskolen i Randers er et alment skoletilbud fra 0. til 6. klasse samt en specialafdeling fra 0. til 10. klasse. I alt vil du møde 75 engagerede kollegaer og ikke mindst 350 fantastiske, dejlige børn og unge.

Specialafdelingen på Østervangsskolen i Randers er et tilbud til børn og unge med forskellige funktionsnedsættelser af enten fysisk eller kognitiv karakter. I hverdagen betyder det et udvidet behov for struktur og hensyn til individuelle behov i et trivsels- og læringsperspektiv.

Afdelingen er normeret til 9 klasser med i alt 72 børn. Vi sammensætter børnene i klasserne ud fra klassetrin, funktionsniveau og specifikke udfordringer. I hverdagen arbejder vi ud fra en forudsætning om, at børnene skal blive livsduelige og have ligestillede muligheder i den tid, de er på skolen/afdelingen. Det betyder også, at vi arbejder med en målsætning om afgangsprøver for de børn, og i de fag, hvor det er en mulighed.

På ØST tror vi på og arbejder i forhold til ”Helhjertet Læring i Fællesskab”

Du kan læse mere på Østervangsskolens hjemmeside

Derudover vil du blive en aktiv medspiller i at fremme de øvrige værdier på skolen, herunder et fokus på at inddrage eleverne i deres egen læring gennem PBL (ProjektBaseret Læring)

Som pædagog i Østervangsskolens specialafdeling forventer vi, at du…
  • deltager ligeværdigt i teamsamarbejde og løfter den samlede opgave i flok
  • har øje for at se det bedste i eleven og er villig til at gå det ekstra skridt for eleven
  • er fleksibel og villig til at justere din didaktiske og pædagogiske praksis, når der er behov for det - Hav en plan B, når plan A fejler
  • har troen på, at et tæt forældresamarbejde er vigtigt for elevens trivsel og læring
  • kan reflektere over egen og andres pædagogiske praksis og indgår i sparring omkring dette
  • i samarbejde med teamet afprøver relevante pædagogiske tilgange for at sikre trivsel og udvikling
  • kan forholde dig roligt i konfliktsituationer og ser bag om adfærd for at være nysgerrig på årsag
  • har gode kommunikations- og relationskompetencer, der gør dig i stand til at indgå i samarbejde med elever, forældre, kollegaer og ledelse

Derfor skal du vælge os
  • Du får mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel for børn og unge med særlige behov
  • Vi arbejder målrettet med relationspædagogik, struktur og forudsigelighed i hverdagen
  • Du bliver en del af et engageret og tværfagligt team med høj faglighed og stærkt kollegialt sammenhold
  • Vi prioriterer faglig sparring, supervision og kompetenceudvikling
  • Du får indflydelse på planlægning og pædagogiske tiltag, i tæt samarbejde med kollegaer og ledelse
  • Vi tilbyder et rummeligt arbejdsmiljø med humor, hjerte og ambitioner om høj faglighed
  • Skolen har fokus på trivsel – både for elever og ansatte
  • Du bliver en del af en afdeling i udvikling, hvor vi sammen skaber de bedste rammer for elevernes læring og livsduelighed

Specialafdelingen ser i dette skoleår ind i flere spændende opgaver. Skoleåret starter blandt andet ud med et fælles kursus. Vi arbejder i fællesskab for at skabe det fundament, specialafdelingen skal stå på i fremtiden. Dette med udgangspunkt i den pædagogiske praksis i og udenfor klasserummet. Et projekt, alle medarbejdere kommer til at deltage i, med forventning om, at alle bidrager til den fælles fremtid.

Yderligere oplysninger
Er du interesseret i stillingen, kan du kontakte
afdelingsleder Allan Kirkegaard (mail allan.kirkegaard1@randers.dk / telefon 21 44 01 17) eller skoleleder Peter Nellemann (mail peter.nellemann@randers.dk / telefon 89 15 44 40) for nærmere oplysninger.

title: Frederikshavn Forsyning A/S søger weekendafløser til Genbrugspladsen i Ravnshøj
description:
Der er tale om en stilling på 7 timer hver anden weekend. Arbejdstiden vil være mellem kl. 08.30 – 15.30 med mulighed for yderligere timer ved tilkald.

Vil du være med i teamet af medarbejdere, som vejleder borgere på genbrugspladserne i Frederikshavn Kommune, så har du mulighed for at søge stillingen som weekendafløser til vores genbrugsplads i Ravnshøj.

Du bliver vores ansigt udadtil. Du servicerer borgere og virksomheder og er med til at sikre driften på vores genbrugspladser. Derudover rådgiver og vejleder du i at sortere affald – på den måde opnår vi de bedst mulige sorteringer, og at så meget som muligt bliver genanvendt.

Kvalifikationer og kompetencer
Stillingen ønskes besat af en medarbejder, der er udadvendt, opsøgende og servicemindet og som også i travle situationer evner at bevare roen.

Det er en fordel, hvis du

  • har gode samarbejdsevner og er fleksibel
  • har ordenssans og kan gøre brug af dine hænder
  • trives med udendørs arbejde
  • har kendskab til it på brugerniveau.

Kørekort til kategori B er et krav.

Løn - og ansættelsesforhold
Der er tale om en afløserstilling på timeløn. Løn - og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til gældende overenskomst. I forbindelse med ansættelsen skal du kunne fremvise en ren straffeattest.

Nærmere oplysninger fås ved henvendelse til
Driftsleder Lise Brunø, mail: litb@forsyningen.dk eller tlf. 5163 2977.

Hvem er vi?
Frederikshavn Forsyning A/S er en multiforsyningskoncern, som består af 9 selskaber. Vi er ca. 240 medarbejdere og omsætter for ca. 650 mio. årligt. Du bliver ansat i Frederikshavn Affald A/S. Affaldsselskabet står for indsamling af affald og driver også kommunens genbrugspladser, miljøanlæg og forbrændingsanlæg.

Læs mere om Frederikshavn Forsyning A/S på www.forsyningen.dk

Din ansøgning
Skriv et par ord om dig selv og din tidligere beskæftigelse, og send os din ansøgning via knappen nederst på siden senest fredag den 28. august 2026.

title: Filling Line Operator I
description:
Overview

Company Overview

At Benjamin Moore, our success is attributable to the employees who dedicate their time and talents to the brand and exemplify our core values of openness, integrity, community, excellence, and safety. Benjamin Moore employees enjoy a competitive and well-rounded benefits package, career development options, business resource groups, and opportunities to come together and connect with colleagues. Join us and be part of a brand that inspires creativity, innovation, and passion while supporting locally owned stores in 65 countries.

Click here to see how you can paint your future!

Mon- Fri 2pm - 10:30pm

Reporting directly to the department Lead, this role will work seamlessly with the facility team and all departments to monitor the filling line and perform quality checks on all products. Additionally, the Filling Line Operator utilizes equipment, ensuring the filling line is running correctly.

Responsibilities

Monitor incoming quality of containers; monitor container supply area by each line to ensure adequate quantity for uninterrupted filling line operation.

Automatic filling machine: Calibrate & properly operate filling machines; check batch ticket for correct product; monitor correct weights & quality appearance of containers (no drips); retain sample for control lab.

Lid dropper: Supplied with adequate amount of lids for uninterrupted operation of filling line; lids properly sealed on containers; lid information is legible and correct for product being filled.

Label machine: Ensure adequate quantity of correct labels and adhesive; monitor quality appearance of label and container.

Maintain proper operation and minor adjustment of bail-o-matic machine.

Case packer: Ensure adequate supply of cartons and tape for uninterrupted operation of filling line; verify carton information is legible and correct for product being filled.

Palletizer: Supply empty pallets to machine; offload full pallets as appropriate.

Responsible for accurate count of fill and input data into terminal for inventory control using electronic information systems.

Maintains forklift or other related equipment by checking battery, electrical hook-up, etc.

Follows all safety guidelines and rules; environmental and regulatory guidelines; uses all required safety equipment. Maintains quality and cleanliness of the work area and equipment.

Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

High School degree or equivalent required.

Basic math skills, ie: addition/subtraction

Ability to work in a team environment and work cross-functionally.

Excellent attention to detail, accuracy and cleanliness.

Ability to use company software and computer system programs.

Good interpersonal communication skills.

Ability to work safely and follow SOP’s

Ability to work overtime (up to 4 hours past regularly scheduled shift) and weekends when required.

Ability to operate fill by weight machine, video jet, labeler, palletizer, case packer, can and carton computer and depalletizer.

Ability to operate the tower independently

Ability to operate a gallon line and quart line independently

Ability to operate a gallon line casepacker and five line independently

Ability to operate a gallon line and operate a small batch

Environmental Factors and exposure throughout shift

Ability to use forklift, winch and trolley system

Running the filling line and packaging goods is most frequent activity (upwards of 8 hours per day)

title: Pædagog til Trekløverskolen, afdeling Sjørslev – 35 timer om ugen
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe en skole og et fritidstilbud, hvor alle børn oplever stærke fællesskaber, trivsel og udvikling?

Trekløverskolens afdeling Sjørslev søger en engageret pædagog til en stilling på 35 timer om ugen med tiltrædelse snarest muligt. Ønskes et lavere timetal, kan dette eventuelt aftales.

Stillingen er forankret i både skole og SFO, og du bliver en vigtig del af børnenes hverdag på tværs af undervisning og fritid. Du bliver en del af et stærkt og engageret team, der arbejder målrettet for at skabe trygge og udviklende rammer for alle børn.

I afdeling Sjørslev har vi fokus på nærhed, fællesskab og høj kvalitet i børnenes hverdag. Som en mindre afdeling tilbyder vi tætte relationer og stor indflydelse, samtidig med at vi er en del af Trekløverskolens fællesskab med afdelingerne i Kjellerup og Vinderslev.

Vi har særligt gode muligheder for at skabe aktive og varierede lærings- og fritidsmiljøer. Skolen er omgivet af gode udearealer og naturskønne omgivelser, som giver oplagte muligheder for outdoor-aktiviteter, leg og bevægelse. Samtidig har vi adgang til en idrætshal, der giver gode rammer for idræt, motorisk udvikling og aktive fællesskaber året rundt.

Vi ønsker, at både skole og SFO er steder, hvor børn får en god start på skolelivet, udvikler stærke kompetencer og skaber gode minder, som de kan bygge videre på.


Om stillingen

Vi søger en pædagog, som:

  • Bidrager til et attraktivt fritidstilbud med legende og udviklende aktiviteter.
  • Gerne arbejder med bevægelse, outdoor-aktiviteter og aktive fællesskaber.
  • Indgår i et tæt og professionelt samarbejde med lærere og pædagoger om at skabe en varieret, tryg og sammenhængende skoledag.
  • Understøtter inklusion og arbejder for, at alle børn oplever trivsel, deltagelse og læring.

Vi tilbyder
  • Stor indflydelse på udviklingen af både skole og SFO.
  • Mulighed for at omsætte egne idéer og initiativer til praksis.
  • En spændende koordinatorrolle i et tæt samarbejde med SFO-koordinatorerne fra Trekløverskolens øvrige afdelinger. Her er det mulighed for udvikling og koordinering af fælles aktiviteter på tværs af afdelingerne, planlægning af ferieaktiviteter, og gode børneoplevelser på tværs af matriklerne.
  • En central rolle som gennemgående og betydningsfuld voksen i børnenes hverdag.
  • En skole med knap 700 elever fordelt på tre matrikler, hvor du bliver tilknyttet afdeling Sjørslev med cirka 60 elever.
  • Gode fysiske rammer med adgang til natur, udeområder og idrætshal, som giver mulighed for at skabe spændende aktiviteter og læringsforløb med fokus på bevægelse, outdoor og fællesskab.
  • Dygtige og udviklingsorienterede kolleger, som brænder for at skabe de bedste rammer for børnene.

Vi søger dig, der
  • Er uddannet pædagog.
  • Har et stærkt ønske om at gøre en forskel for børn.
  • Er samarbejdsorienteret, initiativrig og kan arbejde selvstændigt.
  • Ser aktivitet som en naturlig vej til trivsel, læring og fællesskab.
  • Arbejder ud fra et inkluderende børnesyn.
  • Er tydelig, nærværende og en positiv rollemodel for børnene.
  • Er omstillingsparat og ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger.
  • Bidrager aktivt til fællesskabet og værdsætter det gode samarbejde med kolleger og forældre.

title: Revenue Enablement Program Manager - CONTRACTOR
description:
Azul is the Java company. We deliver JVM performance, security, modernization, and infrastructure solutions to many of the most demanding enterprises in the world, and our global revenue organization sells into a technically sophisticated buyer.

We have an interim need for an experienced Revenue Enablement Program Manager to lead day-to-day engagement with that revenue organization: onboarding new sellers, delivering our recurring enablement cadence, developing the content the field relies on, and maintaining the integrity of our enablement platform. This is a six-month contract role.

You will also design and build Sales Kickoff 2027 in partnership with our Revenue Enablement leader — shaping the agenda and working directly with session leaders to deliver our strongest event to date. The event takes place in February, following the close of this engagement, so the scope of this role is the design and the build rather than live delivery.

This is a hands-on execution role. Enablement strategy, measurement design, and executive enablement remain with the Revenue Enablement leader to whom this position reports. The accountability here is delivery: programs that run reliably, on schedule, and at a standard the field recognizes.

The role partners across Sales, Business Development, Channel, Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, Customer Success, Renewals, Product Marketing, Product, and Revenue Operations. Few positions at Azul offer comparable exposure across the business.

What You'll Do (aka Responsibilities)

Sales Kickoff 2027 — design and build

Sales Kickoff is the largest enablement program of our year. The February 2027 event follows the close of this engagement, which means this role owns the work that determines its success: the design and the build. Responsibilities will include:

  • Partner on agenda design — defining what the revenue organization must leave the event able to do, and structuring the week to achieve it
  • Work directly with session leaders and executive presenters to develop their content: solicit and refine speaker abstracts, guide sessions from outline to final, and maintain the quality standard
  • Manage the content development cycle across a large contributor group — deck standards, copy editing, version control, and rehearsal scheduling
  • Design the post-event reinforcement plan to sustain retention of the material
  • Execute a documented handoff of the complete program, critical path, and session-leader relationships prior to the close of the engagement

    • New hire onboarding

  • Develop role- and region-specific onboarding plans for incoming Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, and other revenue roles
  • Deliver the welcome communication, onboarding plan, and welcome kit, and enroll new hires in the appropriate standing meetings and channels
  • Conduct weekly touchpoints throughout a new hire’s first month — technology stack orientation, AI tooling setup, target account development, and our prospecting motion
  • Administer our sales methodology platform, including course assignment and MEDDPICC fundamentals
  • Report on onboarding progression and product certification completion

    • Recurring enablement cadence

  • Coordinate and host the monthly Sales All Hands — solicit agenda topics from leadership, assemble the presentation with contributor content, develop polling questions, produce the live sessions, and publish recordings
  • Coordinate and host Power Hours, a minimum of two per month — source topics with Product Marketing, Product, and Revenue Operations, develop content with subject matter experts, facilitate, and report on engagement
  • Own calendar management and virtual event production for both programs

    • Content development

  • Curate and maintain the onboarding curriculum
  • Develop new courses and assets, including sales plays, seasonal programs, and Power Hour curricula

    • Enablement platform governance

  • Publish assets to our sales content platform with accurate metadata, tagging, and expiration dates
  • Administer the asset review and expiration cycle to ensure the field accesses only current, approved content
  • Support the monthly governance cadence with our publisher community across Marketing and Product

    • AI enablement delivery

  • Deliver AI enablement to the revenue organization, including individual training on tooling, connectors, and workflow automation, under the direction of the Revenue Enablement leader
  • Distribute the weekly AI briefing and report on adoption

    • Reporting

  • Partner with our enablement analyst on engagement, onboarding, and program reporting
  • Translate reporting into actionable insight for revenue leadership

    • What You'll Bring (aka Skills, Experience, Education)

    Required

  • Five or more years in sales or revenue enablement, sales operations, or comparable program management within B2B technology
  • Demonstrated facilitation experience, including recurring sessions for audiences of fifty or more, with confidence presenting to a large virtual audience
  • Proven program execution discipline — recurring commitments delivered on schedule without oversight
  • Strong writing and process documentation capability. A writing sample will be requested
  • Cross-functional collaboration experience — a record of securing deliverables from stakeholders outside your reporting line and with competing priorities
  • Practical familiarity with AI tooling — experience applying an AI assistant to production work, with the ability to articulate what was built and the outcome achieved
  • Data literacy across spreadsheets, CRM reporting, and engagement analytics
  • Project management across concurrent workstreams

    • Preferred, and available to develop in role

    Candidates who demonstrate the capabilities above will be trained on the following. These are not screening criteria.

  • Sales content platform administration (Highspot, Seismic, Showpad, or comparable)
  • Learning management or sales methodology platform administration
  • Conversation intelligence tooling such as Gong
  • MEDDPICC or Command of the Message certification

  • Er i god fysisk form og psykisk robust
  • Er mødestabil og pligtopfyldende

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for udvikling i form af kurser og uddannelse

Praktiske oplysninger

Jobbet er fuld tid. Ansættelse pr. 1. oktober 2026 – og gerne tidligere, hvis muligt.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til gældende overenskomst samt principperne i Ny Løn. Vi indhenter straffeattester samt referencer fra tidligere ansættelser i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

Ansøgningsfristen er onsdag den 19. august 2026

Vi afholder samtaler tirsdag den 25. august.

Ansøgning, CV, uddannelsesbevis og evt. andre relevante dokumenter sendes elektronisk via kommunens rekrutteringssystem.

title: Telehealth Therapist (Independent Contractor)
description:

The program is designed for youth who need structured therapeutic support but do not require residential or inpatient care, helping them remain stable at home and successful in school.

Being a Therapist with Devereux has its Advantages

Devereux has a zero-tolerance policy for abuse and maintains policies and procedures to systematically reduce the risk of abuse to occur in our organization. Devereux fosters a culture of reporting abuse, and will cooperate with the authorities to the fullest extent possible.

For more information, please reach out us at flrecruitment@devereux.org.

Company Overview

Company Overview

Devereux is one of the nation’s largest nonprofit organizations, providing services, insight and leadership in the evolving field of behavioral healthcare. Founded in 1912, Devereux operates a comprehensive national network of clinical, therapeutic, educational and employment programs that positively impact the lives of 10,000+ children, adults – and their families – every year.

Our Mission: Devereux changes lives – by unlocking and nurturing human potential for people living with emotional, behavioral or cognitive differences.

With nearly 6,500 employees working in programs across the country, Devereux is a trusted partner for families, schools and communities, serving individuals in the areas of autism, intellectual and developmental disabilities, specialty mental health, education and foster care.

At Devereux, Servant Leadership is embedded throughout our culture and every aspect of our organizational framework. Our mission-driven, people-first mindset is at the heart of the compassionate and high-quality programming we provide – every day – for the individuals and families we serve, and other key stakeholders. Devereux offers challenging and exciting work, and our team environment creates an empowering, positive and rewarding atmosphere. To be successful at Devereux, you will: put the needs of others first, feel called to serve and called to lead. As a member of our team, you will be a significant part of our commitment to providing a welcoming and supportive work environment across all programs and services, and within all policies and employee practices.

We believe a workplace rooted in inclusivity – offering a sense of belonging to all those who walk through our doors – is fundamental to delivering the highest quality healthcare services. Through open dialogue and the creation of brave spaces, we will engage in work that gives each of us a chance to change the world – one person, one family, one community at a time.

What Devereux Offers You

In addition to a competitive salary, Devereux provides a comprehensive health and welfare program to eligible full-time employees, family members and domestic partners. Eligible employees are eligible to start benefits after 30 days of employment. In addition, we offer;

  • Medical (including telemedicine via phone, web, app), dental, prescription drug, preventative care, and mental health services.
  • Student loan debt assistance, tuition reimbursement and continuing education assistance.
  • Generous time-off (start accruing 1st day), 403(b) retirement plan with matching benefit, and voluntary/employee paid supplemental life and accident coverage.

Visit www.mydevereuxbenefits.org to see why Devereux is a great place to work!

Devereux is a drug-free workplace, drug screening required. EOE

title: financieel administratief medewerker
description:
Ben jij een administratief talent met oog voor detail? Werk je graag in een prettige en professionele omgeving? Bij Omnyacc in Heerhugowaard zoeken we een enthousiaste collega die met precisie en teamspirit ons team komt versterken. Een mooie kans om je administratieve vaardigheden in te zetten en verder te ontwikkelen binnen een hecht team!

IN JOUW KRACHT MET OMNYACC

Als financieel administratief medewerker ondersteun je onze accountants en financiële professionals bij het voeren en optimaliseren van administraties. Je zorgt ervoor dat financiële processen soepel verlopen en administraties correct, tijdig en volgens wet- en regelgeving zijn ingericht en verwerkt. Je hebt veel contact met klanten en fungeert als aanspreekpunt, waarbij je meedenkt en kansen voor verbetering signaleert.

Je werkt operationeel, maar met een duidelijke eigen verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte om zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen.

JOUW FUNCTIE

In deze rol houd jij je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het opstarten en inrichten van financiële administraties.

  • Het verwerken van administraties.

  • Het voorbereiden en uitvoeren van controles ten behoeve van de jaarafsluiting.

  • Het verzorgen van aangiften omzetbelasting en ICP.

  • Het opstellen van periodieke rapportages.

  • Het signaleren en doorvoeren van verbeteringen in administratieve processen.

  • Het fungeren als eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten.

  • Het samenwerken met accountants en andere financiële specialisten.

WAT BIEDEN WIJ?

Bij Omnyacc krijg je de ruimte om te groeien, jezelf te ontwikkelen en samen met fijne collega’s iedere dag het beste uit jezelf te halen. We creëren een omgeving waarin werkplezier, ontwikkeling en balans centraal staan.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten:

Werken met plezier

  • Een moderne werkplek met thuiswerkmogelijkheden.

  • Hecht, betrokken team waar samenwerken en plezier hand in hand gaan.

  • Actieve personeelsvereniging met leuke uitjes en gezellige borrels.

Groei & ontwikkeling

  • Duidelijke loopbaanpaden en volop kansen om door te groeien.

  • Omnyacc Academy: biedt volop mogelijkheden om jezelf in iedere fase van je loopbaan te blijven ontwikkelen.

  • Wissel kennis en ervaring uit met collega’s in onze 8 vestigingen.

  • Afwisselend werk door contact met diverse klanten en dossiers.

Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Een salaris passend bij jouw ervaring (€2.950 - €3.500,- o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband).

  • Flexibele werktijden.

  • Aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling en een individueel keuzebudget.

  • Maandelijkse internet- en telefoonvergoeding of mobiel abonnement met BYOD-vergoeding.

  • Vitaliteit op één: vers fruit, dagelijkse lunchwandeling en aandacht voor jouw werk-privébalans.

  • Gezelligheid naast je werk, met een dagelijkse verzorgde lunch, teambuildingactiviteiten en een vrijdagmiddagborrel

JOUW INBRENG

Jij brengt het volgende mee:

  • Een afgeronde MBO 4 opleiding in financiële richting.

  • Minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring in een financiële administratieve functie.

  • Inhoudelijke kennis van relevante wet- en regelgeving.

  • Ervaring met boekhoudprogramma’s en digitale administraties.

  • Goede digitale vaardigheden en affiniteit met data.

  • Ervaring met Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word en Outlook).

  • Kennis van Exact Online is een pré.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

  • Weerbaarheid en een professioneel kritische instelling in klantcontact.

  • Zelfstandigheid en een gestructureerde manier van werken.

STA STERK BIJ OMNYACC

Sinds begin 2022 zijn wij met vestiging Heerhugowaard gevestigd aan de W.M. Dudokweg 70a. Een moderne locatie waar je de energie van een hecht team direct voelt. Met ruim 40 collega’s combineren we vakkennis en betrokkenheid. Onze kracht? Ondernemers écht verder helpen door breder te kijken dan alleen cijfers. Loop je bij ons binnen voor belastingadvies, dan denken onze accountants, HR-specialisten en andere collega’s net zo goed mee. Die integrale aanpak zorgt voor vertrouwen bij onze klanten én onderling. Je werkt samen in een professionele omgeving waar je de ruimte krijgt om te groeien én waar er oog is voor elkaar. Ontmoet Wietze, Ralf en Simon, die het kantoor leiden met een open deur en scherpe blik. Zin om onderdeel te worden van dit team?

Bij Omnyacc maken wij ons elke dag sterk voor onze klanten. Wij durven te stellen dat we met 8 vestigingen en 300 specialisten op praktisch alle ondernemersvragen antwoord kunnen geven. Naast onze accountants en belastingadviseurs hebben wij HRM-adviseurs, financieringsspecialisten, estate planners, pensioenadviseurs, fusie- en overnameadviseurs en arbodienstverleners in ons team. En dat allemaal onder één dak bij onze lokale kantoren.

Sinds kort is Omnyacc aangesloten bij PIA Group. Deze samenwerking stelt ons in staat om verder te bouwen aan onze kwaliteit, continuïteit en specialisatie, terwijl we onze lokale betrokkenheid en persoonlijke werkwijze behouden. Voor jou betekent dit werken in een organisatie met sterke groeikansen, kennisdeling op hoog niveau en volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling.

title: Project Manager - Restoration
location: New Hampton, New York, United States
description:
We are seeking an experienced Restoration Project Manager to oversee residential and commercial property restoration projects from initial loss assessment through reconstruction and final closeout. This position is responsible for coordinating mitigation, repairs, field operations, subcontractors, schedules, budgets, documentation, and customer communication throughout the entire project lifecycle.

The ideal candidate has direct experience managing water, fire, storm, or other property damage restoration projects and understands the unique requirements of insurance-related restoration work. This role is well suited for a hands-on project manager who can independently manage multiple active jobs while maintaining strong communication with property owners, insurance representatives, field crews, and subcontractors.

Responsibilities

  • Manage residential and commercial restoration projects from initial inspection and scope development through final completion.
  • Coordinate mitigation, demolition, reconstruction, repairs, and other restoration activities across multiple active job sites.
  • Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, scopes of work, and completion timelines.
  • Schedule and oversee field crews, subcontractors, vendors, inspections, and material deliveries.
  • Review project scopes, estimates, contracts, budgets, and supporting documentation.
  • Communicate regularly with property owners, insurance representatives, adjusters, subcontractors, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Monitor jobsite progress, workmanship, schedules, and costs to ensure projects remain on track.
  • Identify and resolve field issues, scheduling conflicts, scope changes, and other project challenges.
  • Prepare and manage change orders, project updates, progress photos, and job documentation.
  • Assist with estimating, insurance supplements, invoicing, collections, and project closeout as needed.
  • Ensure project documentation is complete, accurate, and maintained throughout each job.
  • Ensure work complies with applicable safety requirements, project specifications, building standards, and restoration industry best practices.
  • Conduct regular site visits to monitor progress, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction.
  • Deliver a positive customer experience through proactive communication, responsiveness, and high-quality project execution.

Requirements

  • Previous project management experience within the property restoration industry is required.
  • Direct experience with water damage, fire damage, storm damage, mitigation, reconstruction, or insurance-related property restoration.
  • Proven ability to manage restoration projects from initial loss through reconstruction and final closeout.
  • Experience managing multiple active projects and jobsites simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of restoration workflows, construction processes, scheduling, budgeting, and cost control.
  • Experience coordinating field crews, subcontractors, vendors, customers, and insurance representatives.
  • Familiarity with estimating, insurance supplements, change orders, invoicing, and restoration project documentation.
  • Ability to identify and resolve field issues while maintaining project schedules and budgets.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, customer service, and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable working in both office and field environments.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to independently manage projects and priorities.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
  • Must be located near New Hampton, New York, or able to reliably commute to regional project sites.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Opportunity to take full ownership of projects from initial loss through completion.
  • Diverse portfolio of residential and commercial restoration and reconstruction projects.
  • Collaborative, team-oriented work environment.
  • Direct interaction with company leadership and key decision-makers.
  • Long-term professional growth and advancement opportunities.
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping property owners recover and rebuild following property damage.

title: Senior Storage Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About Cogent

Cogent is an Applied AI Lab building the next generation of AI agents for cybersecurity. AI has fundamentally changed how attacks happen, allowing malicious actors to operate at unprecedented speed and scale. Cogent's "AI Taskforce" assesses petabytes of enterprise data to remediate these issues before critical breaches occur.

To stay at the cutting edge, we blend frontier research with real-world execution. Alongside our core product work, Cogent Research serves as our applied AI lab, providing the research horsepower needed to make truly agentic security workflows a reality. We partner with Fortune 500 companies to secure some of the most complex production environments in the world.

We're backed by Greylock & Bain Capital Ventures, and we've built a team with the best minds in applied AI. Our team is comprised of people from:

  • Top universities like Stanford, Berkeley, Penn, Duke, Carnegie Mellon, Waterloo

  • Unicorn, high-growth companies like Scale AI, Databricks, Stripe, Tesla, Coinbase

  • World class cybersecurity experts from Wiz, Abnormal AI, Zscaler

  • Preeminent research labs like Deepmind and SAIL

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Storage Infrastructure Engineer on our Core Platform team to own how we store, protect, and operate data at scale. You'll build the backup, observability, and operations layer across our relational, streaming, and analytical stores - and make it agent-forward.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer with deep data infrastructure experience, ideally sharpened at a data-focused startup.


What You'll Do

  • Standardize backup, restore, retention, and encryption policies across Aurora / RDS, Clickhouse, and MSK

  • Build storage observability dashboards for capacity, performance, replication, lag, and cost

  • Create a Storage Operations Agent for incident triage, slow-query investigation, and remediation workflows


What We're Looking For

  • Deep experience with data stores: Aurora RDS, Clickhouse, Kafka / AWS MSK, and Postgres

  • Experience with table formats and lakehouse patterns, including Iceberg

  • Strong coding in Python and Golang

  • Infrastructure-as-code skills with Terraform

  • 3-6 years at a successful tech company (Senior, Staff+)

Bonus Points

  • 1-2 years at a data-focused startup (Databricks, Snowflake)

  • Object and analytical storage experience: S3, GCS, Google BigQuery, AWS Athena, Presto, Parquet

  • Vector and graph stores: VectorDB, Turbopuffer, Puppygraph

  • A secondary spike in Observability Infrastructure

For California Based Applicants

The standard base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $300,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

title: Data Engineer

description:

title: Mechanical Engineering Analyst

title: Host - Pelican Landing

Qualifications

  • Energetic, enthusiastic, and motivated individual
  • Must be able to speak, comprehend, read, and write English.
  • Must have effective communication skills.
  • Ability to implement and uphold service standards.
  • Ability to prioritize and organize work assignments.
  • Ability to interact with all associates and guests of the resort.

  • Must be flexible and available to work, days, evenings, weekends, and holidays.

  • Ability to think clearly, quickly, maintain concentration and make concise decisions in pressure situations.

Experience, Education, & Licensure

  • High School Diploma or GED recommended.

As a valued member of the CoralTree team, you will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

title: Physical Therapy Aide - Terre Haute (Downtown), IN

title: Senior Specialist, Vendor/Order Management
description:
About Us

Centric Brands is a leading lifestyle brand collective that designs, sources, markets and sells high quality products in multiple segments, including women’s, men’s and kid’s apparel, accessories, entertainment and beauty. Centric Brands is focused on our customers and our brands that will drive the company’s future growth. We are defined by innovation as we seize new opportunities and thrive in an environment informed by creativity and thinking that is both analytical and outside the box. Centric Brands reflects a team built on respect, for others and for the hard work it takes to achieve our goals and build our bright future together.

Specific Responsibilities Would Include

Overall Responsibilities

--- Shipping Management

- With 5 years of comprehensive logistics experience, which involved shipping goods to the USA and Europe.

- Oversee the end-to-end shipping process, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of goods.

- Coordinate and communicate with freight forwarders, carriers, and logistics providers to arrange shipments and resolve any issues.

- Monitor and manage shipping schedules to ensure compliance with delivery timelines.

- Ensure the proper documentation is prepared and submitted for each shipment, including bills of loading, customs documents, and invoices.

- Coordinate with vendors and internal Production/Operations team to facilitate smooth shipment arrangements, when needed.

--- Document Management

- Identify and rectify any discrepancies in shipping documentation by collaborating with suppliers and relevant departments.

- Ensure timely transmission of customs clearance documents to freight forwarders and provide complete documentation to customers.

- Maintain organized records of shipments and documentation for compliance and future reference.

--- Data Analysis and Reporting

- Prepare reports to analyze shipping performance metrics, including costs, delivery times, and vendor performance.

- Assist in collecting and analyzing data from shipping operations to generate regular management reports.

- Assist in creating Vendor Score Cards to evaluate vendor and factory performance.

- Collaborate with other departments to track and report on shipping trends and issues.

--- Order Management

- Utilize internal systems (SAP/PLM/IBT) to process and modify Purchase Orders efficiently and ensure the accuracy of PO/SO/Material costing may require leading subordinates to achieve this objective.

- Ensure timely transmission of Purchase Orders to the Infor Nexus system.

- Monitor the status of invoicing and documentation submissions.

- Coordinate with vendors and internal Logistics operations team to facilitate smooth shipment arrangements, when needed.

--- Vendor Management

- Maintain relationships with vendors to facilitate smooth shipping operations.

- Communicate effectively with suppliers, forwarders, and customers to address any shipping-related issues.

- Troubleshoot and monitor any issues regarding the Infor Nexus system for vendors and factories

- Establish and maintain Vendor and Factory profiles across various platforms (Infor Nexus, SAP, OSCA).

- Coordinate on-boarding training for New Vendor and Factory and maintain records.

--- Data Analysis and Reporting

- Prepare reports to cross-check all those data accuracy across the team.

- Assist in collecting data from Business Units to prepare regular Management Reports.

- Assist in creating Vendor Score Cards to evaluate vendor and factory performance.

- Collect and analyze data from vendors to track cotton chains associated with Purchase Orders.

#LI-HR1

Our Best Fit Candidate Would Have

Additional Requirements

- Familiarity with shipping management software and systems (e.g., SAP, Infor Nexus).

- Previous experience in shipping, logistics, or freight forwarding is highly desirable.

- Strong attention to detail to ensure the accuracy of documents and compliance with shipping regulations.

- Ability to work collaboratively with various departments and external partners.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel for data analysis (e.g., Power BI, VBA, Python).

- Experience or expertise in SAP is essential.

- It is an ability to manage multiple tasks independently and meet deadlines while maintaining attention to details.

#LI-HR1
