title: Director, Group Deposits
description:
Job Summary

Retail and Private Banking segments within Wealth and Retail Banking business provide a full-suites of products and services including deposits i.e. Current Account, Saving Account and Fixed Deposit.

The purpose of the role is to support the WRB Deposits agenda by driving product management, pricing optimisation, product governance, deposit performance across markets and market enablement. The role provides Group-level oversight to ensure deposit products for Retail and Private Bank segment deliver sustainable growth and are well controlled and aligned with regulatory and internal policy requirements.

This role will report to [Director, Liquidity and Deposit Pricing], and work with key stakeholders across Group and Country teams including Product Managers, One Delivery, Business Risk Management, Finance, Operations, Balance Sheet Management as well as Risk Framework Owners (RFOs) such as Compliance, Operational Technology and Cyber Risk etc.

Key Responsibilities

• Deposit product management for Retail and Private Bank segment, including product governance and initiative / project across WRB markets.

• Support the delivery of deposit portfolio growth by providing input on product development, portfolio management, and governance process.

• Providing support for market enablement and drive consistent product management standards and best practices across WRB Deposits.

• Provide Group-level oversight and guidance on deposit product governance, ensuring products remain aligned with internal policies, risk appetite and regulatory requirements.

• Support product reviews, product programme refreshes, risk assessments, and governance submissions to ensure deposit products are well controlled and aligned with governance standards.

• Provide guidance to markets on implementation of global standards, policy changes, control enhancements, and product governance requirements.

• Collaborating with Group and Country Data Analytics teams and Finance to provide deposit performance analysis including product performance, deposit growth / NNM and income.

• Support senior management updates by preparing concise materials on deposit performance, pricing initiatives, and strategic priorities.

Strategy*

You must have a set of soft skills such as:

• Strategic mindset - understand market trends, client needs and WRB strategic priorities.

• Data-driven decision making – Uses performance insights, portfolio and financial analysis to support senior management in taking product /portfolio decisions and prioritisation.

Business*

You must have a keen understanding of:

• Deposit products i.e. Current Account, Saving Account, Fixed Deposit available for Retail and Private Banking clients

• Economics of deposit products which include pricing, margin, portfolio performance and growth levers

Processes*

• Understanding of deposit end-to-end processes, including end-to-end processes around transaction processing system (T24).

• Understanding payments services and its interconnectedness with deposit products

People & Talent*

Stakeholder management – Builds strong relationships across Group, Country, Product, Delivery Team and Risk Framework Owners to drive alignment and execution.

Risk Management*

Risk awareness – product risk understanding such as interest rate risk and how the various macroeconomic indicators and market situation affect the performance of the business.

Governance*

Governance awareness –awareness of product governance, regulatory and control discipline

Regulatory & Business Conduct*

• Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.

• Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.

• Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders*

• Group Head, Deposits

• Regional and Country Deposit Product Heads

• Country Retail / WRB Product Teams

• Finance

• One Delivery

• Data Analytics teams

• Model development team

• Segment teams, including Private, PP, Priority, Premium, Personal and SME

• Business Risk Management

• Group and Country RFO teams including Compliance, Financial Crime, Fraud and Conduct Risk

Operations, Operational, Technology and Cyber Risk, Legal, Tax, ICS etc

• WRB Operational Resilience

• Technology / Digital Banking

• Digital Sales and Marketing

• COO / Business Management teams

• Balance Sheet Management / CPM teams

• Treasury / Global Treasury

• Internal Audit

• External Consultants

• Peer banks and industry counterparts for market intelligence and benchmarking

Other Responsibilities*

Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedure

Our Ideal Candidate

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree

• 10 years of relevant Deposits Experience

Role Specific Technical Competencies

• Familiar with product management within Private Banking business

• Familiar customer due diligence processes including FATCA and CRS adherence.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together we:

• Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do

• Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well

• Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

• Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

• Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

• Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.

• Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits

• A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

• Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

description:
As Marqeta’s Analyst on the PNO Announcements, Compliance and Enhancements team reporting to the Manager, Payment Network Operations, you will facilitate multiple aspects of the payments network communication lifecycle, including customer and partner reporting, issue management, and communication organization. You’ll be collaborating closely with the Marqeta extended team, including Network and Bank Partnerships, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Compliance, Legal, Technology, etc.

Payment Network Operations (PNO) is a foundational function to ensure that Marqeta is operationally ‘paving the road’ for our Customers through our network partners, including Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express and others. Our business model thrives on the infrastructures established by these payment networks, necessitating our team's expertise to foster and deepen these invaluable partnerships and open the door to the payments ecosystem for our customers.

The Payment Network Operations Analyst has working knowledge of payments networks and the payments ecosystem. They are expected to operate in a fast-paced environment, and have a passion for increasing their experience and finding a way to deliver for our customers and stakeholders. The Payment Network Operations Analyst has self-motivation and will have moderate guidance and oversight.

We work Flexible First. This role can be performed in a hybrid work model (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday onsite) from our Warsaw office. We’d love for you to join us!

The Impact You’ll Have

The ACE Team ensures Marqeta’s ongoing compliance with card network regulations and prevents potential operational or reputational risks. We help protect Marqeta, our programs, and our issuing bank partners by proactively monitoring and analyzing card network mandates, announcements, and compliance requirements, and working closely with product teams to ensure changes are communicated and executed effectively—helping to avoid potential service disruptions and damage to client trust.

In support of this objective, the Payment Network Operations Analyst for the ACE team will:

  • Facilitate the ingestion of announcements published by our card network partners (Visa, Mastercard, Pulse, Discover, Amex, Moneypass, Allpoint)
    • Process all communications from the network into Jira for review, enabling the assessment of applicability and filtering out announcements which are definitively not applicable to Marqeta’s business
    • Assist with flagging impactful announcements to product managers and relevant stakeholders to ensure Marqeta remains compliant with network regulations and help prevent operational issues for Marqeta, our programs, and our issuing banks.
    • Engage with our network partners to ensure complete receipt of all applicable network communications.
    • Create and maintain all network communication related Jira Epics

Assist with customer and program waivers & participation opt-out

    • Collaborate with other members of the ACE team to submit waiver and participation opt-in/out requests to issuing bank partners and Client Success teams
    • Maintain records of waivers & participation opt-outs for Marqeta Customers
    • Proactively track waiver expiration dates and ensure renewals are submitted and processed timely.

Grow as a subject matter expert for card network compliance & operational questions

    • Manage a queue of inquiries regarding network tools/platforms access in Jira.
    • Actively participate in responding to stakeholder inquiries in Slack with a focus on the team channel #ask-pno.

Act as the Administrator for Payment Network Online Portals

    • Approve and process requests for access, troubleshooting access issues with stakeholders
    • Conduct regular User Access Reviews as required for regulatory compliance

Conduct regular partner reporting

    • Pull and deliver program reports for our internal, payment network and bank partners.

Cross-train with PNO BIN and TAM Teams

    • Assist with onboarding and offboarding BINs and services for customer programs
    • Support payment network initiatives

Who You Are

  • Basic knowledge of Visa and/or Mastercard products, services and policies with at least 1-3 years of experience within the payment network industry
  • Growing ability to bridge the gap between business and technical teams
  • Take ownership and drive accountability for assigned tasks
  • Drive results with a positive outlook and a clear focus on high-quality deliverables
  • Continual growth in communication skills (interpersonal, verbal, presentation, written)
  • Improve existing processes and institute new processes to improve efficiency and accuracy, decrease toil, and expand impact.
  • Collaborate with team members on improvements to process efficiency and effectiveness to decrease toil and expand impact.

Your Manager

  • Joshua Waddell - Director, Payment Network Operations

Recruiter For This Role

  • Agata Wojciechowska

Typical Process

  • Application Submission
  • Recruiter phone call
  • Hiring manager video call
  • Virtual “Onsite” consisting of 4-5, 45 min calls
  • Offer!

Compensation and Benefits

When determining salaries, we consider several factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior experience, and work location. The new-hire base salary range for this position, reflected in PLN, is: 117,000-146,500.

The bonus target for this position is 10% of the applicable base salary, subject to the plan terms and meeting eligibility requirements.

Along with monetary compensation, Marqeta offers

  • Monthly stipend for your home office equipment and connectivity
  • Annual development stipend to support your growth and development
  • Pension Scheme provided by Allianz
  • Employee health through Luxmed with employee cover paid at 100% by Marqeta
  • Four floating holidays as additional paid days off to your annual leave entitlement
  • In-office amenities including: drinks and snacks, wellness room, dedicated barista, community events onsite
  • MultiSport Plus membership offerings.

About Marqeta

Marqeta is on a mission to change the way money moves. We’re one of the earliest enablers of embedded finance, a market opportunity sized up in the trillions. Our card issuing platform provides unprecedented flexibility and control for companies to issue cards, authorize transactions, and manage payment operations in real time. Marqeta is powering the most well known brands in the new economy (Block, Cash App, Affirm, Instacart, Doordash, Uber, Walmart, etc). You don’t need to be a Payments expert to join the Marqeta Team, let us help you with that. This is the opportunity of a lifetime to work with innovators around the world and unlock equitable financial access for all.

Marqeta’s Values

– Solve for the Customer: With a deep understanding of our customers' business and empathy for their needs, we deliver products and services that drive their success. Earning and keeping their trust guides everything we do.

– Do What's Right: Knowing businesses and livelihoods depend on us, we pursue solutions that disrupt responsibly and deliver high-quality results that our customers count on. We own our work from start to finish.

– Simplify and Innovate: We approach challenges with curiosity and take smart risks. Innovation comes from finding better, simpler ways to achieve extraordinary outcomes.

– Win as a Team: We succeed together by embracing diverse perspectives and pushing each other to raise the bar. We lead with humility and set aside hierarchy to work as a team.

– Make it Count: We drive forward with focus and agility. With a sense of urgency and purpose, we get the job done, and done right.

title: Research Fellow (International Dispute Resolution)
description:
Interested applicants are invited to apply directly at the NUS Career Portal. Please note your application will only be processed if you apply via NUS Career Portal.

NUS Career Portal link: https://careers.nus.edu.sg/job/Research-Fellow-%28International-Dispute-Resolution%29/29991-en_GB/

Job Description

The NUS Centre for International Law (CIL) is inviting applications for a one-year Research Fellow position to contribute to the development and research of the International Dispute Resolution (IDR) programme. Candidates with experience in public international law, including in international tribunals such as the International Court of Justice, are encouraged to apply. The focus topic of the IDR programme is disputes involving States and includes issues related to alternative dispute resolution, international courts and tribunals and peace and security.

The duties of the incumbent will include:

  • Conducting research and writing on current issues related to the resolution of disputes involving States;
  • Contributing to the development of the IDR programme's research agenda;
  • Publications in top tier peer-reviewed journals;
  • Development and implementation of conferences, seminars, workshops, and trainings related to international dispute resolution.

The IDR Research Fellow can look forward to working in a small team with a short reporting line and interactions with practitioners in the field. The successful candidate will also have the opportunity to collaborate with other CIL research teams and experts, and to attend conferences and workshops.

Qualifications

  • A PhD in relevant area of international law or equivalent experience;
  • At least 2 years of working experience;
  • Proven records in conducting independent research;
  • Strong analytical and writing skills - experience with publication of journal articles is desirable;
  • Ability to produce academic writing as well as background papers/reports;
  • Demonstrable interest in public international law and dispute resolution;
  • Strong organisational and communications skills;
  • Fluent language skills in English are required;
  • Pro-active personality, with the ability to make suggestions and be a hands-on contributor; and
  • Tech-savvy.

Application Procedures

Interested applicants are invited to apply directly via the NUS Career Portal with the following supporting documents:

  • A covering letter (no more than 1 page) detailing motivations, relevant experience and why the candidate should be considered for the position;
  • A detailed CV (no more than 3 pages);
  • 1 sample of written work; and
  • Names and contact details of 4 referees, including PhD supervisor

Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be notified and invited for an online Zoom interview.

title: Specialist, Spirits
description:
ABOUT SOTHEBY'S

Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby’s and Concierge. Sotheby’s Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

The new Specialist, Spirits will be responsible for new and current business generation in Hong Kong and Singapore, and for the sourcing, solicitation, authentication, evaluation and sale of Asia-based property to meet sales and profit targets across a range of channels and formats as directed by the Wine & Spirits Leadership Team. You will play an active part in the day-to-day business getting for the department’s sales and will work closely with the global Specialist team to support the growth and success of the global Sotheby’s Whisky & Spirits business, taking the lead on growing our new programme of sales in Asia.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Sourcing and Expertise

Sourcing and securing profitable consignments for auction and fixed price opportunities, managing sale production, deadlines and targets

  • Use personal relationships, tastings, dinners and all types of events (private & trade) to build an impressive and important network of private and trade clients who trust your knowledge and expertise and will do business with you on both the buy & sell sides
  • Negotiate and secure whisky and spirits for auction and fixed price selling opportunities, meeting individual and team margin and revenue targets together with local and global annual budget
  • Use Specialist knowledge and expertise on strategic long-term business getting focused on high level clients and their requirements. Act as a client contact for this client base and nurture relationships. Be a respected and trusted authority on the whisky and spirits market and use that experience with clients, press and on social media
  • Set an example of scholarship providing expertise, researching and cataloguing whisky and spirits to the highest standard and in accordance with sale deadlines
  • Value property to provide auction/retail/fair market/insurance estimates
  • Perform property inspection for whisky and spirits at Sotheby’s warehouses and on-site at client’s premises when required
  • Lead on inspections and research/cataloguing of whisky and spirits for sale in Asia, and assist in the Americas and Europe when required
  • Wine knowledge and experience preferred but not essential

Sale Production

  • Manage sale production and deadlines:
  • Inspecting and authenticating property
  • Ensure that all photography is completed in a timely manner
  • Researching and writing catalogue entries
  • Proof reading
  • Liaising with Catalogue Production and Sale Creation teams as appropriate
  • Produce and manage appraisal and proposal coordination
  • Keep business getting spreadsheet updated to current status
  • Liaising with our Marketing team to schedule and create promotional materials

Selling

Proactively sell all Sotheby’s Whisky and Spirits sales (both auction and fixed price offerings) to Sotheby’s global database of clients and actively engage in the growth of the global Sotheby’s Whisky and Spirits audience

  • Build a private client base that actively buys in our global Whisky and Spirits business
  • Act as an ambassador for the Wine and Spirits business within Sotheby’s, promoting its services, products and expertise to internal stakeholders, cross selling the Sotheby’s Wine and Spirits business to all Sotheby’s clients
  • Provide advice to buyers across Sotheby’s Whisky and Spirits global auction and fixed price opportunities
  • Responsible for selling whisky and spirits to clients via telephone, email, in-person and at events
  • Events composition/participation to include client development and entertaining

Other

  • Participate in local, regional and global Sotheby’s Wine and Spirits projects as required
  • Provide support to other parts of the Sotheby’s Wine and Spirits business as and when required
  • Consistently seek opportunities to promote and sell other Sotheby’s categories to own client base
  • Demonstrate a consistently client first approach to business, ensuring active and timely communication with clients and ensuring that their needs are at the center of our decisions and actions while remaining compliant with Sotheby’s policies and code of conduct
  • Demonstrate a “One Sotheby’s” approach to the business, working to build the most effective worldwide business
  • Look for innovative solutions to make our business better
  • Expectation to take on managerial responsibility for further Spirits team members in Asia as they are added

IDEAL EXPERIENCE & COMPETENCIES

  • Outgoing, social and personable character with a strong ability to network and convert social connections into business opportunities
  • Excellent communication skills – fluent in both written and spoken English; Mandarin or Cantonese is a plus
  • Experience networking and selling to high net worth and ultra-high net worth individuals
  • Exceptional knowledge of fine and rare whisky and spirits relevant to the auction & retail market, with a minimum of 5 years’ experience in the industry
  • Understand and demonstrate a “no compromise” attitude towards luxury: protecting the Sotheby’s Whisky and Spirits
  • vision and brand equity while achieving short term sales goals
  • Experience in developing clientele over time and nurturing relationships
  • High level of attention to detail is a must
  • Self-starter with an ability to make commercial decisions independently professional, discreet and commercial client service skills
  • Proficient in MS Word, Excel and SAP preferred
  • Please note this role requires a significant amount of physical work moving cases of spirits in our warehouse and private cellars
  • Domestic and international travel will be required

title: Senior Machine Learning System Builder
description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

As a Senior Machine Learning Systems Builder you own detection capabilities end to end: from problem framing and data, through experimentation, to models running in production and the telemetry that proves they work for customers. We've had a strong presence in Veszprém for over a decade, and we're now expanding into Budapest, this role is based in our newly opening Budapest office, right at the start of that growth.

You Will Have an Opportunity to

  • Own detection capabilities from idea to customer impact across the AI/ML detection portfolio: threat similarity search (behavioral, code-structure, and static features), URL reputation, image-based phishing and brand-spoofing detection, web threat classification, and content classification
  • Build and maintain the data pipelines your models depend on: sample sourcing and collection, ground truth and labeling workflows, feature extraction, and versioned training and evaluation datasets
  • Design, train, fine-tune, and evaluate models, and see them through to production: versioned, runtime-portable artifacts (e.g., ONNX) consumed from the JVM-based backend, with input/output specifications, performance benchmarks, and documented limitations
  • Build an automated model build and release pipeline, in the likes of SageMaker Pipelines: reproducible training runs, automated evaluation gates, and versioned artifact publishing, so that retraining and releasing a model is a routine operation rather than a project
  • Own model quality in production, not just at release: telemetry feedback loops, false positive escalations, drift monitoring, and retraining cadence
  • Design evaluation methodology for an adversarial, drifting domain: time-split validation, strict false positive ceilings, and robustness against evasion
  • Automate the ML lifecycle with AI: use AI-assisted development daily, and build agentic automation for repetitive work such as labeling assistance, evaluation runs, regression testing, and reporting
  • Set your own experimentation roadmap, prioritized by measurable customer-facing detection gains, and share what you learn openly across the team

What We Are Looking for

  • 3+ years applied ML experience across at least two of: text/content classification, computer vision, similarity search / embedding models, security or threat detection
  • Evidence of end-to-end delivery: models you personally took from data to production, running in systems used by other teams or customers
  • Experience building data pipelines for model training: data collection, labeling and ground truth management, feature extraction, dataset versioning
  • Strong Python; PyTorch or TensorFlow; experience with model evaluation frameworks
  • Solid grounding in statistics and experiment design, including evaluation under distribution shift
  • Comfort working across the integration boundary (for example, ONNX consumption from JVM services) rather than stopping at the model artifact
  • Fluency with AI coding and agent tooling, and a track record of automating your own workflow with it
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities; fluent in English

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Innovative Environment: Join a team at the forefront of cybersecurity innovation. At OPSWAT, you'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and contribute to solutions that shape the future of cybersecurity.
  • Collaborative Culture: We foster a culture of collaboration, where every team member's input is valued. You'll have the chance to work alongside talented individuals who are passionate about cybersecurity and dedicated to making a difference.
  • Professional Growth: At OPSWAT, we prioritize the growth and development of our team members. You'll have access to ongoing training and development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career in cybersecurity.
  • Impactful Work: Join a mission-driven company that is committed to securing the digital world. Your work at OPSWAT will have a meaningful impact on organizations worldwide, protecting critical data and assets from evolving cyber threats.
  • Fun and Dynamic Atmosphere: We believe in fostering a fun and dynamic work environment. From team-building activities to social events, you'll have plenty of opportunities to connect with your colleagues and enjoy the journey together.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: VP, Claims
description:
About Strala

Strala is building the world's first AI-native TPA. Insurance is core to the global economy, yet its foundation - claims - is still characterized by legacy tech and fragmented processes. We are changing that. Strala isn't just a software tool; we are a full-service, AI-powered partner rebuilding the mechanics of risk from the ground up. We are reimagining how claims get handled, using AI to make adjusters dramatically more effective and to scale claims capacity far beyond what legacy models allow. Backed by more than $50M, our team combines the elite technical pedigree of Palantir, Oxford AI labs, Geico, CCC, Hertz, and American National with the deep operational expertise of carriers like Travelers and Progressive. We are looking for a VP of Claims to lead this transformation and define what "modern claims" looks like for the world's largest carriers.

The Role

We are looking for an ambitious senior leader as Vice President of Claims - someone with deep experience in P&C claims who wants to build the future of claims with AI, not just apply it. You thrive in fast-paced environments and are eager to build from the ground up. Our mission is to deliver optimal claims outcomes to insurance companies so this leader will be highly influential in making this happen, leading our claims function from strategy through to execution and partnering closely with our engineering and AI teams to translate deep claims expertise into intelligent products. This is a special opportunity to join a well-capitalized company and shape the foundation of a next-generation TPA.

This role combines deep operational ownership with strategic leadership, hands-on AI product collaboration, and customer-facing influence. This is a leadership role and you will be part of Strala's executive team, working directly with Strategy & Operation and Engineering to design and implement claims processes, set our standards of excellence, and be a trusted partner to carriers and MGAs. For an industry leader with a strong foundation in claims, a builder's instinct for technology, and a desire to shape what comes next, this is a chance to build something enduring - with real scale, modern tools, and a world-class team.

What You Will Do

Claims Operations & Systems Buildout

  • Attract, hire and manage high-performance claims teams, workflows, and QA frameworks

  • Leads by example - including when necessary personally handling claims to drive optimal customer outcomes and to inform how our AI products are built

Customer Partnership & Commercial Growth

  • Represent Strala's claims capabilities in sales outreach, RFP, onboarding, and executive discussions

  • Leverage your industry network to drive conversations with carriers, MGAs, and captives

  • Partner closely with Sales to shape SLAs and delivery models tailored to client needs

  • Act as executive sponsor during implementation and long-term customer relationships

Product & AI Strategy

  • Bring firsthand claims expertise into product and engineering discussions as an active, ongoing contributor to how our AI products get built

  • Shape the design of our internal tooling and agentic AI products

  • Define key data capture, workflow, and user experience requirements for adjusters so that claims expertise can be captured, structured, and scaled through technology

  • Apply real-world insight to determine where AI and automation add value - and where human expertise remains essential

Who You Are

  • Minimum of 12+ years experience in P&C claims, ideally spanning auto and liability

  • 5+ years in a senior leadership role at a carrier, TPA, or MGA - preferably during a period of growth or transformation

  • Proven ability to build and scale operational teams and systems from scratch

  • Deep understanding of claims tech stacks, data strategy, and automation

  • Tech-native and genuinely excited by AI - you are fluent working alongside engineers, comfortable with modern AI tooling, and energized by using technology to reinvent how claims are handled

  • Comfortable in external-facing roles and effective at building long-term trust

  • Willing to travel

  • A grounded leader who can operate at both strategic and operational levels

  • Bonus points if you have previously built a new claims department from scratch or have hands-on experience bringing AI or automation into a claims workflow

  • You don't just tolerate an ambitious, fast-moving startup culture - you seek it out, embracing the shift from legacy insurance workflows that we are looking to disrupt to continuous experimentation and break-neck execution.

Why This Role

  • Be an early member of a mission-driven team that is tackling the $280B problem (outsourced claims processing) in one of the world's largest and most important industries

  • Opportunity to shape a core function from the ground up, with strong ownership and influence on both team and product

  • Help define the future of claims technology by helping build the AI behind it, backed by a team of expert builders

title: Socialfaglig medarbejder til Trollesbro beskyttede beskæftigelse
description:
Socialfaglig medarbejder til beskyttet beskæftigelse på Trollesbro – vær med til at skabe udvikling, trivsel og meningsfulde arbejdsfællesskaber.
Trollesbro er et nytænkende, dynamisk og fagligt kraftcenter med plads til borgernes mangfoldighed, båret af bæredygtige og stærke faglige tilbud og fællesskaber, der skaber løsninger.

Centret rummer en bred vifte af tilbud til borgere med forskellige funktionsnedsættelser, herunder psykisk sårbarhed, udviklingshæmning, udviklingsforstyrrelser og senhjerneskader.

I alle vores tilbud på Trollesbro arbejder vi med at støtte borgere i sårbare positioner.
  • Vi bærer håbet og troen på borgernes muligheder og ressourcer.
  • Vi styrker borgerne, så de selv finder muligheder og veje, der giver mening for dem.
  • Vi understøtter inklusion og medborgerskab i værdiskabende fællesskaber, også uden for Trollesbros rammer.
Du kan læse mere om centret og vores arbejde på hjemmesiden

Om stillingen
Montageværkstedet tilbyder beskyttet beskæftigelse for borgere med forskellige funktionsnedsættelser. Derfor søger vi en medarbejder, som møder mennesker med faglig nysgerrighed, respekt og et stærkt pædagogisk blik for den enkeltes ressourcer og støttebehov.
Kerneopgaven er at understøtte den enkelte borgers udvikling, mestring og trivsel gennem meningsfulde arbejdsfællesskaber, samtidig med at værkstedets montage- og pakkeopgaver løses i samarbejde med borgerne.

Det er vigtigt, at man også kan strukturere arbejdsprocesser, og holde styr på produktions-flowet, samtidig med at der skabes meningsfuld beskæftigelse og god trivsel.
Beskæftigelsen har i alt 6 forskellige værksteder hvor vi er ansvarlige for eget værksted og støtter op om hinanden når det er nødvendigt.

Trollesbro er et hus i stadig udvikling, og vi er for tiden i gang med at undersøge hvordan vores klubtilbud Café Oasen og den beskyttede beskæftigelse kan arbejde tættere sammen.
For den rigtige kandidat vil der derfor være mulighed for at tilrettelægge en mere varieret arbejdsuge i forhold til arbejdstid og indhold.

Arbejdsopgaverne vil bl.a. være
  • Beskæftigelse og instruktion af beskyttede medarbejdere i forskellige arbejdsopgaver
  • Pædagogisk arbejde med vores medarbejdere for at styrke deres sociale og faglige kompetencer (instruktion, coaching og motivation)
  • Dokumentationsarbejde i.f.t. den enkelte medarbejder i beskyttet beskæftigelse (journalnotater, pædagogisk handleplan, status, mv.)
  • Planlægning af dagligdag og produktioner, samt udvikling af nye arbejdsopgaver og kundepleje
  • Løbende dialog med kommuner og støttekontaktpersoner

Vi forestiller os, at du
  • har lyst til at arbejde med, og formår, at rumme mennesker med behov for støtte til at bruge deres arbejdsevne – stor som lille
  • har energi og kan få (nye) ting til at ske
  • kan omsætte pædagogisk viden til praksis og skabe struktur, forudsigelighed og udviklingsmuligheder for borgere med forskellige støttebehov
  • har lyst til at arbejde med både praktiske opgaver og motivationsarbejde i.f.t. den enkelte medarbejder i beskyttet beskæftigelse
  • er stærk i relationsarbejde og møder mennesker med anerkendelse, respekt og tydelighed
  • kan kombinere pædagogiske indsatser med praktiske arbejdsopgaver.
  • kan skabe struktur, overblik og forudsigelighed i hverdagen.
  • trives i en hverdag, hvor udvikling, samarbejde og medansvar er en naturlig del af arbejdet.
  • har lyst og engagement til at være med i udviklingen af centrets værkstedstilbud

Vi tilbyder
  • Et afvekslende arbejde med stor indflydelse på opgaveløsningen og din arbejdsdag
  • Et arbejde hvor du er tæt på mennesker og får lov til at være med til at skabe nye muligheder for dem
  • Mulighed for tæt parløb med kolleger i det pædagogiske arbejde
  • Et godt og tæt samspil mellem leder og personale
  • Tid til forberedelse og dokumentation

Andre kvalifikationer
Skriftlig dokumentation er en del af vores dagligdag, vores nuværende fagsystem er Sensum One, og det vil være en fordel hvis du har kendskab til dette system.

Kørekort til personbil (B) er et krav for opretholdelse af stillingen.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelse sker i henhold til overenskomst med SL, med lokalaftale for årsnorm. Arbejdet i beskæftigelsen tilrettelægges i tidsrummet 07.30 – 15.30 mandag til fredag.
Stillingen er på 37 timer/uge.
Tiltrædelse pr. 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest herefter.

Frist for ansøgning
Vi skal modtage din ansøgning senest den 21. august 2026 kl. 08.00.

Samtaler
Vi forventer at holde samtaler den 26. august.

Besøg på arbejdspladsen
Der vil være mulighed for en rundvisning på værkstederne den 18. august fra kl. 16.00-17.00.

Yderligere information
For yderligere information om stillingen, kan du kontakte afdelingsleder Jannik Møller, telefon 72 32 36 25, mail: jamol@hillerod.dk.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Ansøgningen sendes elektronisk via linket

Hos os er det ikke kun arbejdet, der tæller, men også menneskene bag.

I fællesskab gør vi hver dag en forskel for kommunens mere end 54.000 borgere, og vi sætter pris på det helt særlige bidrag, som du kommer med. Vi er stolte af at gå nye veje og sammen finde løsninger på de udfordringer, som møder os. Hillerød Kommune er en fleksibel arbejdsplads, hvor vi tror på værdien af både forskellighed og sammenhold. Det er vigtigt, at alle føler sig anerkendt og respekteret, for hos os er arbejdsglæde en forudsætning for den gode kvalitet og tilfredse borgere.

title: Financial Accounts Specialist / Associate Financial Accounts Specialist
description:
The Financial Accounts Specialist plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of financial operations through the management of accounting transactions, inventory controls, reconciliations, compliance reporting, and master data governance. This role offers valuable exposure to end-to-end finance processes, ERP systems, cross-functional collaboration, and continuous improvement initiatives in a fast-paced multinational environment.

The incumbent is responsible for operational accounting & financial functions of Company's account and maintenance of internal control system and generation of financial and management data and reports.

JOB DESCRIPTION

  • Manage the end-to-end Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) processes, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant processing of invoices, payments, collections and financial transactions.
  • Review and validate supporting documentation to ensure adherence to company policies, accounting standards, and internal controls.
  • Maintain and update foreign exchange rates and support foreign currency revaluation activities.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and master data within the SAP B1 while supporting continuous process improvements and automation initiatives.
  • Perform timely reconciliation of bank accounts, intercompany balances, general ledger accounts, and sub-ledgers to ensure the integrity and completeness of financial records.
  • Investigate and resolve reconciliation variances, outstanding items, and accounting discrepancies in a proactive manner.
  • Support cash flow monitoring, treasury activities, and working capital management through effective cash and account oversight.
  • Support the preparation, reconciliation, and submission of Goods and Services Tax (GST) returns in accordance with local regulatory requirements.
  • Assist with withholding tax computation, filing, and reporting to ensure timely regulatory compliance.
  • Maintain proper tax documentation and support tax audits or queries from relevant authorities when required.
  • Prepare financial analyses, reconciliations, variance reports and accounting schedules to support accurate financial reporting and closing activities to support business and regulatory reporting requirements.
  • Drive month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities, including journal entries, accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, and account reconciliations.
  • Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial data in compliance with accounting standards and corporate reporting requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards (IFRS/SFRS(I)/GAAP), corporate policies, tax regulations, and statutory requirements.
  • Maintain strong internal controls and support risk management initiatives to safeguard company assets and financial data integrity.
  • Coordinate and support internal and external audits by preparing audit schedules, documentation, and responding to audit queries in a timely manner.
  • Serve as a trusted finance partner and primary point of contact for internal departments, vendors, customers, and external stakeholders on financial matters.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with commercial, supply chain, HR, procurement, and regional teams to ensure smooth financial operations and issue resolution.
  • Provide professional support and guidance on financial processes, policies, and system-related inquiries.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Diploma or Degree in Accounting, Finance, Banking, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • Fresh graduates are welcome to apply for the Associate Financial Accounts Specialist role.
  • Minimum 3 - 8 years of relevant Financial Accounting experience, preferably in a multinational corporation (MNC), will be considered for the Senior Financial Accounts Specialist role.
  • Strong knowledge of Financial Accounting, Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), and month-end closing processes.
  • Good understanding of IFRS/SFRS(I), GST, Withholding Tax, Corporate Income Tax, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Experience in account reconciliations, balance sheet schedules, and financial reporting activities.
  • Proficiency in SAP Business One (SAP B1) or other ERP systems is advantageous.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, Power Query, and financial data analysis.
  • Knowledge of internal controls, audit requirements, and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience in master data management, including vendor, customer, and financial master data maintenance.
  • Exposure to finance process improvement initiatives, automation, and system enhancement projects.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across all levels of the organization.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining a collaborative team-oriented mindset.
  • Proactive, resourceful and self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset.
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and accountability in handling confidential financial information.
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn in a fast-paced and evolving business environment.
  • Accurate and timely maintenance of vendor master data, employee accounts, and related finance master data.

title: Afløser til natarbejde på Solhjem - et lille plejehjem med højt til loftet
description:
På Solhjem Plejecenter søger vi en ny timelønnet afløser, som trives med at arbejde primært om natten.

Så er du B-menneske og trives godt med at arbejde om natten i ny og næ, så er der her et godt tilbud.

Solhjem er et lille plejehjem med 31 beboere og en gruppe af dedikerede, omsorgsfulde og fagligt dygtige medarbejdere, som passer godt på beboerne både dag, aften og ikke mindst i de mørke timer om natten.

Og det er altså primært om natten, at vi mangler en dygtig afløser, når de faste medarbejdere har brug for at holde fri.

På Solhjem kender alle hinanden, og det giver tryghed og fleksibilitet i hverdagen for både beboere og medarbejdere.

Vi er et aktivt hus, hvor natur og udeliv er i fokus hver dag.

Vi sætter trivsel højt - på Solhjem skal både beboere, medarbejdere og de gode ideer blomstre.

Selvom vi alle er glade for vores arbejde, så skal vi også holde ferie og have fri en gang imellem, så derfor søger vi lige nu timelønnet afløsere til primært nat.

Hvem er du?
  • Du er over 18 år og har måske erfaring med at arbejde med ældre mennesker og pleje - og omsorgsopgaver, eller har lyst til at lære det.
  • Du vil gerne have et arbejde, der altid giver mening og hvor du har mulighed for at gøre en forskel ved at skabe en tryg nat for beboerne i samarbejde med faglært kollega.
  • Du har lyst til at arbejde med mennesker, få nye kompetencer og blive klogere på både dig selv og andre.
  • Du vil gerne have erfaring indenfor et fagområde, hvor du aldrig keder dig og hvor du altid kan få et job.
Hvad kan du forvente af os?
  • Vi sørger for at du får en grundig oplæring, hvor ingen spørgsmål er dumme og hvor din tryghed er den vigtigste faktor.
  • Vi har en stor fast gruppe af uddannet medarbejdere, så der er altid nogen, du kan spørge og finde hjælp hos.
  • Vi er et lille hus med en nærværende ledelse. På Solhjem er det vigtigt, at alle føler sig velkomne og aldrig føler sig alene.
  • På Solhjem er vi altid åbne for nye ideer og der er kort fra tanke til handling. Vi giver plads til, at dine ideer og kompetencer kan blive en del af hverdagen. Så kan du spille ukulele, hækle eller lave negle, kan det også komme i spil.

Lyder det her som lige noget for dig, så tøv ikke med at kontakte os for en snak eller en kop kaffe og en rundvisning på skønne Solhjem.

Kontakt virksomhedsleder Rikke Wagner Ludvig 30 51 36 98 eller områdeleder Mille Stensgaard 21 79 73 60

Der bliver indkaldt til samtaler løbende.

Bliv en del af Halsnæs – et godt sted at arbejde og et godt sted at bo

Vi er en moderne og rummelig arbejdsplads med cirka 3.000 kollegaer, der hver dag gør sig umage for at levere velfærd og service af høj kvalitet. Vores værdier – redelighed, mulighed og helhed – er fundamentet for alt, vi gør.

Hos Halsnæs Kommune arbejder vi tæt på natur, hav og fjord – og med hovedstaden inden for rækkevidde. Her får du ikke kun et spændende job, men også muligheden for at skabe et liv med ro, fællesskab og aktive oplevelser. Mange vælger at bosætte sig her for at få mere plads, nærhed til naturen og et stærkt lokalt sammenhold.

Vil du vide mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde i Halsnæs Kommune? Besøg vores hjemmeside eller vores LinkedIn-profil.

title: Software Engineer, Toolkit
description:
At Tiger Data, formerly Timescale, we empower developers and businesses with the fastest PostgreSQL platform designed for transactional, analytical, and agentic workloads. Trusted globally by thousands of organizations, Tiger accelerates real-time insights, drives intelligent applications, and powers critical infrastructure at scale. As a globally distributed, remote-first team committed to direct communication, accountability, and collaborative excellence, we're shaping the future of data infrastructure, built for speed, flexibility, and simplicity.

Toolkit Engineer

As a toolkit Engineer, you'll own one of the most important touchpoints developers have with TimescaleDB. TimescaleDB toolkit provides an additive set of hyperfunctions enabling users to offload complex calculations into the database, transforming raw time-series data into production-ready insights. You'll shape the roadmap, identify what should be built next, and deliver developer experiences that help engineers solve increasingly complex problems across industrial IoT, manufacturing, observability, financial markets, and beyond.

This isn't a feature factory role. We're looking for an engineer who enjoys identifying patterns across customer problems, making thoughtful technical tradeoffs, and building developer tools that feel intuitive, reliable, and built to last.

📍 Location: This role is fully remote and open globally. English language fluency is required. We welcome candidates across time zones, and overlapping collaboration hours with a globally distributed engineering team are preferred rather than required.

What you will be responsible for in this role

  • Own the long-term evolution of the TimescaleDB toolkit, balancing customer needs, technical excellence, and product strategy.

  • Define and prioritize toolkit’s roadmap by identifying emerging customer needs across IoT, industrial systems, observability, financial markets, and other time-series applications.

  • Partner closely with Product, Sales, and customers to understand real-world workflows and translate those insights into intuitive developer experiences.

  • Improve reliability, testing, documentation, performance, and maintainability so new capabilities are production-ready from day one.

  • Maintain a healthy balance between shipping new functionality and improving long-term code quality.

You could be a great fit if you...

  • At least 2+ years of experience with Rust.

  • Have strong software engineering fundamentals and contributed to Open Source projects.

  • Have experience building SDKs, client libraries, developer tooling, APIs, or platforms used by other engineers.

  • Basic knowledge of statistical functions, e.g. last observation carried forward.

  • Understand database fundamentals including indexing, query execution, transactions, partitioning, and performance tradeoffs.

  • Enjoy working across product discovery and implementation rather than waiting for fully defined requirements.

  • Are naturally curious about how customers use your software and use that curiosity to influence what gets built.

  • Work effectively in a highly collaborative, globally distributed engineering organization.

Nice to have

  • Experience building databases, query engines, or data infrastructure products.

  • Familiarity with time-series databases, observability platforms, or analytics systems.

  • Experience working with physical IoT systems, industrial software, manufacturing, or similar data-intensive domains.

  • Experience contributing to open-source software.

Our Commitment:

  • We respond to every applicant.

  • We review applications fairly and objectively, and shortlist based on relevant skills and experience.

  • We ensure clear and timely communication throughout your candidate journey.

  • We maintain a rigorous interview process with a high bar, designed to give you the opportunity to meet various team members you'll collaborate with across our organization.

About Tiger Data🐯

Tiger Data, formerly Timescale, sets the standard as the fastest PostgreSQL platform for modern workloads. Trusted by more than 2,000 customers across 25+ countries and powering over 3 million active databases, we enable developers and organizations to build real-time, intelligent applications at scale. Backed by $180 million from top-tier investors, Tiger Data is building the new standard for data infrastructure, built on PostgreSQL, designed for the future.

👉 👉 Want to get a feel for how we work and what we value? Check out our blog post: What It Takes to Thrive at Tiger Data

We embrace diversity, curiosity, and collaboration. Whether debating the perfect chicken nugget crunch 🍗, sharing workout routines 💪, or discussing your favorite plants 🌱 and pets 🐾, you'll find your community here.

Our Tech Stack:

We don't require previous experience with our tech stack, but enthusiasm for learning is key. Our technologies include PostgreSQL, Tiger Cloud, AWS, Go, Docker, Kubernetes, Python, and innovative features like Hypertables, Hypercore, vector search, and real-time analytics.

Learn more at or follow us on Twitter @TigerDatabase

What We Offer:

(Please note that benefits may vary based on country.)

  • Flexible PTO and comprehensive family leave

  • Fridays off in August 😎

  • Fully remote opportunities globally

  • Stock options for long-term growth

  • Monthly WiFi stipend

  • Professional development and educational resources 📚

  • Premium insurance options for you and your family (US-based employees)

Ready to join the future of PostgreSQL? We can’t wait to meet you. 🚀🐯

title: Projektchef til Arkils Bro & Beton-afdeling i Randers
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for komplekse totalentrepriser og skabe resultater gennem tydelig ledelse, godt samarbejde og sikker projektgennemførelse? Hos Arkils Bro & Beton-afdeling søger vi en projektchef, der kan tage det samlede ansvar fra kontrakt til aflevering.

Om jobbet

Du får ansvar for én eller flere totalentrepriser i Jylland og på Fyn, afhængigt af projekternes størrelse og kompleksitet. Afdelingen arbejder blandt andet med industri- og energibyggeri, vandværker, renseanlæg, råhuse og projekter inden for energi- og forsyningssektoren.

Du har det overordnede ansvar for økonomi, tid, kvalitet, sikkerhed og kontraktuelle forhold. Samtidig sammensætter og leder du projektorganisationen og skaber tydelige rammer for projektledere, entrepriseledere og formænd.

Du har kontor i Randers, frem til slutningen af 2027, hvor afdelingen indgår i en sammenlægning med flere afdelinger og får kontor i Lystrup ved Aarhus.

Dine primære opgaver

– Ledelse af projekter fra kontraktindgåelse til aflevering
– Ansvar for projektøkonomi, tidsplaner, risici og kontrakter
– Sammensætning og ledelse af projektteams
– Dialog og forhandling med bygherrer, rådgivere og samarbejdspartnere
– Sikring af kvalitet, arbejdsmiljø og sikkerhed

Hvad får du hos Arkil?

Du får stor indflydelse på både projekterne og afdelingens udvikling samt mulighed for at præge arbejdsmetoder og dele din erfaring.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

– varierede totalentrepriser med faglig bredde
– fokus på sikkerhed, samarbejde og balance mellem arbejde og fritid
– gode muligheder for udvikling og efteruddannelse
– attraktiv lønpakke, sundhedsforsikring og 13 % arbejdsgiverbetalt pension
– mulighed for firmabil og hjemmearbejde, når projekterne tillader det

Dine kvalifikationer

Du har erfaring som projektchef eller erfaren projektleder og har arbejdet med totalentrepriser, projektøkonomi, tidsplaner og kontraktstyring. Du er uddannet ingeniør, bygningskonstruktør eller har en anden relevant teknisk baggrund.

Du skaber retning gennem tydelig kommunikation og godt samarbejde og kan navigere mellem tekniske, økonomiske og menneskelige hensyn.

Ansøgning

Stillingen ønskes besat pr. 1. oktober 2026.

Upload dit CV via ansøgningsknappen senest den 20. august.

Første samtale afholdes den 24. august, og anden samtale den 26. august 2026.

Har du spørgsmål, kan du kontakte afdelingschef Markus Nikolaj Stamnes på telefon 20756856.

Om Arkil

Arkil prioriterer sikkerhed højt og efterlever virksomhedens værdier om høj faglighed og ordentlighed for at sikre en stabil, sund og fremtidssikret forretning.

Arkil er en af Danmarks største entreprenørvirksomheder med 2.300 ansatte, aktiviteter i flere lande og en omsætning på over 4,9 milliarder kr. I Danmark udfører vi entreprenørprojekter over hele landet, og vi arbejder sammen med både offentlige og private bygherrer samt rådgivere. Igennem mere end 85 år har vi sat solide aftryk på infrastrukturen i de lande, vi opererer i – og det bliver vi ved med.

title: ACMV Test & Commissioning Engineer
description:
About Our Client

Our client is a leading air-conditioning and mechanical ventilation (ACMV) provider with a long and successful track record of completing many quality projects.

They are now looking for a competent and committed individual to join their team.

ACMV Test &Commissioning Engineer

Job Description:

  • Review approved drawings, specifications and commissioning procedures
  • Prepare testing and commissioning (T&C) method statements, checklists and schedules.
  • Inspect AHU, FCU and MV fan installations before commissioning.
  • Verify mechanical and electrical installation, including piping, ductwork, wiring, dampers, valves and controls.
  • Perform pre-commissioning checks, including motor rotation, insulation resistance, VSD settings and safety devices.
  • Carry out functional testing of AHUs, FCUs and MV fans to verify design performance.
  • Coordinate with TAB contractor to achieve specified airflows and system balancing.
  • Test and verify BMS controls, alarms, interlocks and control sequences. Coordinate integrated testing with electrical, firm alarm and other building services.
  • Record commissioning results and prepare T&C reports, checklists and as-built documentation.
  • Identify defects, coordinate rectification works and conduct re-testing until compliance is achieved
  • Attend inspections, witness testing with consultants and clients, and support system handover.
  • Ensure all commissioning activities comply with project specifications, local codes, safety requirements and quality standards.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  • At least 2 years of Testing and Commissioning experience, with at least one major hospital or pharmaceutical / Data Centre project completed from construction to handover, will be an added advantage.
  • Excellent negotiation, team leadership, and communication skills to resolve disputes between construction teams and design consultants.

Cresco Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all applicants will be considered without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”) Notice to Applicants:
Please read the California Employee Privacy Notice (“CA Privacy Notice”) regarding Sunnyside* and its affiliate Cresco Labs’ policies pertaining to the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information. This CA Privacy Notice supplements the information contained in the Sunnyside* Privacy Policy and applies to California resident employees and job applicants. Applicants with disabilities may access this notice in an alternative format by contacting CCPAnotice@crescolabs.com
Reporting a Scam:

Cresco Labs is aware of fictitious employment offers being circulated from various sources. Many of these schemes consist of an alleged offer of employment with Cresco Labs with the intention of gaining personal information, including payment and/or banking information. Be aware that fraudulent job offers and correspondence may appear legitimate: they may feature a Cresco Labs logo, they may appear to originate from an official-looking email address or web site, or they may be sent by individuals purporting to represent Cresco Labs or an entity which includes the word Cresco Labs in its name.

Please note that Cresco Labs does not ask for payment or personal banking information as a condition of employment. Any personal information is requested for payroll or state badging purposes only. Applications can be securely submitted through our career’s pages.
We are working diligently to block this from happening. Beware if an offer of employment looks too good to be true. Never divulge personal and banking information or send money if you are unsure of the authenticity of an email or other communication in the name of Cresco Labs.
If you are in doubt, please contact us at Report-a-spam@crescolabs.com with questions.

title: Logistics Coordinator - Inbound
description:
Job title:

Logistics Coordinator - Inbound (Internal Only)

Department:

 Logistics

Terms of employment:

Contract, Full-Time, Salary

Tsering Paldon, Logistics Lead

Apply by:

 12:00 PM EST on Thursday, August 13, 2026

Location:

Hybrid
Etobicoke, ON

Job Posting: Logistics Coordinator - Inbound

Availability: Full-time with an ability to work mornings, afternoons, overnights, holidays, and occasional weekends.

Lush Fresh Handmade Cosmetics supports more than 250 retail stores in Canada and the USA, a mail-order business, and Distribution and Manufacturing centers based in Toronto. Lush is known worldwide for our unique bath and beauty products, amazing skin and hair care, personalized customer service, environmental activism, and a fun & funky store atmosphere. We are dedicated to the practices of fair-trade sourcing and supporting sustainable communities, giving back to organizations that can make a difference through our Community Donations program.

Reporting to the Inbound Lead, this role ensures that inbound, export, and community donations logistical requirements are met while optimizing costs and ensuring service expectations. This role requires a self-driven individual with strong communication and organizational skills who can deliver high-level service through proactive communication.

The ideal candidate will understand business-critical functions and priorities. They will confidently communicate timelines and delivery expectations across inbound, exports, and donation streams. They will drive operational excellence, identify process improvements, and ensure quality, compliance, and value across all National & International activities.

As an Inbound Coordinator, you bring LUSH’s practices into all elements of your work: Be Real, Be Curious, Lead Fearlessly, Adapt and Evolve, Grow Talent, and Live with Purpose.

What you do (responsibilities):

  • Support the execution of inbound national and international logistics operations into North America, ensuring alignment with the direction set by the Inbound Lead
  • Coordinate and track inbound shipments from global suppliers and manufacturing sites into LUSH North America distribution points
  • Work closely with freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers to ensure timely and compliant import and export of goods.
  • Assist in maintaining and executing inbound transportation and export SOPs to ensure shipments meet all regulatory and customs requirements
  • Monitor shipment status, delivery timelines, transport costs, and service performance, escalating issues to the Inbound Lead as required.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including Procurement, Manufacturing, and warehouse teams, to support smooth inbound and export flow and resolve operational challenges
  • Provide regular updates and visibility on inbound shipment status, delays, and risks to stakeholders
  • Support customs clearance processes by ensuring documentation accuracy and compliance with import and export regulations.
  • Assist in identifying cost-saving opportunities such as freight consolidation, routing efficiencies, and carrier utilization improvements.
  • Maintain accurate data records, shipment tracking, and documentation within internal systems
  • Help identify inbound logistics constraints and proactively communicate risks to support contingency planning led by the Inbound Lead.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on efficiency, cost reduction, and service level enhancements.
  • Support carrier performance tracking and contract compliance, flagging discrepancies or issues
  • Provide operational support for projects and initiatives related to inbound international logistics
  • Foster strong working relationships with external partners (freight forwarders, brokers, vendors) and internal teams to ensure alignment and service excellence
  • Take a proactive, solution-oriented approach to problem-solving, escalating complex issues appropriately to the Inbound Lead
  • Ensure timely communication of any disruptions that could impact inventory availability or downstream operations

Who you are (qualifications):

Required:

  • Has held current role for a minimum of 1 year
  • At least 2 years of direct experience working in Logistics, Procurement and/or Distribution at Lush or externally
  • Demonstrated ability to be proactive and resourceful when dealing with issues and challenges
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively and communicate effectively with others at all levels within the organization
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-pressure, and dynamic environment, and the ability to adapt and change
  • Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Self-directed and driven to achieve desired results
  • Service-oriented with keen attention to detail and diligent on follow-up
  • Proficient with MS Office and Google Suite
  • Respect for your working environment and those around you
  • Ability to travel domestically or or International travel as required

Preferred:

  • A minimum of 2 years of direct experience in freight/transportation and procurement
  • Strong understanding of transportation metrics and their role in supporting supply chain objectives
  • Transportation of Dangerous Goods certified
  • Knowledgeable in transportation laws and regulations
  • Experience with all modes of transportation

How to Apply: Submit an application found on the Colleague Center Internal Job Board

Need help? Email monica.pinzon@lush.com

Only select applicants will be considered for this opportunity based on our selection criteria

Remote

title: Claims Examiner, Medical Only

title: Rental Coordinator
description:
Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a Rental Coordinator

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring a Rental Coordinator at our rental facility in Okmulgee, OK, and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM and offers overtime pay after working 40 hours.

Primary Responsibilities

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just renting equipment - we’re transforming the rental experience with our proprietary T3 technology. Our tech platform empowers rental coordinators to work smarter by keeping up-to-date information on every machine and ensuring each customer gets the right equipment at the right time.

  • Respond to inbound leads and guide customers through the EquipmentShare rental process

  • Expand our existing customer base by building relationships with contractors and construction company principals. Educate our customers about the numerous ways EquipmentShare can help save them money, make more money, and operate more efficiently

  • Maintain and nurture existing customer relationships to ensure our customers are 100% satisfied with the level of service and support they are receiving from EquipmentShare. Keep them up-­to­-date about new or additional ways in which EquipmentShare can help improve their business

  • Promptly respond to and resolve customer inquiries, requests, complaints or other communications

  • Develop new sales strategies and techniques to increase our market share and improve our customer experience

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

  • Monthly Family Dinner Night — We treat you and your family to dinner every month, because family comes first. (An employee favorite!) *restrictions apply

  • Competitive compensation

  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

  • Generous PTO + paid holidays

  • 401(k) + company match

  • Tool and boot reimbursements (role dependent)

  • Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

  • Company events, food truck nights, and monthly team dinners

  • 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home

  • Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

  • Access to industry leading diagnostic tools

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

  • See challenges as opportunities

  • Embrace change and continuous improvement

  • Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

Skills & Qualifications

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • You’re a great listener and care about solving your customer’s problems

  • You’re energized by building, nurturing and maintaining relationships with customers throughout every step of the rental process

  • You have strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills

  • You can adapt to the fast pace of a growing company and stay continuously educated on the latest EquipmentShare products and services

Education and Experience:

  • High School diploma or equivalent

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

EquipmentShare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Employment is contingent on passing a background check. Additionally, some roles require passing a drug test, depending on the job responsibilities.

title: Bliv Sterilsupporter i Den Fælles Sterilcentral, Herlev Hospital
description:
Er du på udkig efter et spændende fuldtidsjob med mening? Den Fælles Sterilcentral søger engagerede og ansvarsbevidste sterilsupportere.

Hos os bliver du en vigtig del af et moderne arbejdsmiljø, hvor teknologi, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd. Du bliver en del af en organisation, der hver dag bidrager til sikker behandling af patienter ved at sikre, at kirurgiske instrumenter genbehandles korrekt og er klar til brug.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen med blandede dag- og aftenvagter:

  • Dagvagt: kl. 07.00-15.00
  • Aftenvagt: kl. 15.00-23.00
Hvad går jobbet ud på?
Som sterilsupporter er du en vigtig del af den daglige drift på sterilcentralen. Du understøtter produktionen ved at transportere instrumenter, vogne og udstyr mellem sterilcentralens forskellige områder og hospitalets afdelinger. Du sørger for, at de rette materialer er tilgængelige på det rette tidspunkt, så produktionen kan forløbe effektivt og uden unødige forsinkelser.

Du bliver grundigt oplært i sterilcentralens arbejdsgange, kvalitetskrav og infektionshygiejniske retningslinjer.

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og trives med en fysisk aktiv arbejdsdag.
  • Arbejder struktureret og har et godt overblik.
  • Er serviceminded og sætter en ære i at hjælpe kolleger.
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage initiativ.
  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og en positiv indstilling.
  • Er mødestabil og fleksibel.
Hvorfor vælge os?

  • Du bliver en del af en moderne arbejdsplads med robotstyrede processer og topmoderne faciliteter.
  • Du bliver en del af et stærkt team, hvor samarbejde, kvalitet og fællesskab er i fokus.
  • Du får et meningsfuldt arbejde, hvor du bidrager direkte til patientsikkerheden.
  • Du får en grundig oplæring og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling.
Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • En fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.
  • Blandede dag- og aftenvagter.
  • Et godt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø.
  • En aktiv hverdag med varierede arbejdsopgaver.
  • Grundig oplæring og løbende kompetenceudvikling.
  • Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.
Om Den Fælles Sterilcentral
Den Fælles Sterilcentral er en virksomhed i Region Hovedstaden, hvor vi genbehandler kirurgiske instrumenter ved hjælp af moderne teknologi og højt automatiserede processer. Vi arbejder hver dag for at sikre høj kvalitet og patientsikkerhed og er blandt de mest moderne sterilcentraler i verden.

Ansættelsesvilkår

  • Fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.
  • Arbejdstid: Blandede dag- og aftenvagter (07.00-15.00 og 15.00-23.00).
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelse sker i henhold til nedenstående overenskomst. Startlønnen kan variere afhængigt af din anciennitet, erfaring, uddannelse samt arbejdsstedets geografiske placering.

Overenskomst:
Overenskomst om Løn- og arbejdsforhold for husassistenter m.fl. - 34.01.1

Stilling:
Sterilsupporter

Udover startlønnen kan du have:

  • ret til tillæg efter lokale forhåndsaftaler.
  • ret til særydelser, fx tillæg for aften-, nat- og weekendarbejde.
  • mulighed for at forhandle individuelle tillæg afhængigt af stillingen samt din erfaring og dine kvalifikationer.
Har du spørgsmål?
Ønsker du at høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:
Enhedschef for Produktion og Kvalitetschef: Sani Iqbal
E-mail: sani.iqbal@regionh.dk

Samtaler afholdes løbende.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.
